examples.zh: 这家老店的味道从来都没变过,几十年如一日。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo diàn de wèi dào cóng lái dōu méi biàn guò, jǐ shí nián rú yí rì。
examples.en: This old shop's flavor has never changed in decades.

examples.zh: 她对待每一位客人从来都是笑脸相迎,热情周到。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì dài měi yī wèi kè rén cóng lái dōu shì xiào liǎn xiāng yíng, rè qíng zhōu dào。
examples.en: She always greets every guest with a smile, warm and attentive.

examples.zh: 爷爷从来都是天不亮就起床,几十年从没睡过懒觉。
examples.pinyin: Yé yé cóng lái dōu shì tiān bù liàng jiù qǐ chuáng, jǐ shí nián cóng méi shuì guò lǎn jiào。
examples.en: Grandpa always rises before dawn, never sleeping in for decades.

examples.zh: 在困难面前,他从来都是第一个站出来的人。
examples.pinyin: Zài kùn nán miàn qián, tā cóng lái dōu shì dì yí gè zhàn chū lái de rén。
examples.en: In the face of difficulty, he's always the first to step up.

examples.zh: 我们家从来都是有话直说,从不藏着掖着。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā cóng lái dōu shì yǒu huà zhí shuō, cóng bù cáng zhe yē zhe。
examples.en: In our family we've always spoken frankly, never hiding things.

examples.zh: 他从来都对朋友很讲义气,谁有事都愿意帮一把。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái dōu duì péng yǒu hěn jiǎng yì qì, shuí yǒu shì dōu yuàn yì bāng yī bǎ。
examples.en: He's always loyal to friends, willing to help anyone in need.

examples.zh: 这位老师从来都是耐心地对待每一个学生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī cóng lái dōu shì nài xīn de duì dài měi yí gè xué shēng。
examples.en: This teacher has always treated every student with patience.

examples.zh: 她从来都把家里收拾得干干净净,一尘不染。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái dōu bǎ jiā lǐ shōu shí de gān gān jìng jìng, yī chén bù rǎn。
examples.en: She always keeps the home spotlessly clean.

examples.zh: 面对表扬,他从来都很谦虚,说这是大家的功劳。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì biǎo yáng, tā cóng lái dōu hěn qiān xū, shuō zhè shì dà jiā de gōng láo。
examples.en: At praise, he's always modest, saying it's everyone's credit.

examples.zh: 这些年他从来都没有忘记过帮助过自己的人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē nián tā cóng lái dōu méi yǒu wàng jì guò bāng zhù guò zì jǐ de rén。
examples.en: All these years he's never forgotten those who helped him.

examples.zh: 我对你的心意从来都没变过,以后也不会变。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì nǐ de xīn yì cóng lái dōu méi biàn guò, yǐ hòu yě bú huì biàn。
examples.en: My feelings for you have never changed, and never will.

examples.zh: 他花钱从来都很有分寸,不该花的一分也不花。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā qián cóng lái dōu hěn yǒu fēn cùn, bù gāi huā de yī fēn yě bù huā。
examples.en: He's always measured with money, not spending a cent unnecessarily.

examples.zh: 奶奶做的饭从来都那么香,是我最想念的味道。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi zuò de fàn cóng lái dōu nà me xiāng, shì wǒ zuì xiǎng niàn de wèi dào。
examples.en: Grandma's cooking is always so fragrant; it's the taste I miss most.

examples.zh: 这个团队从来都是团结一心,再难的任务也不怕。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge tuán duì cóng lái dōu shì tuán jié yī xīn, zài nán de rèn wù yě bù pà。
examples.en: This team has always been united; no task is too hard.

examples.zh: 他对工作从来都一丝不苟,难怪领导那么信任他。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōng zuò cóng lái dōu yī sī bù gǒu, nán guài lǐng dǎo nà me xìn rèn tā。
examples.en: He's always meticulous at work; no wonder the boss trusts him.

examples.zh: 不管遇到什么事,她从来都是那么镇定、从容。
examples.pinyin: Bù guǎn yù dào shén me shì, tā cóng lái dōu shì nà me zhèn dìng、 cóng róng。
examples.en: No matter what happens, she's always calm and composed.

examples.zh: 我们之间从来都是坦诚相待,没有一句假话。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī jiān cóng lái dōu shì tǎn chéng xiāng dài, méi yǒu yī jù jiǎ huà。
examples.en: Between us it's always been honesty, not a single lie.

examples.zh: 这条河从来都是这个村子最重要的水源。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé cóng lái dōu shì zhè ge cūn zi zuì zhòng yào de shuǐ yuán。
examples.en: This river has always been the village's most important water source.

examples.zh: 他从来都很守时,约好的时间从不让人等。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng lái dōu hěn shǒu shí, yuē hǎo de shí jiān cóng bù ràng rén děng。
examples.en: He's always punctual, never keeping anyone waiting.

examples.zh: 父母从来都支持我的每一个决定,给了我很大的勇气。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ cóng lái dōu zhī chí wǒ de měi yí gè jué dìng, gěi le wǒ hěn dà de yǒng qì。
examples.en: My parents have always supported my every decision, giving me great courage.

examples.zh: 这么多年,他对读书的热情从来都没有减退过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián, tā duì dú shū de rè qíng cóng lái dōu méi yǒu jiǎn tuì guò。
examples.en: All these years, his passion for reading has never waned.

title: "结果" ile "sonuçta, neticede"
summary: "结果" (jiéguǒ) bir gelişmenin (çoğu zaman beklenmedik) SONUCUNU bağlar: 我等了很久,结果他没来 = Çok bekledim, sonuçta gelmedi.
explanation: "结果" bir olaydan sonra ortaya çıkan SONUCU tanıtır — çoğu zaman beklenenin tersi ya da sürpriz bir sonuç: "sonuçta, neticede, sonunda, meğer". 我准备了半天,结果会议取消了 (Uzun uzun hazırlandım, sonuçta toplantı iptal oldu), 他本来想省钱,结果花得更多了 (Para biriktirecekti, neticede daha çok harcadı). Cümlenin ikinci bölümünün başında, çoğu zaman virgülden sonra gelir ve önceki durumla bağlantılı bir SONUÇ/gelişme bildirir. Sık sık beklentinin boşa çıktığını vurgular. "结果" ayrıca isim olarak "sonuç, netice" anlamına da gelir (考试结果 = sınav sonucu). Türkçedeki "sonuçta, neticede, sonunda, bir de baktım ki" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir olayın nasıl bittiğini anlatmada çok kullanılır.

examples.zh: 我在门口等了他一个多小时,结果他早就走了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài mén kǒu děng le tā yí gè duō xiǎo shí, jié guǒ tā zǎo jiù zǒu le。
examples.en: I waited over an hour at the door; turns out he'd already left.

examples.zh: 本来打算周末去爬山,结果下起了大雨,只好在家待着。
examples.pinyin: Běn lái dǎ suàn zhōu mò qù pá shān, jié guǒ xià qǐ le dà yǔ, zhǐ hǎo zài jiā dài zhe。
examples.en: We planned to hike on the weekend, but it rained hard, so we stayed home.

examples.zh: 他为了省钱自己修车,结果越修越坏,花了更多钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi le shěng qián zì jǐ xiū chē, jié guǒ yuè xiū yuè huài, huā le gèng duō qián。
examples.en: He fixed the car himself to save money, but made it worse and spent more.

examples.zh: 我以为这道题很简单,结果想了半天也没做出来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi zhè dào tí hěn jiǎn dān, jié guǒ xiǎng le bàn tiān yě méi zuò chū lái。
examples.en: I thought this problem was easy, but I pondered for ages and couldn't solve it.

examples.zh: 大家都劝他别去,结果他还是坚持去了。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu quàn tā bié qù, jié guǒ tā hái shì jiān chí qù le。
examples.en: Everyone advised him not to go, but in the end he insisted on going.

examples.zh: 他熬夜复习了一整晚,结果考试还是没通过。
examples.pinyin: Tā áo yè fù xí le yī zhěng wǎn, jié guǒ kǎo shì hái shì méi tōng guò。
examples.en: He stayed up all night reviewing, but still failed the exam.

examples.zh: 我特意早出门,结果路上堵车,还是迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tè yì zǎo chū mén, jié guǒ lù shàng dǔ chē, hái shì chí dào le。
examples.en: I left early on purpose, but traffic jammed and I was still late.

examples.zh: 本以为这次能中奖,结果一个号码都没对上。
examples.pinyin: Běn yǐ wéi zhè cì néng zhòng jiǎng, jié guǒ yí gè hào mǎ dōu méi duì shàng。
examples.en: I thought I'd win this time, but not a single number matched.

examples.zh: 他们吵了一架,结果谁也不肯先低头,冷战了好几天。
examples.pinyin: Tā men chǎo le yī jià, jié guǒ shuí yě bù kěn xiān dī tóu, lěng zhàn le hǎo jǐ tiān。
examples.en: They had a fight; neither would yield first, so they sulked for days.

examples.zh: 我劝他慢点开车,结果他不听,差点出了事故。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ quàn tā màn diǎn kāi chē, jié guǒ tā bù tīng, chà diǎn chū liǎo shì gù。
examples.en: I told him to drive slower; he didn't listen and nearly had an accident.

examples.zh: 原本说好一起去的,结果最后只有我一个人到了。
examples.pinyin: Yuán běn shuō hǎo yì qǐ qù de, jié guǒ zuì hòu zhǐ yǒu wǒ yí gè rén dào le。
examples.en: We agreed to go together, but in the end only I showed up.

examples.zh: 他想给大家一个惊喜,结果反而把大家吓了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gěi dà jiā yí gè jīng xǐ, jié guǒ fǎn ér bǎ dà jiā xià le yī tiào。
examples.en: He wanted to surprise everyone but ended up giving them a fright.

examples.zh: 我把闹钟定得很早,结果一觉睡到了大中午。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ nào zhōng dìng de hěn zǎo, jié guǒ yī jiào shuì dào le dà zhōng wǔ。
examples.en: I set the alarm early, but ended up sleeping until midday.

examples.zh: 这道菜我照着菜谱做,结果味道还是差了很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wǒ zhào zhe cài pǔ zuò, jié guǒ wèi dào hái shì chà le hěn duō。
examples.en: I followed the recipe for this dish, but it still turned out far off.

examples.zh: 他到处打听那本书,结果在自己家里找到了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào chù dǎ tīng nà běn shū, jié guǒ zài zì jǐ jiā lǐ zhǎo dào le。
examples.en: He asked around everywhere for the book, only to find it at home.

examples.zh: 我们满怀希望地去了,结果那家店已经关门了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men mǎn huái xī wàng de qù le, jié guǒ nà jiā diàn yǐ jīng guān mén le。
examples.en: We went full of hope, only to find the shop already closed.

examples.zh: 他答应帮我搬家,结果那天临时有事没来。
examples.pinyin: Tā dā yìng bāng wǒ bān jiā, jié guǒ nà tiān lín shí yǒu shì méi lái。
examples.en: He promised to help me move, but had something come up and didn't show.

examples.zh: 本来只想买一件衣服,结果一口气买了三件。
examples.pinyin: Běn lái zhǐ xiǎng mǎi yī jiàn yī fú, jié guǒ yì kǒu qì mǎi le sān jiàn。
examples.en: I meant to buy just one outfit, but ended up buying three.

examples.zh: 我以为他会生气,结果他不但没生气,还笑了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi tā huì shēng qì, jié guǒ tā bù dàn méi shēng qì, hái xiào le。
examples.en: I thought he'd be angry, but he not only wasn't, he laughed.

examples.zh: 孩子偷偷把花瓶藏起来,结果第二天就被发现了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi tōu tōu bǎ huā píng cáng qǐ lái, jié guǒ dì èr tiān jiù bèi fā xiàn le。
examples.en: The child secretly hid the vase, only to be found out the next day.

examples.zh: 我们绕了一大圈想走近路,结果反而更远了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men rào le yī dà quān xiǎng zǒu jìn lù, jié guǒ fǎn ér gèng yuǎn le。
examples.en: We took a big detour thinking it was a shortcut, but it was farther.

examples.zh: 他信心满满地去面试,结果紧张得说不出话来。
examples.pinyin: Tā xìn xīn mǎn mǎn de qù miàn shì, jié guǒ jǐn zhāng de shuō bù chū huà lái。
examples.en: He went to the interview full of confidence, but was too nervous to speak.

examples.zh: 大家你一言我一语地讨论了半天,结果还是没个定论。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā nǐ yī yán wǒ yī yǔ de tǎo lùn le bàn tiān, jié guǒ hái shì méi gè dìng lùn。
examples.en: Everyone discussed back and forth, but still reached no conclusion.

examples.zh: 我提前订好了餐厅,结果那天他们临时休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tí qián dìng hǎo le cān tīng, jié guǒ nà tiān tā men lín shí xiū xī。
examples.en: I booked the restaurant in advance, but they happened to be closed that day.

examples.zh: 他本想低调处理这件事,结果反而闹得人尽皆知。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn xiǎng dī diào chǔ lǐ zhè jiàn shì, jié guǒ fǎn ér nào de rén jǐn jiē zhī。
examples.en: He wanted to handle it quietly, but it ended up known to all.

title: Bir şeyin ne kadardır YAPILMADIĞI
summary: Bir eylemin ne kadar zamandır YAPILMADIĞINI anlatmak için süre "没"ten önce gelir: 我三天没睡好觉了 = Üç gündür iyi uyuyamıyorum.
explanation: Bir eylemin belli bir SÜREDİR yapılmadığını/gerçekleşmediğini anlatmak için, süre ifadesi "没"ten ÖNCE gelir: Süre + 没 + fiil (+ 了). 我三天没吃饭了 (Üç gündür (doğru dürüst) yemek yemedim), 他一个星期没来上课了 (Bir haftadır derse gelmiyor), 我们好久没见了 (Uzun zamandır görüşmedik). Bu, olumlu "süre" yapısının (Fiil + 了 + süre, bkz. ayrı konu) OLUMSUZ karşılığıdır — olumluda süre fiilden SONRA, olumsuzda "没"ten ÖNCE gelir. Cümle sonundaki "了" durumun HÂLÂ sürdüğünü (hâlâ yapılmıyor) belirtir. Türkçedeki "...-dır ...-madı / ...-alı ... oldu" yapısına denk gelir; bir aksamayı, özlemi ya da alışkanlığın kesilmesini anlatmada çok kullanılır.

examples.zh: 我们好久没见了,你最近过得怎么样?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn le, nǐ zuì jìn guò de zěn me yàng?
examples.en: We haven't seen each other in a long time; how have you been?

examples.zh: 他病了,已经三天没来上班了,大家都很担心。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìng le, yǐ jīng sān tiān méi lái shàng bān le, dà jiā dōu hěn dān xīn。
examples.en: He's ill and hasn't come to work for three days; everyone's worried.

examples.zh: 我都一个星期没好好睡觉了,累得眼睛都睁不开。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dōu yí gè xīng qī méi hǎo hǎo shuì jiào le, lèi de yǎn jīng dōu zhēng bù kāi。
examples.en: I haven't slept well in a week; I'm so tired I can barely keep my eyes open.

examples.zh: 这么多年没回老家了,不知道那里变成什么样了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián méi huí lǎo jiā le, bù zhī dào nà lǐ biàn chéng shén me yàng le。
examples.en: I haven't been home in so many years; I wonder how it's changed.

examples.zh: 他俩闹别扭,已经好几天没说话了。
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎ nào biè niǔ, yǐ jīng hǎo jǐ tiān méi shuō huà le。
examples.en: The two of them fell out and haven't spoken for several days.

examples.zh: 我好久没运动了,今天爬两层楼就累得直喘气。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo jiǔ méi yùn dòng le, jīn tiān pá liǎng céng lóu jiù lèi de zhí chuǎn qì。
examples.en: I haven't exercised in ages; two flights of stairs left me panting today.

examples.zh: 这台旧钢琴很久没弹了,琴键上落了一层灰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù gāng qín hěn jiǔ méi dàn le, qín jiàn shàng là le yī céng huī。
examples.en: This old piano hasn't been played in ages; dust has settled on the keys.

examples.zh: 孩子出国以后,我们已经半年没见到他了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi chū guó yǐ hòu, wǒ men yǐ jīng bàn nián méi jiàn dào tā le。
examples.en: Since the child went abroad, we haven't seen him for half a year.

examples.zh: 我好几个月没读书了,一拿起书就觉得亲切。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo jǐ gè yuè méi dú shū le, yī ná qǐ shū jiù jué de qīn qiè。
examples.en: I hadn't read a book in months; picking one up feels dear.

examples.zh: 这条路好久没修了,坑坑洼洼的,很不好走。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hǎo jiǔ méi xiū le, kēng kēng wā wā de, hěn bù hǎo zǒu。
examples.en: This road hasn't been repaired in a long time; it's full of potholes.

examples.zh: 他戒烟以后,已经两年没碰过一根烟了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiè yān yǐ hòu, yǐ jīng liǎng nián méi pèng guò yī gēn yān le。
examples.en: Since quitting, he hasn't touched a single cigarette in two years.

examples.zh: 我们家的那只猫,两天没吃东西了,是不是病了?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā de nà zhǐ māo, liǎng tiān méi chī dōng xī le, shì bú shì bìng le?
examples.en: Our cat hasn't eaten in two days; could it be sick?

examples.zh: 我都一个多月没给爸妈打电话了,真是太不应该了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dōu yí gè duō yuè méi gěi bà mā dǎ diàn huà le, zhēn shì tài bù yīng gāi le。
examples.en: I haven't called my parents in over a month; that's really wrong of me.

examples.zh: 这么久没联系,他一定以为我把他忘了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me jiǔ méi lián xì, tā yí dìng yǐ wéi wǒ bǎ tā wàng le。
examples.en: After being out of touch so long, he must think I forgot him.

examples.zh: 我好长时间没吃到家乡菜了,做梦都想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo zhǎng shí jiān méi chī dào jiā xiāng cài le, zuò mèng dōu xiǎng。
examples.en: I haven't had hometown food in a long time; I dream about it.

examples.zh: 下了这么多天雨,我们都好几天没出门了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le zhè me duō tiān yǔ, wǒ men dōu hǎo jǐ tiān méi chū mén le。
examples.en: After so many days of rain, we haven't been out in days.

examples.zh: 这本书买回来半年了,我一直没时间看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū mǎi huí lái bàn nián le, wǒ yì zhí méi shí jiān kàn。
examples.en: I bought this book half a year ago and never had time to read it.

examples.zh: 他们分开以后,再也没见过面,一晃十年了。
examples.pinyin: Tā men fēn kāi yǐ hòu, zài yě méi jiàn guò miàn, yī huǎng shí nián le。
examples.en: After they parted, they never met again; ten years have slipped by.

examples.zh: 我好久没这么开心地大笑了,今天真是太痛快了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo jiǔ méi zhè me kāi xīn de dà xiào le, jīn tiān zhēn shì tài tòng kuài le。
examples.en: I haven't laughed so heartily in ages; today was truly delightful.

examples.zh: 这台机器很久没用了,得先检查一下能不能开机。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jī qì hěn jiǔ méi yòng le, de xiān jiǎn chá yī xià néng bù néng kāi jī。
examples.en: This machine hasn't been used in a while; check if it still starts.

examples.zh: 我们全家已经好几年没一起旅行了,今年一定要去。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men quán jiā yǐ jīng hǎo jǐ nián méi yì qǐ lǚ xíng le, jīn nián yí dìng yào qù。
examples.en: Our family hasn't traveled together in years; this year we must go.

examples.zh: 他忙得连着一个月没休息了,身体快撑不住了。
examples.pinyin: Tā máng de lián zhe yí gè yuè méi xiū xī le, shēn tǐ kuài chēng bú zhù le。
examples.en: He's been busy without a break for a month; his body can barely take it.

examples.zh: 这片田地荒了好几年没种了,长满了野草。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn tián dì huāng le hǎo jǐ nián méi zhǒng le, zhǎng mǎn le yě cǎo。
examples.en: This field has lain fallow for years, overgrown with weeds.

examples.zh: 自从搬了家,我们就再也没吃过那家的面条了。
examples.pinyin: Zì cóng bān le jiā, wǒ men jiù zài yě méi chī guò nà jiā de miàn tiáo le。
examples.en: Since we moved, we haven't eaten that shop's noodles again.

examples.zh: 好几天没下雨了,地里的庄稼都快旱死了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ tiān méi xià yǔ le, de lǐ de zhuāng jià dōu kuài hàn sǐ le。
examples.en: It hasn't rained in days; the crops in the field are nearly parched.

title: "互相" ile "karşılıklı, birbirine"
summary: "互相" (hùxiāng) bir eylemin KARŞILIKLI yapıldığını gösterir: 互相帮助 = birbirine yardım etmek.
explanation: "互相" bir eylemin iki (ya da daha çok) taraf arasında KARŞILIKLI, iki yönlü yapıldığını bildirir: "birbirine, karşılıklı, birbirini". 我们应该互相帮助 (Birbirimize yardım etmeliyiz), 他们互相尊重 (Birbirlerine saygı duyuyorlar), 邻居之间要互相照顾 (Komşular birbirini kollamalı). Bir zarf olarak fiilin önünde durur ve genelde iki heceli fiillerle kullanılır (互相理解, 互相支持, 互相学习). Öznenin çoğul/iki taraflı olmasını gerektirir. Türkçedeki "birbirine, karşılıklı olarak, karşılıklı" ifadelerine denk gelir. "彼此" (bǐcǐ = birbiri) ile anlamca yakındır; "互相" eylemin karşılıklılığını, "彼此" ise tarafları vurgular. Dostluk, yardımlaşma ve ilişkileri anlatmada çok kullanılır.

examples.zh: 同学之间应该互相帮助,一起进步。
examples.pinyin: Tóng xué zhī jiān yīng gāi hù xiāng bāng zhù, yì qǐ jìn bù。
examples.en: Classmates should help each other and progress together.

examples.zh: 他们俩性格很不一样,却能互相理解、互相包容。
examples.pinyin: Tā men liǎ xìng gé hěn bù yí yàng, què néng hù xiāng lǐ jiě、 hù xiāng bāo róng。
examples.en: The two have very different personalities, yet understand and tolerate each other.

examples.zh: 邻里之间互相照应,遇到困难也不觉得孤单。
examples.pinyin: Lín lǐ zhī jiān hù xiāng zhào yìng, yù dào kùn nán yě bù jué de gū dān。
examples.en: Neighbors look out for one another, so hardships feel less lonely.

examples.zh: 夫妻俩这么多年,一直是互相扶持走过来的。
examples.pinyin: Fū qī liǎ zhè me duō nián, yì zhí shì hù xiāng fú chí zǒu guò lái de。
examples.en: The couple has supported each other through all these years.

examples.zh: 我们虽然是竞争对手,但也常常互相学习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men suī rán shì jìng zhēng duì shǒu, dàn yě cháng cháng hù xiāng xué xí。
examples.en: Though we're competitors, we often learn from each other.

examples.zh: 一个好的团队,成员之间要互相信任、互相配合。
examples.pinyin: Yí gè hǎo de tuán duì, chéng yuán zhī jiān yào hù xiāng xìn rèn、 hù xiāng pèi hé。
examples.en: In a good team, members must trust and cooperate with one another.

examples.zh: 他们从小一起长大,互相了解得不能再了解了。
examples.pinyin: Tā men cóng xiǎo yì qǐ zhǎng dà, hù xiāng liǎo jiě de bù néng zài liǎo jiě le。
examples.en: They grew up together and couldn't understand each other more.

examples.zh: 遇到分歧的时候,双方要互相体谅,别急着争输赢。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào fēn qí de shí hòu, shuāng fāng yào hù xiāng tǐ liàng, bié jí zhe zhēng shū yíng。
examples.en: When disagreements arise, both sides should be considerate, not rush to win.

examples.zh: 这两个国家的人民一直互相往来,关系很密切。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè guó jiā de rén mín yì zhí hù xiāng wǎng lái, guān xì hěn mì qiè。
examples.en: The peoples of these two countries have long interacted closely.

examples.zh: 我们约好了以后要经常互相联系,别断了消息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yuē hǎo le yǐ hòu yào jīng cháng hù xiāng lián xì, bié duàn le xiāo xī。
examples.en: We agreed to keep in touch often and not lose contact.

examples.zh: 兄弟姐妹之间就该互相谦让,不能太计较。
examples.pinyin: Xiōng dì jiě mèi zhī jiān jiù gāi hù xiāng qiān ràng, bù néng tài jì jiào。
examples.en: Siblings should yield to one another and not be too calculating.

examples.zh: 他们在工作中互相帮助,渐渐成了很好的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā men zài gōng zuò zhōng hù xiāng bāng zhù, jiàn jiàn chéng le hěn hǎo de péng yǒu。
examples.en: They helped each other at work and gradually became good friends.

examples.zh: 两个班的同学互相交流学习经验,收获都很大。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng gè bān de tóng xué hù xiāng jiāo liú xué xí jīng yàn, shōu huò dōu hěn dà。
examples.en: Students from both classes exchanged study experiences and gained a lot.

examples.zh: 生活中难免有摩擦,重要的是能互相原谅。
examples.pinyin: Shēng huó zhōng nán miǎn yǒu mó cā, zhòng yào de shì néng hù xiāng yuán liàng。
examples.en: Friction in life is inevitable; what matters is forgiving each other.

examples.zh: 他们虽然分隔两地,却一直互相牵挂着对方。
examples.pinyin: Tā men suī rán fēn gé liǎng de, què yì zhí hù xiāng qiān guà zhe duì fāng。
examples.en: Though far apart, they've always cared for one another.

examples.zh: 好朋友之间不需要客气,可以互相开开玩笑。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo péng yǒu zhī jiān bù xū yào kè qì, kě yǐ hù xiāng kāi kāi wán xiào。
examples.en: Good friends need no formality and can joke with each other.

examples.zh: 这次活动让新老员工有机会互相认识、互相熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huó dòng ràng xīn lǎo yuán gōng yǒu jī huì hù xiāng rèn shí、 hù xiāng shú xī。
examples.en: This event let new and old staff get to know one another.

examples.zh: 面对灾难,人们互相鼓励、互相支持,共渡难关。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì zāi nàn, rén men hù xiāng gǔ lì、 hù xiāng zhī chí, gòng dù nán guān。
examples.en: Facing disaster, people encourage and support each other through hardship.

examples.zh: 我们应该互相尊重彼此的想法,而不是强求一致。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi hù xiāng zūn zhòng bǐ cǐ de xiǎng fǎ, ér bú shì qiǎng qiú yí zhì。
examples.en: We should respect each other's ideas rather than force agreement.

examples.zh: 两支球队赛后互相握手,展现了良好的风度。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng zhī qiú duì sài hòu hù xiāng wò shǒu, zhǎn xiàn le liáng hǎo de fēng dù。
examples.en: The two teams shook hands after the match, showing good sportsmanship.

examples.zh: 多年的老同事,大家早已习惯了互相照顾。
examples.pinyin: Duō nián de lǎo tóng shì, dà jiā zǎo yǐ xí guàn le hù xiāng zhào gù。
examples.en: Longtime colleagues have long been used to caring for each other.

examples.zh: 恋人之间除了相爱,更要学会互相包容。
examples.pinyin: Liàn rén zhī jiān chú le xiāng ài, gèng yào xué huì hù xiāng bāo róng。
examples.en: Beyond love, couples must learn to tolerate each other.

examples.zh: 这几个小国经常互相合作,共同发展经济。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ gè xiǎo guó jīng cháng hù xiāng hé zuò, gòng tóng fā zhǎn jīng jì。
examples.en: These small countries often cooperate to develop their economies.

examples.zh: 我们一家人有事就商量,从来都是互相支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yī jiā rén yǒu shì jiù shāng liáng, cóng lái dōu shì hù xiāng zhī chí。
examples.en: Our family discusses everything and has always supported one another.

examples.zh: 在困难时期,正是大家的互相帮助让人倍感温暖。
examples.pinyin: Zài kùn nán shí qī, zhèng shì dà jiā de hù xiāng bāng zhù ràng rén bèi gǎn wēn nuǎn。
examples.en: In hard times, it's mutual help that makes people feel warmth.

title: "就" ile erkenlik/çabukluk
pattern: Özne + Zaman + 就 + Fiil + 了
summary: "就" bir eylemin BEKLENENDEN ERKEN/çabuk olduğunu vurgular: 他五点就起床了 = O daha saat beşte kalktı (erkenden).
explanation: "就" bir zaman ifadesinin ardından gelip eylemin BEKLENENDEN ERKEN, çabuk ya da hemen gerçekleştiğini vurgular: 他六点就来了 (Daha saat altıda geldi — erkenden), 我说一遍他就懂了 (Bir kez söyledim, hemen anladı). Cümle çoğu zaman "了" ile biter. Karşıtı "才"dır: "就" "erken/çabuk", "才" "geç/ancak" bildirir — 他六点就来了 (erken geldi) vs 他九点才来 (ancak dokuzda geldi). "就" ayrıca iki olayın hemen ardışıklığını da gösterir: 一...就... (...-ır ...-maz). Bu konuda özellikle ERKENLİK/çabukluk vurgusunu ele alıyoruz. Türkçedeki "daha ... -de, ...-er ...-mez, hemen, çoktan" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir şeyin ne kadar erken olduğunu belirtir.

examples.zh: 他每天早上五点就起床,然后去公园锻炼。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo shàng wǔ diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng, rán hòu qù gōng yuán duàn liàn。
examples.en: He gets up at five every morning and then exercises in the park.

examples.zh: 这么简单的道理,孩子一听就明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me jiǎn dān de dào lǐ, hái zi yī tīng jiù míng bái le。
examples.en: Such a simple idea — the child understood it as soon as he heard it.

examples.zh: 我们还没准备好,客人七点就到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men hái méi zhǔn bèi hǎo, kè rén qī diǎn jiù dào le。
examples.en: We weren't ready yet, but the guests arrived as early as seven.

examples.zh: 他很小的时候就展现出了画画的天分。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎo de shí hòu jiù zhǎn xiàn chū le huà huà de tiān fèn。
examples.en: He showed a talent for painting from a very young age.

examples.zh: 天还没亮,渔民们就出海了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hái méi liàng, yú mín men jiù chū hǎi le。
examples.en: Before dawn even broke, the fishermen had already set out to sea.

examples.zh: 这本书我昨天一拿到就一口气读完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ zuó tiān yī ná dào jiù yì kǒu qì dú wán le。
examples.en: I got this book yesterday and finished it in one sitting right away.

examples.zh: 你放心,东西我早就给你准备好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, dōng xī wǒ zǎo jiù gěi nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo le。
examples.en: Rest assured; I prepared the things for you long ago.

examples.zh: 会议才开始十分钟,他就把问题解决了。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì cái kāi shǐ shí fēn zhōng, tā jiù bǎ wèn tí jiě jué le。
examples.en: Only ten minutes into the meeting, he had already solved the problem.

examples.zh: 春节还没到,他半个月前就买好了回家的车票。
examples.pinyin: Chūn jié hái méi dào, tā bàn gè yuè qián jiù mǎi hǎo le huí jiā de chē piào。
examples.en: The Spring Festival hadn't come, yet he'd bought his ticket home half a month early.

examples.zh: 刚上小学的时候,他就立志要当科学家。
examples.pinyin: Gāng shàng xiǎo xué de shí hòu, tā jiù lì zhì yào dāng kē xué jiā。
examples.en: When he'd just started primary school, he already aspired to be a scientist.

examples.zh: 我一进门就闻到了饭菜的香味,原来妈妈早做好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yī jìn mén jiù wén dào le fàn cài de xiāng wèi, yuán lái mā mā zǎo zuò hǎo le。
examples.en: The moment I entered I smelled the food; mom had cooked it already.

examples.zh: 这件事他很早就知道了,只是一直没说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tā hěn zǎo jiù zhī dào le, zhǐ shì yì zhí méi shuō。
examples.en: He knew about this very early on, but just never mentioned it.

examples.zh: 闹钟还没响,他六点不到就醒了。
examples.pinyin: Nào zhōng hái méi xiǎng, tā liù diǎn bú dào jiù xǐng le。
examples.en: Before the alarm rang, he woke before six.

examples.zh: 这些孩子三岁就会自己穿衣服、吃饭了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē hái zi sān suì jiù huì zì jǐ chuān yī fú、 chī fàn le。
examples.en: These children could dress and feed themselves at three.

examples.zh: 你来得正好,我刚泡好茶你就到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhèng hǎo, wǒ gāng pào hǎo chá nǐ jiù dào le。
examples.en: You came at just the right time; I'd just made tea when you arrived.

examples.zh: 他学东西特别快,别人还没开始,他就学会了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué dōng xī tè bié kuài, bié rén hái méi kāi shǐ, tā jiù xué huì le。
examples.en: He learns fast; before others even start, he's already mastered it.

examples.zh: 那家店生意好,常常还没到中午菜就卖光了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn shēng yì hǎo, cháng cháng hái méi dào zhōng wǔ cài jiù mài guāng le。
examples.en: That shop does good business; often the dishes sell out before noon.

examples.zh: 我们计划下午出发,可他一大早就把行李收拾好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jì huà xià wǔ chū fā, kě tā yī dà zǎo jiù bǎ xíng lǐ shōu shí hǎo le。
examples.en: We planned to leave in the afternoon, but he packed early in the morning.

examples.zh: 这个消息一传出去,不到一个小时全公司就都知道了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāo xī yī chuán chū qù, bú dào yí gè xiǎo shí quán gōng sī jiù dōu zhī dào le。
examples.en: Once the news got out, the whole company knew within an hour.

examples.zh: 他刚坐下没多久,饭菜就端上来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng zuò xià méi duō jiǔ, fàn cài jiù duān shàng lái le。
examples.en: Not long after he sat down, the food was served.

examples.zh: 下课铃一响,同学们就飞快地跑出了教室。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè líng yī xiǎng, tóng xué men jiù fēi kuài de pǎo chū le jiào shì。
examples.en: The moment the bell rang, the students dashed out of the classroom.

examples.zh: 我提醒了他一句,他马上就想起来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tí xǐng le tā yī jù, tā mǎ shàng jiù xiǎng qǐ lái le。
examples.en: I gave him a hint, and he remembered right away.

examples.zh: 这场雨来得急,刚才还是晴天,一会儿就下起来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǔ lái de jí, gāng cái hái shì qíng tiān, yī huì er jiù xià qǐ lái le。
examples.en: This rain came fast; it was clear just now and started in no time.

examples.zh: 他年纪轻轻就当上了这家公司的经理。
examples.pinyin: Tā nián jì qīng qīng jiù dāng shàng le zhè jiā gōng sī de jīng lǐ。
examples.en: At a young age he already became the manager of this company.

examples.zh: 我们约的是八点,他七点半就在门口等着了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yuē de shì bā diǎn, tā qī diǎn bàn jiù zài mén kǒu děng zhe le。
examples.en: We agreed on eight, but he was waiting at the door by seven-thirty.

title: "够" ile "yeterli, yetmek"
summary: "够" (gòu) bir şeyin YETERLİ olduğunu bildirir: 钱够了 = Para yetti; 时间不够 = Zaman yetmiyor.
explanation: "够" bir miktarın, sürenin ya da derecenin YETERLİ olduğunu belirtir: 钱够了 (Para yeterli), 这些菜够我们吃了 (Bu yemekler bize yeter), 时间不够 (Zaman yetmiyor). Bir isimden önce "够 + isim" = "yeterince ...": 够时间 (yeterli zaman), 够钱 (yeterli para). Bir sıfattan önce "够 + sıfat" = "yeterince ...": 够大 (yeterince büyük), 够高 (yeterince uzun). Olumsuzu "不够" (yetmez, yeterli değil). Konuşma dilinde "够了" tek başına "yeter! bu kadar yeter" anlamına da gelir. "够呛" gibi deyimsel kullanımları da vardır (bir hayli zor). Türkçedeki "yeter, yeterli, yetmek, yeterince" karşılıklarına denk gelir; bir şeyin gereksinimi karşılayıp karşılamadığını anlatır.

examples.zh: 这些钱够我们买两张票了,不用再取了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē qián gòu wǒ men mǎi liǎng zhāng piào le, bù yòng zài qǔ le。
examples.en: This money is enough for two tickets; no need to withdraw more.

examples.zh: 时间不够了,咱们打车去吧,不然要迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān bù gòu le, zán men dǎ chē qù ba, bù rán yào chí dào le。
examples.en: There's not enough time; let's take a taxi, or we'll be late.

examples.zh: 我做了这么多菜,应该够大家吃了吧?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuò le zhè me duō cài, yīng gāi gòu dà jiā chī le ba?
examples.en: I made so many dishes; that should be enough for everyone, right?

examples.zh: 这个房间不够大,放不下这么多家具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fáng jiān bù gòu dà, fàng bù xià zhè me duō jiā jù。
examples.en: This room isn't big enough to fit so much furniture.

examples.zh: 你准备的材料够充分,面试肯定没问题。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhǔn bèi de cái liào gòu chōng fèn, miàn shì kěn dìng méi wèn tí。
examples.en: Your prepared materials are thorough enough; the interview will be fine.

examples.zh: 忙了一整天,他累得够呛,一回家就睡了。
examples.pinyin: Máng le yī zhěng tiān, tā lèi de gòu qiàng, yī huí jiā jiù shuì le。
examples.en: After a busy day he was thoroughly worn out and slept as soon as he got home.

examples.zh: 这点儿水不够浇这么多花,你再接一桶吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn ér shuǐ bù gòu jiāo zhè me duō huā, nǐ zài jiē yī tǒng ba。
examples.en: This water isn't enough for so many flowers; go get another bucket.

examples.zh: 行了行了,够了,别再给我夹菜了,我吃饱了。
examples.pinyin: Xíng le xíng le, gòu le, bié zài gěi wǒ jiā cài le, wǒ chī bǎo le。
examples.en: That's enough, stop putting food on my plate; I'm full.

examples.zh: 他个子够高,打篮球特别有优势。
examples.pinyin: Tā gè zi gòu gāo, dǎ lán qiú tè bié yǒu yōu shì。
examples.en: He's tall enough; it's a real advantage in basketball.

examples.zh: 你别担心钱的事,我带的钱够花了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié dān xīn qián de shì, wǒ dài de qián gòu huā le。
examples.en: Don't worry about money; I brought enough to spend.

examples.zh: 这条绳子不够长,够不到对面的树。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shéng zi bù gòu zhǎng, gòu bú dào duì miàn de shù。
examples.en: This rope isn't long enough; it won't reach the tree across.

examples.zh: 我们的准备时间够充裕,不用那么着急。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men de zhǔn bèi shí jiān gòu chōng yù, bù yòng nà me zhe jí。
examples.en: We have plenty of preparation time; no need to rush.

examples.zh: 这么点儿米不够一家人吃一顿的,得再买点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me diǎn er mǐ bù gòu yī jiā rén chī yī dùn de, de zài mǎi diǎn。
examples.en: This little rice isn't enough for the family's meal; buy some more.

examples.zh: 他的能力足够胜任这份工作,大家都很放心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de néng lì zú gòu shèng rèn zhè fèn gōng zuò, dà jiā dōu hěn fàng xīn。
examples.en: His ability is more than enough for this job; everyone's at ease.

examples.zh: 天气够冷的,你就穿这么点儿,不冻坏才怪。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì gòu lěng de, nǐ jiù chuān zhè me diǎn er, bù dòng huài cái guài。
examples.en: It's cold enough; dressed so lightly, you'll surely freeze.

examples.zh: 这些作业够他忙一晚上的了,别再给他加了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zuò yè gòu tā máng yī wǎn shàng de le, bié zài gěi tā jiā le。
examples.en: This homework is enough to keep him busy all night; don't add more.

examples.zh: 桌子上的位子不够坐,得再搬两把椅子来。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng de wèi zi bù gòu zuò, de zài bān liǎng bǎ yǐ zi lái。
examples.en: There aren't enough seats at the table; bring two more chairs.

examples.zh: 你受的苦已经够多了,以后该为自己好好活。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shòu de kǔ yǐ jīng gòu duō le, yǐ hòu gāi wèi zì jǐ hǎo hǎo huó。
examples.en: You've endured enough hardship; live well for yourself from now on.

examples.zh: 这块布够做一件衣服吗?好像有点儿短。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài bù gòu zuò yī jiàn yī fú ma? hǎo xiàng yǒu diǎn ér duǎn。
examples.en: Is this cloth enough for a garment? It seems a bit short.

examples.zh: 光靠热情是不够的,还得有真本事。
examples.pinyin: Guāng kào rè qíng shì bù gòu de, hái de yǒu zhēn běn shì。
examples.en: Enthusiasm alone isn't enough; you also need real skill.

examples.zh: 时间够的话,我想顺便去看看老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān gòu de huà, wǒ xiǎng shùn biàn qù kàn kàn lǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: If there's enough time, I'd like to visit an old friend too.

examples.zh: 这台空调够大了,足够整个客厅用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái kōng tiáo gòu dà le, zú gòu zhěng gè kè tīng yòng。
examples.en: This air conditioner is big enough for the whole living room.

examples.zh: 你别客气,菜够多了,再点就吃不完了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié kè qì, cài gòu duō le, zài diǎn jiù chī bù wán le。
examples.en: Don't be shy; there's enough food, more and we can't finish.

examples.zh: 经过这些年的磨炼,他已经足够成熟稳重了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhè xiē nián de mó liàn, tā yǐ jīng zú gòu chéng shú wěn zhòng le。
examples.en: After years of tempering, he's mature and steady enough.

examples.zh: 光有钱是不够的,健康和家人的陪伴同样重要。
examples.pinyin: Guāng yǒu qián shì bù gòu de, jiàn kāng hé jiā rén de péi bàn tóng yàng zhòng yào。
examples.en: Money alone isn't enough; health and family matter just as much.

title: "终于" ile "sonunda, nihayet"
summary: "终于" (zhōngyú) uzun bir bekleyiş/çabadan sonra beklenen sonucun GELDİĞİNİ bildirir: 他终于来了 = Sonunda geldi.
explanation: "终于" uzun bir süre, çaba ya da bekleyişin ARDINDAN, beklenen (genelde OLUMLU) bir sonucun nihayet gerçekleştiğini bildirir: "sonunda, nihayet, en sonunda". 等了这么久,他终于来了 (Bunca bekleyişten sonra sonunda geldi), 经过多年努力,她终于实现了梦想 (Yıllarca uğraştıktan sonra sonunda hayalini gerçekleştirdi). Yüklemden önce gelir ve cümle çoğu zaman "了" ile biter (yeni durumu vurgular). Bir sürecin sonucunu bildirdiği için ani/kısa olaylarla değil, beklenen/uğraşılan sonuçlarla kullanılır. Genelde olumlu, rahatlama içeren bir tonu vardır. Türkçedeki "sonunda, nihayet, en sonunda" ifadelerine denk gelir; uzun bir bekleyiş ya da çabanın meyvesini anlatır.

examples.zh: 经过三年的努力,他终于考上了理想的大学。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò sān nián de nǔ lì, tā zhōng yú kǎo shàng le lǐ xiǎng de dà xué。
examples.en: After three years of effort, he finally got into his dream university.

examples.zh: 等了整整一个下午,我们终于等到了那趟迟来的火车。
examples.pinyin: Děng le zhěng zhěng yí gè xià wǔ, wǒ men zhōng yú děng dào le nà tàng chí lái de huǒ chē。
examples.en: After waiting all afternoon, we finally caught the long-delayed train.

examples.zh: 试了很多次以后,他终于把这道难题解开了。
examples.pinyin: Shì le hěn duō cì yǐ hòu, tā zhōng yú bǎ zhè dào nán tí jiě kāi le。
examples.en: After many attempts, he finally cracked this tough problem.

examples.zh: 忙了大半年,这个项目终于顺利完成了。
examples.pinyin: Máng le dà bàn nián, zhè ge xiàng mù zhōng yú shùn lì wán chéng le。
examples.en: After half a year of work, the project was finally completed smoothly.

examples.zh: 下了好几天的雨,今天终于放晴了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de yǔ, jīn tiān zhōng yú fàng qíng le。
examples.en: After days of rain, today it finally cleared up.

examples.zh: 找了半天,我终于在旧箱子里找到了那张照片。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎo le bàn tiān, wǒ zhōng yú zài jiù xiāng zi lǐ zhǎo dào le nà zhāng zhào piān。
examples.en: After searching a long while, I finally found that photo in the old box.

examples.zh: 经过医生的精心治疗,他的病终于好了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī shēng de jīng xīn zhì liáo, tā de bìng zhōng yú hǎo le。
examples.en: After the doctor's careful treatment, he finally recovered.

examples.zh: 说了这么多年,他们终于决定去看看外面的世界。
examples.pinyin: Shuō le zhè me duō nián, tā men zhōng yú jué dìng qù kàn kàn wài miàn de shì jiè。
examples.en: After talking about it for years, they finally decided to see the world.

examples.zh: 排了两个小时的队,我们终于买到了票。
examples.pinyin: Pái le liǎng gè xiǎo shí de duì, wǒ men zhōng yú mǎi dào le piào。
examples.en: After queuing for two hours, we finally got the tickets.

examples.zh: 经历了无数次失败,这次试验终于成功了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng lì liǎo wú shù cì shī bài, zhè cì shì yàn zhōng yú chéng gōng le。
examples.en: After countless failures, this experiment finally succeeded.

examples.zh: 盼了好久,女儿终于放假回家了。
examples.pinyin: Pàn le hǎo jiǔ, nǚ ér zhōng yú fàng jià huí jiā le。
examples.en: After a long wait, the daughter finally came home for the holiday.

examples.zh: 忙碌了一整天,他终于可以坐下来好好吃顿饭了。
examples.pinyin: Máng lù le yī zhěng tiān, tā zhōng yú kě yǐ zuò xià lái hǎo hǎo chī dùn fàn le。
examples.en: After a busy day, he could finally sit down for a proper meal.

examples.zh: 经过反复修改,这篇文章终于让他满意了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò fǎn fù xiū gǎi, zhè piān wén zhāng zhōng yú ràng tā mǎn yì le。
examples.en: After repeated revisions, he was finally satisfied with the article.

examples.zh: 走了很远的山路,我们终于看到了山顶的日出。
examples.pinyin: Zǒu le hěn yuǎn de shān lù, wǒ men zhōng yú kàn dào le shān dǐng de rì chū。
examples.en: After a long mountain trek, we finally saw the sunrise from the peak.

examples.zh: 努力存了好几年,他终于买下了属于自己的房子。
examples.pinyin: Nǔ lì cún le hǎo jǐ nián, tā zhōng yú mǎi xià le shǔ yú zì jǐ de fáng zi。
examples.en: After saving for years, he finally bought a home of his own.

examples.zh: 经过大家的共同努力,这个难关终于闯过去了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò dà jiā de gòng tóng nǔ lì, zhè ge nán guān zhōng yú chuǎng guò qù le。
examples.en: Through everyone's joint effort, this hurdle was finally overcome.

examples.zh: 解释了半天,他终于明白了我的一片好心。
examples.pinyin: Jiě shì le bàn tiān, tā zhōng yú míng bái le wǒ de yī piàn hǎo xīn。
examples.en: After much explaining, he finally understood my good intentions.

examples.zh: 盼星星盼月亮,他们终于盼来了盼望已久的好消息。
examples.pinyin: Pàn xīng xīng pàn yuè liàng, tā men zhōng yú pàn lái le pàn wàng yǐ jiǔ de hǎo xiāo xī。
examples.en: Longing day and night, they finally received the long-awaited good news.

examples.zh: 学了三年汉语,我终于能看懂中文小说了。
examples.pinyin: Xué le sān nián hàn yǔ, wǒ zhōng yú néng kàn dǒng zhōng wén xiǎo shuō le。
examples.en: After three years of Chinese, I can finally read Chinese novels.

examples.zh: 经过长时间的沟通,双方终于达成了一致。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhǎng shí jiān de gōu tōng, shuāng fāng zhōng yú dá chéng le yí zhì。
examples.en: After lengthy communication, both sides finally reached agreement.

examples.zh: 在大家的鼓励下,他终于鼓起勇气站上了舞台。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà jiā de gǔ lì xià, tā zhōng yú gǔ qǐ yǒng qì zhàn shàng le wǔ tái。
examples.en: With everyone's encouragement, he finally worked up the courage to go on stage.

examples.zh: 修了整整一个星期,那条路终于通车了。
examples.pinyin: Xiū le zhěng zhěng yí gè xīng qī, nà tiáo lù zhōng yú tōng chē le。
examples.en: After a full week of repairs, that road finally opened to traffic.

examples.zh: 找工作找了好几个月,他终于收到了录用通知。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎo gōng zuò zhǎo le hǎo jǐ gè yuè, tā zhōng yú shōu dào le lù yòng tōng zhī。
examples.en: After months of job-hunting, he finally received an offer.

examples.zh: 经过多年的分离,两位老朋友终于又见面了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò duō nián de fēn lí, liǎng wèi lǎo péng yǒu zhōng yú yòu jiàn miàn le。
examples.en: After years apart, the two old friends finally met again.

examples.zh: 熬过了最艰难的日子,他们的生活终于好起来了。
examples.pinyin: Áo guò le zuì jiān nán de rì zi, tā men de shēng huó zhōng yú hǎo qǐ lái le。
examples.en: Having survived the hardest days, their life finally took a turn for the better.

title: "还是" ile "...-sen daha iyi"
summary: "还是" (háishì) düşünüp taşınıp bir seçeneği tercih etmeyi bildirir: "yine de, en iyisi ...": 你还是早点回去吧 = En iyisi erken dön.
explanation: "还是" bu kullanımda, çeşitli seçenekleri tartıp sonunda BİRİNİ tercih etmeyi/tavsiye etmeyi bildirir: "yine de, en iyisi, ...-sen daha iyi". 天太晚了,你还是别去了 (Çok geç oldu, en iyisi gitme), 我们还是坐地铁吧,又快又便宜 (En iyisi metroya binelim, hem hızlı hem ucuz). Cümle çoğu zaman "吧" ile biter ve yumuşak bir öneri/karar tonu taşır. Bir değerlendirme sonucu "düşününce en makul olan bu" fikrini verir. ("还是"nın soru cümlelerinde "...mı yoksa ...mı" seçenek sorma anlamı ayrıdır.) Türkçedeki "yine de, en iyisi, bence ...-sen daha iyi" ifadelerine denk gelir; kararsızlıktan sonra varılan makul seçimi belirtir.

examples.zh: 外面雨这么大,你还是等雨小一点再走吧。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn yǔ zhè me dà, nǐ hái shì děng yǔ xiǎo yì diǎn zài zǒu ba。
examples.en: The rain's heavy; you'd better wait until it eases before going.

examples.zh: 这件事挺复杂的,咱们还是当面谈比较好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì tǐng fù zá de, zán men hái shì dāng miàn tán bǐ jiào hǎo。
examples.en: This is rather complex; we'd better talk in person.

examples.zh: 天太晚了,你一个人回去我不放心,还是我送你吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài wǎn le, nǐ yí gè rén huí qù wǒ bù fàng xīn, hái shì wǒ sòng nǐ ba。
examples.en: It's late; I'm uneasy about you going alone, let me see you back.

examples.zh: 与其在这儿瞎猜,还是直接去问问他本人吧。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ qí zài zhè ér xiā cāi, hái shì zhí jiē qù wèn wèn tā běn rén ba。
examples.en: Rather than guessing here, we'd better just go ask him directly.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅太贵了,咱们还是换一家实惠点的吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng tài guì le, zán men hái shì huàn yī jiā shí huì diǎn de ba。
examples.en: This restaurant is too pricey; let's switch to a more affordable one.

examples.zh: 你身体不舒服,今天还是在家好好休息吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēn tǐ bù shū fú, jīn tiān hái shì zài jiā hǎo hǎo xiū xī ba。
examples.en: You're unwell; you'd better rest well at home today.

examples.zh: 这个决定太重要了,你还是跟家里人商量一下再定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jué dìng tài zhòng yào le, nǐ hái shì gēn jiā lǐ rén shāng liáng yī xià zài dìng。
examples.en: This decision is important; better discuss it with family first.

examples.zh: 坐飞机虽然快,但为了看风景,我们还是坐火车吧。
examples.pinyin: Zuò fēi jī suī rán kuài, dàn wèi le kàn fēng jǐng, wǒ men hái shì zuò huǒ chē ba。
examples.en: Flying is faster, but for the scenery, let's take the train.

examples.zh: 既然大家意见不一致,这件事还是从长计议吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán dà jiā yì jiàn bù yī zhì, zhè jiàn shì hái shì cóng cháng jì yì ba。
examples.en: Since opinions differ, let's take our time deciding this.

examples.zh: 网上的说法不一定可靠,你还是问问医生比较好。
examples.pinyin: Wǎng shàng de shuō fǎ bù yí dìng kě kào, nǐ hái shì wèn wèn yī shēng bǐ jiào hǎo。
examples.en: Online claims aren't always reliable; better ask a doctor.

examples.zh: 这么贵重的东西,你还是自己收好,别让我保管了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me guì zhòng de dōng xī, nǐ hái shì zì jǐ shōu hǎo, bié ràng wǒ bǎo guǎn le。
examples.en: Such a valuable thing — you'd better keep it yourself, not me.

examples.zh: 与其勉强他来,还是让他在家安心休息吧。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ qí miǎn qiǎng tā lái, hái shì ràng tā zài jiā ān xīn xiū xī ba。
examples.en: Rather than force him to come, better let him rest at home.

examples.zh: 路上不太好走,你们还是早点出发比较稳妥。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng bù tài hǎo zǒu, nǐ men hái shì zǎo diǎn chū fā bǐ jiào wěn tuǒ。
examples.en: The road isn't easy; you'd better set off early to be safe.

examples.zh: 这件衣服颜色太亮了,我觉得你还是穿那件深色的好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú yán sè tài liàng le, wǒ jué de nǐ hái shì chuān nà jiàn shēn sè de hǎo。
examples.en: This outfit's too bright; I think you'd better wear the dark one.

examples.zh: 既然拿不准,这笔钱你还是先别投进去了。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán ná bù zhǔn, zhè bǐ qián nǐ hái shì xiān bié tóu jìn qù le。
examples.en: Since you're unsure, you'd better not invest this money yet.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,这些事你还是别让他知道得太早。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hái xiǎo, zhè xiē shì nǐ hái shì bié ràng tā zhī dào de tài zǎo。
examples.en: The child is young; better not let him know these things too soon.

examples.zh: 与其自己在这里发愁,还是找朋友聊聊心里好受些。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ qí zì jǐ zài zhè lǐ fā chóu, hái shì zhǎo péng yǒu liáo liáo xīn lǐ hǎo shòu xiē。
examples.en: Rather than fretting alone, better talk to a friend to feel better.

examples.zh: 这道题我实在做不出来,还是等老师来讲吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí wǒ shí zài zuò bù chū lái, hái shì děng lǎo shī lái jiǎng ba。
examples.en: I really can't do this problem; better wait for the teacher to explain.

examples.zh: 你最近咳嗽得厉害,还是把烟戒了吧,对身体好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì jìn ké sòu de lì hài, hái shì bǎ yān jiè le ba, duì shēn tǐ hǎo。
examples.en: You've been coughing badly; you'd better quit smoking for your health.

examples.zh: 这么远的路,你还是别骑车了,太累也不安全。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me yuǎn de lù, nǐ hái shì bié qí chē le, tài lèi yě bù ān quán。
examples.en: It's such a long way; better not cycle, it's tiring and unsafe.

examples.zh: 既然你那么喜欢,这个就还是留给你吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán nǐ nà me xǐ huān, zhè ge jiù hái shì liú gěi nǐ ba。
examples.en: Since you like it so much, you'd better keep this one.

examples.zh: 天气预报说要降温,你出门还是多带件外套吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō yào jiàng wēn, nǐ chū mén hái shì duō dài jiàn wài tào ba。
examples.en: The forecast says it'll get colder; better take an extra coat.

examples.zh: 这件事牵扯的人太多,咱们还是谨慎处理为好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì qiān chě de rén tài duō, zán men hái shì jǐn shèn chǔ lǐ wèi hǎo。
examples.en: This involves too many people; we'd better handle it cautiously.

examples.zh: 与其买那么多零食,还是把钱花在有用的地方吧。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ qí mǎi nà me duō líng shí, hái shì bǎ qián huā zài yǒu yòng de dì fāng ba。
examples.en: Rather than buying so many snacks, better spend the money usefully.

examples.zh: 你已经忙了一整天了,剩下的还是明天再做吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǐ jīng máng le yī zhěng tiān le, shèng xià de hái shì míng tiān zài zuò ba。
examples.en: You've been busy all day; better do the rest tomorrow.

title: "最好" ile "en iyisi ...-sen"
summary: "最好" (zuìhǎo) bir tavsiye verir: "en iyisi ..., ...-sen iyi olur": 你最好早点去 = En iyisi erken git.
explanation: "最好" bir öneri/tavsiye sunar: "en iyisi ..., ...-sen iyi olur, ...-mek en iyisi". 你最好带上伞,好像要下雨 (En iyisi şemsiye al, yağmur yağacak gibi), 这件事你最好别告诉他 (En iyisi bunu ona söyleme). Yüklemden önce gelir ve konuşmacının gördüğü en uygun seçeneği önerir; "还是"dan biraz daha güçlü, öğüt/uyarı tonu taşır. Sözlük anlamı "en iyi"dir (bir sıfat öbeği olarak da kullanılır: 最好的朋友 = en iyi arkadaş), ama zarf olarak tavsiye bildirir. Olumsuz öneride "最好别/最好不要" gelir: en iyisi ...-me. Türkçedeki "en iyisi, ...-sen iyi edersin, ...-melisin (öneri)" ifadelerine denk gelir; nazik ama net bir tavsiye vermenin yaygın bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 明天有重要的会,你最好提前半小时到公司。
examples.pinyin: Míng tiān yǒu zhòng yào de huì, nǐ zuì hǎo tí qián bàn xiǎo shí dào gōng sī。
examples.en: There's an important meeting tomorrow; you'd best arrive half an hour early.

examples.zh: 天气预报说下午有雨,你出门最好带把伞。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō xià wǔ yǒu yǔ, nǐ chū mén zuì hǎo dài bǎ sǎn。
examples.en: The forecast says rain this afternoon; best take an umbrella.

examples.zh: 这件事关系重大,你最好先跟领导汇报一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì guān xì zhòng dà, nǐ zuì hǎo xiān gēn lǐng dǎo huì bào yī xià。
examples.en: This is a significant matter; you'd best report to your boss first.

examples.zh: 你最近脸色不好,最好去医院做个检查。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì jìn liǎn sè bù hǎo, zuì hǎo qù yī yuàn zuò gè jiǎn chá。
examples.en: You've looked unwell lately; you'd best get a checkup at the hospital.

examples.zh: 这道菜最好趁热吃,凉了味道就差多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài zuì hǎo chèn rè chī, liáng le wèi dào jiù chà duō le。
examples.en: This dish is best eaten hot; cold it tastes much worse.

examples.zh: 你们最好早点出发,免得路上堵车耽误了时间。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ men zuì hǎo zǎo diǎn chū fā, miǎn de lù shàng dǔ chē dān wù le shí jiān。
examples.en: You'd best leave early to avoid delays from traffic.

examples.zh: 这种药最好饭后吃,不然容易伤胃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yào zuì hǎo fàn hòu chī, bù rán róng yì shāng wèi。
examples.en: This medicine is best taken after meals, or it may upset your stomach.

examples.zh: 要想学好一门语言,最好每天都坚持练习。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng xué hǎo yī mén yǔ yán, zuì hǎo měi tiān dōu jiān chí liàn xí。
examples.en: To master a language, it's best to practice every day.

examples.zh: 这件事你最好别插手,免得惹上不必要的麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ zuì hǎo bié chā shǒu, miǎn de rě shàng bù bì yào de má fán。
examples.en: You'd best not get involved, to avoid unnecessary trouble.

examples.zh: 买这么贵的东西,你最好先货比三家。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi zhè me guì de dōng xī, nǐ zuì hǎo xiān huò bǐ sān jiā。
examples.en: For such an expensive purchase, you'd best compare a few shops first.

examples.zh: 你最好把重要的文件多备份几份,以防万一。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ zhòng yào de wén jiàn duō bèi fèn jǐ fèn, yǐ fáng wàn yī。
examples.en: You'd best back up important files several times, just in case.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,这些危险的东西最好放高一点。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hái xiǎo, zhè xiē wēi xiǎn de dōng xī zuì hǎo fàng gāo yì diǎn。
examples.en: The child is young; these dangerous things are best kept up high.

examples.zh: 你要是想减肥,最好少吃甜食,多做运动。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì xiǎng jiǎn féi, zuì hǎo shǎo chī tián shí, duō zuò yùn dòng。
examples.en: If you want to lose weight, best eat fewer sweets and exercise more.

examples.zh: 路不太熟的话,你最好打开导航跟着走。
examples.pinyin: Lù bù tài shú de huà, nǐ zuì hǎo dǎ kāi dǎo háng gēn zhe zǒu。
examples.en: If you don't know the way well, best follow the navigation.

examples.zh: 这么重要的约会,你最好别迟到,给人留个好印象。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng yào de yuē huì, nǐ zuì hǎo bié chí dào, gěi rén liú gè hǎo yìn xiàng。
examples.en: For such an important date, best not be late to make a good impression.

examples.zh: 天冷了,老人和孩子最好少出门,注意保暖。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, lǎo rén hé hái zi zuì hǎo shǎo chū mén, zhù yì bǎo nuǎn。
examples.en: It's cold; the elderly and children had best stay in and keep warm.

examples.zh: 你最好把想说的话先写下来,免得到时候忘了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì hǎo bǎ xiǎng shuō de huà xiān xiě xià lái, miǎn dé dào shí hòu wàng le。
examples.en: You'd best write down what you want to say, lest you forget.

examples.zh: 坐长途车,最好带点水和吃的,路上方便。
examples.pinyin: Zuò cháng tú chē, zuì hǎo dài diǎn shuǐ hé chī de, lù shàng fāng biàn。
examples.en: For a long trip, best bring water and snacks for the road.

examples.zh: 这个问题比较敏感,你最好换一种方式来问。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí bǐ jiào mǐn gǎn, nǐ zuì hǎo huàn yī zhǒng fāng shì lái wèn。
examples.en: This question is sensitive; you'd best ask in a different way.

examples.zh: 你既然答应了,最好就说到做到,别让人失望。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì rán dā yìng le, zuì hǎo jiù shuō dào zuò dào, bié ràng rén shī wàng。
examples.en: Since you promised, best follow through and not disappoint.

examples.zh: 出远门之前,家里的水电最好都检查一遍。
examples.pinyin: Chū yuǎn mén zhī qián, jiā lǐ de shuǐ diàn zuì hǎo dōu jiǎn chá yī biàn。
examples.en: Before a long trip, best check the home's water and electricity.

examples.zh: 你最好现在就把这件事处理好,别拖到最后。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì hǎo xiàn zài jiù bǎ zhè jiàn shì chǔ lǐ hǎo, bié tuō dào zuì hòu。
examples.en: You'd best handle this now, not put it off to the last minute.

examples.zh: 学游泳的时候,身边最好有个会游的人照看着。
examples.pinyin: Xué yóu yǒng de shí hòu, shēn biān zuì hǎo yǒu gè huì yóu de rén zhào kàn zhe。
examples.en: When learning to swim, best have a swimmer nearby to watch.

examples.zh: 这些话最好当面说清楚,别在背后议论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē huà zuì hǎo dāng miàn shuō qīng chǔ, bié zài bèi hòu yì lùn。
examples.en: These things are best said clearly to one's face, not gossiped behind backs.

examples.zh: 你既然身体不舒服,最好还是请一天假休息休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì rán shēn tǐ bù shū fú, zuì hǎo hái shì qǐng yī tiān jiǎ xiū xī xiū xī。
examples.en: Since you're unwell, you'd best take a day off to rest.

title: "这样" ile "böylece, bu şekilde"
summary: "这样" (zhèyàng) önceki duruma bağlı bir sonuç/amaç bağlar: "böyle, bu şekilde, böylece": 早点睡,这样明天才有精神 = Erken yat ki yarın dinç olasın.
explanation: "这样" "böyle, bu şekilde" anlamına gelir ve iki işlevi öne çıkar: (1) Bir eylemin BİÇİMİNİ gösterir — 你这样做就对了 (Böyle yaparsan doğru olur). (2) Önceki koşula bağlı bir SONUÇ/AMAÇ bağlar, çoğu zaman ikinci cümlenin başında — 你多穿点,这样就不会感冒了 (Kalın giyin ki üşütmeyesin), 我们分工合作,这样能节省不少时间 (İş bölümü yapalım, böylece çok zaman kazanırız). Bir önceki cümledeki yöntem/koşul sayesinde doğan sonucu bağlar; Türkçedeki "böylece, bu şekilde, böyle yaparsak/yaparsan" ifadelerine denk gelir. "这样一来" (böylece, bu durumda) da yakın bir kalıptır. Neden-sonuç ve amaç anlatımında akıcı geçiş sağlar.

examples.zh: 你每天坚持背几个单词,这样一年下来就能记住不少。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ měi tiān jiān chí bèi jǐ gè dān cí, zhè yàng yī nián xià lái jiù néng jì zhù bù shǎo。
examples.en: Memorize a few words daily, and this way you'll learn a lot in a year.

examples.zh: 我们提前订好票,这样就不用担心到时候买不到了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men tí qián dìng hǎo piào, zhè yàng jiù bù yòng dān xīn dào shí hòu mǎi bú dào le。
examples.en: Let's book tickets in advance, so we needn't worry about them selling out.

examples.zh: 你多喝点热水,好好休息,这样感冒才能快点好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duō hē diǎn rè shuǐ, hǎo hǎo xiū xī, zhè yàng gǎn mào cái néng kuài diǎn hǎo。
examples.en: Drink hot water and rest well; this way the cold will heal faster.

examples.zh: 咱们分头去找,这样能快点把丢的东西找到。
examples.pinyin: Zán men fēn tóu qù zhǎo, zhè yàng néng kuài diǎn bǎ diū de dōng xī zhǎo dào。
examples.en: Let's search separately; this way we'll find the lost item faster.

examples.zh: 把重要的事情写下来,这样就不容易忘记了。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ zhòng yào de shì qíng xiě xià lái, zhè yàng jiù bù róng yì wàng jì le。
examples.en: Write down important things, and this way you won't forget them easily.

examples.zh: 你先冷静下来再说,这样才能把问题讲清楚。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān lěng jìng xià lái zài shuō, zhè yàng cái néng bǎ wèn tí jiǎng qīng chǔ。
examples.en: Calm down first before speaking; only this way can you explain clearly.

examples.zh: 我们轮流照顾老人,这样谁都不会太累。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men lún liú zhào gù lǎo rén, zhè yàng shéi dōu bú huì tài lèi。
examples.en: Let's take turns caring for the elderly, so no one gets too tired.

examples.zh: 你按我说的步骤做,这样操作起来就简单多了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ àn wǒ shuō de bù zhòu zuò, zhè yàng cāo zuò qǐ lái jiù jiǎn dān duō le。
examples.en: Follow the steps I described, and it'll be much simpler to operate.

examples.zh: 平时多存点钱,这样遇到急事就不至于手忙脚乱。
examples.pinyin: Píng shí duō cún diǎn qián, zhè yàng yù dào jí shì jiù bù zhì yú shǒu máng jiǎo luàn。
examples.en: Save money regularly, so emergencies won't catch you unprepared.

examples.zh: 把家具靠墙摆,这样房间能显得宽敞一些。
examples.pinyin: Bǎ jiā jù kào qiáng bǎi, zhè yàng fáng jiān néng xiǎn de kuān chǎng yī xiē。
examples.en: Place the furniture against the wall; this way the room looks more spacious.

examples.zh: 你先跟他道个歉,这样两个人才好继续合作。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān gēn tā dào gè qiàn, zhè yàng liǎng gè rén cái hǎo jì xù hé zuò。
examples.en: Apologize to him first, so you two can keep working together.

examples.zh: 我们把任务分成几部分,这样做起来就不会那么吃力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ rèn wù fēn chéng jǐ bù fèn, zhè yàng zuò qǐ lái jiù bú huì nà me chī lì。
examples.en: Let's split the task into parts, and it won't be so strenuous.

examples.zh: 孩子从小养成读书的习惯,这样长大后受益无穷。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi cóng xiǎo yǎng chéng dú shū de xí guàn, zhè yàng zhǎng dà hòu shòu yì wú qióng。
examples.en: If a child forms a reading habit early, they benefit endlessly later.

examples.zh: 你把车停在阴凉处,这样车里就不会太热了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ chē tíng zài yīn liáng chù, zhè yàng chē lǐ jiù bú huì tài rè le。
examples.en: Park the car in the shade, so it won't get too hot inside.

examples.zh: 咱们早点出发,这样就能赶在天黑前到达。
examples.pinyin: Zán men zǎo diǎn chū fā, zhè yàng jiù néng gǎn zài tiān hēi qián dào dá。
examples.en: Let's leave early, so we can arrive before dark.

examples.zh: 你把想法都说出来,这样大家才能一起想办法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ xiǎng fǎ dōu shuō chū lái, zhè yàng dà jiā cái néng yì qǐ xiǎng bàn fǎ。
examples.en: Share all your ideas, so everyone can figure things out together.

examples.zh: 多跟中国人聊天,这样口语才能提高得更快。
examples.pinyin: Duō gēn zhōng guó rén liáo tiān, zhè yàng kǒu yǔ cái néng tí gāo de gèng kuài。
examples.en: Chat with Chinese people more; this way your speaking improves faster.

examples.zh: 你把手机放远一点,这样睡觉才不会老想着看。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ shǒu jī fàng yuǎn yì diǎn, zhè yàng shuì jiào cái bú huì lǎo xiǎng zhe kàn。
examples.en: Put your phone farther away, so you won't keep wanting to check it in bed.

examples.zh: 我们把会议提前到上午,这样下午就有时间处理别的事。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bǎ huì yì tí qián dào shàng wǔ, zhè yàng xià wǔ jiù yǒu shí jiān chǔ lǐ bié de shì。
examples.en: Let's move the meeting to the morning, freeing the afternoon for other things.

examples.zh: 你把步骤记牢,这样以后自己一个人也能做。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ bù zhòu jì láo, zhè yàng yǐ hòu zì jǐ yí gè rén yě néng zuò。
examples.en: Memorize the steps, so you can do it alone later.

examples.zh: 大家都遵守规则,这样活动才能顺利进行。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu zūn shǒu guī zé, zhè yàng huó dòng cái néng shùn lì jìn xíng。
examples.en: If everyone follows the rules, the event can go smoothly.

examples.zh: 你把窗帘拉上,这样屋里就不会那么晒了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ chuāng lián lā shàng, zhè yàng wū lǐ jiù bú huì nà me shài le。
examples.en: Draw the curtains, so the room won't be so sunny.

examples.zh: 我们互相监督,这样谁都不好意思偷懒。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men hù xiāng jiān dū, zhè yàng shéi dōu bù hǎo yì sī tōu lǎn。
examples.en: Let's supervise each other, so no one is inclined to slack off.

examples.zh: 你把重点画出来,这样复习的时候就一目了然。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ zhòng diǎn huà chū lái, zhè yàng fù xí de shí hòu jiù yī mù liǎo rán。
examples.en: Highlight the key points, so reviewing is clear at a glance.

examples.zh: 提前把材料准备好,这样开会的时候就不慌了。
examples.pinyin: Tí qián bǎ cái liào zhǔn bèi hǎo, zhè yàng kāi huì de shí hòu jiù bù huāng le。
examples.en: Prepare the materials in advance, so you won't panic during the meeting.

title: "才" ile geç kalma/ancak
summary: "才" bir eylemin BEKLENENDEN GEÇ olduğunu vurgular: 他九点才来 = O ancak dokuzda geldi (geç).
explanation: "才" bir zaman ifadesinin ardından gelip eylemin BEKLENENDEN GEÇ, ancak o zaman gerçekleştiğini vurgular: 他九点才到 (Ancak dokuzda geldi — geç), 我劝了半天他才同意 (Uzun uzun ikna ettim de ancak öyle razı oldu). "就"un tam KARŞITIDIR: "就" "erken/çabuk", "才" "geç/ancak" bildirir. Önemli bir gramer noktası: "才"lı cümle geçmiş bir olay bile anlatsa genelde "了" ALMAZ (他昨天很晚才睡 — "了" yok). "才" ayrıca "sadece, ancak (az miktar)" anlamına da gelebilir: 他才五岁 (daha beş yaşında). Bu konuda özellikle GEÇLİK vurgusunu ele alıyoruz. Türkçedeki "ancak, ...-ınca, geç, nihayet" karşılıklarına denk gelir; bir şeyin ne kadar geç/güçlükle olduğunu belirtir.

examples.zh: 昨天晚上他忙到十二点才睡觉,今天没什么精神。
examples.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǎn shàng tā máng dào shí èr diǎn cái shuì jiào, jīn tiān méi shén me jīng shén。
examples.en: Last night he worked until midnight before sleeping; today he's listless.

examples.zh: 我们等了好久,他才不慌不忙地走了过来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men děng le hǎo jiǔ, tā cái bù huāng bù máng de zǒu le guò lái。
examples.en: We waited a long time before he sauntered over unhurriedly.

examples.zh: 这道题我想了半天,才终于弄明白是怎么回事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí wǒ xiǎng le bàn tiān, cái zhōng yú nòng míng bái shì zěn me huí shì。
examples.en: I pondered this problem for a long time before finally figuring it out.

examples.zh: 他一直不肯说,直到我再三追问,才说出了真相。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì zhí bù kěn shuō, zhí dào wǒ zài sān zhuī wèn, cái shuō chū le zhēn xiàng。
examples.en: He wouldn't tell until, after repeated questioning, he revealed the truth.

examples.zh: 火车晚点了,我们比原计划晚了两个小时才到。
examples.pinyin: Huǒ chē wǎn diǎn le, wǒ men bǐ yuán jì huà wǎn le liǎng gè xiǎo shí cái dào。
examples.en: The train was delayed; we arrived two hours later than planned.

examples.zh: 这本书我读了好几遍,才慢慢体会到它的深意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ dú le hǎo jǐ biàn, cái màn màn tǐ huì dào tā de shēn yì。
examples.en: I read this book several times before slowly grasping its deeper meaning.

examples.zh: 孩子玩得太开心,叫了好几声才依依不舍地回家。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi wán de tài kāi xīn, jiào le hǎo jǐ shēng cái yī yī bù shě de huí jiā。
examples.en: The child was having so much fun that he only came home reluctantly after several calls.

examples.zh: 经过反复解释,他才勉强接受了我的建议。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò fǎn fù jiě shì, tā cái miǎn qiǎng jiē shòu le wǒ de jiàn yì。
examples.en: After repeated explaining, he reluctantly accepted my suggestion.

examples.zh: 我找了整整一个上午,才在角落里找到那把钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǎo le zhěng zhěng yí gè shàng wǔ, cái zài jiǎo luò lǐ zhǎo dào nà bǎ yào shi。
examples.en: I searched all morning before finding the key in a corner.

examples.zh: 他病了很久,吃了不少药,才慢慢好了起来。

title: "一 + ölçü" ikilemesiyle "tek tek"
pattern: 一 + Ölçü + 一 + Ölçü (+ 地)
summary: "一 + ölçü" kalıbını tekrarlamak "tek tek, birer birer" anlamı verir: 一个一个地检查 = teker teker kontrol etmek.
explanation: "一 + ölçü sözcüğü" kalıbını iki kez tekrarlamak, bir eylemin BİRER BİRER, tek tek, sırayla yapıldığını anlatır: 一个一个 (teker teker), 一步一步 (adım adım), 一天一天 (gün geçtikçe), 一遍一遍 (defalarca). Çoğu zaman ardından zarf yapıcı "地" gelip fiili niteler: 一个一个地数 (teker teker saymak), 一步一步地往上爬 (adım adım tırmanmak). Aynı ölçü sözcüğü iki "一" ile tekrarlanır ve eylemin tek tek, sabırla ya da tedricen ilerlediğini vurgular. Türkçedeki "birer birer, tek tek, adım adım, gitgide" ikilemelerine denk gelir; bir eylemin sıralı/tedrici doğasını canlı biçimde betimler.

title: "就" ile "yalnızca, sadece" (az miktar)
summary: "就" bir miktarın az/tek olduğunu vurgular: "yalnızca, sadece, bir tek": 就他一个人来了 = Bir tek o geldi.
explanation: "就" burada bir miktarın SADECE bu kadar, az ya da tek olduğunu vurgular — "yalnızca, sadece, bir tek, topu topu". 就他一个人知道 (Bir tek o biliyor), 我就买了一件 (Sadece bir tane aldım), 家里就剩一点米了 (Evde topu topu biraz pirinç kaldı). "就" vurgulanan az miktar/tek öğenin hemen önünde durur ve "başka değil, sadece bu" fikrini verir. "只" (yalnızca) ile çok yakın anlamlıdır ve çoğu bağlamda değiştirilebilir; "就" konuşma dilinde daha vurgulu/duygusal olabilir. Bu, "就"un erkenlik ya da hemen-ardışıklık anlamlarından farklıdır; burada NİCELİK sınırlaması vardır. Türkçedeki "yalnızca, sadece, bir tek, topu topu" ifadelerine denk gelir.
