title: "先...再..." ile sıralama
summary: "先...再..." (xiān...zài...) iki eylemin SIRASINI verir: önce ..., sonra ...: 先做作业,再看电视 = Önce ödev yap, sonra televizyon izle.
explanation: "先...再..." iki (ya da daha çok) eylemin gerçekleşme SIRASINI net biçimde belirtir: önce biri, ardından öteki. 你先洗手,再吃饭 (Önce ellerini yıka, sonra ye), 我们先商量一下,再做决定 (Önce görüşelim, sonra karar verelim). "先" ilk eylemi, "再" ikinci (sonraki) eylemi işaretler. Buradaki "再" "tekrar" değil, "ondan sonra" anlamındadır (gelecekteki bir sonraki adım). Genellikle bir planı, adım adım bir işlemi ya da bir tavsiyeyi anlatır. "先...然后..." da benzer işlevdedir; "然后" (sonra) daha genel, "再" ise ilk eylemin tamamlanmasına bağlı bir sonrakiliği vurgular. Türkçedeki "önce ..., sonra/ardından ..." sıralamasına birebir denk gelir; işlem sırasını anlatmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 你先把作业做完,再出去和朋友玩儿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ zuò yè zuò wán, zài chū qù hé péng yǒu wán ér。
examples.en: Finish your homework first, then go out to play with friends.

examples.zh: 我们先吃点东西垫垫肚子,再慢慢逛。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xiān chī diǎn dōng xī diàn diàn dǔ zi, zài màn màn guàng。
examples.en: Let's eat something to tide us over first, then stroll slowly.

examples.zh: 做这道菜,要先把油烧热,再放葱姜爆香。
examples.pinyin: Zuò zhè dào cài, yào xiān bǎ yóu shāo rè, zài fàng cōng jiāng bào xiāng。
examples.en: For this dish, heat the oil first, then add scallion and ginger.

examples.zh: 你先冷静一下,再想想到底该怎么处理。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān lěng jìng yī xià, zài xiǎng xiǎng dào dǐ gāi zěn me chǔ lǐ。
examples.en: Calm down first, then think about how to handle it.

examples.zh: 咱们先把重要的事情办好,再考虑其他的。
examples.pinyin: Zán men xiān bǎ zhòng yào de shì qíng bàn hǎo, zài kǎo lǜ qí tā de。
examples.en: Let's take care of the important things first, then consider the rest.

examples.zh: 上车以后,请先刷卡,再往里面走。
examples.pinyin: Shàng chē yǐ hòu, qǐng xiān shuā kǎ, zài wǎng lǐ miàn zǒu。
examples.en: After boarding, please swipe your card first, then move inside.

examples.zh: 你先把情况了解清楚,再下结论也不迟。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ qíng kuàng liǎo jiě qīng chǔ, zài xià jié lùn yě bù chí。
examples.en: Understand the situation clearly first; it's not too late to conclude then.

examples.zh: 我打算先工作几年,攒点钱,再考虑出国留学。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ suàn xiān gōng zuò jǐ nián, zǎn diǎn qián, zài kǎo lǜ chū guó liú xué。
examples.en: I plan to work a few years and save money before studying abroad.

examples.zh: 看病要先挂号,再去相应的科室排队。
examples.pinyin: Kàn bìng yào xiān guà hào, zài qù xiāng yìng de kē shì pái duì。
examples.en: To see a doctor, register first, then queue at the right department.

examples.zh: 你先把地扫干净,再拖一遍,屋子就亮堂了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ de sǎo gān jìng, zài tuō yī biàn, wū zi jiù liàng táng le。
examples.en: Sweep the floor first, then mop it, and the room will be bright.

examples.zh: 我们先把行李放到酒店,再出去找地方吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xiān bǎ xíng lǐ fàng dào jiǔ diàn, zài chū qù zhǎo dì fāng chī fàn。
examples.en: Let's drop the luggage at the hotel first, then find somewhere to eat.

examples.zh: 学做菜要先学会控制火候,再慢慢练习调味。
examples.pinyin: Xué zuò cài yào xiān xué huì kòng zhì huǒ hòu, zài màn màn liàn xí tiáo wèi。
examples.en: Learning to cook, master heat control first, then practice seasoning.

examples.zh: 你先把这段话读熟,再试着背下来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ zhè duàn huà dú shú, zài shì zhe bèi xià lái。
examples.en: Read this passage until fluent first, then try to memorize it.

examples.zh: 买房这么大的事,最好先跟家人商量,再做决定。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi fáng zhè me dà de shì, zuì hǎo xiān gēn jiā rén shāng liáng, zài zuò jué dìng。
examples.en: For something as big as buying a house, discuss with family before deciding.

examples.zh: 咱们先把方案定下来,再分头去准备。
examples.pinyin: Zán men xiān bǎ fāng àn dìng xià lái, zài fēn tóu qù zhǔn bèi。
examples.en: Let's finalize the plan first, then prepare separately.

examples.zh: 他习惯先把当天的事列出来,再一件件去完成。
examples.pinyin: Tā xí guàn xiān bǎ dàng tiān de shì liè chū lái, zài yī jiàn jiàn qù wán chéng。
examples.en: He likes to list the day's tasks first, then finish them one by one.

examples.zh: 你先把伤口清理干净,再贴上创可贴。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ shāng kǒu qīng lǐ gān jìng, zài tiē shàng chuàng kě tiē。
examples.en: Clean the wound first, then put on a bandage.

examples.zh: 我们先在网上查查资料,再决定去哪个城市旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xiān zài wǎng shàng zhā zhā zī liào, zài jué dìng qù nǎ ge chéng shì lǚ xíng。
examples.en: Let's look up info online first, then decide which city to visit.

examples.zh: 吃药以前,要先看清楚说明书,再按量服用。
examples.pinyin: Chī yào yǐ qián, yào xiān kàn qīng chǔ shuō míng shū, zài àn liàng fú yòng。
examples.en: Before taking medicine, read the instructions first, then take the right dose.

examples.zh: 你先把要点记下来,再慢慢展开写成一篇文章。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ yào diǎn jì xià lái, zài màn màn zhǎn kāi xiě chéng yì piān wén zhāng。
examples.en: Note the key points first, then slowly expand them into an article.

examples.zh: 搬家那天,我们先搬大件家具,再收拾零碎东西。
examples.pinyin: Bān jiā nà tiān, wǒ men xiān bān dà jiàn jiā jù, zài shōu shí líng suì dōng xī。
examples.en: On moving day, we moved big furniture first, then small items.

examples.zh: 孩子睡觉前,妈妈总是先给他讲个故事,再关灯。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shuì jiào qián, mā mā zǒng shì xiān gěi tā jiǎng gè gù shì, zài guān dēng。
examples.en: Before bed, mom always tells the child a story first, then turns off the light.

examples.zh: 面试的时候,你先做个自我介绍,再谈谈你的经历。
examples.pinyin: Miàn shì de shí hòu, nǐ xiān zuò gè zì wǒ jiè shào, zài tán tán nǐ de jīng lì。
examples.en: In the interview, introduce yourself first, then talk about your experience.

examples.zh: 我们先把预算算清楚,再决定要不要买。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xiān bǎ yù suàn suàn qīng chǔ, zài jué dìng yào bù yào mǎi。
examples.en: Let's work out the budget clearly first, then decide whether to buy.

examples.zh: 学游泳要先在浅水区练习,再慢慢往深处去。
examples.pinyin: Xué yóu yǒng yào xiān zài qiǎn shuǐ qū liàn xí, zài màn màn wǎng shēn chù qù。
examples.en: To learn swimming, practice in the shallow end first, then go deeper.

title: "老(是)" ile sürekli/sitemli "hep"
summary: "老(是)" (lǎo shì) bir şeyin sürekli tekrarlandığını, çoğu zaman SİTEM tonuyla bildirir: 他老是迟到 = Sürekli geç kalıyor.
explanation: "老" (ya da "老是") bir eylemin/durumun sürekli, tekrar tekrar olduğunu bildirir ve genelde ŞİKÂYET, sitem ya da bıkkınlık tonu taşır: "hep, sürekli, boyuna, bir türlü". 他老是忘带东西 (Sürekli bir şeyler unutuyor), 你怎么老是迟到? (Nasıl hep geç kalıyorsun?), 这孩子老哭 (Bu çocuk boyuna ağlıyor). "总是"ye benzer ama "老是" daha çok OLUMSUZ/rahatsız edici bir tekrarı vurgular ve konuşma dilindedir. Fiil ya da sıfatın önünde durur. "是" çoğu zaman düşebilir (老迟到 = 老是迟到). Türkçedeki "hep, sürekli, boyuna, bir türlü, illa" gibi sitem içeren tekrar ifadelerine denk gelir; can sıkıcı bir alışkanlıktan yakınmanın doğal yoludur.

examples.zh: 你怎么老是把东西乱放,用的时候又找不到?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me lǎo shì bǎ dōng xī luàn fàng, yòng de shí hòu yòu zhǎo bú dào?
examples.en: Why do you always leave things everywhere and then can't find them?

examples.zh: 这台旧电脑老是死机,真该换一台新的了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù diàn nǎo lǎo shì sǐ jī, zhēn gāi huàn yī tái xīn de le。
examples.en: This old computer keeps freezing; it really needs replacing.

examples.zh: 他上课老是走神,难怪成绩总上不去。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng kè lǎo shì zǒu shén, nán guài chéng jì zǒng shàng bù qù。
examples.en: He always spaces out in class; no wonder his grades don't improve.

examples.zh: 你别老是熬夜了,身体迟早会被你拖垮的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié lǎo shì áo yè le, shēn tǐ chí zǎo huì bèi nǐ tuō kuǎ de。
examples.en: Stop always staying up late; you'll ruin your health eventually.

examples.zh: 这孩子老是挑食,青菜一口都不肯吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè hái zi lǎo shì tiāo shí, qīng cài yī kǒu dōu bù kěn chī。
examples.en: This child is always picky, refusing to eat any vegetables.

examples.zh: 你怎么老是忘记关灯,电费都比别人高。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me lǎo shì wàng jì guān dēng, diàn fèi dōu bǐ bié rén gāo。
examples.en: Why do you always forget to turn off the lights? Your bill is higher than others'.

examples.zh: 他做事老是三分钟热度,很难坚持下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì lǎo shì sān fēn zhōng rè dù, hěn nán jiān chí xià lái。
examples.en: He always starts things eagerly but can't stick with them.

examples.zh: 你别老是低头看手机,抬头看看路。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié lǎo shì dī tóu kàn shǒu jī, tái tóu kàn kàn lù。
examples.en: Stop always staring down at your phone; look up at the road.

examples.zh: 最近天气老是阴沉沉的,好久没见到太阳了。
examples.pinyin: Zuì jìn tiān qì lǎo shì yīn chén chén de, hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn dào tài yáng le。
examples.en: The weather has been gloomy lately; I haven't seen the sun in ages.

examples.zh: 他老是把责任推给别人,自己从不反省。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǎo shì bǎ zé rèn tuī gěi bié rén, zì jǐ cóng bù fǎn xǐng。
examples.en: He always shifts the blame to others and never reflects on himself.

examples.zh: 你怎么老是这么粗心,又把钥匙落在家里了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me lǎo shì zhè me cū xīn, yòu bǎ yào shi luò zài jiā lǐ le。
examples.en: Why are you always so careless? You left the keys at home again.

examples.zh: 这条老街老是这么热闹,一到晚上人特别多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lǎo jiē lǎo shì zhè me rè nào, yī dào wǎn shàng rén tè bié duō。
examples.en: This old street is always so lively; at night it's especially crowded.

examples.zh: 他老是说要减肥,可是从来没真正开始过。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǎo shì shuō yào jiǎn féi, kě shì cóng lái méi zhēn zhèng kāi shǐ guò。
examples.en: He's always saying he'll lose weight but never actually starts.

examples.zh: 你别老是担心这担心那,顺其自然就好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié lǎo shì dān xīn zhè dān xīn nà, shùn qí zì rán jiù hǎo。
examples.en: Stop always worrying about this and that; just let things be.

examples.zh: 这个水龙头老是关不紧,总是滴滴答答地漏水。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shuǐ lóng tóu lǎo shì guān bù jǐn, zǒng shì dī dī dā dā de lòu shuǐ。
examples.en: This tap never shuts tight and keeps dripping.

examples.zh: 他老是迟到,老板已经找他谈过好几次了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǎo shì chí dào, lǎo bǎn yǐ jīng zhǎo tā tán guò hǎo jǐ cì le。
examples.en: He's always late; the boss has spoken to him about it several times.

examples.zh: 你怎么老是打断我说话,能不能让我说完?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me lǎo shì dǎ duàn wǒ shuō huà, néng bù néng ràng wǒ shuō wán?
examples.en: Why do you always interrupt me? Can you let me finish?

examples.zh: 弟弟老是缠着我陪他玩,一点儿也不让我安静。
examples.pinyin: Dì di lǎo shì chán zhe wǒ péi tā wán, yì diǎn ér yě bù ràng wǒ ān jìng。
examples.en: My brother is always pestering me to play, never letting me be.

examples.zh: 最近他老是不接电话,不知道是不是出什么事了。
examples.pinyin: Zuì jìn tā lǎo shì bù jiē diàn huà, bù zhī dào shì bú shì chū shén me shì le。
examples.en: Lately he never answers his phone; I wonder if something's wrong.

examples.zh: 你别老是拿自己跟别人比,每个人都有自己的节奏。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié lǎo shì ná zì jǐ gēn bié rén bǐ, měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de jié zòu。
examples.en: Stop always comparing yourself to others; everyone has their own pace.

examples.zh: 这台旧空调老是发出奇怪的声音,吵得人睡不着。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù kōng tiáo lǎo shì fā chū qí guài de shēng yīn, chǎo de rén shuì bù zhe。
examples.en: This old AC keeps making strange noises, keeping people awake.

examples.zh: 他老是把简单的事情想得太复杂,自己给自己添麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǎo shì bǎ jiǎn dān de shì qíng xiǎng de tài fù zá, zì jǐ gěi zì jǐ tiān má fán。
examples.en: He always overcomplicates simple things, making trouble for himself.

examples.zh: 你怎么老是这么客气,咱们都是自己人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me lǎo shì zhè me kè qì, zán men dōu shì zì jǐ rén。
examples.en: Why are you always so formal? We're all like family here.

examples.zh: 孩子老是在墙上乱画,家里的墙都花了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi lǎo shì zài qiáng shàng luàn huà, jiā lǐ de qiáng dōu huā le。
examples.en: The child always scribbles on the walls; they're all a mess.

examples.zh: 他老是把工作带回家做,连周末都不休息。
examples.pinyin: Tā lǎo shì bǎ gōng zuò dài huí jiā zuò, lián zhōu mò dōu bù xiū xī。
examples.en: He always brings work home, not even resting on weekends.

title: "才" ile küçük sayı vurgusu
summary: "才" bir sayının önünde "sadece, ancak, daha" der ve az olduğunu vurgular: 他才五岁 = O daha beş yaşında.
explanation: "才" bir sayı/miktar ifadesinin ÖNÜNDE gelince miktarın AZ, beklenenden düşük olduğunu vurgular: "sadece, ancak, topu topu, daha". 他才五岁 (Daha beş yaşında), 我才睡了三个小时 (Sadece üç saat uyudum), 这么多活儿才两个人做 (Bunca işi topu topu iki kişi yapıyor). Konuşmacı miktarın YETERSİZ, şaşırtıcı derecede az ya da beklenenin altında olduğunu belirtir. "就"un miktar anlamıyla (bkz. "就 + az miktar") yakındır ama "才" özellikle "bu kadar az mı!" şaşkınlık/yetersizlik tonu taşır. Bu, "才"un "geç" anlamından (zaman ifadesinden SONRA gelir) farklıdır; burada "才" sayıdan ÖNCE gelir. Türkçedeki "daha, sadece, topu topu, ancak" azlık vurgularına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 他才三岁,就已经会背好几首古诗了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cái sān suì, jiù yǐ jīng huì bèi hǎo jǐ shǒu gǔ shī le。
examples.en: He's only three, yet can already recite several classical poems.

examples.zh: 现在才五点,天还早着呢,再睡一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài cái wǔ diǎn, tiān hái zǎo zhe ne, zài shuì yī huì er ba。
examples.en: It's only five now; it's still early, sleep a bit more.

examples.zh: 这么难的工作,他们组才三个人,实在忙不过来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me nán de gōng zuò, tā men zǔ cái sān gè rén, shí zài máng bù guò lái。
examples.en: For such hard work, their group has only three people; they can't cope.

examples.zh: 我昨晚才睡了四个小时,今天困得睁不开眼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuó wǎn cái shuì le sì gè xiǎo shí, jīn tiān kùn de zhēng bù kāi yǎn。
examples.en: I only slept four hours last night; today I can barely keep my eyes open.

examples.zh: 这件衣服才五十块钱,又好看又便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú cái wǔ shí kuài qián, yòu hǎo kàn yòu pián yi。
examples.en: This outfit is only fifty yuan, both pretty and cheap.

examples.zh: 他工作才半年,就已经成了组里的骨干。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōng zuò cái bàn nián, jiù yǐ jīng chéng le zǔ lǐ de gǔ gàn。
examples.en: He's worked only half a year, yet is already a key member.

examples.zh: 这个班才八个学生,老师能照顾得很周到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bān cái bā gè xué shēng, lǎo shī néng zhào gù de hěn zhōu dào。
examples.en: This class has only eight students, so the teacher can attend to each well.

examples.zh: 我们爬了这么久,怎么才到半山腰?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men pá le zhè me jiǔ, zěn me cái dào bàn shān yāo?
examples.en: We've climbed so long; how are we only halfway up?

examples.zh: 他一个月才挣这么点儿钱,日子过得挺紧。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí gè yuè cái zhēng zhè me diǎn er qián, rì zi guò de tǐng jǐn。
examples.en: He earns only this much a month; life is rather tight.

examples.zh: 孩子才上一年级,你就给他报这么多补习班?
examples.pinyin: Hái zi cái shàng yì nián jí, nǐ jiù gěi tā bào zhè me duō bǔ xí bān?
examples.en: The child's only in first grade, and you enroll him in so many tutoring classes?

examples.zh: 这么大的西瓜才十块钱,真是太划算了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de xī guā cái shí kuài qián, zhēn shì tài huá suàn le。
examples.en: Such a big watermelon for only ten yuan; what a bargain.

examples.zh: 我到现在才吃了半个包子,忙得连饭都顾不上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào xiàn zài cái chī le bàn gè bāo zi, máng de lián fàn dōu gù bù shàng。
examples.en: So far I've only eaten half a bun; too busy even to eat.

examples.zh: 他家离公司才两站地,走路也就十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā lí gōng sī cái liǎng zhàn de, zǒu lù yě jiù shí fēn zhōng。
examples.en: His home is only two stops from work, a ten-minute walk.

examples.zh: 这本书我才看了几页,就被它深深吸引了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ cái kàn le jǐ yè, jiù bèi tā shēn shēn xī yǐn le。
examples.en: I've only read a few pages of this book and I'm already hooked.

examples.zh: 都过了这么久,你才回复我一条消息。
examples.pinyin: Dōu guò le zhè me jiǔ, nǐ cái huí fù wǒ yī tiáo xiāo xī。
examples.en: After all this time, you replied with only one message.

examples.zh: 这么大的房子才住着一位老人,显得有些冷清。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de fáng zi cái zhù zhe yī wèi lǎo rén, xiǎn de yǒu xiē lěng qīng。
examples.en: Such a big house with only one elderly person feels rather empty.

examples.zh: 我才来这个城市几天,还什么都不熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cái lái zhè ge chéng shì jǐ tiān, hái shén me dōu bù shú xī。
examples.en: I've only been in this city a few days; I'm not familiar with anything.

examples.zh: 这道菜才放了一点点盐,怎么这么咸?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài cái fàng le yì diǎn diǎn yán, zěn me zhè me xián?
examples.en: This dish has only a tiny bit of salt; why is it so salty?

examples.zh: 他今年才二十出头,却已经很有主见了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīn nián cái èr shí chū tóu, què yǐ jīng hěn yǒu zhǔ jiàn le。
examples.en: He's only just over twenty, yet already very self-assured.

examples.zh: 这么重要的会议,才来了这么几个人,人也太少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng yào de huì yì, cái lái le zhè me jǐ gè rén, rén yě tài shǎo le。
examples.en: For such an important meeting, so few came; that's too few people.

examples.zh: 我才休息了一天,一堆工作就堆积起来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cái xiū xī le yī tiān, yī duī gōng zuò jiù duī jī qǐ lái le。
examples.en: I rested just one day, and a pile of work stacked up.

examples.zh: 这条鱼才一斤多,不够我们一家人吃的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú cái yī jīn duō, bù gòu wǒ men yī jiā rén chī de。
examples.en: This fish is just over a jin, not enough for our whole family.

examples.zh: 他学开车才一个月,现在已经开得挺稳了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué kāi chē cái yí gè yuè, xiàn zài yǐ jīng kāi de tǐng wěn le。
examples.en: He's learned driving for only a month, yet drives quite steadily now.

examples.zh: 这么长的一篇文章,你才用了半天就写完了?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhǎng de yì piān wén zhāng, nǐ cái yòng le bàn tiān jiù xiě wán le?
examples.en: Such a long article — you finished it in just half a day?

examples.zh: 离考试才剩三天了,他却一点儿都不着急。
examples.pinyin: Lí kǎo shì cái shèng sān tiān le, tā què yì diǎn ér dōu bù zháo jí。
examples.en: Only three days left before the exam, yet he's not worried at all.

title: "也" ve "都" birlikte kullanımı
summary: "也都" birlikte gelince "onlar da hepsi" anlamı verir: 他们也都同意了 = Onlar da hepsi kabul etti.
explanation: "也" (de/da — ekleme) ve "都" (hepsi — kapsam) birlikte "也都" biçiminde kullanılabilir ve iki anlamı birleştirir: bir öznenin/grubun EKLENDİĞİNİ ("da") ve o grubun TAMAMININ ("hepsi") söz konusu olduğunu belirtir. 我们也都是学生 (Biz de hepimiz öğrenciyiz), 他的家人也都来了 (Ailesi de hep geldi), 这些问题他也都解决了 (Bu sorunları da hepsini çözdü). Sıra sabittir: önce "也", sonra "都" ("都也" yanlıştır) ve ikisi de yüklemden önce gelir. "也" bir öncekiyle karşılaştırma/ekleme, "都" ise söz konusu bütünü kapsar. Türkçede "onlar da hep(si), ... da tümü" gibi ifadelerle karşılanır; hem ekleme hem kapsayıcılık gerektiğinde kullanılır.

examples.zh: 我喜欢旅行,我的家人也都喜欢到处走走看看。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huān lǚ xíng, wǒ de jiā rén yě dōu xǐ huān dào chù zǒu zǒu kàn kàn。
examples.en: I love travel, and my family all enjoy going places too.

examples.zh: 这次考试,不只是他,别的同学也都考得不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì, bù zhǐ shì tā, bié de tóng xué yě dōu kǎo de bù cuò。
examples.en: In this exam, not only he but the other students all did well too.

examples.zh: 你放心,该准备的东西我也都准备好了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, gāi zhǔn bèi de dōng xī wǒ yě dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le。
examples.en: Rest assured; I've prepared all the things that needed preparing too.

examples.zh: 他们兄弟几个也都很孝顺,轮流照顾着老人。
examples.pinyin: Tā men xiōng dì jǐ gè yě dōu hěn xiào shùn, lún liú zhào gù zhe lǎo rén。
examples.en: The brothers are all filial too, taking turns caring for the elderly.

examples.zh: 除了你,我们也都觉得这个方案挺可行的。
examples.pinyin: Chú le nǐ, wǒ men yě dōu jué de zhè ge fāng àn tǐng kě xíng de。
examples.en: Besides you, we all think this plan is quite feasible too.

examples.zh: 那几件旧衣服我也都送人了,家里清爽多了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jǐ jiàn jiù yī fú wǒ yě dōu sòng rén le, jiā lǐ qīng shuǎng duō le。
examples.en: I gave away those old clothes too; the home is much tidier.

examples.zh: 不光是孩子,连大人也都被这个故事感动了。
examples.pinyin: Bù guāng shì hái zi, lián dà rén yě dōu bèi zhè ge gù shì gǎn dòng le。
examples.en: Not just the children, even the adults were all moved by this story.

examples.zh: 这些道理我也都懂,只是一时做不到罢了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē dào lǐ wǒ yě dōu dǒng, zhǐ shì yī shí zuò bú dào bà le。
examples.en: I understand all these principles too; I just can't do them for now.

examples.zh: 他会的那几门外语,我也都学过一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì de nà jǐ mén wài yǔ, wǒ yě dōu xué guò yì diǎn ér。
examples.en: The foreign languages he knows, I've studied a bit of them all too.

examples.zh: 邻居们也都很热心,搬家那天来了不少人帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Lín jū men yě dōu hěn rè xīn, bān jiā nà tiān lái le bù shǎo rén bāng máng。
examples.en: The neighbors are all warm-hearted too; many came to help on moving day.

examples.zh: 你说的那些地方,我以前也都去过。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de nà xiē dì fāng, wǒ yǐ qián yě dōu qù guò。
examples.en: The places you mentioned, I've been to them all before too.

examples.zh: 这次活动,老师和同学也都积极地参加了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huó dòng, lǎo shī hé tóng xué yě dōu jī jí de cān jiā le。
examples.en: In this event, teachers and students all took part actively too.

examples.zh: 剩下的那点儿活儿,我也都替你干完了。
examples.pinyin: Shèng xià de nà diǎn ér huó er, wǒ yě dōu tì nǐ gàn wán le。
examples.en: I finished all the remaining bit of work for you too.

examples.zh: 他提出的意见,大家也都表示赞同。
examples.pinyin: Tā tí chū de yì jiàn, dà jiā yě dōu biǎo shì zàn tóng。
examples.en: Everyone agreed with all the opinions he raised too.

examples.zh: 这些照片背后的故事,他也都一一讲给我们听。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān bèi hòu de gù shì, tā yě dōu yī yī jiǎng gěi wǒ men tīng。
examples.en: He told us all the stories behind these photos one by one too.

examples.zh: 不只是我,身边的朋友也都很看好你的未来。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhǐ shì wǒ, shēn biān de péng yǒu yě dōu hěn kàn hǎo nǐ de wèi lái。
examples.en: Not just me, the friends around me are all optimistic about your future too.

examples.zh: 那些难题,经过大家的努力也都一个个解决了。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiē nán tí, jīng guò dà jiā de nǔ lì yě dōu yí gè gè jiě jué le。
examples.en: Those tough problems were all solved one by one through everyone's effort too.

examples.zh: 你担心的那几点,我也都替你考虑到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dān xīn de nà jǐ diǎn, wǒ yě dōu tì nǐ kǎo lǜ dào le。
examples.en: The points you were worried about, I've considered them all for you too.

examples.zh: 这几年他去过的城市,我也都差不多去遍了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián tā qù guò de chéng shì, wǒ yě dōu chà bu duō qù biàn le。
examples.en: The cities he's visited these years, I've been to nearly all of them too.

examples.zh: 散场以后,该关的灯、该锁的门也都处理好了。
examples.pinyin: Sàn chǎng yǐ hòu, gāi guān de dēng、 gāi suǒ de mén yě dōu chǔ lǐ hǎo le。
examples.en: After the event, all the lights and doors were taken care of too.

examples.zh: 他推荐的那些书,我后来也都找来读了一遍。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuī jiàn de nà xiē shū, wǒ hòu lái yě dōu zhǎo lái dú le yī biàn。
examples.en: The books he recommended, I later found and read them all too.

examples.zh: 这次的损失我们也都认了,重要的是吸取教训。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de sǔn shī wǒ men yě dōu rèn le, zhòng yào de shì xī qǔ jiào xùn。
examples.en: We've accepted all these losses too; what matters is learning the lesson.

examples.zh: 孩子们长大以后也都各自成了家,过得很好。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men zhǎng dà yǐ hòu yě dōu gè zì chéng le jiā, guò de hěn hǎo。
examples.en: After growing up, the children all started their own families too and live well.

examples.zh: 你交代的事情,我也都一件不落地办妥了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiāo dài de shì qíng, wǒ yě dōu yī jiàn bù luò de bàn tuǒ le。
examples.en: The things you assigned, I handled them all without missing one too.

examples.zh: 这些年经历过的酸甜苦辣,我们也都一起走过来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē nián jīng lì guò de suān tián kǔ là, wǒ men yě dōu yì qǐ zǒu guò lái le。
examples.en: The ups and downs of these years, we've been through them all together too.

title: "那么/这么" ile derece vurgusu
summary: "这么" (bu kadar) ve "那么" (o kadar) bir sıfatın derecesini vurgular: 这么冷 = bu kadar soğuk; 那么远 = o kadar uzak.
explanation: "这么" ve "那么" bir sıfatın (ya da fiilin) önüne gelip DERECEYİ vurgular: "bu kadar, şu kadar, o kadar, böylesine". "这么" konuşmacıya YAKIN olanı (buradaki, şimdiki): 今天这么冷,多穿点 (Bugün bu kadar soğuk, kalın giyin). "那么" konuşmacıdan UZAK olanı ya da bilinen bir dereceyi: 他家那么远,你怎么去? (Evi o kadar uzak, nasıl gideceksin?). İkisi de sıfatın derecesini güçlendirir ve çoğu zaman şaşkınlık, vurgu ya da bir sebep/sonuç bağı taşır: 你怎么走得这么快? (Nasıl bu kadar hızlı yürüyorsun?). "这么/那么 + sıfat + 的" bir ismi de niteleyebilir: 这么好的机会 (böyle iyi bir fırsat). Türkçedeki "bu kadar, o kadar, böylesine, şu kadar" derece belirteçlerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 今天怎么这么冷,昨天还挺暖和的呢。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān zěn me zhè me lěng, zuó tiān hái tǐng nuǎn huo de ne。
examples.en: Why is it so cold today? Yesterday was quite warm.

examples.zh: 他家离这儿那么远,你还是坐车去吧。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā lí zhè ér nà me yuǎn, nǐ hái shì zuò chē qù ba。
examples.en: His home is so far from here; you'd better take a car.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会,你可千万别错过了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo de jī huì, nǐ kě qiān wàn bié cuò guò le。
examples.en: Such a good opportunity — you must not miss it.

examples.zh: 你怎么走得这么快,我都快跟不上了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me zǒu de zhè me kuài, wǒ dōu kuài gēn bù shàng le。
examples.en: Why do you walk so fast? I can hardly keep up.

examples.zh: 外面那么吵,你还能睡得着,真佩服你。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn nà me chǎo, nǐ hái néng shuì de zhe, zhēn pèi fú nǐ。
examples.en: It's so noisy outside, yet you can sleep; I admire you.

examples.zh: 这道题没有你想的那么难,静下心来就会了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí méi yǒu nǐ xiǎng de nà me nán, jìng xià xīn lái jiù huì le。
examples.en: This problem isn't as hard as you think; calm down and you'll get it.

examples.zh: 他年纪这么小,懂的道理却那么多。
examples.pinyin: Tā nián jì zhè me xiǎo, dǒng de dào lǐ què nà me duō。
examples.en: He's so young, yet understands so much.

examples.zh: 你别把事情想得那么复杂,其实很简单。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié bǎ shì qíng xiǎng de nà me fù zá, qí shí hěn jiǎn dān。
examples.en: Don't think of it as so complicated; it's actually simple.

examples.zh: 这条鱼这么新鲜,清蒸最能吃出原味。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú zhè me xīn xiān, qīng zhēng zuì néng chī chū yuán wèi。
examples.en: This fish is so fresh; steaming brings out its natural flavor best.

examples.zh: 天都这么晚了,你怎么还不回家?
examples.pinyin: Tiān dōu zhè me wǎn le, nǐ zěn me hái bù huí jiā?
examples.en: It's so late already; why aren't you going home?

examples.zh: 那家餐厅那么贵,我们还是换一家吧。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cān tīng nà me guì, wǒ men hái shì huàn yī jiā ba。
examples.en: That restaurant is so expensive; let's try another.

examples.zh: 你对我这么好,我真不知道该怎么感谢你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì wǒ zhè me hǎo, wǒ zhēn bù zhī dào gāi zěn me gǎn xiè nǐ。
examples.en: You're so good to me; I don't know how to thank you.

examples.zh: 这个孩子那么懂事,让人看了特别心疼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hái zi nà me dǒng shì, ràng rén kàn le tè bié xīn téng。
examples.en: This child is so sensible; it makes one's heart ache with tenderness.

examples.zh: 路上车那么多,你开车一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng chē nà me duō, nǐ kāi chē yí dìng yào xiǎo xīn。
examples.en: There's so much traffic; do drive carefully.

examples.zh: 你怎么把房间收拾得这么干净,我都认不出来了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me bǎ fáng jiān shōu shí de zhè me gān jìng, wǒ dōu rèn bù chū lái le。
examples.en: How did you clean the room so spotless? I hardly recognize it.

examples.zh: 他说得那么诚恳,我实在没办法拒绝。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de nà me chéng kěn, wǒ shí zài méi bàn fǎ jù jué。
examples.en: He spoke so sincerely that I really couldn't refuse.

examples.zh: 这本书这么厚,你一个星期就看完了?
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhè me hòu, nǐ yí gè xīng qī jiù kàn wán le?
examples.en: This book is so thick; you finished it in a week?

examples.zh: 天气这么好,不出去走走真是可惜了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zhè me hǎo, bù chū qù zǒu zǒu zhēn shì kě xī le。
examples.en: The weather is so nice; it'd be a pity not to go out.

examples.zh: 你别站得那么远,过来一起照张相。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié zhàn de nà me yuǎn, guò lái yì qǐ zhào zhāng xiāng。
examples.en: Don't stand so far away; come take a photo together.

examples.zh: 他对工作那么认真,难怪领导那么信任他。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōng zuò nà me rèn zhēn, nán guài lǐng dǎo nà me xìn rèn tā。
examples.en: He's so serious about work; no wonder the boss trusts him.

examples.zh: 这么重的东西,你一个人怎么搬得动?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng de dōng xī, nǐ yí gè rén zěn me bān de dòng?
examples.en: Such heavy things — how can you carry them alone?

examples.zh: 没想到这么简单的办法,竟然那么管用。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎng dào zhè me jiǎn dān de bàn fǎ, jìng rán nà me guǎn yòng。
examples.en: I didn't expect such a simple method to be so effective.

examples.zh: 你笑得这么开心,是不是有什么好事?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiào de zhè me kāi xīn, shì bú shì yǒu shén me hǎo shì?
examples.en: You're laughing so happily; did something good happen?

examples.zh: 他们俩关系那么好,几乎形影不离。
examples.pinyin: Tā men liǎ guān xì nà me hǎo, jī hū xíng yǐng bù lí。
examples.en: The two are so close; they're almost inseparable.

examples.zh: 这么冷的天,他还坚持每天晨跑,真有毅力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me lěng de tiān, tā hái jiān chí měi tiān chén pǎo, zhēn yǒu yì lì。
examples.en: In such cold weather, he still runs every morning; what perseverance.

title: "挺...的" ile "epeyce, oldukça"
summary: "挺...的" (tǐng...de) bir niteliğin "epeyce, oldukça, bir hayli" olduğunu bildirir: 挺好的 = epey iyi; 挺贵的 = oldukça pahalı.
explanation: "挺" bir sıfatın (ya da bazı duygu fiillerinin) önüne gelip "epeyce, oldukça, bir hayli" anlamı verir ve neredeyse her zaman cümle sonunda "的" ile tamamlanır: 挺好的 (epey iyi), 挺累的 (bir hayli yorgun), 这地方挺安静的 (Burası epey sessiz). "很"e benzer ama "挺...的" daha KONUŞMA DİLİNE ait, samimi ve biraz daha yumuşak/ölçülü bir derece bildirir. Sondaki "的" bu kalıbın karakteristik parçasıdır; çoğu zaman düşmez. "挺 + sıfat" bir ismi de niteleyebilir: 挺好的一个人 (epey iyi biri). Türkçedeki "epeyce, oldukça, bir hayli, gayet" karşılıklarına denk gelir; günlük, rahat bir üslupla derece bildirmenin yaygın bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 这家小店的东西挺便宜的,味道也不错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de dōng xī tǐng pián yi de, wèi dào yě bù cuò。
examples.en: This little shop's items are quite cheap, and the taste is good too.

examples.zh: 忙了一天,他看上去挺累的,你别再打扰他了。
examples.pinyin: Máng le yī tiān, tā kàn shàng qù tǐng lèi de, nǐ bié zài dǎ rǎo tā le。
examples.en: After a busy day he looks quite tired; don't bother him anymore.

examples.zh: 这个人虽然话不多,但是心眼儿挺好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge rén suī rán huà bù duō, dàn shì xīn yǎn ér tǐng hǎo de。
examples.en: Though this person doesn't talk much, he's quite kind-hearted.

examples.zh: 你今天穿的这件衣服挺好看的,在哪儿买的?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān chuān de zhè jiàn yī fú tǐng hǎo kàn de, zài nǎ ér mǎi de?
examples.en: The outfit you're wearing today is quite nice; where did you buy it?

examples.zh: 这部电影挺感人的,我看的时候差点儿哭了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng tǐng gǎn rén de, wǒ kàn de shí hòu chà diǎn ér kū le。
examples.en: This movie is quite touching; I almost cried watching it.

examples.zh: 新来的同事挺热情的,主动帮了我不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Xīn lái de tóng shì tǐng rè qíng de, zhǔ dòng bāng le wǒ bù shǎo máng。
examples.en: The new colleague is quite warm; she helped me a lot proactively.

examples.zh: 这几天天气挺闷的,估计快要下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tiān qì tǐng mèn de, gū jì kuài yào xià yǔ le。
examples.en: The weather's been quite muggy these days; rain is probably coming.

examples.zh: 这道题挺有意思的,我想了半天才做出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí tǐng yǒu yì si de, wǒ xiǎng le bàn tiān cái zuò chū lái。
examples.en: This problem is quite interesting; I thought hard before solving it.

examples.zh: 他做的饭挺好吃的,没想到他还有这手艺。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de fàn tǐng hǎo chī de, méi xiǎng dào tā hái yǒu zhè shǒu yì。
examples.en: The food he cooked is quite tasty; I didn't know he had this skill.

examples.zh: 这个地方挺安静的,很适合看书和休息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dì fāng tǐng ān jìng de, hěn shì hé kàn shū hé xiū xī。
examples.en: This place is quite quiet, ideal for reading and resting.

examples.zh: 这台新买的手机用起来挺顺手的,反应也快。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái xīn mǎi de shǒu jī yòng qǐ lái tǐng shùn shǒu de, fǎn yìng yě kuài。
examples.en: This newly bought phone is quite handy to use and responds fast.

examples.zh: 他最近工作压力挺大的,你多关心关心他。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuì jìn gōng zuò yā lì tǐng dà de, nǐ duō guān xīn guān xīn tā。
examples.en: He's under quite a lot of work stress lately; do show him some care.

examples.zh: 这条路虽然远了点,但风景挺美的,不觉得累。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù suī rán yuǎn le diǎn, dàn fēng jǐng tǐng měi de, bù jué de lèi。
examples.en: Though this road is a bit far, the scenery is quite lovely, so it's not tiring.

examples.zh: 孩子这次考得挺不错的,进步很明显。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhè cì kǎo de tǐng bù cuò de, jìn bù hěn míng xiǎn。
examples.en: The child did quite well this time; the progress is obvious.

examples.zh: 这家酒店的服务挺周到的,住得很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔ diàn de fú wù tǐng zhōu dào de, zhù de hěn shū fú。
examples.en: This hotel's service is quite attentive; the stay was comfortable.

examples.zh: 他这个人挺实在的,答应的事从来不含糊。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè ge rén tǐng shí zài de, dā yìng de shì cóng lái bù hán hù。
examples.en: He's quite genuine; he never wavers on what he promises.

examples.zh: 外面风挺大的,你出门记得把外套的扣子扣好。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn fēng tǐng dà de, nǐ chū mén jì de bǎ wài tào de kòu zi kòu hǎo。
examples.en: It's quite windy outside; remember to button up your coat.

examples.zh: 这本书挺厚的,不过内容写得很吸引人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū tǐng hòu de, bù guò nèi róng xiě de hěn xī yǐn rén。
examples.en: This book is quite thick, but the content is very engaging.

examples.zh: 他们俩聊得挺投机的,一见面就有说不完的话。
examples.pinyin: Tā men liǎ liáo de tǐng tóu jī de, yī jiàn miàn jiù yǒu shuō bù wán de huà。
examples.en: The two got along quite well, with endless things to talk about.

examples.zh: 这次旅行安排得挺周到的,一路上都很顺利。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng ān pái de tǐng zhōu dào de, yī lù shàng dōu hěn shùn lì。
examples.en: This trip was quite well arranged; everything went smoothly.

examples.zh: 这种茶喝起来挺香的,回味还有点儿甜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng chá hē qǐ lái tǐng xiāng de, huí wèi hái yǒu diǎn ér tián。
examples.en: This tea is quite fragrant, with a slightly sweet aftertaste.

examples.zh: 他虽然嘴上不说,可心里挺在乎你的。
examples.pinyin: Tā suī rán zuǐ shàng bù shuō, kě xīn lǐ tǐng zài hū nǐ de。
examples.en: Though he doesn't say it, he cares about you quite a lot.

examples.zh: 这套房子采光挺好的,白天基本不用开灯。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào fáng zi cǎi guāng tǐng hǎo de, bái tiān jī běn bù yòng kāi dēng。
examples.en: This apartment gets quite good light; you hardly need lamps by day.

examples.zh: 这个周末过得挺充实的,既休息了又见了朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōu mò guò de tǐng chōng shí de, jì xiū xī le yòu jiàn le péng yǒu。
examples.en: This weekend was quite fulfilling; I both rested and saw friends.

examples.zh: 刚开始我还挺担心的,后来发现一切都很顺利。
examples.pinyin: Gāng kāi shǐ wǒ hái tǐng dān xīn de, hòu lái fā xiàn yī qiè dōu hěn shùn lì。
examples.en: At first I was quite worried, but later found everything went smoothly.

title: "比较" ile "nispeten, oldukça"
summary: "比较" (bǐjiào) bir niteliğin nispeten/oldukça yüksek olduğunu bildirir: 今天比较冷 = Bugün nispeten soğuk.
explanation: "比较" bir sıfatın önüne gelip "nispeten, oldukça, görece, epeyce" anlamı verir; açık bir kıyas nesnesi olmadan da bir niteliğin ORTA-YÜKSEK derecesini, ölçülü biçimde bildirir: 这个问题比较难 (Bu soru oldukça zor), 他性格比较内向 (Karakteri nispeten içe dönük), 今天人比较多 (Bugün epeyce kalabalık). "很"den daha ÖLÇÜLÜ, ihtiyatlı bir derece belirtir — "çok" değil, "görece". Sözlük anlamı "karşılaştırmak"tır (fiil), ama zarf olarak kıyaslamayı örtük bırakıp ölçülü bir derece verir. Türkçedeki "nispeten, oldukça, görece, epeyce" karşılıklarına denk gelir; kesin/abartılı olmadan bir niteliği belirtmenin yaygın, kibar bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 这道题比较难,你要是不会做,我可以教你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí bǐ jiào nán, nǐ yào shì bú huì zuò, wǒ kě yǐ jiào nǐ。
examples.en: This problem is rather hard; if you can't do it, I can teach you.

examples.zh: 他性格比较内向,不太喜欢在人多的地方说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā xìng gé bǐ jiào nèi xiàng, bù tài xǐ huān zài rén duō de dì fāng shuō huà。
examples.en: He's rather introverted and doesn't like speaking in crowds.

examples.zh: 周末超市里人比较多,咱们还是平时去吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò chāo shì lǐ rén bǐ jiào duō, zán men hái shì píng shí qù ba。
examples.en: The supermarket is rather crowded on weekends; let's go on a weekday.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅的口味比较清淡,很适合老人和孩子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng de kǒu wèi bǐ jiào qīng dàn, hěn shì hé lǎo rén hé hái zi。
examples.en: This restaurant's food is rather mild, suitable for the old and young.

examples.zh: 最近工作比较忙,我都没什么时间陪家人。
examples.pinyin: Zuì jìn gōng zuò bǐ jiào máng, wǒ dōu méi shén me shí jiān péi jiā rén。
examples.en: Work's been rather busy lately; I've had little time for family.

examples.zh: 这条路比较近,不过路面不太平,你开车小心点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bǐ jiào jìn, bù guò lù miàn bù tài píng, nǐ kāi chē xiǎo xīn diǎn。
examples.en: This road is rather short, but bumpy, so drive carefully.

examples.zh: 南方的冬天比较潮湿,北方人刚去可能不太习惯。
examples.pinyin: Nán fāng de dōng tiān bǐ jiào cháo shī, běi fāng rén gāng qù kě néng bù tài xí guàn。
examples.en: Southern winters are rather damp; northerners may not be used to it.

examples.zh: 他做事比较谨慎,每一步都会考虑得很周全。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì bǐ jiào jǐn shèn, měi yī bù dū huì kǎo lǜ de hěn zhōu quán。
examples.en: He's rather cautious, considering every step thoroughly.

examples.zh: 这几天天气比较好,适合出去晒晒被子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tiān qì bǐ jiào hǎo, shì hé chū qù shài shài bèi zi。
examples.en: The weather's rather nice these days, good for airing the quilts.

examples.zh: 我对历史比较感兴趣,常常看这方面的书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì lì shǐ bǐ jiào gǎn xìng qù, cháng cháng kàn zhè fāng miàn de shū。
examples.en: I'm rather interested in history and often read books on it.

examples.zh: 这个牌子的东西质量比较可靠,用着放心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge pái zi de dōng xī zhì liàng bǐ jiào kě kào, yòng zhe fàng xīn。
examples.en: This brand's quality is rather reliable; it's reassuring to use.

examples.zh: 早上路上车比较堵,你最好提前出门。
examples.pinyin: Zǎo shàng lù shàng chē bǐ jiào dǔ, nǐ zuì hǎo tí qián chū mén。
examples.en: Traffic is rather heavy in the morning; you'd best leave early.

examples.zh: 他说话比较直,你别往心里去,他没有恶意。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō huà bǐ jiào zhí, nǐ bié wǎng xīn lǐ qù, tā méi yǒu è yì。
examples.en: He's rather blunt; don't take it to heart, he means no harm.

examples.zh: 这种植物比较好养,不用天天浇水也能活。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhòng zhí wù bǐ jiào hǎo yǎng, bù yòng tiān tiān jiāo shuǐ yě néng huó。
examples.en: This plant is rather easy to keep; it survives without daily watering.

examples.zh: 今天的会议内容比较重要,大家都认真做了笔记。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān de huì yì nèi róng bǐ jiào zhòng yào, dà jiā dōu rèn zhēn zuò le bǐ jì。
examples.en: Today's meeting was rather important; everyone took careful notes.

examples.zh: 这份工作比较稳定,就是收入不算特别高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōng zuò bǐ jiào wěn dìng, jiù shì shōu rù bù suàn tè bié gāo。
examples.en: This job is rather stable, just the income isn't especially high.

examples.zh: 他年纪比较大了,爬这么高的山可能有点吃力。
examples.pinyin: Tā nián jì bǐ jiào dà le, pá zhè me gāo de shān kě néng yǒu diǎn chī lì。
examples.en: He's rather old; climbing such a high mountain may be a strain.

examples.zh: 这几个方案里,我觉得这个比较可行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ gè fāng àn lǐ, wǒ jué de zhè ge bǐ jiào kě xíng。
examples.en: Of these plans, I think this one is rather feasible.

examples.zh: 孩子这段时间比较听话,可能是长大懂事了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhè duàn shí jiān bǐ jiào tīng huà, kě néng shì zhǎng dà dǒng shì le。
examples.en: The child has been rather obedient lately; perhaps he's growing up.

examples.zh: 这家医院离得比较远,不过医生的水平很高。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yī yuàn lí de bǐ jiào yuǎn, bù guò yī shēng de shuǐ píng hěn gāo。
examples.en: This hospital is rather far, but the doctors are highly skilled.

examples.zh: 刚开始学的时候,发音比较难,慢慢就好了。
examples.pinyin: Gāng kāi shǐ xué de shí hòu, fā yīn bǐ jiào nán, màn màn jiù hǎo le。
examples.en: Pronunciation is rather hard at first, but it gets better gradually.

examples.zh: 这件衣服的款式比较简单,但是很耐看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú de kuǎn shì bǐ jiào jiǎn dān, dàn shì hěn nài kàn。
examples.en: This outfit's style is rather simple, but pleasing over time.

examples.zh: 他对这方面比较在行,有问题可以问他。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zhè fāng miàn bǐ jiào zài háng, yǒu wèn tí kě yǐ wèn tā。
examples.en: He's rather expert in this area; ask him if you have questions.

examples.zh: 今年的雨水比较多,河里的水位涨了不少。
examples.pinyin: Jīn nián de yǔ shuǐ bǐ jiào duō, hé lǐ de shuǐ wèi zhǎng le bù shǎo。
examples.en: There's been rather a lot of rain this year; the river rose quite a bit.

examples.zh: 这个时间段比较安静,适合专心看书或者工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shí jiān duàn bǐ jiào ān jìng, shì hé zhuān xīn kàn shū huò zhě gōng zuò。
examples.en: This time slot is rather quiet, good for focused reading or work.

title: "什么的" ile "falan, filan"
titleEn: Ending a non-exhaustive list with "shenme de"
summary: "什么的" (shénme de) bir listenin sonuna gelip "falan, filan, ve benzeri" anlamı verir: 苹果、香蕉什么的 = elma, muz falan.
explanation: "什么的" bir ya da birkaç örnek saydıktan sonra listenin sonuna eklenip "falan, filan, gibi şeyler, ve benzeri" anlamı verir; listenin TAM olmadığını, daha başka benzer öğelerin de olduğunu belirtir: 我买了些水果,苹果、香蕉什么的 (Biraz meyve aldım, elma muz falan), 周末喜欢看看书、听听音乐什么的 (Hafta sonu kitap okumak, müzik dinlemek gibi şeyler severim). Konuşma diline özgü, rahat bir ifadedir. Tek bir öğeden sonra da gelebilir: 喝点茶什么的 (çay falan iç). "等等" ve "之类的" ile benzer işlevdedir ama "什么的" en gündelik/samimi olanıdır. Türkçedeki "falan, filan, ...gibi şeyler, ve benzeri" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir listeyi açık uçlu, gündelik bir tonla bitirir.

examples.zh: 周末我喜欢在家看看书、听听音乐什么的,挺放松的。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ xǐ huān zài jiā kàn kàn shū、 tīng tīng yīn yuè shén me de, tǐng fàng sōng de。
examples.en: On weekends I like reading, listening to music and such at home; it's relaxing.

examples.zh: 你去超市的时候,顺便买点水果、酸奶什么的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù chāo shì de shí hòu, shùn biàn mǎi diǎn shuǐ guǒ、 suān nǎi shén me de。
examples.en: When you go to the supermarket, grab some fruit, yogurt and the like.

examples.zh: 他平时爱运动,跑步、打球什么的都很在行。
examples.pinyin: Tā píng shí ài yùn dòng, pǎo bù、 dǎ qiú shén me de dōu hěn zài háng。
examples.en: He loves sports; running, ball games and such, he's good at them all.

examples.zh: 桌子上放着些零食,瓜子、花生什么的,你随便吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe xiē líng shí, guā zi、 huā shēng shén me de, nǐ suí biàn chī。
examples.en: There are snacks on the table, seeds, peanuts and such; help yourself.

examples.zh: 搬家的时候,那些旧书、旧衣服什么的我都送人了。
examples.pinyin: Bān jiā de shí hòu, nà xiē jiù shū、 jiù yī fú shén me de wǒ dōu sòng rén le。
examples.en: When moving, I gave away all those old books, clothes and such.

examples.zh: 她包里总是装着纸巾、口红什么的,一应俱全。
examples.pinyin: Tā bāo lǐ zǒng shì zhuāng zhe zhǐ jīn、 kǒu hóng shén me de, yī yīng jù quán。
examples.en: Her bag always has tissues, lipstick and such, everything covered.

examples.zh: 过年要准备的东西可多了,春联、糖果什么的都得买。
examples.pinyin: Guò nián yào zhǔn bèi de dōng xī kě duō le, chūn lián、 táng guǒ shén me de dōu de mǎi。
examples.en: There's much to prepare for New Year: couplets, candy and such.

examples.zh: 闲下来的时候,他就喜欢养养花、钓钓鱼什么的。
examples.pinyin: Xián xià lái de shí hòu, tā jiù xǐ huān yǎng yǎng huā、 diào diào yú shén me de。
examples.en: In his free time, he likes tending flowers, fishing and such.

examples.zh: 感冒了多喝点热水,姜茶什么的,出出汗就好了。
examples.pinyin: Gǎn mào le duō hē diǎn rè shuǐ, jiāng chá shén me de, chū chū hàn jiù hǎo le。
examples.en: With a cold, drink hot water, ginger tea and such, sweat it out.

examples.zh: 我不太挑食,面条、米饭什么的都能吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài tiāo shí, miàn tiáo、 mǐ fàn shén me de dōu néng chī。
examples.en: I'm not picky; noodles, rice and such, I can eat them all.

examples.zh: 你有什么烦心事、不开心的什么的,都可以跟我说。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shén me fán xīn shì、 bù kāi xīn de shén me de, dōu kě yǐ gēn wǒ shuō。
examples.en: If you have worries, unhappy things and such, you can tell me.

examples.zh: 他房间里堆满了模型、玩具什么的,像个小型展览。
examples.pinyin: Tā fáng jiān lǐ duī mǎn le mó xíng、 wán jù shén me de, xiàng gè xiǎo xíng zhǎn lǎn。
examples.en: His room is piled with models, toys and such, like a mini exhibition.

examples.zh: 出门旅行,充电器、雨伞什么的可别忘了带。
examples.pinyin: Chū mén lǚ xíng, chōng diàn qì、 yǔ sǎn shén me de kě bié wàng le dài。
examples.en: When traveling, don't forget the charger, umbrella and such.

examples.zh: 这些琐事,交水电费、买菜什么的,一般都是我来做。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē suǒ shì, jiāo shuǐ diàn fèi、 mǎi cài shén me de, yì bān dōu shì wǒ lái zuò。
examples.en: These chores — paying bills, buying groceries and such — I usually do.

examples.zh: 他喜欢收集邮票、硬币什么的,已经攒了好多年了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐ huān shōu jí yóu piào、 yìng bì shén me de, yǐ jīng zǎn le hǎo duō nián le。
examples.en: He likes collecting stamps, coins and such; he's saved for years.

examples.zh: 你要是饿了,冰箱里有面包、鸡蛋什么的,自己热一下。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì è le, bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu miàn bāo、 jī dàn shén me de, zì jǐ rè yī xià。
examples.en: If you're hungry, there's bread, eggs and such in the fridge; heat them up.

examples.zh: 周末我们经常一起吃个饭、聊聊天什么的。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ men jīng cháng yì qǐ chī gè fàn、 liáo liáo tiān shén me de。
examples.en: On weekends we often eat together, chat and such.

examples.zh: 孩子的文具、书本什么的,开学前都得准备好。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi de wén jù、 shū běn shén me de, kāi xué qián dōu de zhǔn bèi hǎo。
examples.en: The child's stationery, books and such must be ready before school.

examples.zh: 他对做饭一窍不通,煮个面、下个饺子什么的都不会。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zuò fàn yī qiào bù tōng, zhǔ gè miàn、 xià gè jiǎo zi shén me de dōu bú huì。
examples.en: He knows nothing about cooking; noodles, dumplings and such, he can't make.

examples.zh: 退休以后,老人打打太极、下下棋什么的,日子过得挺充实。
examples.pinyin: Tuì xiū yǐ hòu, lǎo rén dǎ dǎ tài jí、 xià xià qí shén me de, rì zi guò de tǐng chōng shí。
examples.en: After retiring, the old man does tai chi, plays chess and such, a full life.

examples.zh: 你别老是买这些没用的小摆件什么的,家里都放不下了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié lǎo shì mǎi zhè xiē méi yòng de xiǎo bǎi jiàn shén me de, jiā lǐ dōu fàng bù xià le。
examples.en: Stop buying these useless little ornaments and such; there's no room left.

examples.zh: 生病的时候,有人送点花、水果什么的,心里就暖暖的。
examples.pinyin: Shēng bìng de shí hòu, yǒu rén sòng diǎn huā、 shuǐ guǒ shén me de, xīn lǐ jiù nuǎn nuǎn de。
examples.en: When ill, someone bringing flowers, fruit and such warms your heart.

title: "之类的" ile "...gibi şeyler"
summary: "之类的" (zhī lèi de) bir örnekten sonra "...gibi şeyler, ...türünden" anlamı verir: 像水果之类的 = meyve gibi şeyler.
explanation: "之类的" bir ya da birkaç örnek verdikten sonra "...gibi şeyler, ...türünden, o kategoriden" anlamı katar ve çoğu zaman "像...之类的" biçiminde kullanılır: 像苹果、橘子之类的水果 (elma, portakal gibi meyveler), 他喜欢看科幻、探险之类的电影 (Bilim kurgu, macera türü filmler sever). "什么的"ye benzer ama "之类的" biraz daha RESMÎ/yazılı dile yakındır ve çoğu zaman ardından bir KATEGORİ ismi gelir (之类的东西/电影/问题). Bir örneği bir sınıfın temsilcisi olarak sunup benzerlerini de kapsar. Türkçedeki "...gibi şeyler, ...türünden, ... ve benzerleri, o cinsten" ifadelerine denk gelir; örnek vererek bir kategoriyi anlatmanın düzgün bir yoludur.

title: "等/等等" ile liste bitirme
summary: "等" ya da "等等" (děng/děngděng) bir listeyi "vb., ve benzeri, gibi" diye bitirir: 苹果、香蕉等水果 = elma, muz gibi meyveler.
explanation: "等" (ya da ikilenmiş "等等") sayılan öğelerin ardına gelip listenin tam olmadığını, benzer başka öğelerin de bulunduğunu belirtir: "vb., ve benzeri, gibi, ve saire". İki kullanımı: (1) "等" + genel kategori — 北京、上海、广州等大城市 (Pekin, Şanghay, Guangzhou gibi büyük şehirler). (2) Liste sonunda tek başına "等" ya da "等等" — 我买了笔、本子、橡皮等等 (Kalem, defter, silgi vb. aldım). "什么的" ve "之类的"ye benzer ama "等/等等" en RESMÎ, yazılı ve akademik olanıdır; raporlarda, listelerde çok kullanılır. Bazen sayılan öğelerin tümünü toparlamak için de kullanılır ("等" + sayı: 三人). Türkçedeki "vb., ve benzeri, gibi, ve saire" karşılıklarına denk gelir; resmî listelerin standart bitiricisidir.

title: "不过" ile yumuşak "ama, yalnız"
summary: "不过" (búguò) hafif bir çekince/karşıtlık ekler: "ama, yalnız, ne var ki, gerçi": 这件衣服不错,不过有点儿贵 = Güzel, yalnız biraz pahalı.
explanation: "不过" "但是/可是"ye benzer bir "ama" bağlacıdır ama daha HAFİF, yumuşak bir çekince/dönüş katar: "ama, yalnız, ne var ki, gerçi, şu var ki". 这个方法很好,不过实施起来有点难 (Bu yöntem iyi, yalnız uygulaması biraz zor), 天气不错,不过风有点大 (Hava güzel, gerçi rüzgâr biraz sert). "但是"den daha küçük, tali bir karşıtlık ya da ek bilgi verir; çoğu zaman önceki olumlu ifadeye küçük bir düzeltme/uyarı ekler. İkinci cümlenin başında gelir. Konuşma dilinde çok yaygındır. "不过" ayrıca "sadece, yalnızca" anlamında da kullanılır (只不过). Türkçedeki "ama, yalnız, gerçi, ne var ki, şu var ki" gibi yumuşak karşıtlık ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 那本书内容很好,不过有点儿厚,得慢慢看。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn shū nèi róng hěn hǎo, bù guò yǒu diǎn ér hòu, de màn màn kàn。
examples.en: That book's content is good, only it's a bit thick, so read it slowly.

examples.zh: 他答应会来,不过可能会稍微晚一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Tā dā yìng huì lái, bù guò kě néng huì shāo wēi wǎn yì diǎn ér。
examples.en: He agreed to come, but he might be a little late.

examples.zh: 这件衣服样子不错,不过颜色我不太喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú yàng zi bù cuò, bù guò yán sè wǒ bù tài xǐ huān。
examples.en: This outfit's style is nice, only I don't quite like the color.

examples.zh: 这个计划挺好的,不过还有一些细节需要再讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jì huà tǐng hǎo de, bù guò hái yǒu yī xiē xì jié xū yào zài tǎo lùn。
examples.en: This plan is good, though some details still need discussing.

examples.zh: 今天的活动很成功,不过也暴露出一些小问题。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān de huó dòng hěn chéng gōng, bù guò yě bào lù chū yī xiē xiǎo wèn tí。
examples.en: Today's event was a success, though it revealed some minor issues.

examples.zh: 这条路是近一些,不过不太好走,你自己决定吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù shì jìn yī xiē, bù guò bù tài hǎo zǒu, nǐ zì jǐ jué dìng ba。
examples.en: This road is a bit shorter, but not easy to walk; you decide.

examples.zh: 他汉语说得不错,不过写字还需要多练习。
examples.pinyin: Tā hàn yǔ shuō de bù cuò, bù guò xiě zì hái xū yào duō liàn xí。
examples.en: His spoken Chinese is good, but his writing needs more practice.

examples.zh: 我很想去,不过那天正好有别的安排,去不了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù, bù guò nà tiān zhèng hǎo yǒu bié de ān pái, qù bù liǎo。
examples.en: I'd love to go, but I happen to have other plans that day.

examples.zh: 这个手机功能挺全的,不过电池不太耐用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shǒu jī gōng néng tǐng quán de, bù guò diàn chí bù tài nài yòng。
examples.en: This phone has full features, only the battery doesn't last well.

examples.zh: 孩子这次进步很大,不过还有提升的空间。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhè cì jìn bù hěn dà, bù guò hái yǒu tí shēng de kōng jiān。
examples.en: The child made great progress, though there's still room to improve.

examples.zh: 这道菜我尝了,味道不错,不过好像盐放少了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wǒ cháng le, wèi dào bù cuò, bù guò hǎo xiàng yán fàng shǎo le。
examples.en: I tasted this dish; it's good, only it seems a bit under-salted.

examples.zh: 他为人很热心,不过说话有点直,你别介意。
examples.pinyin: Tā wéi rén hěn rè xīn, bù guò shuō huà yǒu diǎn zhí, nǐ bié jiè yì。
examples.en: He's warm-hearted, but speaks a bit bluntly; don't mind it.

examples.zh: 这次考试题目不难,不过时间有点紧张。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì tí mù bù nán, bù guò shí jiān yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng。
examples.en: This exam wasn't hard, only the time was a bit tight.

examples.zh: 我们的座位挺好的,不过离舞台稍微远了一些。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men de zuò wèi tǐng hǎo de, bù guò lí wǔ tái shāo wēi yuǎn le yī xiē。
examples.en: Our seats are good, only a bit far from the stage.

examples.zh: 这份工作待遇不错,不过经常需要加班。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōng zuò dài yù bù cuò, bù guò jīng cháng xū yào jiā bān。
examples.en: This job pays well, but often requires overtime.

examples.zh: 那家店的服务很好,不过东西的种类不太多。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de fú wù hěn hǎo, bù guò dōng xī de zhǒng lèi bù tài duō。
examples.en: That shop's service is great, though the variety isn't wide.

examples.zh: 他答应帮忙了,不过要过几天才有时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā dā yìng bāng máng le, bù guò yào guò jǐ tiān cái yǒu shí jiān。
examples.en: He agreed to help, but won't have time for a few days.

examples.zh: 这个办法确实管用,不过操作起来比较麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bàn fǎ què shí guǎn yòng, bù guò cāo zuò qǐ lái bǐ jiào má fán。
examples.en: This method really works, only it's rather cumbersome to do.

examples.zh: 天气预报说今天晴,不过我看云挺多的。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō jīn tiān qíng, bù guò wǒ kàn yún tǐng duō de。
examples.en: The forecast said sunny today, but I see quite a lot of clouds.

examples.zh: 我大概明白你的意思了,不过还有一点没太懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dà gài míng bái nǐ de yì si le, bù guò hái yǒu yì diǎn méi tài dǒng。
examples.en: I roughly get your meaning, but there's still one bit I don't quite grasp.

title: "要不" ile öneri: "ya da, istersen"
summary: "要不" (yàobù) bir öneri/alternatif sunar: "istersen, ya da, olmazsa": 要不咱们改天再去? = İstersen başka gün gidelim mi?
explanation: "要不" (ya da "要不然") iki işlev taşır: (1) ÖNERİ/alternatif sunma — "istersen, ya da, olmazsa, ne dersin": 要不咱们坐出租车吧 (İstersen taksiye binelim), 你要是累了,要不先休息一下? (Yorulduysan, istersen biraz dinlensen?). (2) UYARI/aksi hâlde — "yoksa, aksi takdirde": 快点走,要不就迟到了 (Çabuk ol, yoksa geç kalacağız). İlk anlamda bir teklifi nazikçe ortaya atar; ikinci anlamda "不然" ile eş anlamlıdır. Cümle başında (ya da bir durum belirtildikten sonra) gelir. Türkçedeki "istersen, ya da, olmazsa, ne dersin" (öneri) ve "yoksa, aksi takdirde" (uyarı) ifadelerine denk gelir; günlük konuşmada öneri sunmanın çok yaygın bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅要排很久的队,要不咱们换一家吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng yào pái hěn jiǔ de duì, yào bù zán men huàn yī jiā ba。
examples.en: This restaurant has a long queue; how about we go elsewhere?

examples.zh: 你看起来很累,要不今天就早点回去休息?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn lèi, yào bù jīn tiān jiù zǎo diǎn huí qù xiū xī?
examples.en: You look tired; how about heading back to rest early today?

examples.zh: 外面雨还没停,要不你再等一会儿再走?
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn yǔ hái méi tíng, yào bù nǐ zài děng yī huì er zài zǒu?
examples.en: The rain hasn't stopped; how about waiting a bit longer before leaving?

examples.zh: 这个问题咱们讨论不出结果,要不先放一放?
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí zán men tǎo lùn bù chū jié guǒ, yào bù xiān fàng yī fàng?
examples.en: We can't resolve this by discussion; how about we set it aside for now?

examples.zh: 你一个人搬不动这个箱子,要不我来帮你?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yí gè rén bān bù dòng zhè ge xiāng zi, yào bù wǒ lái bāng nǐ?
examples.en: You can't move this box alone; how about I help you?

examples.zh: 时间还早,要不咱们再去别的地方转转?
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān hái zǎo, yào bù zán men zài qù bié de dì fāng zhuǎn zhuǎn?
examples.en: It's still early; how about we go explore somewhere else?

examples.zh: 你要是拿不定主意,要不问问家里人的意见?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì ná bù dìng zhǔ yì, yào bù wèn wèn jiā lǐ rén de yì jiàn?
examples.en: If you can't decide, how about asking your family's opinion?

examples.zh: 今天人太多了,要不我们明天再来?
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān rén tài duō le, yào bù wǒ men míng tiān zài lái?
examples.en: It's too crowded today; how about we come again tomorrow?

examples.zh: 这道题太难了,要不咱们跳过去先做后面的?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí tài nán le, yào bù zán men tiào guò qù xiān zuò hòu miàn de?
examples.en: This problem is too hard; how about we skip it and do the rest first?

examples.zh: 你快点儿吧,要不电影就要开始了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kuài diǎn ér ba, yào bù diàn yǐng jiù yào kāi shǐ le。
examples.en: Hurry up, or the movie's about to start.

examples.zh: 菜好像不太够,要不再加一个菜?
examples.pinyin: Cài hǎo xiàng bù tài gòu, yào bù zài jiā yí gè cài?
examples.en: The food seems a bit short; how about ordering one more dish?

examples.zh: 天快黑了,要不我们抓紧下山吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān kuài hēi le, yào bù wǒ men zhuā jǐn xià shān ba。
examples.en: It's getting dark; how about we hurry down the mountain?

examples.zh: 你既然那么喜欢,要不就买下来吧,别犹豫了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì rán nà me xǐ huān, yào bù jiù mǎi xià lái ba, bié yóu yù le。
examples.en: Since you like it so much, how about just buying it? Don't hesitate.

examples.zh: 这条路好像堵住了,要不我们绕另一条路走?
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hǎo xiàng dǔ zhù le, yào bù wǒ men rào lìng yī tiáo lù zǒu?
examples.en: This road seems jammed; how about we take another route?

examples.zh: 你别一个人待着了,要不出来跟大家聊聊天?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié yí gè rén dài zhe le, yào bù chū lái gēn dà jiā liáo liáo tiān?
examples.en: Don't stay alone; how about coming out to chat with everyone?

examples.zh: 快把外套穿上,要不一会儿该着凉了。
examples.pinyin: Kuài bǎ wài tào chuān shàng, yào bù yī huì er gāi zháo liáng le。
examples.en: Put on your coat, or you'll catch a chill soon.

examples.zh: 这么晚了叫外卖也麻烦,要不我下厨给你做点?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le jiào wài mài yě má fán, yào bù wǒ xià chú gěi nǐ zuò diǎn?
examples.en: Ordering in this late is a hassle; how about I cook something for you?

examples.zh: 你既然不放心,要不我陪你一起去看看?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì rán bù fàng xīn, yào bù wǒ péi nǐ yì qǐ qù kàn kàn?
examples.en: Since you're worried, how about I go with you to check?

examples.zh: 这个周末没什么安排,要不咱们去郊外走走?
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōu mò méi shén me ān pái, yào bù zán men qù jiāo wài zǒu zǒu?
examples.en: There's nothing planned this weekend; how about a trip to the countryside?

examples.zh: 你得赶紧把作业交上去,要不老师又该批评你了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi gǎn jǐn bǎ zuò yè jiāo shàng qù, yào bù lǎo shī yòu gāi pī píng nǐ le。
examples.en: Hand in your homework quickly, or the teacher will scold you again.

examples.zh: 既然大家意见不一致,要不我们投票决定吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán dà jiā yì jiàn bù yī zhì, yào bù wǒ men tóu piào jué dìng ba。
examples.en: Since opinions differ, how about we decide by voting?

examples.zh: 你脸色不太好,要不去医院检查一下比较放心?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ liǎn sè bù tài hǎo, yào bù qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá yī xià bǐ jiào fàng xīn?
examples.en: You don't look well; how about a hospital checkup to be safe?

examples.zh: 这些活儿一个人干太累,要不咱们分一分?
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē huó er yí gè rén gàn tài lèi, yào bù zán men fēn yī fēn?
examples.en: Doing all this alone is tiring; how about we split it up?

examples.zh: 你要是没时间做饭,要不我们出去吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì méi shí jiān zuò fàn, yào bù wǒ men chū qù chī ba。
examples.en: If you have no time to cook, how about we eat out?

examples.zh: 我实在想不出好办法,要不你来出个主意?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shí zài xiǎng bù chū hǎo bàn fǎ, yào bù nǐ lái chū gè zhǔ yì?
examples.en: I really can't think of a good idea; how about you suggest one?

title: "还有" ile "ayrıca, bir de"
summary: "还有" (háiyǒu) bir listeye ya da açıklamaya ekleme yapar: "ayrıca, bir de, dahası": ...还有,别忘了带钱 = Bir de, parayı almayı unutma.
explanation: "还有" bir öğe ya da bilgi ekler: "ayrıca, bir de, dahası, bir şey daha". İki kullanımı: (1) Bir listeye öğe eklemek — 我买了苹果、香蕉,还有一些橘子 (Elma, muz, bir de biraz portakal aldım). (2) Yeni bir nokta/hatırlatma eklemek, çoğu zaman cümle başında — 还有,明天记得早点来 (Bir de, yarın erken gelmeyi unutma). Sözlük anlamı "hâlâ var / daha var"dır (还 + 有), ama bağlaç gibi ek bilgi tanıtır. "另外" ve "再说" ile benzer işlevdedir ama "还有" en gündelik/basit olanıdır. Türkçedeki "ayrıca, bir de, dahası, bir şey daha" ifadelerine denk gelir; konuşurken sonradan akla gelen bir ekleme yapmanın doğal yoludur.

examples.zh: 你去超市,买点米、油,还有一些鸡蛋回来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù chāo shì, mǎi diǎn mǐ、 yóu, hái yǒu yī xiē jī dàn huí lái。
examples.en: Go to the supermarket for rice, oil, and also some eggs.

examples.zh: 这次旅行,我们去了长城、故宫,还有颐和园。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng, wǒ men qù le cháng chéng、 gù gōng, hái yǒu yí hé yuán。
examples.en: On this trip we visited the Great Wall, the Palace Museum, and the Summer Palace too.

examples.zh: 走之前记得关灯、锁门,还有别忘了带钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Zǒu zhī qián jì de guān dēng、 suǒ mén, hái yǒu bié wàng le dài yào shi。
examples.en: Before leaving, turn off the lights, lock the door, and don't forget your keys.

examples.zh: 他会弹钢琴、拉小提琴,还有一手好书法。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì tán gāng qín、 lā xiǎo tí qín, hái yǒu yī shǒu hǎo shū fǎ。
examples.en: He can play piano, violin, and also has fine calligraphy.

examples.zh: 这道菜要放葱、姜、蒜,还有一点点糖提味。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài yào fàng cōng、 jiāng、 suàn, hái yǒu yì diǎn diǎn táng tí wèi。
examples.en: This dish needs scallion, ginger, garlic, and a bit of sugar for flavor.

examples.zh: 参加会议的有经理、几位同事,还有两位客户。
examples.pinyin: Cān jiā huì yì de yǒu jīng lǐ、 jǐ wèi tóng shì, hái yǒu liǎng wèi kè hù。
examples.en: Attending the meeting are the manager, some colleagues, and two clients.

examples.zh: 你要准备好身份证、车票,还有一些换洗的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhǔn bèi hǎo shēn fèn zhèng、 chē piào, hái yǒu yī xiē huàn xǐ de yī fú。
examples.en: Prepare your ID, tickets, and also some change of clothes.

examples.zh: 我喜欢看书、听音乐,还有偶尔画画。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huān kàn shū、 tīng yīn yuè, hái yǒu ǒu ěr huà huà。
examples.en: I like reading, listening to music, and occasionally painting too.

examples.zh: 桌上有水果、点心,还有刚泡好的热茶,随便用。
examples.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu shuǐ guǒ、 diǎn xīn, hái yǒu gāng pào hǎo de rè chá, suí biàn yòng。
examples.en: There's fruit, snacks, and freshly brewed tea on the table; help yourself.

examples.zh: 这件事得跟经理说一声,还有,也要通知一下财务。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de gēn jīng lǐ shuō yī shēng, hái yǒu, yě yào tōng zhī yī xià cái wù。
examples.en: We must inform the manager, and also notify the finance department.

examples.zh: 行李里装了衣服、洗漱用品,还有几本路上看的书。
examples.pinyin: Xíng lǐ lǐ zhuāng le yī fú、 xǐ shù yòng pǐn, hái yǒu jǐ běn lù shàng kàn de shū。
examples.en: The luggage holds clothes, toiletries, and a few books for the road.

examples.zh: 这个周末我要打扫房间、洗衣服,还有去趟菜市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ yào dǎ sǎo fáng jiān、 xǐ yī fú, hái yǒu qù tàng cài shì chǎng。
examples.en: This weekend I'll clean the room, do laundry, and go to the market too.

examples.zh: 他不但学习好,人也很热心,还有一副好嗓子。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù dàn xué xí hǎo, rén yě hěn rè xīn, hái yǒu yī fù hǎo sǎng zi。
examples.en: He not only studies well but is warm-hearted, and has a fine voice too.

examples.zh: 这家店卖文具、书本,还有各种各样的小玩具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài wén jù、 shū běn, hái yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de xiǎo wán jù。
examples.en: This shop sells stationery, books, and all kinds of little toys too.

examples.zh: 你把窗户关好,把火关掉,还有,记得给花浇点水。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ chuāng hù guān hǎo, bǎ huǒ guān diào, hái yǒu, jì de gěi huā jiāo diǎn shuǐ。
examples.en: Close the windows, turn off the stove, and also water the flowers.

examples.zh: 这次考试考语文、数学,还有英语,一共三门。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì kǎo yǔ wén、 shù xué, hái yǒu yīng yǔ, yī gòng sān mén。
examples.en: This exam covers Chinese, math, and English — three subjects in all.

examples.zh: 他的优点是踏实、认真,还有很强的责任心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yōu diǎn shì tà shí、 rèn zhēn, hái yǒu hěn qiáng de zé rèn xīn。
examples.en: His strengths are being down-to-earth, careful, and very responsible too.

examples.zh: 我们准备了饮料、零食,还有一个大蛋糕给她庆生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zhǔn bèi le yǐn liào、 líng shí, hái yǒu yí gè dà dàn gāo gěi tā qìng shēng。
examples.en: We prepared drinks, snacks, and a big cake to celebrate her birthday.

examples.zh: 你先把这几件事办了,还有,别忘了回复那封邮件。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ zhè jǐ jiàn shì bàn le, hái yǒu, bié wàng le huí fù nà fēng yóu jiàn。
examples.en: Handle these few things first, and also don't forget to reply to that email.

examples.zh: 这附近有超市、银行,还有一家不错的医院。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fù jìn yǒu chāo shì、 yín háng, hái yǒu yī jiā bù cuò de yī yuàn。
examples.en: Nearby there's a supermarket, a bank, and also a decent hospital.

examples.zh: 我想跟你说的,一是感谢,二是道歉,还有一个请求。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shuō de, yī shì gǎn xiè, èr shì dào qiàn, hái yǒu yí gè qǐng qiú。
examples.en: What I want to tell you: thanks, an apology, and also a request.

examples.zh: 他给孩子买了书包、文具,还有一双新运动鞋。
examples.pinyin: Tā gěi hái zi mǎi le shū bāo、 wén jù, hái yǒu yī shuāng xīn yùn dòng xié。
examples.en: He bought the child a schoolbag, stationery, and new sports shoes too.

examples.zh: 这道菜的关键是火候、时间,还有调料的比例。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de guān jiàn shì huǒ hòu、 shí jiān, hái yǒu tiáo liào de bǐ lì。
examples.en: The keys to this dish are heat, timing, and the seasoning ratio too.

examples.zh: 你要注意休息、按时吃药,还有别再熬夜了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zhù yì xiū xī、 àn shí chī yào, hái yǒu bié zài áo yè le。
examples.en: Mind your rest, take medicine on time, and stop staying up late too.

examples.zh: 展览上有绘画、摄影,还有一些手工艺品。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎn lǎn shàng yǒu huì huà、 shè yǐng, hái yǒu yī xiē shǒu gōng yì pǐn。
examples.en: The exhibition has paintings, photography, and some handicrafts too.

title: "另外" ile "ayrıca, başka, öte yandan"
summary: "另外" (lìngwài) yeni/ayrı bir şey ekler: "ayrıca, bunun dışında, başka, öte yandan": 另外,我还有件事跟你说 = Ayrıca, sana söyleyecek bir şeyim daha var.
explanation: "另外" bir öncekinden AYRI, ek bir konu/öğe getirir: "ayrıca, bunun dışında, başka, öte yandan". İki kullanımı: (1) Bağlaç gibi yeni bir nokta tanıtma, çoğu zaman cümle başında — 这件事就这么定了。另外,下周的安排也得讨论一下 (Bu böyle kararlaştı. Ayrıca gelecek haftanın planını da konuşmalıyız). (2) Sıfat/belirteç gibi "başka bir, diğer" — 我们另外找个时间谈吧 (Başka bir zaman konuşalım), 这是另外一回事 (Bu başka bir mesele). "还有"dan biraz daha RESMÎ ve genelde birbirinden ayrı, bağımsız konuları eklerken kullanılır. Türkçedeki "ayrıca, bunun dışında, öte yandan, başka bir" ifadelerine denk gelir; ayrı bir konu ya da seçenek eklemenin düzgün bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 这个方案基本可以了,另外,预算部分还需要再核对一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fāng àn jī běn kě yǐ le, lìng wài, yù suàn bù fèn hái xū yào zài hé duì yī xià。
examples.en: This plan is basically fine; also, the budget part needs rechecking.

examples.zh: 你把报告交给我,另外,再准备一份给客户。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ bào gào jiāo gěi wǒ, lìng wài, zài zhǔn bèi yī fèn gěi kè hù。
examples.en: Hand me the report; also, prepare another one for the client.

examples.zh: 今天就聊到这儿吧,另外的事情咱们改天再说。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān jiù liáo dào zhè ér ba, lìng wài de shì qíng zán men gǎi tiān zài shuō。
examples.en: Let's stop here today; we'll discuss the other matters another day.

examples.zh: 这次没选上没关系,另外还有很多机会等着你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì méi xuǎn shàng méi guān xì, lìng wài hái yǒu hěn duō jī huì děng zhe nǐ。
examples.en: It's fine you weren't chosen; there are many other chances waiting.

examples.zh: 这件衣服有点小,麻烦你另外给我拿一件大号的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú yǒu diǎn xiǎo, má fán nǐ lìng wài gěi wǒ ná yī jiàn dà hào de。
examples.en: This outfit's a bit small; please get me another in a larger size.

examples.zh: 会议定在周三,另外,请大家提前把材料看一遍。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì dìng zài zhōu sān, lìng wài, qǐng dà jiā tí qián bǎ cái liào kàn yī biàn。
examples.en: The meeting is Wednesday; also, please review the materials beforehand.

examples.zh: 这两件事没什么关系,是另外两回事,别混在一起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì méi shén me guān xì, shì lìng wài liǎng huí shì, bié hùn zài yì qǐ。
examples.en: These two matters are unrelated, two separate things; don't mix them.

examples.zh: 这笔钱先付房租,另外的部分留着应急。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián xiān fù fáng zū, lìng wài de bù fèn liú zhe yìng jí。
examples.en: Use this money for rent first; keep the rest for emergencies.

examples.zh: 他除了会英语,另外还掌握了两门小语种。
examples.pinyin: Tā chú le huì yīng yǔ, lìng wài hái zhǎng wò le liǎng mén xiǎo yǔ zhǒng。
examples.en: Besides English, he's also mastered two less common languages.

examples.zh: 原来的计划不变,另外我再补充两点建议。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái de jì huà bù biàn, lìng wài wǒ zài bǔ chōng liǎng diǎn jiàn yì。
examples.en: The original plan stays; I'll add two more suggestions as well.

examples.zh: 这个房间给客人住,另外那间当书房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fáng jiān gěi kè rén zhù, lìng wài nà jiān dāng shū fáng。
examples.en: This room is for guests; that other one will be the study.

examples.zh: 你先把这些做完,另外的任务下午再安排。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ zhè xiē zuò wán, lìng wài de rèn wù xià wǔ zài ān pái。
examples.en: Finish these first; the other tasks will be arranged in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 食材我都买好了,另外还准备了一些饮料。
examples.pinyin: Shí cái wǒ dōu mǎi hǎo le, lìng wài hái zhǔn bèi le yī xiē yǐn liào。
examples.en: I've bought all the ingredients; I also prepared some drinks.

examples.zh: 这件事我理解你的想法,另外也希望你听听我的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ lǐ jiě nǐ de xiǎng fǎ, lìng wài yě xī wàng nǐ tīng tīng wǒ de。
examples.en: I understand your view on this; I also hope you'll hear mine.

examples.zh: 原定的地点变了,咱们另外找个方便的地方见吧。
examples.pinyin: Yuán dìng de dì diǎn biàn le, zán men lìng wài zhǎo gè fāng biàn de dì fāng jiàn ba。
examples.en: The original venue changed; let's find another convenient place to meet.

examples.zh: 除了工资,公司另外还提供交通和餐饮补贴。
examples.pinyin: Chú le gōng zī, gōng sī lìng wài hái tí gōng jiāo tōng hé cān yǐn bǔ tiē。
examples.en: Besides salary, the company also provides transport and meal allowances.

examples.zh: 这个问题先放一放,另外我们谈谈下一步的计划。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí xiān fàng yī fàng, lìng wài wǒ men tán tán xià yī bù de jì huà。
examples.en: Let's set this aside; separately, let's talk about the next steps.

examples.zh: 这本书我看完了,另外我还想推荐你几本别的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn wán le, lìng wài wǒ hái xiǎng tuī jiàn nǐ jǐ běn bié de。
examples.en: I've finished this book; I'd also like to recommend a few others.

examples.zh: 你需要的资料在这个文件夹里,另外一份在我这儿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xū yào de zī liào zài zhè ge wén jiàn jiā lǐ, lìng wài yī fèn zài wǒ zhè ér。
examples.en: The data you need is in this folder; another copy is with me.

examples.zh: 除了照顾好自己,另外也要多关心一下父母。
examples.pinyin: Chú le zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ, lìng wài yě yào duō guān xīn yī xià fù mǔ。
examples.en: Besides taking care of yourself, also show more care to your parents.

examples.zh: 这次的问题解决了,另外我们也要防止以后再发生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de wèn tí jiě jué le, lìng wài wǒ men yě yào fáng zhǐ yǐ hòu zài fā shēng。
examples.en: This issue is solved; we must also prevent it from recurring.

examples.zh: 你把旧的处理掉,我另外给你买个新的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ jiù de chǔ lǐ diào, wǒ lìng wài gěi nǐ mǎi gè xīn de。
examples.en: Get rid of the old one; I'll buy you a new one separately.

examples.zh: 这几点我都同意,另外我还有一个小小的顾虑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ diǎn wǒ dōu tóng yì, lìng wài wǒ hái yǒu yí gè xiǎo xiǎo de gù lǜ。
examples.en: I agree with these points; I also have one small concern.

examples.zh: 原来的老师请假了,学校另外安排了一位代课老师。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái de lǎo shī qǐng jià le, xué xiào lìng wài ān pái le yī wèi dài kè lǎo shī。
examples.en: The original teacher is on leave; the school arranged a substitute.

examples.zh: 正餐之外,他们另外还准备了精致的甜点。
examples.pinyin: Zhèng cān zhī wài, tā men lìng wài hái zhǔn bèi le jīng zhì de tián diǎn。
examples.en: Besides the main course, they also prepared exquisite desserts.

title: "再说" ile "hem, üstelik / sonra bakarız"
summary: "再说" (zàishuō) bir gerekçeye ek sebep katar: "hem, üstelik, kaldı ki"; ayrıca "sonra düşünürüz" anlamı da vardır.
explanation: "再说" iki temel işlev taşır: (1) EK GEREKÇE — önceki bir görüşe/karara destek olacak ek bir sebep ekler: "hem, üstelik, kaldı ki, zaten": 今天太晚了,再说我也累了,咱们改天去吧 (Bugün çok geç oldu, üstelik yoruldum da, başka gün gidelim). (2) ERTELEME — bir kararı sonraya bırakma: "sonra bakarız/düşünürüz": 这件事以后再说吧 (Bu meseleyi sonra konuşuruz). İlk anlamda bir gerekçeyi güçlendirmek için ikinci, çoğu zaman daha kişisel bir sebep sunar. Cümle başında (ek sebep) ya da sonunda (erteleme) gelir. Türkçedeki "hem, üstelik, kaldı ki, zaten" (ek sebep) ve "sonra bakarız, sonraya kalsın" (erteleme) ifadelerine denk gelir; bir kararı gerekçelendirmede sık kullanılır.

examples.zh: 这么晚了别去了,再说明天你还得早起上班呢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le bié qù le, zài shuō míng tiān nǐ hái de zǎo qǐ shàng bān ne。
examples.en: Don't go this late; besides, you have to get up early for work tomorrow.

examples.zh: 这件衣服太贵了,再说颜色我也不太喜欢,不买了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú tài guì le, zài shuō yán sè wǒ yě bù tài xǐ huān, bù mǎi le。
examples.en: This outfit's too pricey; besides, I don't like the color, so I won't buy it.

examples.zh: 你别担心,他很有经验,再说还有我们帮着呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié dān xīn, tā hěn yǒu jīng yàn, zài shuō hái yǒu wǒ men bāng zhe ne。
examples.en: Don't worry; he's experienced, and besides, we're here to help too.

examples.zh: 今天就先这样吧,剩下的事以后再说。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān jiù xiān zhè yàng ba, shèng xià de shì yǐ hòu zài shuō。
examples.en: Let's leave it here for today; the rest we'll deal with later.

examples.zh: 那个地方太远了,再说我们时间也不多,还是别去了。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge dì fāng tài yuǎn le, zài shuō wǒ men shí jiān yě bù duō, hái shì bié qù le。
examples.en: That place is too far; besides, we're short on time, so let's not go.

examples.zh: 你先把身体养好,工作的事以后再说。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ shēn tǐ yǎng hǎo, gōng zuò de shì yǐ hòu zài shuō。
examples.en: Get your health back first; we'll talk about work later.

examples.zh: 这个价钱挺合适,再说这种机会也不多,就定了吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jià qián tǐng hé shì, zài shuō zhè zhǒng jī huì yě bù duō, jiù dìng le ba。
examples.en: This price is reasonable; besides, such chances are rare, so let's settle it.

examples.zh: 现在讨论这个还太早,等情况明朗了再说。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài tǎo lùn zhè ge hái tài zǎo, děng qíng kuàng míng lǎng le zài shuō。
examples.en: It's too early to discuss this; let's wait until things are clearer.

examples.zh: 他不会介意的,再说这也不是什么大不了的事。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú huì jiè yì de, zài shuō zhè yě bú shì shén me dà bù liǎo de shì。
examples.en: He won't mind; besides, it's not a big deal anyway.

examples.zh: 天气这么好,别待在家里了,再说出去走走对身体也好。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zhè me hǎo, bié dài zài jiā lǐ le, zài shuō chū qù zǒu zǒu duì shēn tǐ yě hǎo。
examples.en: The weather's so nice; don't stay in — besides, a walk is good for you.

examples.zh: 这份工作待遇不错,再说离家又近,你就答应吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōng zuò dài yù bù cuò, zài shuō lí jiā yòu jìn, nǐ jiù dā yìng ba。
examples.en: This job pays well; besides, it's close to home, so just accept it.

examples.zh: 买不买以后再说,你先试试合不合身。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi bù mǎi yǐ hòu zài shuō, nǐ xiān shì shì hé bù hé shēn。
examples.en: Whether to buy can wait; first try it on to see if it fits.

examples.zh: 别听他的,他根本不懂,再说他也没安好心。
examples.pinyin: Bié tīng tā de, tā gēn běn bù dǒng, zài shuō tā yě méi ān hǎo xīn。
examples.en: Don't listen to him; he doesn't get it, and besides, he means no good.

examples.zh: 现在下结论太早,等把情况都了解清楚再说。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài xià jié lùn tài zǎo, děng bǎ qíng kuàng dōu liǎo jiě qīng chǔ zài shuō。
examples.en: It's too early to conclude; let's wait until we understand everything.

examples.zh: 这点小事你别放在心上,再说谁还没个疏忽的时候。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shì nǐ bié fàng zài xīn shàng, zài shuō shuí hái méi gè shū hū de shí hòu。
examples.en: Don't dwell on this trifle; besides, everyone slips up sometimes.

examples.zh: 坐飞机吧,又快又省事,再说也没贵多少。
examples.pinyin: Zuò fēi jī ba, yòu kuài yòu shěng shì, zài shuō yě méi guì duō shǎo。
examples.en: Let's fly; it's fast and easy, and besides, it's not much pricier.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,这些道理等他长大了再说也不迟。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hái xiǎo, zhè xiē dào lǐ děng tā zhǎng dà le zài shuō yě bù chí。
examples.en: The child is young; explaining these can wait until he's grown.

examples.zh: 你就放心去吧,家里有我呢,再说也就几天而已。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiù fàng xīn qù ba, jiā lǐ yǒu wǒ ne, zài shuō yě jiù jǐ tiān ér yǐ。
examples.en: Go without worry; I'm here, and besides, it's only a few days.

examples.zh: 这本书值得买,内容好,再说也不算贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhí de mǎi, nèi róng hǎo, zài shuō yě bù suàn guì。
examples.en: This book is worth buying; good content, and besides, it's not expensive.

examples.zh: 现在急也没用,等他回来了再说吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài jí yě méi yòng, děng tā huí lái le zài shuō ba。
examples.en: Rushing now is useless; let's wait until he's back.

examples.zh: 咱们走着去吧,反正不远,再说走走还能锻炼身体。
examples.pinyin: Zán men zǒu zhe qù ba, fǎn zhèng bù yuǎn, zài shuō zǒu zǒu hái néng duàn liàn shēn tǐ。
examples.en: Let's walk; it's not far anyway, and besides, walking is good exercise.

examples.zh: 这件事我得考虑考虑,过几天想好了再说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ de kǎo lǜ kǎo lǜ, guò jǐ tiān xiǎng hǎo le zài shuō。
examples.en: I need to think this over; I'll decide in a few days.

examples.zh: 别勉强他了,他实在不愿意,再说强扭的瓜不甜。
examples.pinyin: Bié miǎn qiǎng tā le, tā shí zài bù yuàn yì, zài shuō qiáng niǔ de guā bù tián。
examples.en: Don't force him; he really doesn't want to, and forced things never turn out well.

examples.zh: 先把眼前的事做好,长远的计划以后再说。
examples.pinyin: Xiān bǎ yǎn qián de shì zuò hǎo, cháng yuǎn de jì huà yǐ hòu zài shuō。
examples.en: Do the immediate things well first; long-term plans can come later.

examples.zh: 这条路更近,再说风景也好,咱们就走这边吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù gèng jìn, zài shuō fēng jǐng yě hǎo, zán men jiù zǒu zhè biān ba。
examples.en: This road is shorter; besides, the scenery is nice, so let's go this way.

title: "那么" ile "o zaman, öyleyse"
summary: "那么" (nàme) önceki duruma bağlı bir sonuç/karar bağlar: "o zaman, öyleyse, madem öyle": 那么我们就出发吧 = Öyleyse yola çıkalım.
explanation: "那么" (konuşmada çoğu zaman kısaca "那") bir koşul/durumdan çıkarılan bir SONUCU ya da kararı bağlar: "o zaman, öyleyse, madem öyle, o hâlde". 你要是不舒服,那么就在家休息吧 (Rahatsızsan, o zaman evde dinlen), 既然大家都同意,那么就这么决定了 (Madem herkes hemfikir, öyleyse böyle karar verildi). Genelde "如果/既然...那么..." biçiminde bir şart/gerekçenin ardından gelir ve mantıksal sonucu ya da bir sonraki adımı tanıtır. Konuşmayı bir sonuca bağlarken, konu geçişi yaparken de kullanılır. Bu, "那么"nın derece belirteci anlamından (那么大 = o kadar büyük) farklıdır. Türkçedeki "o zaman, öyleyse, o hâlde, madem öyle" bağlaçlarına denk gelir; bir çıkarımı ya da kararı ifade etmenin temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 既然你已经决定了,那么我就不再多说什么了。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán nǐ yǐ jīng jué dìng le, nà me wǒ jiù bù zài duō shuō shén me le。
examples.en: Since you've decided, then I won't say anything more.

examples.zh: 如果明天下雨,那么我们的郊游就只能改期了。
examples.pinyin: Rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ, nà me wǒ men de jiāo yóu jiù zhǐ néng gǎi qī le。
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, then our outing will have to be postponed.

examples.zh: 大家的意见都一致,那么这件事就这么定了。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā de yì jiàn dōu yí zhì, nà me zhè jiàn shì jiù zhè me dìng le。
examples.en: Everyone's opinion agrees, so then this matter is settled.

examples.zh: 你要是真心想学,那么就得付出比别人更多的努力。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì zhēn xīn xiǎng xué, nà me jiù de fù chū bǐ bié rén gèng duō de nǔ lì。
examples.en: If you truly want to learn, then you must work harder than others.

examples.zh: 既然时间还早,那么咱们就慢慢走过去吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán shí jiān hái zǎo, nà me zán men jiù màn màn zǒu guò qù ba。
examples.en: Since it's still early, then let's just walk over slowly.

examples.zh: 如果这个办法行不通,那么我们就换一个思路。
examples.pinyin: Rú guǒ zhè ge bàn fǎ xíng bù tōng, nà me wǒ men jiù huàn yí gè sī lù。
examples.en: If this method doesn't work, then let's switch to another approach.

examples.zh: 你既然答应了别人,那么就应该说到做到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì rán dā yìng le bié rén, nà me jiù yīng gāi shuō dào zuò dào。

examples.zh: 你要是喜欢这里,那么就多住几天,不用着急走。

title: "来" ile iki fiili bağlama (yöntem-amaç)
titleEn: Using "lai" to connect two verb phrases
pattern: 通过 / 用 + Yöntem + 来 + Fiil Öbeği
summary: "来" bir yöntem ile amacı bağlar: 用行动来证明 = eylemle kanıtlamak (eylem kullanarak kanıtlamak).
explanation: "来" iki fiil öbeğini bağlayıp birincisinin İKİNCİSİNİ gerçekleştirmek için kullanılan YÖNTEM/araç olduğunu gösterir: (yöntem) + 来 + (amaç/eylem). 用实际行动来表达爱 (Sevgiyi somut eylemlerle ifade etmek), 通过努力来实现梦想 (Çabayla hayali gerçekleştirmek), 他想办法来解决问题 (Sorunu çözmek için bir yol buluyor). Çoğu zaman "用...来..." (... kullanarak ...) ya da "通过...来..." (... yoluyla ...) kalıbında görülür. Buradaki "来" fiziksel "gelmek" değil, iki eylem arasında amaç/araç bağı kuran soyut bir bağlaçtır; birinci öbek araç, ikinci öbek hedeftir. Türkçedeki "...-erek, ... yoluyla, ... için, ... kullanarak" bağlantılarına denk gelir; yöntem-amaç ilişkisini anlatmanın düzgün bir yoludur.

title: Ölçü sözcüğü ikilemesi ("her biri")
summary: Bir ölçü sözcüğünü ikilemek "her biri, istisnasız hepsi" anlamı verir: 个个都很棒 = her biri harika; 天天锻炼 = her gün spor yapmak.
explanation: Bir ölçü sözcüğünü (量词) ikilemek "her bir, istisnasız hepsi" anlamı verir ve çoğu zaman genellemede kullanılır: 个个 (her biri), 条条 (her bir), 家家 (her ev), 天天 (her gün), 年年 (her yıl), 人人 (herkes). İkilenmiş ölçü çoğu zaman öznedir ve yüklemden önce "都" ile pekişir: 他们个个都很聪明 (Her biri çok akıllı), 家家户户都挂上了灯笼 (Her ev fener astı). "每 + ölçü"ye (her) çok yakındır ama ikileme daha vurgulu, edebî bir "istisnasız hepsi" tonu taşır. Zaman ölçüleri (天/年) ikilenince "her gün/her yıl" düzenli tekrarı anlatır: 天天进步 (her gün ilerlemek). Türkçedeki "her biri, her ..., istisnasız hepsi" ifadelerine denk gelir; kapsayıcı bir genelleme yapmanın canlı bir yoludur.
