examples.zh: 这件旧毛衣她一直留着,直到搬家才舍得送人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn jiù máo yī tā yì zhí liú zhe, zhí dào bān jiā cái shě de sòng rén。
examples.en: She kept this old sweater, giving it away only when she moved.

title: "给" ile "...-e, ... için"
summary: "给" (gěi) bir eylemin kime yönelik/kimin için yapıldığını gösterir: 给你打电话 = sana telefon etmek; 给妈妈做饭 = anne için yemek yapmak.
explanation: "给" bir edat olarak bir eylemin ALICISINI ya da o eylemin KİMİN İÇİN yapıldığını belirtir ve fiilden ÖNCE gelir: Özne + 给 + kişi + fiil. 我给你写信 (Sana mektup yazıyorum), 妈妈给我们做了一桌菜 (Annem bize bir sofra yemek yaptı), 请给大家介绍一下 (Lütfen herkese tanıt). Türkçedeki "-e/-a" yönelme ve "... için" anlamlarını taşır. "给" ayrıca tam bir fiil olarak "vermek" anlamına da gelir (给我一本书 = bana bir kitap ver) ve edilgen/ettirgen yapılarda da kullanılır. Bu konuda özellikle EDAT işlevini (alıcı/yarar) ele alıyoruz. Türkçedeki "...-e, ... için, ... adına" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir eylemin yöneldiği kişiyi belirtmenin temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 我一到家就给妈妈打了个电话,报个平安。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yī dào jiā jiù gěi mā mā dǎ le gè diàn huà, bào gè píng ān。
examples.en: As soon as I got home, I called mom to say I was safe.

examples.zh: 她每天都给阳台上的花浇水,照顾得很用心。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān dōu gěi yáng tái shàng de huā jiāo shuǐ, zhào gù de hěn yòng xīn。
examples.en: She waters the balcony flowers daily, tending them with care.

examples.zh: 老师给我们讲了一个很有意义的故事。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī gěi wǒ men jiǎng le yí gè hěn yǒu yì yì de gù shì。
examples.en: The teacher told us a very meaningful story.

examples.zh: 周末我打算给孩子做一顿他最爱吃的红烧肉。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ dǎ suàn gěi hái zi zuò yī dùn tā zuì ài chī de hóng shāo ròu。
examples.en: This weekend I plan to cook the child his favorite braised pork.

examples.zh: 你能不能给我介绍一下这里的情况?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng gěi wǒ jiè shào yī xià zhè lǐ de qíng kuàng?
examples.en: Could you brief me on the situation here?

examples.zh: 他特意给远方的朋友寄了一份家乡特产。
examples.pinyin: Tā tè yì gěi yuǎn fāng de péng yǒu jì le yī fèn jiā xiāng tè chǎn。
examples.en: He specially mailed a hometown specialty to a faraway friend.

examples.zh: 请你给大家倒杯茶,他们赶了很远的路。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gěi dà jiā dào bēi chá, tā men gǎn le hěn yuǎn de lù。
examples.en: Please pour everyone tea; they came a long way.

examples.zh: 妈妈给我织了一条围巾,戴上特别暖和。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā gěi wǒ zhī le yī tiáo wéi jīn, dài shàng tè bié nuǎn huo。
examples.en: Mom knitted me a scarf; it's very warm to wear.

examples.zh: 有什么需要帮忙的,随时给我发消息。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me xū yào bāng máng de, suí shí gěi wǒ fā xiāo xī。
examples.en: If you need any help, message me anytime.

examples.zh: 他常常给社区里的老人读报纸、聊聊天。
examples.pinyin: Tā cháng cháng gěi shè qū lǐ de lǎo rén dú bào zhǐ、 liáo liáo tiān。
examples.en: He often reads the paper to and chats with the community's elderly.

examples.zh: 我给你留了一份饭,在锅里热着呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ liú le yī fèn fàn, zài guō lǐ rè zhe ne。
examples.en: I saved you a meal; it's warming in the pot.

examples.zh: 护士细心地给病人换了药,又叮嘱了几句。
examples.pinyin: Hù shì xì xīn de gěi bìng rén huàn le yào, yòu dīng zhǔ le jǐ jù。
examples.en: The nurse carefully changed the patient's dressing and gave some advice.

examples.zh: 你出门的时候,顺便给楼下的信箱看一眼。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chū mén de shí hòu, shùn biàn gěi lóu xià de xìn xiāng kàn yī yǎn。
examples.en: When you go out, take a glance at the mailbox downstairs.

examples.zh: 爸爸答应给我买一辆新自行车当生日礼物。
examples.pinyin: Bà bà dā yìng gěi wǒ mǎi yī liàng xīn zì xíng chē dāng shēng rì lǐ wù。
examples.en: Dad promised to buy me a new bike as a birthday gift.

examples.zh: 每逢过节,他都会给老家的父母寄些钱。
examples.pinyin: Měi féng guò jié, tā dū huì gěi lǎo jiā de fù mǔ jì xiē qián。
examples.en: Every festival, he sends some money to his parents back home.

examples.zh: 请你给我们表演一个节目,好不好?
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ men biǎo yǎn yí gè jié mù, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.en: Would you perform something for us, please?

examples.zh: 她耐心地给刚入学的新生介绍学校的环境。
examples.pinyin: Tā nài xīn de gěi gāng rù xué de xīn shēng jiè shào xué xiào de huán jìng。
examples.en: She patiently introduced the campus to the new students.

examples.zh: 我给你留了个座位,你快过来坐吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ liú le gè zuò wèi, nǐ kuài guò lái zuò ba。
examples.en: I saved you a seat; come over and sit.

examples.zh: 他利用假期给村里的孩子们免费补习功课。
examples.pinyin: Tā lì yòng jià qī gěi cūn lǐ de hái zi men miǎn fèi bǔ xí gōng kè。
examples.en: He tutors the village children for free during the holidays.

examples.zh: 你把地址给我发过来,我好把东西寄给你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ dì zhǐ gěi wǒ fā guò lái, wǒ hǎo bǎ dōng xī jì gěi nǐ。
examples.en: Send me your address so I can mail you the things.

examples.zh: 奶奶总喜欢给我们讲她年轻时候的往事。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi zǒng xǐ huān gěi wǒ men jiǎng tā nián qīng shí hòu de wǎng shì。
examples.en: Grandma always likes to tell us stories from her youth.

examples.zh: 请你给这盆花换个大一点的花盆吧。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gěi zhè pén huā huàn gè dà yī diǎn de huā pén ba。
examples.en: Please repot this plant into a bigger pot.

examples.zh: 我给你带了点家乡的水果,你尝尝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi nǐ dài le diǎn jiā xiāng de shuǐ guǒ, nǐ cháng cháng。
examples.en: I brought you some fruit from home; give it a taste.

examples.zh: 他每天早上都给全家人准备好早饭才去上班。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu gěi quán jiā rén zhǔn bèi hǎo zǎo fàn cái qù shàng bān。
examples.en: Every morning he prepares breakfast for the family before work.

examples.zh: 有困难别自己扛着,给我们说一声。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu kùn nán bié zì jǐ káng zhe, gěi wǒ men shuō yī shēng。
examples.en: Don't bear difficulties alone; let us know.

title: "为" ile "... için, ... uğruna"
summary: "为" (wèi) bir eylemin amacını/yararına yapıldığı kişiyi gösterir: 为你高兴 = senin adına seviniyorum; 为梦想努力 = hayali için çabalamak.
explanation: "为" bir edat olarak bir eylemin KİMİN İÇİN/YARARINA ya da NE AMAÇLA yapıldığını belirtir: "... için, ... uğruna, ... adına". 我为你感到骄傲 (Seninle gurur duyuyorum), 他为家人付出了很多 (Ailesi için çok fedakârlık yaptı), 大家都在为考试做准备 (Herkes sınav için hazırlanıyor). Duygu ifadelerinde "为...(而)..." kalıbı sık görülür: 为他的成功而高兴 (Başarısına sevinmek). "给" ile farkı: "给" doğrudan alıcıyı (birine bir şey yapmak), "为" ise yarar/amaç (birinin uğruna, bir amaç için) vurgular. "为了" ise özellikle AMAÇ bildirir (bkz. ayrı konu). Türkçedeki "... için, ... uğruna, ... adına, ...-e" ifadelerine denk gelir; yarar ve amaç ilişkisini anlatmanın temel yollarından biridir.

examples.zh: 听到你考上了理想的大学,我真为你高兴。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào nǐ kǎo shàng le lǐ xiǎng de dà xué, wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng。
examples.en: Hearing you got into your dream university, I'm truly happy for you.

examples.zh: 父母为孩子付出了太多,我们应该懂得感恩。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ wèi hái zi fù chū le tài duō, wǒ men yīng gāi dǒng de gǎn ēn。
examples.en: Parents give so much for their children; we should be grateful.

examples.zh: 他这些年一直在为自己的梦想默默努力。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè xiē nián yì zhí zài wèi zì jǐ de mèng xiǎng mò mò nǔ lì。
examples.en: He's been quietly striving for his dream all these years.

examples.zh: 大家都在为即将到来的考试紧张地准备着。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu zài wèi jí jiāng dào lái de kǎo shì jǐn zhāng de zhǔn bèi zhe。
examples.en: Everyone is nervously preparing for the coming exam.

examples.zh: 我们要为保护环境尽自己的一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yào wèi bǎo hù huán jìng jǐn zì jǐ de yī fèn lì liàng。
examples.en: We should do our part to protect the environment.

examples.zh: 看到球队赢了,全场观众都为他们欢呼。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào qiú duì yíng le, quán chǎng guān zhòng dōu wèi tā men huān hū。
examples.en: Seeing the team win, the whole crowd cheered for them.

examples.zh: 他为这个项目熬了好几个通宵,人都瘦了。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zhè ge xiàng mù áo le hǎo jǐ gè tōng xiāo, rén dōu shòu le。
examples.en: He stayed up several nights for this project and grew thin.

examples.zh: 请大家为这位辛勤的老师鼓鼓掌。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā wèi zhè wèi xīn qín de lǎo shī gǔ gǔ zhǎng。
examples.en: Let's all applaud this hardworking teacher.

examples.zh: 她一辈子都在为这个家操劳,从没为自己想过。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī bèi zi dōu zài wèi zhè ge jiā cāo láo, cóng méi wèi zì jǐ xiǎng guò。
examples.en: She toiled for this family all her life, never for herself.

examples.zh: 我们不应该只为眼前的利益而放弃长远的目标。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bù yīng gāi zhǐ wèi yǎn qián de lì yì ér fàng qì cháng yuǎn de mù biāo。
examples.en: We shouldn't abandon long-term goals just for short-term gain.

examples.zh: 为了给孩子更好的教育,他们搬到了城里。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le gěi hái zi gèng hǎo de jiào yù, tā men bān dào le chéng lǐ。
examples.en: To give the child a better education, they moved to the city.

examples.zh: 听到这个坏消息,大家都为他捏了一把汗。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè ge huài xiāo xī, dà jiā dōu wèi tā niē le yī bǎ hàn。
examples.en: Hearing the bad news, everyone was anxious for him.

examples.zh: 他常常为别人着想,却很少考虑自己。
examples.pinyin: Tā cháng cháng wèi bié rén zhuó xiǎng, què hěn shǎo kǎo lǜ zì jǐ。
examples.en: He often thinks of others but rarely of himself.

examples.zh: 我们要为自己的选择负责,不能半途而废。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yào wèi zì jǐ de xuǎn zé fù zé, bù néng bàn tú ér fèi。
examples.en: We must take responsibility for our choices and not quit halfway.

examples.zh: 看到女儿长大成人,母亲的眼里满是欣慰。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào nǚ ér zhǎng dà chéng rén, mǔ qīn de yǎn lǐ mǎn shì xīn wèi。
examples.en: Seeing her daughter grown, the mother's eyes were full of relief.

examples.zh: 他愿意为朋友两肋插刀,是个重情重义的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā yuàn yì wèi péng yǒu liǎng lèi chā dāo, shì gè zhòng qíng zhòng yì de rén。
examples.en: He'd go to any length for a friend; he's loyal and true.

examples.zh: 全村人都在为修建这条新路而忙碌着。
examples.pinyin: Quán cūn rén dōu zài wèi xiū jiàn zhè tiáo xīn lù ér máng lù zhe。
examples.en: The whole village is busy building this new road.

examples.zh: 我们为共同的目标走到了一起,携手前进。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men wèi gòng tóng de mù biāo zǒu dào le yì qǐ, xié shǒu qián jìn。
examples.en: We came together for a common goal and advance hand in hand.

examples.zh: 他默默地为这个团队做了很多不为人知的事。
examples.pinyin: Tā mò mò de wèi zhè ge tuán duì zuò le hěn duō bù wéi rén zhī de shì。
examples.en: He quietly did much unseen work for this team.

examples.zh: 请为你今天的行为向大家道个歉。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng wèi nǐ jīn tiān de xíng wéi xiàng dà jiā dào gè qiàn。
examples.en: Please apologize to everyone for your behavior today.

examples.zh: 老师为了我们能听懂,把一个问题讲了好几遍。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī wèi le wǒ men néng tīng dǒng, bǎ yí gè wèn tí jiǎng le hǎo jǐ biàn。
examples.en: For us to understand, the teacher explained a point several times.

examples.zh: 他们为能够重逢而激动得热泪盈眶。
examples.pinyin: Tā men wèi néng gòu chóng féng ér jī dòng de rè lèi yíng kuàng。
examples.en: They were moved to tears at being able to reunite.

examples.zh: 我们每个人都在为让生活变得更好而努力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men měi gè rén dōu zài wèi ràng shēng huó biàn de gèng hǎo ér nǔ lì。
examples.en: Each of us strives to make life better.

examples.zh: 别为一点小事就伤了和气,大家好好谈谈。
examples.pinyin: Bié wèi yì diǎn xiǎo shì jiù shāng le hé qì, dà jiā hǎo hǎo tán tán。
examples.en: Don't spoil the harmony over a trifle; let's talk it out.

examples.zh: 他一生都在为科学事业无私地奉献。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī shēng dōu zài wèi kē xué shì yè wú sī de fèng xiàn。
examples.en: He devoted his whole life selflessly to science.

title: "不到" ile "...-den az, ...-e varmaz"
summary: "不到" (bú dào) bir miktara ULAŞMAYAN, ondan az bir değeri bildirir: 不到十块钱 = on liradan az; 不到一个小时 = bir saati bulmadan.
explanation: "不到" bir sayı/miktar ifadesinin önüne gelip o miktara ULAŞILMADIĞINI, ondan AZ olduğunu bildirir: "...-den az, ...-i bulmaz, ...-e varmaz". 不到二十岁 (yirmi yaşından küçük), 花了不到一百块 (yüz liradan az harcadı), 不到一个星期就完成了 (bir haftayı bulmadan bitirdi). Kelime kelime "ulaşmaz/varmaz" demektir (不 + 到) ve bir eşiğin altında kalmayı vurgular. Karşıtı "多" (küsur, fazla) ya da "以上" (üstü) ile kurulur. Sayı çoğu zaman şaşırtıcı derecede az olduğunda kullanılır ve bir çabukluk/azlık vurgusu taşır. Bütün sayılar Çince rakamlarla yazılır. Türkçedeki "...-den az, ...-i bulmadan, ...-e varmadan, ...-den küçük" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir üst sınırın altında kalmayı belirtir.

examples.zh: 这家店离我家很近,走路不到十分钟就到了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn, zǒu lù bú dào shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le。
examples.en: This shop is close to my home, less than a ten-minute walk.

examples.zh: 他来公司还不到半年,就已经很受重用了。
examples.pinyin: Tā lái gōng sī hái bú dào bàn nián, jiù yǐ jīng hěn shòu zhòng yòng le。
examples.en: He's been at the company less than half a year, yet is already valued.

examples.zh: 这么好的西瓜,居然不到十块钱一个。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo de xī guā, jū rán bú dào shí kuài qián yí gè。
examples.en: Such a good watermelon, and it's under ten yuan each.

examples.zh: 这本书不到二百页,我一个下午就看完了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bú dào èr bǎi yè, wǒ yí gè xià wǔ jiù kàn wán le。
examples.en: This book is under two hundred pages; I finished it in an afternoon.

examples.zh: 他年纪不到三十,却已经有了丰富的经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā nián jì bú dào sān shí, què yǐ jīng yǒu le fēng fù de jīng yàn。
examples.en: He's under thirty, yet already has rich experience.

examples.zh: 这个孩子学得真快,不到一个月就学会了游泳。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hái zi xué de zhēn kuài, bú dào yí gè yuè jiù xué huì le yóu yǒng。
examples.en: This child learns fast; he learned to swim in under a month.

examples.zh: 会议开始不到十分钟,他就匆匆离开了。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì kāi shǐ bú dào shí fēn zhōng, tā jiù cōng cōng lí kāi le。
examples.en: Less than ten minutes into the meeting, he hurried off.

examples.zh: 这条裙子打完折不到一百块,真是太划算了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qún zi dǎ wán zhé bú dào yì bǎi kuài, zhēn shì tài huá suàn le。
examples.en: This dress is under a hundred after the discount; what a bargain.

examples.zh: 那家新餐厅开业不到一年就成了网红店。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā xīn cān tīng kāi yè bú dào yī nián jiù chéng le wǎng hóng diàn。
examples.en: That new restaurant became a hit in under a year.

examples.zh: 他跑得飞快,不到十秒就冲到了终点。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de fēi kuài, bú dào shí miǎo jiù chōng dào le zhōng diǎn。
examples.en: He ran so fast, reaching the finish in under ten seconds.

examples.zh: 这点儿活儿不到一个小时就干完了,很轻松。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn ér huó er bú dào yí gè xiǎo shí jiù gàn wán le, hěn qīng sōng。
examples.en: This bit of work was done in under an hour; quite easy.

examples.zh: 我们村现在常住的不到一百人了,很冷清。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men cūn xiàn zài cháng zhù de bú dào yì bǎi rén le, hěn lěng qīng。
examples.en: Our village now has fewer than a hundred permanent residents; very quiet.

examples.zh: 这台手机用了还不到两年,就开始出各种问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái shǒu jī yòng le hái bú dào liǎng nián, jiù kāi shǐ chū gè zhǒng wèn tí。
examples.en: This phone, used less than two years, started having all sorts of problems.

examples.zh: 从这儿到机场不到二十公里,很快就能到。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè ér dào jī chǎng bú dào èr shí gōng lǐ, hěn kuài jiù néng dào。
examples.en: It's under twenty kilometers to the airport; we'll get there soon.

examples.zh: 他工资不高,一个月不到五千块。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōng zī bù gāo, yí gè yuè bú dào wǔ qiān kuài。
examples.en: His salary isn't high, under five thousand a month.

examples.zh: 这么大的蛋糕,不到十分钟就被孩子们分光了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de dàn gāo, bú dào shí fēn zhōng jiù bèi hái zi men fēn guāng le。
examples.en: Such a big cake was divided up by the kids in under ten minutes.

examples.zh: 他学汉语还不到一年,已经能进行简单交流了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué hàn yǔ hái bú dào yī nián, yǐ jīng néng jìn xíng jiǎn dān jiāo liú le。
examples.en: He's studied Chinese under a year, yet can hold simple conversations.

examples.zh: 那些限量商品上架不到五分钟就卖光了。
examples.pinyin: Nà xiē xiàn liàng shāng pǐn shàng jià bú dào wǔ fēn zhōng jiù mài guāng le。
examples.en: Those limited items sold out in under five minutes.

examples.zh: 这间小屋子不到十平米,却收拾得很温馨。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān xiǎo wū zi bú dào shí píng mǐ, què shōu shí de hěn wēn xīn。
examples.en: This small room is under ten square meters, yet cozily kept.

examples.zh: 离截止日期不到三天了,他还有很多没做完。
examples.pinyin: Lí jié zhǐ rì qī bú dào sān tiān le, tā hái yǒu hěn duō méi zuò wán。
examples.en: With under three days to the deadline, he still has much unfinished.

examples.zh: 这条鱼不到一斤,不太够我们两个人吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú bú dào yī jīn, bù tài gòu wǒ men liǎng gè rén chī。
examples.en: This fish is under a jin, not quite enough for the two of us.

examples.zh: 他搬进新家还不到一个月,就把这里布置得很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Tā bān jìn xīn jiā hái bú dào yí gè yuè, jiù bǎ zhè lǐ bù zhì de hěn piào liàng。
examples.en: Less than a month into his new home, he'd decorated it beautifully.

examples.zh: 这次考试不到一半的人及格,大家都很意外。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì bú dào yí bàn de rén jí gé, dà jiā dōu hěn yì wài。
examples.en: Fewer than half passed this exam, surprising everyone.

examples.zh: 我等了不到五分钟,公交车就来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng le bú dào wǔ fēn zhōng, gōng jiāo chē jiù lái le。
examples.en: I waited under five minutes before the bus came.

examples.zh: 这么重要的决定,他不到一分钟就做出了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng yào de jué dìng, tā bú dào yì fēn zhōng jiù zuò chū le。
examples.en: Such an important decision, and he made it in under a minute.

title: "向" ile "...-e doğru, ...-e karşı"
summary: "向" (xiàng) bir eylemin yönünü ya da yöneldiği kişiyi gösterir: 向前走 = ileriye doğru yürümek; 向老师问好 = öğretmene selam vermek.
explanation: "向" bir edat olarak bir eylemin YÖNÜNÜ ya da yöneldiği KİŞİYİ belirtir ve fiilden önce gelir: 向前看 (ileriye bak), 向北走 (kuzeye doğru git), 向他学习 (ondan/ona bakarak öğren), 向大家道歉 (herkesten özür dile). Hem somut YÖN (向左, 向东) hem de soyut YÖNELME (向...请教 = birine danışmak, 向...表示感谢 = birine teşekkür etmek) için kullanılır. "往" ile yakındır ama "向" hem yön hem de kişiye yönelmede kullanılabilirken, "往" daha çok somut hareket yönünde kullanılır; ayrıca "向" soyut fiillerle (学习, 请教, 表示) daha çok gelir. Türkçedeki "...-e doğru, ...-e karşı, ...-den (öğrenmek)" ifadelerine denk gelir; yön ve yönelme anlatmanın temel yollarından biridir.

examples.zh: 请大家向前看,不要回头,注意脚下的路。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā xiàng qián kàn, bú yào huí tóu, zhù yì jiǎo xià de lù。
examples.en: Everyone look forward, don't turn back, watch your step.

examples.zh: 他微笑着向我们走来,热情地打招呼。
examples.pinyin: Tā wēi xiào zhe xiàng wǒ men zǒu lái, rè qíng de dǎ zhāo hū。
examples.en: He walked toward us smiling and greeted us warmly.

examples.zh: 遇到不懂的问题,应该虚心向别人请教。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào bù dǒng de wèn tí, yīng gāi xū xīn xiàng bié rén qǐng jiào。
examples.en: When facing puzzles, one should humbly ask others for advice.

examples.zh: 我代表全公司向各位客户表示衷心的感谢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dài biǎo quán gōng sī xiàng gè wèi kè hù biǎo shì zhōng xīn de gǎn xiè。
examples.en: On behalf of the company, I sincerely thank all our clients.

examples.zh: 他做错了事,主动向对方道了歉。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò cuò liǎo shì, zhǔ dòng xiàng duì fāng dào le qiàn。
examples.en: Having done wrong, he apologized to the other party on his own.

examples.zh: 这条河一直向东流,最后汇入大海。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé yì zhí xiàng dōng liú, zuì hòu huì rù dà hǎi。
examples.en: This river flows east, finally merging into the sea.

examples.zh: 我们要向那些无私奉献的人学习。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yào xiàng nà xiē wú sī fèng xiàn de rén xué xí。
examples.en: We should learn from those who give selflessly.

examples.zh: 一群大雁排成人字形向南方飞去。
examples.pinyin: Yī qún dà yàn pái chéng rén zì xíng xiàng nán fāng fēi qù。
examples.en: A flock of wild geese flew south in a V-formation.

examples.zh: 他向老师深深地鞠了一躬,表示敬意。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng lǎo shī shēn shēn de jū le yī gōng, biǎo shì jìng yì。
examples.en: He bowed deeply to the teacher to show respect.

examples.zh: 有什么困难,你可以随时向我们求助。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me kùn nán, nǐ kě yǐ suí shí xiàng wǒ men qiú zhù。
examples.en: If you have any trouble, you can ask us for help anytime.

examples.zh: 车子向前开了一段,在一个路口停了下来。
examples.pinyin: Chē zi xiàng qián kāi le yī duàn, zài yí gè lù kǒu tíng le xià lái。
examples.en: The car drove forward a bit and stopped at an intersection.

examples.zh: 我想向你打听一件事,不知道方不方便。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiàng nǐ dǎ tīng yī jiàn shì, bù zhī dào fāng bù fāng biàn。
examples.en: I'd like to ask you about something, if it's convenient.

examples.zh: 他一步步向着自己的目标坚定地走去。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí bù bù xiàng zhe zì jǐ de mù biāo jiān dìng de zǒu qù。
examples.en: Step by step, he walked resolutely toward his goal.

examples.zh: 请向左转,前面第二个路口就是那家医院。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn, qián miàn dì èr gè lù kǒu jiù shì nà jiā yī yuàn。
examples.en: Turn left; the second intersection ahead is the hospital.

examples.zh: 我们全体员工向坚守岗位的同事致敬。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men quán tǐ yuán gōng xiàng jiān shǒu gǎng wèi de tóng shì zhì jìng。
examples.en: All of us employees salute the colleagues who stayed at their posts.

examples.zh: 孩子怯生生地向陌生人点了点头。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi qiè shēng shēng de xiàng mò shēng rén diǎn le diǎn tóu。
examples.en: The child shyly nodded to the stranger.

examples.zh: 他向大家详细地介绍了这次活动的安排。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng dà jiā xiáng xì de jiè shào le zhè cì huó dòng de ān pái。
examples.en: He introduced the event's arrangements to everyone in detail.

examples.zh: 太阳每天从东方升起,向西方落下。
examples.pinyin: Tài yáng měi tiān cóng dōng fāng shēng qǐ, xiàng xī fāng là xià。
examples.en: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west each day.

examples.zh: 他一直向往着自由自在的乡村生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì zhí xiàng wǎng zhe zì yóu zì zài de xiāng cūn shēng huó。
examples.en: He has always longed for a free and easy country life.

examples.zh: 请向服务台咨询,他们会给你详细的解答。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng xiàng fú wù tái zī xún, tā men huì gěi nǐ xiáng xì de jiě dá。
examples.en: Please inquire at the service desk; they'll answer in detail.

examples.zh: 我们要勇敢地向困难挑战,不能轻易低头。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yào yǒng gǎn de xiàng kùn nán tiǎo zhàn, bù néng qīng yì dī tóu。
examples.en: We should bravely challenge difficulties and not yield easily.

examples.zh: 船缓缓地向岸边驶去,乘客们都很兴奋。
examples.pinyin: Chuán huǎn huǎn de xiàng àn biān shǐ qù, chéng kè men dōu hěn xīng fèn。
examples.en: The boat slowly headed for the shore, and the passengers were excited.

examples.zh: 他向父母表明了自己想出国留学的决心。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng fù mǔ biǎo míng liǎo zì jǐ xiǎng chū guó liú xué de jué xīn。
examples.en: He expressed to his parents his resolve to study abroad.

examples.zh: 每当想起故乡,他的心就飞向了远方。
examples.pinyin: Měi dāng xiǎng qǐ gù xiāng, tā de xīn jiù fēi xiàng le yuǎn fāng。
examples.en: Whenever he thinks of home, his heart flies to the distance.

examples.zh: 大家纷纷向这位见义勇为的年轻人竖起大拇指。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā fēn fēn xiàng zhè wèi jiàn yì yǒng wéi de nián qīng rén shù qǐ dà mǔ zhǐ。
examples.en: Everyone gave a thumbs-up to this brave young man.

title: "往" ile "...-e doğru" (hareket yönü)
summary: "往" (wǎng) somut hareket yönünü gösterir: 往前走 = ileriye doğru yürü; 往里放 = içeriye doğru koy.
explanation: "往" bir edat olarak somut bir HAREKETİN yönünü belirtir ve çoğu zaman fiilden önce ya da bazı hareket fiillerinden sonra gelir: 往前走 (ileri git), 往东开 (doğuya sür), 往里边坐 (içeriye doğru otur), 往下看 (aşağı bak). Ardından genelde bir yön sözcüğü (前/后/上/下/左/右/东/南/里/外) ya da bir yer gelir. "向" ile büyük ölçüde değiştirilebilir, ama "往" özellikle SOMUT hareket yönünde kullanılır ve soyut "...-e öğrenmek/teşekkür etmek" gibi kullanımları YOKTUR ("往他学习" yanlış; "向他学习" doğru). Yol tarifi verirken çok kullanılır: 一直往前走,到路口往右拐 (Dümdüz git, kavşaktan sağa dön). Türkçedeki "...-e doğru, ...-e, ...-ye" hareket yönü ifadelerine denk gelir; somut yönlendirmenin en yaygın yoludur.

examples.zh: 你一直往前走,到第二个路口往右拐就到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu, dào dì èr gè lù kǒu wǎng yòu guǎi jiù dào le。
examples.en: Keep going straight; turn right at the second intersection and you're there.

examples.zh: 车太挤了,大家请尽量往里边走一走。
examples.pinyin: Chē tài jǐ le, dà jiā qǐng jǐn liàng wǎng lǐ biān zǒu yī zǒu。
examples.en: The bus is packed; please move inward as much as you can.

examples.zh: 他往窗外看了一眼,发现天已经黑了。
examples.pinyin: Tā wǎng chuāng wài kàn le yī yǎn, fā xiàn tiān yǐ jīng hēi le。
examples.en: He glanced out the window and saw it had gotten dark.

examples.zh: 请把桌子往左边挪一点,好让出一条过道。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhuō zi wǎng zuǒ biān nuó yì diǎn, hǎo ràng chū yī tiáo guò dào。
examples.en: Please move the table a bit to the left to make a passage.

examples.zh: 这条路往北通向火车站,往南通向机场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǎng běi tōng xiàng huǒ chē zhàn, wǎng nán tōng xiàng jī chǎng。
examples.en: This road leads north to the train station and south to the airport.

examples.zh: 孩子好奇地往盒子里看,想知道里面装的是什么。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hào qí de wǎng hé zi lǐ kàn, xiǎng zhī dào lǐ miàn zhuāng de shì shén me。
examples.en: The child peered curiously into the box to see what was inside.

examples.zh: 上山的路很陡,大家小心地往上爬。
examples.pinyin: Shàng shān de lù hěn dǒu, dà jiā xiǎo xīn de wǎng shàng pá。
examples.en: The mountain path is steep; everyone climbed up carefully.

examples.zh: 他往后退了一步,给别人让出了位置。
examples.pinyin: Tā wǎng hòu tuì le yī bù, gěi bié rén ràng chū le wèi zhì。
examples.en: He stepped back to make room for others.

examples.zh: 你往前坐一点,后面还有人要上车。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wǎng qián zuò yì diǎn, hòu miàn hái yǒu rén yào shàng chē。
examples.en: Move forward a bit; more people are boarding at the back.

examples.zh: 河水日夜不停地往低处流,最终流入大海。
examples.pinyin: Hé shuǐ rì yè bù tíng de wǎng dī chù liú, zuì zhōng liú rù dà hǎi。
examples.en: The river flows down day and night, finally into the sea.

examples.zh: 请大家往两边散开,给救护车让出通道。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā wǎng liǎng biān sàn kāi, gěi jiù hù chē ràng chū tōng dào。
examples.en: Please spread to both sides to make way for the ambulance.

examples.zh: 他把信封往桌上一放,转身就走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ xìn fēng wǎng zhuō shàng yī fàng, zhuǎn shēn jiù zǒu le。
examples.en: He tossed the envelope on the table and turned to leave.

examples.zh: 往前再走几步就是电梯,你跟我来。
examples.pinyin: Wǎng qián zài zǒu jǐ bù jiù shì diàn tī, nǐ gēn wǒ lái。
examples.en: A few more steps ahead is the elevator; follow me.

examples.zh: 天气冷了,大雁开始往温暖的南方飞。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì lěng le, dà yàn kāi shǐ wǎng wēn nuǎn de nán fāng fēi。
examples.en: As it grew cold, the geese began flying to the warm south.

examples.zh: 你把音量往小了调一点,别吵到邻居。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ yīn liàng wǎng xiǎo le diào yì diǎn, bié chǎo dào lín jū。
examples.en: Turn the volume down a bit so as not to disturb the neighbors.

examples.zh: 他往后一靠,舒服地闭上了眼睛。
examples.pinyin: Tā wǎng hòu yī kào, shū fú de bì shàng le yǎn jīng。
examples.en: He leaned back and comfortably closed his eyes.

examples.zh: 往里走是卧室,往外走就是客厅了。
examples.pinyin: Wǎng lǐ zǒu shì wò shì, wǎng wài zǒu jiù shì kè tīng le。
examples.en: Inward is the bedroom; outward is the living room.

examples.zh: 请把车往边上停一停,别挡着后面的车。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ chē wǎng biān shàng tíng yī tíng, bié dǎng zhe hòu miàn de chē。
examples.en: Please pull the car to the side; don't block the ones behind.

examples.zh: 他抬头往山顶望去,还有很长一段路要爬。
examples.pinyin: Tā tái tóu wǎng shān dǐng wàng qù, hái yǒu hěn zhǎng yī duàn lù yào pá。
examples.en: He looked up toward the summit; there was still a long way to climb.

examples.zh: 你顺着这条街一直往东走,银行就在右手边。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shùn zhe zhè tiáo jiē yì zhí wǎng dōng zǒu, yín háng jiù zài yòu shǒu biān。
examples.en: Follow this street east; the bank is on your right.

examples.zh: 孩子往妈妈怀里一扑,紧紧地抱住了她。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi wǎng mā mā huái lǐ yī pū, jǐn jǐn de bào zhù le tā。
examples.en: The child threw himself into mom's arms and held her tight.

examples.zh: 请大家往前挪一挪,把后面的座位留给老人。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dà jiā wǎng qián nuó yī nuó, bǎ hòu miàn de zuò wèi liú gěi lǎo rén。
examples.en: Please move forward and leave the back seats for the elderly.

examples.zh: 他把头往门外探了探,看看外面有没有人。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ tóu wǎng mén wài tàn le tàn, kàn kàn wài miàn yǒu méi yǒu rén。
examples.en: He poked his head out the door to see if anyone was outside.

examples.zh: 这些水一直往外冒,得赶紧把水管关上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē shuǐ yì zhí wǎng wài mào, de gǎn jǐn bǎ shuǐ guǎn guān shàng。
examples.en: Water keeps gushing out; we must shut off the pipe quickly.

examples.zh: 我们往回走吧,天色不早,该回家了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men wǎng huí zǒu ba, tiān sè bù zǎo, gāi huí jiā le。
examples.en: Let's head back; it's getting late and time to go home.

title: "在...上" ile "... bakımından, ...konusunda"
summary: "在...上" soyut bir alan/açı belirtir: "... bakımından, ...konusunda, ... açısından": 在学习上 = öğrenim konusunda.
explanation: "在...上" somut bir konum dışında SOYUT bir ALAN, açı ya da bakımı da belirtir: "... bakımından, ... açısından, ... konusunda, ... hususunda". 在学习上,他一直很努力 (Öğrenim konusunda hep çalışkandır), 在这个问题上,大家的看法不一样 (Bu konuda görüşler farklı), 在生活上,父母给了我很多帮助 (Yaşam bakımından ailem çok yardım etti). "上" burada fiziksel "üst" değil, bir konuyu/alanı çerçeveleyen soyut bir işarettir. Genelde cümle başında bir çerçeve/konu kurar ve ardından o alandaki durum söylenir. Benzer kalıplar: 在...方面 (... yönünden), 在...中 (... içinde). Türkçedeki "... bakımından, ... açısından, ... konusunda, ... hususunda" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir konuyu ya da açıyı çerçevelemenin yaygın bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 在学习上,他从来不用父母操心,一直很自觉。
examples.pinyin: Zài xué xí shàng, tā cóng lái bù yòng fù mǔ cāo xīn, yì zhí hěn zì jué。
examples.en: In studies, he never worries his parents; he's always self-disciplined.

examples.zh: 在这个问题上,我和你的看法基本一致。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè ge wèn tí shàng, wǒ hé nǐ de kàn fǎ jī běn yí zhì。
examples.en: On this issue, my view and yours basically agree.

examples.zh: 在生活上遇到困难,别硬扛着,跟家里说一声。
examples.pinyin: Zài shēng huó shàng yù dào kùn nán, bié yìng káng zhe, gēn jiā lǐ shuō yī shēng。
examples.en: If you face hardship in life, don't tough it out alone; tell your family.

examples.zh: 在工作上,他是个精益求精、一丝不苟的人。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōng zuò shàng, tā shì gè jīng yì qiú jīng、 yī sī bù gǒu de rén。
examples.en: At work, he's someone who strives for perfection and is meticulous.

examples.zh: 在教育孩子的问题上,夫妻俩常常意见不合。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiào yù hái zi de wèn tí shàng, fū qī liǎ cháng cháng yì jiàn bù hé。
examples.en: On educating the children, the couple often disagrees.

examples.zh: 他在音乐上很有天分,几乎无师自通。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yīn yuè shàng hěn yǒu tiān fèn, jī hū wú shī zì tōng。
examples.en: He's very gifted in music, almost self-taught.

examples.zh: 在待人接物上,她一向温和有礼,很受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zài dài rén jiē wù shàng, tā yí xiàng wēn hé yǒu lǐ, hěn shòu huān yíng。
examples.en: In dealing with people, she's always gentle and polite, well liked.

examples.zh: 我们要在思想上重视安全,不能有丝毫马虎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yào zài sī xiǎng shàng zhòng shì ān quán, bù néng yǒu sī háo mǎ hǔ。
examples.en: We must value safety in our thinking, without the slightest carelessness.

examples.zh: 在饮食上,老人应该少油少盐,多吃清淡的。
examples.pinyin: Zài yǐn shí shàng, lǎo rén yīng gāi shǎo yóu shǎo yán, duō chī qīng dàn de。
examples.en: In diet, the elderly should eat less oil and salt, more light food.

examples.zh: 在事业上,他取得了不小的成就,令人佩服。
examples.pinyin: Zài shì yè shàng, tā qǔ de le bù xiǎo de chéng jiù, lìng rén pèi fú。
examples.en: In his career, he achieved a lot, which is admirable.

examples.zh: 在时间安排上,你最好留出一些机动的余地。
examples.pinyin: Zài shí jiān ān pái shàng, nǐ zuì hǎo liú chū yī xiē jī dòng de yú de。
examples.en: In scheduling, you'd best leave some flexible room.

examples.zh: 在这件事上,我觉得他做得一点儿也没错。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiàn shì shàng, wǒ jué de tā zuò de yì diǎn ér yě méi cuò。
examples.en: On this matter, I think he did nothing wrong at all.

examples.zh: 在语言学习上,坚持和积累比什么都重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài yǔ yán xué xí shàng, jiān chí hé jī lěi bǐ shén me dōu zhòng yào。
examples.en: In language learning, persistence and accumulation matter most.

examples.zh: 父母在经济上支持我,在精神上鼓励我。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ zài jīng jì shàng zhī chí wǒ, zài jīng shén shàng gǔ lì wǒ。
examples.en: My parents support me financially and encourage me spiritually.

examples.zh: 在这个方向上,我们已经取得了阶段性的进展。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè ge fāng xiàng shàng, wǒ men yǐ jīng qǔ de le jiē duàn xìng de jìn zhǎn。
examples.en: In this direction, we've made phased progress.

examples.zh: 在为人处世上,他比同龄人成熟得多。
examples.pinyin: Zài wéi rén chǔ shì shàng, tā bǐ tóng líng rén chéng shú de duō。
examples.en: In dealing with the world, he's far more mature than his peers.

examples.zh: 我们在细节上还需要再打磨打磨,力求完美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zài xì jié shàng hái xū yào zài dǎ mó dǎ mó, lì qiú wán měi。
examples.en: We need to polish the details more, striving for perfection.

examples.zh: 在健康上投资,永远都是最划算的事。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiàn kāng shàng tóu zī, yǒng yuǎn dōu shì zuì huá suàn de shì。
examples.en: Investing in health is always the most worthwhile thing.

examples.zh: 在这一点上,我不得不承认他说得很有道理。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè yì diǎn shàng, wǒ bù de bù chéng rèn tā shuō de hěn yǒu dào lǐ。
examples.en: On this point, I must admit he makes a lot of sense.

examples.zh: 他在专业上很强,可是在沟通上还有待提高。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhuān yè shàng hěn qiáng, kě shì zài gōu tōng shàng hái yǒu dài tí gāo。
examples.en: He's strong professionally, but his communication needs improving.

examples.zh: 在环保上,我们每个人都可以出一份力。
examples.pinyin: Zài huán bǎo shàng, wǒ men měi gè rén dōu kě yǐ chū yī fèn lì。
examples.en: In environmental protection, each of us can contribute.

examples.zh: 在感情上,他一直是个很专一、很负责的人。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǎn qíng shàng, tā yì zhí shì gè hěn zhuān yī、 hěn fù zé de rén。
examples.en: In matters of the heart, he's always been devoted and responsible.

examples.zh: 在这个领域里,她是公认的专家。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè ge lǐng yù lǐ, tā shì gōng rèn de zhuān jiā。
examples.en: In this field, she's a recognized expert.

examples.zh: 在原则问题上,我们绝不能有半点让步。
examples.pinyin: Zài yuán zé wèn tí shàng, wǒ men jué bù néng yǒu bàn diǎn ràng bù。
examples.en: On matters of principle, we cannot make the slightest concession.

examples.zh: 在困难面前,大家在行动上表现出了极强的团结。
examples.pinyin: Zài kùn nán miàn qián, dà jiā zài háng dòng shàng biǎo xiàn chū le jí qiáng de tuán jié。
examples.en: In the face of difficulty, everyone showed great unity in action.

title: "对" ile "...-e (karşı), ... için"
summary: "对" (duì) bir eylemin/tutumun yöneldiği kişi ya da şeyi gösterir: 对我很好 = bana çok iyi (davranıyor); 对身体好 = sağlığa iyi.
explanation: "对" bir edat olarak bir eylemin, tutumun ya da etkinin YÖNELDİĞİ kişiyi/şeyi belirtir ve yüklemden önce gelir: 他对我很好 (Bana çok iyi davranıyor), 抽烟对身体不好 (Sigara sağlığa zararlı), 我对这件事很感兴趣 (Bu konuya çok ilgi duyuyorum), 对这个问题,大家有不同意见 (Bu konuya dair farklı görüşler var). Türkçedeki "...-e, ...-e karşı, ... için, ... hakkında" anlamlarını taşır. "对...来说" (... açısından/-e göre) sık bir kalıptır. Tutum bildiren fiil/sıfatlarla (好, 客气, 满意, 感兴趣, 有帮助, 负责) çok kullanılır. "向" ile farkı: "对" hedef/tutum/etki (bir şeye karşı), "向" ise yön/yönelme (bir yöne doğru) vurgular. Türkçedeki "...-e (karşı), ... için, ... hakkında" ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 他对每一位客人都很热情,让人感觉很温暖。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì měi yī wèi kè rén dōu hěn rè qíng, ràng rén gǎn jué hěn wēn nuǎn。
examples.en: He's warm to every guest, making people feel welcome.

examples.zh: 经常熬夜对身体的伤害很大,你要注意休息。
examples.pinyin: Jīng cháng áo yè duì shēn tǐ de shāng hài hěn dà, nǐ yào zhù yì xiū xī。
examples.en: Frequently staying up harms your health greatly; mind your rest.

examples.zh: 我对中国的历史文化一直特别感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhōng guó de lì shǐ wén huà yì zhí tè bié gǎn xìng qù。
examples.en: I've always been especially interested in Chinese history and culture.

examples.zh: 老师对学生很负责,常常利用课余时间辅导他们。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī duì xué shēng hěn fù zé, cháng cháng lì yòng kè yú shí jiān fǔ dǎo tā men。
examples.en: The teacher is responsible toward students, often tutoring after class.

examples.zh: 多吃蔬菜水果对身体有很多好处。
examples.pinyin: Duō chī shū cài shuǐ guǒ duì shēn tǐ yǒu hěn duō hǎo chù。
examples.en: Eating more fruit and vegetables benefits your health greatly.

examples.zh: 他对自己要求很高,做什么事都力求做到最好。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì zì jǐ yāo qiú hěn gāo, zuò shén me shì dōu lì qiú zuò dào zuì hǎo。
examples.en: He demands a lot of himself, striving to do everything best.

examples.zh: 对这次的安排,大家都表示非常满意。
examples.pinyin: Duì zhè cì de ān pái, dà jiā dōu biǎo shì fēi cháng mǎn yì。
examples.en: Everyone expressed great satisfaction with this arrangement.

examples.zh: 父母对我们的爱是无私的,不求任何回报。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ duì wǒ men de ài shì wú sī de, bù qiú rèn hé huí bào。
examples.en: Our parents' love is selfless, seeking no reward.

examples.zh: 你这样做对他不太公平,应该多为他想想。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè yàng zuò duì tā bù tài gōng píng, yīng gāi duō wèi tā xiǎng xiǎng。
examples.en: Doing this isn't quite fair to him; think more of him.

examples.zh: 坚持锻炼对预防疾病很有帮助。
examples.pinyin: Jiān chí duàn liàn duì yù fáng jí bìng hěn yǒu bāng zhù。
examples.en: Persistent exercise helps a lot in preventing illness.

examples.zh: 他对工作认真负责,从来不敷衍了事。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōng zuò rèn zhēn fù zé, cóng lái bù fū yǎn liǎo shì。
examples.en: He's earnest and responsible at work, never perfunctory.

examples.zh: 对陌生人要有礼貌,但也要保持一定的警惕。
examples.pinyin: Duì mò shēng rén yào yǒu lǐ mào, dàn yě yào bǎo chí yí dìng de jǐng tì。
examples.en: Be polite to strangers, but also stay somewhat alert.

examples.zh: 这本书对我的影响很大,改变了我很多想法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū duì wǒ de yǐng xiǎng hěn dà, gǎi biàn le wǒ hěn duō xiǎng fǎ。
examples.en: This book influenced me greatly, changing many of my ideas.

examples.zh: 对朋友,他一向真诚,从不虚情假意。
examples.pinyin: Duì péng yǒu, tā yí xiàng zhēn chéng, cóng bù xū qíng jiǎ yì。
examples.en: To friends, he's always sincere, never false.

examples.zh: 我对这道菜的味道不太满意,好像少了点什么。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè dào cài de wèi dào bù tài mǎn yì, hǎo xiàng shǎo le diǎn shén me。
examples.en: I'm not quite satisfied with this dish; it seems to lack something.

examples.zh: 良好的睡眠对孩子的成长非常重要。
examples.pinyin: Liáng hǎo de shuì mián duì hái zi de chéng zhǎng fēi cháng zhòng yào。
examples.en: Good sleep is very important for a child's growth.

examples.zh: 他对家乡有着深厚的感情,退休后就搬回去住了。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì jiā xiāng yǒu zhe shēn hòu de gǎn qíng, tuì xiū hòu jiù bān huí qù zhù le。
examples.en: He has deep feelings for his hometown and moved back after retiring.

examples.zh: 对这个建议,领导表示会认真研究一下。
examples.pinyin: Duì zhè ge jiàn yì, lǐng dǎo biǎo shì huì rèn zhēn yán jiū yī xià。
examples.en: On this suggestion, the leader said it would be seriously studied.

examples.zh: 你对自己要有信心,别总是低估自己的能力。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì zì jǐ yào yǒu xìn xīn, bié zǒng shì dī gū zì jǐ de néng lì。
examples.en: Have confidence in yourself; don't always underestimate your abilities.

examples.zh: 长期看手机对眼睛的伤害不容忽视。
examples.pinyin: Cháng qī kàn shǒu jī duì yǎn jīng de shāng hài bù róng hū shì。
examples.en: The harm of prolonged phone use to the eyes can't be ignored.

examples.zh: 他对每个细节都很认真,难怪工作做得那么出色。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì měi gè xì jié dōu hěn rèn zhēn, nán guài gōng zuò zuò de nà me chū sè。
examples.en: He's careful about every detail; no wonder his work is excellent.

examples.zh: 对我来说,家人的健康比什么都重要。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, jiā rén de jiàn kāng bǐ shén me dōu zhòng yào。
examples.en: To me, my family's health matters more than anything.

examples.zh: 这位老师对教育事业充满了热情和责任感。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī duì jiào yù shì yè chōng mǎn le rè qíng hé zé rèn gǎn。
examples.en: This teacher is full of passion and responsibility for education.

examples.zh: 你对他误会了,他其实一直在默默地帮你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duì tā wù huì le, tā qí shí yì zhí zài mò mò de bāng nǐ。
examples.en: You've misunderstood him; he's actually been quietly helping you.

examples.zh: 保持乐观的心态对战胜困难很有帮助。
examples.pinyin: Bǎo chí lè guān de xīn tài duì zhàn shèng kùn nán hěn yǒu bāng zhù。
examples.en: Keeping an optimistic attitude helps a lot in overcoming difficulties.

title: "看起来" ile "görünüşe göre, ...gibi görünüyor"
summary: "看起来" (kànqǐlái) bir şeyin dıştan nasıl göründüğünü/izlenimini bildirir: 他看起来很累 = O yorgun görünüyor.
explanation: "看起来" bir şeyin/kişinin DIŞ görünüşünü ya da bir durumdan çıkan izlenimi bildirir: "...gibi görünüyor, görünüşe göre, dıştan ... görünüyor". 他看起来很年轻 (Genç görünüyor), 天看起来要下雨了 (Hava yağmur yağacak gibi görünüyor), 这道题看起来难,其实不难 (Bu soru zor görünüyor ama aslında değil). Bir gözleme dayalı yargı/tahmin bildirir ve çoğu zaman gerçeğin farklı olabileceğini ima eder (看起来...,其实... = görünüşte ... ama aslında ...). Cümlenin başında ya da öznenin ardından gelir. Benzer ifadeler: 看上去 (aynı anlam), 听起来 (kulağa ... geliyor). Türkçedeki "...gibi görünüyor, görünüşe göre, anlaşılan, ...-mış gibi" ifadelerine denk gelir; dış izlenime dayalı çıkarım yapmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 他今天看起来气色不太好,是不是没休息好?
examples.pinyin: Tā jīn tiān kàn qǐ lái qì sè bù tài hǎo, shì bú shì méi xiū xī hǎo?
examples.en: He looks a bit unwell today; didn't he rest well?

examples.zh: 这道菜看起来普普通通,没想到味道这么好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài kàn qǐ lái pǔ pǔ tōng tōng, méi xiǎng dào wèi dào zhè me hǎo。
examples.en: This dish looks ordinary, but surprisingly tastes great.

examples.zh: 天看起来要变了,乌云越来越厚,我们快回去吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān kàn qǐ lái yào biàn le, wū yún yuè lái yuè hòu, wǒ men kuài huí qù ba。
examples.en: The weather looks like it'll change; the clouds thicken, let's head back.

examples.zh: 这个问题看起来很复杂,理清思路后其实很简单。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí kàn qǐ lái hěn fù zá, lǐ qīng sī lù hòu qí shí hěn jiǎn dān。
examples.en: This problem looks complex, but once you sort it out, it's simple.

examples.zh: 她看起来很年轻,谁也没想到她已经四十多岁了。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn nián qīng, shuí yě méi xiǎng dào tā yǐ jīng sì shí duō suì le。
examples.en: She looks young; no one would guess she's over forty.

examples.zh: 这件衣服看起来质量不错,你可以试试。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú kàn qǐ lái zhì liàng bù cuò, nǐ kě yǐ shì shì。
examples.en: This outfit looks well-made; you could try it on.

examples.zh: 他看起来很冷淡,其实内心非常热情。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn lěng dàn, qí shí nèi xīn fēi cháng rè qíng。
examples.en: He seems cold, but he's actually very warm inside.

examples.zh: 这条路看起来不远,走起来才发现挺费劲的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù kàn qǐ lái bù yuǎn, zǒu qǐ lái cái fā xiàn tǐng fèi jìn de。
examples.en: This road looks short, but walking it turns out quite tiring.

examples.zh: 孩子看起来很懂事,做事有条有理的。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi kàn qǐ lái hěn dǒng shì, zuò shì yǒu tiáo yǒu lǐ de。
examples.en: The child seems sensible, doing things in an orderly way.

examples.zh: 这台机器看起来很旧,但用起来还是很顺手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jī qì kàn qǐ lái hěn jiù, dàn yòng qǐ lái hái shì hěn shùn shǒu。
examples.en: This machine looks old, but it's still smooth to use.

examples.zh: 他俩看起来很像,其实一点血缘关系都没有。
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎ kàn qǐ lái hěn xiàng, qí shí yì diǎn xuè yuán guān xì dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: The two look alike, but have no blood relation at all.

examples.zh: 外面看起来挺暖和,可一出门就被风吹得直哆嗦。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn kàn qǐ lái tǐng nuǎn huo, kě yī chū mén jiù bèi fēng chuī de zhí duō suo。
examples.en: It looks warm out, but the wind makes you shiver once outside.

examples.zh: 这份工作看起来轻松,做起来其实压力不小。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōng zuò kàn qǐ lái qīng sōng, zuò qǐ lái qí shí yā lì bù xiǎo。
examples.en: This job looks easy, but doing it is quite stressful.

examples.zh: 他看起来很有把握,说话的语气特别自信。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn yǒu bǎ wò, shuō huà de yǔ qì tè bié zì xìn。
examples.en: He looks confident; his tone is especially assured.

examples.zh: 这些水果看起来很新鲜,应该是刚到货的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē shuǐ guǒ kàn qǐ lái hěn xīn xiān, yīng gāi shì gāng dào huò de。
examples.en: This fruit looks fresh; it must have just arrived.

examples.zh: 事情看起来已经解决了,可其实还有不少隐患。
examples.pinyin: Shì qíng kàn qǐ lái yǐ jīng jiě jué le, kě qí shí hái yǒu bù shǎo yǐn huàn。
examples.en: The matter looks resolved, but there are still hidden risks.

examples.zh: 她看起来心情不错,一直在笑,不知道有什么好事。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái xīn qíng bù cuò, yì zhí zài xiào, bù zhī dào yǒu shén me hǎo shì。
examples.en: She seems in a good mood, smiling; I wonder what good news there is.

examples.zh: 这栋楼看起来不高,里面的结构却很复杂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng lóu kàn qǐ lái bù gāo, lǐ miàn de jié gòu què hěn fù zá。
examples.en: This building doesn't look tall, but its structure is complex.

examples.zh: 他看起来很轻松地就完成了,背后其实下了很多功夫。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái hěn qīng sōng de jiù wán chéng le, bèi hòu qí shí xià le hěn duō gōng fu。
examples.en: He seemed to finish easily, but put in much effort behind it.

examples.zh: 天色看起来还早,其实太阳很快就要落山了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān sè kàn qǐ lái hái zǎo, qí shí tài yáng hěn kuài jiù yào luò shān le。
examples.en: It looks early, but the sun will set soon.

examples.zh: 这个方案看起来可行,不过还需要进一步验证。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fāng àn kàn qǐ lái kě xíng, bù guò hái xū yào jìn yí bù yàn zhèng。
examples.en: This plan looks feasible, but needs further verification.

examples.zh: 他看起来什么都不在乎,心里其实特别敏感。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐ lái shén me dōu bù zài hū, xīn lǐ qí shí tè bié mǐn gǎn。
examples.en: He looks like he cares about nothing, but is very sensitive inside.

examples.zh: 这只小猫看起来很凶,其实特别黏人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǐ xiǎo māo kàn qǐ lái hěn xiōng, qí shí tè bié nián rén。
examples.en: This kitten looks fierce, but is actually very clingy.

examples.zh: 你看起来瘦了不少,最近是不是太累了?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn qǐ lái shòu le bù shǎo, zuì jìn shì bú shì tài lèi le?
examples.en: You look a lot thinner; have you been too tired lately?

examples.zh: 这场比赛看起来我们赢定了,可结果却输了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐ sài kàn qǐ lái wǒ men yíng dìng le, kě jié guǒ què shū le。
examples.en: This match looked like a sure win, but we ended up losing.

title: "让/叫/使" ile ettirgen yapı
pattern: Özne + 让 / 叫 / 使 + Kişi + Yüklem
summary: "让/叫/使" birine bir şey yaptırmayı ya da bir duyguya yol açmayı bildirir: 让我想想 = düşünmeme izin ver; 使人感动 = insanı duygulandırmak.
explanation: "让", "叫" ve "使" ETTİRGEN (sebep bildiren) fiillerdir; birinin bir şeyi YAPMASINA yol açmayı ya da bir duyguyu/durumu ORTAYA ÇIKARMAYI bildirir. Kalıp: Özne + 让/叫/使 + kişi + yüklem. (1) "让": izin verme ya da yaptırma, en yaygın ve nötr — 妈妈让我早点回家 (Annem erken dönmemi istedi), 让我看看 (bir bakayım). (2) "叫": "让"e benzer, biraz daha buyurgan/konuşma dili — 老师叫他回答问题 (Öğretmen ona soruyu cevaplattı). (3) "使": daha soyut/resmî, çoğu zaman bir duyguya/sonuca yol açar, kişi yerine durum da gelebilir — 这件事使我很难过 (Bu olay beni çok üzdü), 使人感动 (insanı duygulandırır). Türkçedeki "...-tırmak, ...-e izin vermek, ...-e yol açmak, -e neden olmak" ettirgen anlamlarına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 妈妈让我把房间收拾干净再出去玩。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā ràng wǒ bǎ fáng jiān shōu shí gān jìng zài chū qù wán。
examples.en: Mom told me to clean my room before going out to play.

examples.zh: 老师叫小明到黑板前面来做这道题。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī jiào xiǎo míng dào hēi bǎn qián miàn lái zuò zhè dào tí。
examples.en: The teacher had Xiao Ming come to the board to do this problem.

examples.zh: 这部电影的结局使很多观众都流下了眼泪。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diàn yǐng de jié jú shǐ hěn duō guān zhòng dōu liú xià le yǎn lèi。
examples.en: The movie's ending made many viewers shed tears.

examples.zh: 对不起,让你久等了,路上实在太堵了。
examples.pinyin: Duì bù qǐ, ràng nǐ jiǔ děng le, lù shàng shí zài tài dǔ le。
examples.en: Sorry to keep you waiting; the traffic was really terrible.

examples.zh: 他的一番话让我彻底改变了对这件事的看法。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yī fān huà ràng wǒ chè dǐ gǎi biàn le duì zhè jiàn shì de kàn fǎ。
examples.en: His words completely changed my view on this matter.

examples.zh: 请让一让,后面的人要下车了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng ràng yī ràng, hòu miàn de rén yào xià chē le。
examples.en: Please make way; the people behind need to get off.

examples.zh: 父母从小就叫我们自己的事情自己做。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ cóng xiǎo jiù jiào wǒ men zì jǐ de shì qíng zì jǐ zuò。
examples.en: Our parents had us do our own things from childhood.

examples.zh: 这次失败使他明白了坚持的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shī bài shǐ tā míng bái le jiān chí de zhòng yào xìng。
examples.en: This failure made him understand the importance of persistence.

examples.zh: 医生让他这几天多喝水,好好休息。
examples.pinyin: Yī shēng ràng tā zhè jǐ tiān duō hē shuǐ, hǎo hǎo xiū xī。
examples.en: The doctor told him to drink more water and rest these days.

examples.zh: 他的诚实和善良使大家都很信任他。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéng shí hé shàn liáng shǐ dà jiā dōu hěn xìn rèn tā。
examples.en: His honesty and kindness made everyone trust him.

examples.zh: 妈妈不让孩子吃太多糖,怕对牙齿不好。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā bù ràng hái zi chī tài duō táng, pà duì yá chǐ bù hǎo。
examples.en: Mom won't let the child eat too much sugar, fearing tooth damage.

examples.zh: 这件事让我认识到,做人一定要有责任心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ rèn shí dào, zuò rén yí dìng yào yǒu zé rèn xīn。
examples.en: This made me realize that one must have a sense of responsibility.

examples.zh: 老板叫我明天一早去他办公室一趟。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo bǎn jiào wǒ míng tiān yī zǎo qù tā bàn gōng shì yī tàng。
examples.en: The boss told me to come to his office first thing tomorrow.

examples.zh: 优美的音乐使人的心情一下子放松下来。
examples.pinyin: Yōu měi de yīn yuè shǐ rén de xīn qíng yī xià zi fàng sōng xià lái。
examples.en: Beautiful music instantly relaxes one's mood.

examples.zh: 请你让孩子早点睡觉,别老让他看电视。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ ràng hái zi zǎo diǎn shuì jiào, bié lǎo ràng tā kàn diàn shì。
examples.en: Please let the child sleep early; don't always let him watch TV.

examples.zh: 他坚持不懈的精神使身边的人深受鼓舞。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiān chí bù xiè de jīng shén shǐ shēn biān de rén shēn shòu gǔ wǔ。
examples.en: His unremitting spirit deeply inspired those around him.

examples.zh: 外面太吵了,吵得让人根本没法安心工作。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn tài chǎo le, chǎo de ràng rén gēn běn méi fǎ ān xīn gōng zuò。
examples.en: It's so noisy outside that one simply can't work in peace.

examples.zh: 这次旅行让我们全家人的感情更亲密了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng ràng wǒ men quán jiā rén de gǎn qíng gèng qīn mì le。
examples.en: This trip made our whole family closer.

examples.zh: 老师叫大家把这篇课文背下来。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī jiào dà jiā bǎ zhè piān kè wén bèi xià lái。
examples.en: The teacher had everyone memorize this text.

examples.zh: 科技的进步使我们的生活变得越来越方便。
examples.pinyin: Kē jì de jìn bù shǐ wǒ men de shēng huó biàn de yuè lái yuè fāng biàn。
examples.en: Technological progress makes our lives ever more convenient.

examples.zh: 他的进步让所有关心他的人都感到欣慰。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìn bù ràng suǒ yǒu guān xīn tā de rén dōu gǎn dào xīn wèi。
examples.en: His progress comforted everyone who cares about him.

examples.zh: 妈妈让我替她给楼下的邻居送点自己包的饺子。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā ràng wǒ tì tā gěi lóu xià de lín jū sòng diǎn zì jǐ bāo de jiǎo zi。
examples.en: Mom had me deliver some homemade dumplings to the downstairs neighbor.

examples.zh: 这段经历使他成长了很多,也成熟了很多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn jīng lì shǐ tā chéng zhǎng le hěn duō, yě chéng shú le hěn duō。
examples.en: This experience made him grow and mature a lot.

examples.zh: 请你让开一点,别挡着大家看比赛。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ ràng kāi yì diǎn, bié dǎng zhe dà jiā kàn bǐ sài。
examples.en: Please move aside; don't block everyone's view of the match.

examples.zh: 孩子的一句话,让在场的人都笑了起来。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi de yī jù huà, ràng zài chǎng de rén dōu xiào le qǐ lái。
examples.en: One remark from the child made everyone present laugh.

title: "要看/得看" ile "... duruma bağlı"
pattern: 这 / 那 + 要看 / 得看 + Belirsiz Durum
summary: "要看/得看" bir sonucun bir şeye BAĞLI olduğunu bildirir: 这得看天气 = Bu havaya bağlı; 要看你怎么想 = Sana kalmış.
explanation: "要看" ya da "得看" (děi kàn) bir şeyin başka bir koşula/duruma BAĞLI olduğunu, ona göre değişeceğini bildirir: "... duruma bağlı, ...-e bağlı, ...-e göre değişir". 去不去要看天气怎么样 (Gidip gitmemek havaya bağlı), 这件事得看他愿不愿意 (Bu, onun isteyip istemediğine bağlı), 能不能成功,要看你的努力 (Başarı senin çabana bağlı). "看" burada "bakmak" değil, "...-e bağlı olmak, ...-e göre belirlenmek" anlamındadır ve ardından çoğu zaman belirsiz bir durum/soru öbeği gelir (要看...怎么样 / 愿不愿意 / 能不能). Bir kesin cevaptan kaçınıp koşula işaret eder. Türkçedeki "... duruma bağlı, ...-e bağlı, ...-e göre değişir, ...-e kalmış, ona bakar" ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 周末去不去爬山,还要看天气怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò qù bù qù pá shān, hái yào kàn tiān qì zěn me yàng。
examples.en: Whether we hike this weekend depends on the weather.

examples.zh: 这件事能不能办成,得看他愿不愿意帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì néng bù néng bàn chéng, de kàn tā yuàn bù yuàn yì bāng máng。
examples.en: Whether this can be done depends on whether he's willing to help.

examples.zh: 你能取得多大的进步,要看你自己有多努力。

examples.en: How much progress you make depends on how hard you try.

examples.zh: 买不买这套房子,还得看价钱合不合适。
