examples.en: Whether to buy this house depends on whether the price is right.

examples.zh: 我们几点出发,要看路上堵不堵车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jǐ diǎn chū fā, yào kàn lù shàng dǔ bù dǔ chē。
examples.en: When we set off depends on whether the roads are jammed.

examples.zh: 这道菜好不好吃,主要得看火候掌握得怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài hǎo bù hǎo chī, zhǔ yào de kàn huǒ hòu zhǎng wò de zěn me yàng。
examples.en: Whether this dish is tasty mainly depends on the heat control.

examples.zh: 他会不会来,现在还说不准,得看他有没有时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì bú huì lái, xiàn zài hái shuō bù zhǔn, de kàn tā yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān。
examples.en: Whether he'll come is uncertain; it depends on if he has time.

examples.zh: 这次比赛谁赢谁输,还要看临场的发挥。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bǐ sài shuí yíng shuí shū, hái yào kàn lín chǎng de fā huī。
examples.en: Who wins this match depends on the on-the-spot performance.

examples.zh: 能不能按时完成,要看大家配合得好不好。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng àn shí wán chéng, yào kàn dà jiā pèi hé de hǎo bù hǎo。
examples.en: Whether we finish on time depends on how well everyone cooperates.

examples.zh: 孩子将来有没有出息,很大程度上要看家庭教育。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi jiāng lái yǒu méi yǒu chū xī, hěn dà chéng dù shàng yào kān jiā tíng jiào yù。
examples.en: Whether a child succeeds later largely depends on family education.

examples.zh: 这笔生意做不做得成,得看双方能不能谈拢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ shēng yì zuò bù zuò de chéng, de kàn shuāng fāng néng bù néng tán lǒng。
examples.en: Whether this deal closes depends on whether both sides can agree.

examples.zh: 你穿多少衣服,要看今天到底有多冷。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ chuān duō shǎo yī fú, yào kàn jīn tiān dào dǐ yǒu duō lěng。
examples.en: How much you wear depends on just how cold it is today.

examples.zh: 这件事怎么处理,还得看领导是什么意见。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zěn me chǔ lǐ, hái de kàn lǐng dǎo shì shén me yì jiàn。
examples.en: How to handle this depends on the leader's opinion.

examples.zh: 我们能玩多久,要看爸妈几点来接我们。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men néng wán duō jiǔ, yào kàn bà mā jǐ diǎn lái jiē wǒ men。
examples.en: How long we can play depends on when our parents pick us up.

examples.zh: 身体能不能好得快,主要得看你听不听医生的话。
examples.pinyin: Shēn tǐ néng bù néng hǎo de kuài, zhǔ yào de kàn nǐ tīng bù tīng yī shēng de huà。
examples.en: Whether you recover fast mainly depends on heeding the doctor.

examples.zh: 这场雨会不会影响出行,还要看它下多久。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǔ huì bú huì yǐng xiǎng chū xíng, hái yào kàn tā xià duō jiǔ。
examples.en: Whether the rain affects travel depends on how long it lasts.

examples.zh: 最后选哪个方案,要看哪个更符合实际情况。
examples.pinyin: Zuì hòu xuǎn nǎ ge fāng àn, yào kàn nǎ ge gèng fú hé shí jì qíng kuàng。
examples.en: Which plan is chosen depends on which fits reality better.

examples.zh: 能不能考上,不光要看努力,也得看临场心态。
examples.pinyin: Néng bù néng kǎo shàng, bù guāng yào kàn nǔ lì, yě de kàn lín chǎng xīn tài。
examples.en: Passing depends not only on effort but also on one's mindset.

examples.zh: 这东西值不值这个价,得看你到底有多需要它。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dōng xī zhí bù zhí zhè ge jià, de kàn nǐ dào dǐ yǒu duō xū yào tā。
examples.en: Whether it's worth the price depends on how much you need it.

examples.zh: 我们下午去哪儿玩,还要看你想不想去海边。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xià wǔ qù nǎ ér wán, hái yào kàn nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù hǎi biān。
examples.en: Where we go this afternoon depends on whether you want the beach.

examples.zh: 这个计划能不能推进,要看资金到不到位。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jì huà néng bù néng tuī jìn, yào kàn zī jīn dào bú dào wèi。
examples.en: Whether this plan proceeds depends on whether funds are in place.

examples.zh: 他适不适合这份工作,还得看试用期的表现。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì bú shì hé zhè fèn gōng zuò, hái de kàn shì yòng qī de biǎo xiàn。
examples.en: Whether he suits this job depends on his probation performance.

examples.zh: 菜种得好不好,很大程度上要看天气和土壤。
examples.pinyin: Cài zhǒng de hǎo bù hǎo, hěn dà chéng dù shàng yào kàn tiān qì hé tǔ rǎng。
examples.en: How well crops grow largely depends on weather and soil.

examples.zh: 我们要不要改计划,得看明天的情况再决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yào bù yào gǎi jì huà, de kàn míng tiān de qíng kuàng zài jué dìng。
examples.en: Whether we change plans depends on tomorrow's situation.

examples.zh: 这本书值不值得读,要看你对这个话题感不感兴趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū zhí bù zhí de dú, yào kàn nǐ duì zhè ge huà tí gǎn bù gǎn xìng qù。
examples.en: Whether this book is worth reading depends on your interest in the topic.

title: "好像" ile "sanki, ...gibi görünüyor"
summary: "好像" (hǎoxiàng) bir tahmin ya da benzetme bildirir: "sanki, galiba, ...gibi görünüyor": 他好像生病了 = Galiba hasta.
explanation: "好像" iki yakın işlev taşır: (1) TAHMİN/belirsizlik — kesin olmayan bir yargı: "galiba, sanırım, ...gibi görünüyor, öyle sanıyorum": 他好像不太高兴 (Pek mutlu değil gibi), 我好像在哪儿见过你 (Seni bir yerde görmüş gibiyim). (2) BENZETME — "sanki, tıpkı ...gibi", çoğu zaman "好像...一样/似的" kalıbında: 他高兴得好像个孩子一样 (Bir çocuk gibi sevindi), 天冷得好像到了冬天 (Sanki kış gelmiş gibi soğuk). Yüklemden önce ya da cümle başında gelir. Kesin olmayan bir izlenimi ya da bir benzetmeyi yumuşak biçimde ifade eder. Türkçedeki "sanki, galiba, sanırım, ...gibi görünüyor, tıpkı ...gibi" ifadelerine denk gelir; ihtiyatlı tahmin ve benzetme yapmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 他今天好像有心事,一整天都没怎么说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīn tiān hǎo xiàng yǒu xīn shì, yī zhěng tiān dōu méi zěn me shuō huà。
examples.en: He seems troubled today; he barely spoke all day.

examples.zh: 外面好像下雨了,你听,窗户上有滴答声。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn hǎo xiàng xià yǔ le, nǐ tīng, chuāng hù shàng yǒu dī dā shēng。
examples.en: It seems to be raining outside; listen, there's a pattering on the window.

examples.zh: 我好像在哪儿见过你,你是不是小王的朋友?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo xiàng zài nǎ ér jiàn guò nǐ, nǐ shì bú shì xiǎo wáng de péng yǒu?
examples.en: I seem to have seen you somewhere; are you Xiao Wang's friend?

examples.zh: 这道题我好像做过,可是一时想不起答案了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí wǒ hǎo xiàng zuò guò, kě shì yī shí xiǎng bù qǐ dá àn le。
examples.en: I seem to have done this problem, but can't recall the answer now.

examples.zh: 他跑得飞快,好像一阵风一样从我身边掠过。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de fēi kuài, hǎo xiàng yī zhèn fēng yī yàng cóng wǒ shēn biān lüè guò。
examples.en: He ran so fast, brushing past me like a gust of wind.

examples.zh: 天气好像要转凉了,你出门多带件衣服吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì hǎo xiàng yào zhuǎn liáng le, nǐ chū mén duō dài jiàn yī fú ba。
examples.en: The weather seems to be turning cool; take an extra layer.

examples.zh: 她笑起来的样子,好像她妈妈年轻的时候。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiào qǐ lái de yàng zi, hǎo xiàng tā mā mā nián qīng de shí hòu。
examples.en: The way she smiles is just like her mother when young.

examples.zh: 我好像把钥匙落在办公室了,得回去拿一趟。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo xiàng bǎ yào shi luò zài bàn gōng shì le, de huí qù ná yī tàng。
examples.en: I seem to have left my keys at the office; I need to go back for them.

examples.zh: 这孩子懂事得好像个小大人似的,真让人喜欢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè hái zi dǒng shì de hǎo xiàng gè xiǎo dà rén shì de, zhēn ràng rén xǐ huān。
examples.en: This child is sensible like a little adult; truly likable.

examples.zh: 他好像对这件事不太感兴趣,一直没什么反应。
examples.pinyin: Tā hǎo xiàng duì zhè jiàn shì bù tài gǎn xìng qù, yì zhí méi shén me fǎn yìng。
examples.en: He seems uninterested in this; there's been little reaction.

examples.zh: 那座山远远望去,好像一头卧着的大象。
examples.pinyin: Nà zuò shān yuǎn yuǎn wàng qù, hǎo xiàng yī tóu wò zhe de dà xiàng。
examples.en: Seen from afar, that mountain looks like a lying elephant.

examples.zh: 你的脸色好像不太好,是不是哪里不舒服?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de liǎn sè hǎo xiàng bù tài hǎo, shì bú shì nǎ lǐ bù shū fú?
examples.en: Your color seems off; are you unwell somewhere?

examples.zh: 时间过得好像流水一样,一转眼就是好多年。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān guò de hǎo xiàng liú shuǐ yī yàng, yī zhuǎn yǎn jiù shì hǎo duō nián。
examples.en: Time passes like flowing water; in a blink, many years.

examples.zh: 我好像听见有人叫我,你有没有听到?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo xiàng tīng jiàn yǒu rén jiào wǒ, nǐ yǒu méi yǒu tīng dào?
examples.en: I seem to hear someone calling me; did you hear it?

examples.zh: 这两个字长得好像,一不小心就容易写错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè zì zhǎng de hǎo xiàng, yí bù xiǎo xīn jiù róng yì xiě cuò。
examples.en: These two characters look alike; it's easy to write them wrong.

examples.zh: 他激动得好像中了大奖一样,又蹦又跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā jī dòng de hǎo xiàng zhōng le dà jiǎng yī yàng, yòu bèng yòu tiào。
examples.en: He was as excited as if he'd won a jackpot, jumping about.

examples.zh: 这附近好像新开了一家书店,咱们去看看?
examples.pinyin: Zhè fù jìn hǎo xiàng xīn kāi le yī jiā shū diàn, zán men qù kàn kàn?
examples.en: It seems a new bookstore opened nearby; shall we take a look?

examples.zh: 她的声音好像有点儿哑,可能是感冒了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shēng yīn hǎo xiàng yǒu diǎn ér yǎ, kě néng shì gǎn mào le。
examples.en: Her voice sounds a bit hoarse; she may have a cold.

examples.zh: 这道菜的味道好像少了点儿什么,是不是忘放盐了?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de wèi dào hǎo xiàng shǎo le diǎn ér shén me, shì bú shì wàng fàng yán le?
examples.en: This dish seems to lack something; did we forget the salt?

examples.zh: 站在山顶,好像整个世界都在自己脚下。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shān dǐng, hǎo xiàng zhěng gè shì jiè dōu zài zì jǐ jiǎo xià。
examples.en: Standing on the summit, it feels as if the whole world is beneath you.

examples.zh: 他好像有话想说,却又欲言又止,似乎很为难。
examples.pinyin: Tā hǎo xiàng yǒu huà xiǎng shuō, què yòu yù yán yòu zhǐ, sì hū hěn wéi nán。
examples.en: He seems to have something to say but keeps hesitating, as if troubled.

examples.zh: 这几天他好像特别忙,连吃饭的时间都没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tā hǎo xiàng tè bié máng, lián chī fàn de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: These days he seems especially busy, without even time to eat.

examples.zh: 孩子睡着的样子,好像天使一样安静、可爱。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shuì zháo de yàng zi, hǎo xiàng tiān shǐ yī yàng ān jìng、 kě ài。
examples.en: The sleeping child looks as quiet and adorable as an angel.

examples.zh: 我好像把这件事跟你说过,你还记得吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo xiàng bǎ zhè jiàn shì gēn nǐ shuō guò, nǐ hái jì de ma?
examples.en: I seem to have told you this; do you remember?

examples.zh: 窗外的月亮又大又圆,好像一个银盘挂在天上。
examples.pinyin: Chuāng wài de yuè liàng yòu dà yòu yuán, hǎo xiàng yí gè yín pán guà zài tiān shàng。
examples.en: The moon outside is big and round, like a silver plate in the sky.

title: "以为" ile yanlış sanı
summary: "以为" (yǐwéi) çoğu zaman YANLIŞ çıkan bir sanıyı bildirir: 我以为你走了 = Gittiğini sanmıştım (ama gitmemişsin).
explanation: "以为" bir şeyi düşünmek/sanmaktır, ama neredeyse her zaman sonradan YANLIŞ çıkan bir varsayımı bildirir: "...sanmak, ...zannetmek" (ama aslında öyle değil). 我以为今天是星期天 (Bugünü pazar sanmıştım — değilmiş), 大家都以为他不来了,结果他来了 (Herkes gelmeyeceğini sandı, ama geldi). Konuşmacı önceki (hatalı) inancını, sonradan öğrendiği gerçekle örtük biçimde karşılaştırır. "觉得" (düşünmek/hissetmek) ve "认为" (kanısında olmak) tarafsızken, "以为" özellikle GERÇEĞE AYKIRI çıkan sanıyı vurgular. Cümle çoğu zaman "...,其实/结果..." ile devam eder. Türkçedeki "...sanmak, ...zannetmek, ...diye düşünmek (ama yanılmak)" anlamına denk gelir; yanlış bir varsayımı ve sürpriz gerçeği anlatmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 我以为今天不上班,结果闹钟一响才想起来要上班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi jīn tiān bù shàng bān, jié guǒ nào zhōng yī xiǎng cái xiǎng qǐ lái yào shàng bān。
examples.en: I thought there was no work today, but the alarm reminded me there was.

examples.zh: 大家都以为他会迟到,没想到他第一个就到了。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu yǐ wéi tā huì chí dào, méi xiǎng dào tā dì yí gè jiù dào le。
examples.en: Everyone thought he'd be late, but he was the first to arrive.

examples.zh: 我一直以为这道题很难,做起来才发现其实很简单。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì zhí yǐ wéi zhè dào tí hěn nán, zuò qǐ lái cái fā xiàn qí shí hěn jiǎn dān。
examples.en: I always thought this problem was hard, but it turned out simple.

examples.zh: 他以为没人看见,悄悄把最后一块蛋糕吃掉了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi méi rén kàn jiàn, qiāo qiāo bǎ zuì hòu yī kuài dàn gāo chī diào le。
examples.en: Thinking no one saw, he quietly ate the last piece of cake.

examples.zh: 我还以为你早就把这件事忘了呢,原来你一直记着。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ zǎo jiù bǎ zhè jiàn shì wàng le ne, yuán lái nǐ yì zhí jì zhe。
examples.en: I thought you'd long forgotten this, but you remembered all along.

examples.zh: 她以为儿子还在睡觉,推开门才发现床是空的。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi ér zi hái zài shuì jiào, tuī kāi mén cái fā xiàn chuáng shì kōng de。
examples.en: She thought her son was still asleep, but the bed was empty.

examples.zh: 我以为这条路是近路,结果反而多走了很多冤枉路。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi zhè tiáo lù shì jìn lù, jié guǒ fǎn ér duō zǒu le hěn duō yuān wǎng lù。
examples.en: I thought this road was a shortcut, but it took much longer instead.

examples.zh: 大家原以为会下雨,结果一整天都是大晴天。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā yuán yǐ wéi huì xià yǔ, jié guǒ yī zhěng tiān dōu shì dà qíng tiān。
examples.en: Everyone thought it would rain, but it was sunny all day.

examples.zh: 他以为自己听错了,又反复问了好几遍。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi zì jǐ tīng cuò le, yòu fǎn fù wèn le hǎo jǐ biàn。
examples.en: Thinking he'd misheard, he asked again several times.

examples.zh: 我以为这件衣服很贵,一看价格才发现挺便宜的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi zhè jiàn yī fú hěn guì, yī kàn jià gé cái fā xiàn tǐng pián yi de。
examples.en: I thought this outfit was pricey, but the price was quite cheap.

examples.zh: 你别以为我不知道,你做的那些事我都清楚。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié yǐ wéi wǒ bù zhī dào, nǐ zuò de nà xiē shì wǒ dōu qīng chǔ。
examples.en: Don't think I don't know; I'm clear about all you've done.

examples.zh: 我以为他是本地人,聊了才知道他也是外地来的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi tā shì běn dì rén, liáo le cái zhī dào tā yě shì wài dì lái de。
examples.en: I thought he was a local, but chatting revealed he's from elsewhere too.

examples.zh: 孩子以为妈妈生气了,一直小心翼翼地不敢说话。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi yǐ wéi mā mā shēng qì le, yì zhí xiǎo xīn yì yì de bù gǎn shuō huà。
examples.en: The child thought mom was angry and cautiously kept silent.

examples.zh: 我原以为这本书很枯燥,读起来却意外地有趣。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yuán yǐ wéi zhè běn shū hěn kū zào, dú qǐ lái què yì wài dì yǒu qù。
examples.en: I thought this book was dull, but it was unexpectedly interesting.

examples.zh: 他以为把门锁好了,回来才发现门根本没关严。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi bǎ mén suǒ hǎo le, huí lái cái fā xiàn mén gēn běn méi guān yán。
examples.en: He thought he'd locked the door, but found it hadn't shut properly.

examples.zh: 我以为你不喜欢吃辣,所以特意点了清淡的菜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ bù xǐ huān chī là, suǒ yǐ tè yì diǎn le qīng dàn de cài。
examples.en: I thought you disliked spicy food, so I ordered mild dishes.

examples.zh: 大家以为比赛已经结束了,没想到还有加时赛。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā yǐ wéi bǐ sài yǐ jīng jié shù le, méi xiǎng dào hái yǒu jiā shí sài。
examples.en: Everyone thought the match was over, not expecting overtime.

examples.zh: 我一开始以为他在开玩笑,后来才知道他是认真的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yī kāi shǐ yǐ wéi tā zài kāi wán xiào, hòu lái cái zhī dào tā shì rèn zhēn de。
examples.en: At first I thought he was joking; later I knew he was serious.

examples.zh: 她以为把秘密藏得很好,其实早就被大家看出来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi bǎ mì mì cáng de hěn hǎo, qí shí zǎo jiù bèi dà jiā kàn chū lái le。
examples.en: She thought her secret was well hidden, but everyone had seen through it.

examples.zh: 我以为走错了地方,再一看门牌才发现没错。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi zǒu cuò le dì fāng, zài yī kān mén pái cái fā xiàn méi cuò。
examples.en: I thought I'd come to the wrong place, but the number was right.

examples.zh: 他以为这次肯定能成功,结果还是差了一点。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi zhè cì kěn dìng néng chéng gōng, jié guǒ hái shì chà le yì diǎn。
examples.en: He thought he'd surely succeed, but fell just short.

examples.zh: 我以为这只是件小事,没想到会闹得这么大。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi zhè zhǐ shì jiàn xiǎo shì, méi xiǎng dào huì nào de zhè me dà。
examples.en: I thought it was a small thing, not expecting such a big fuss.

examples.zh: 你们别以为他年纪小就好欺负,他可机灵着呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ men bié yǐ wéi tā nián jì xiǎo jiù hǎo qī fù, tā kě jī líng zhe ne。
examples.en: Don't think he's easy to bully because he's young; he's quite sharp.

examples.zh: 我以为把窗户关上就不冷了,谁知屋里还是那么凉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi bǎ chuāng hù guān shàng jiù bù lěng le, shuí zhī wū lǐ hái shì nà me liáng。
examples.en: I thought closing the window would stop the cold, but it stayed chilly.

examples.zh: 他以为父母不会同意,鼓起勇气一问,竟然答应了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi fù mǔ bú huì tóng yì, gǔ qǐ yǒng qì yī wèn, jìng rán dā yìng le。
examples.en: He thought his parents wouldn't agree, but they surprisingly said yes.

title: "经过" ile "...-den geçerek, ...sonucunda"
summary: "经过" (jīngguò) bir SÜREÇTEN/aşamadan geçmeyi bildirir: 经过努力 = çabanın ardından; 经过这里 = buradan geçerek.
explanation: "经过" bir eylemin/sonucun bir SÜREÇTEN, aşamadan ya da yerden GEÇEREK gerçekleştiğini bildirir: "...-den geçerek, ...sonucunda, ...-in ardından". İki kullanımı: (1) Soyut süreç/deneyim — 经过多年的努力,他终于成功了 (Yıllarca uğraştıktan sonra sonunda başardı), 经过这件事,我成长了很多 (Bu olaydan sonra çok olgunlaştım). (2) Somut mekândan geçiş — 每天上班都要经过这座桥 (Her gün işe giderken bu köprüden geçerim). Cümle başında bir süreç/koşul çerçevesi kurar ve ardından sonuç gelir. Ayrıca isim olarak "süreç, geçiş, olayın gelişimi" anlamına da gelir (事情的经过 = olayın gelişimi). Türkçedeki "...-den geçerek, ...sonucunda, ...-in ardından, ...-den sonra" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir süreci ve sonucunu vurgulamada kullanılır.

examples.zh: 经过三年的刻苦学习,他终于考上了心仪的大学。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò sān nián de kè kǔ xué xí, tā zhōng yú kǎo shàng le xīn yí de dà xué。
examples.en: After three years of hard study, he finally got into his dream university.

examples.zh: 经过大家的共同努力,这个难题终于解决了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò dà jiā de gòng tóng nǔ lì, zhè ge nán tí zhōng yú jiě jué le。
examples.en: Through everyone's joint effort, this tough problem was finally solved.

examples.zh: 每天上班,我都要经过这座古老的石桥。
examples.pinyin: Měi tiān shàng bān, wǒ dōu yào jīng guò zhè zuò gǔ lǎo de shí qiáo。
examples.en: Every day to work, I pass this ancient stone bridge.

examples.zh: 经过一番激烈的讨论,双方终于达成了一致。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī fān jī liè de tǎo lùn, shuāng fāng zhōng yú dá chéng le yí zhì。
examples.en: After a heated discussion, both sides finally reached agreement.

examples.zh: 经过这次失败,他明白了许多以前不懂的道理。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhè cì shī bài, tā míng bái le xǔ duō yǐ qián bù dǒng de dào lǐ。
examples.en: After this failure, he understood many things he hadn't before.

examples.zh: 这趟火车经过好几个城市,最后才到达终点站。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tàng huǒ chē jīng guò hǎo jǐ gè chéng shì, zuì hòu cái dào dá zhōng diǎn zhàn。
examples.en: This train passes several cities before reaching its final stop.

examples.zh: 经过医生的精心治疗,病人的情况一天天好转。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī shēng de jīng xīn zhì liáo, bìng rén de qíng kuàng yī tiān tiān hǎo zhuǎn。
examples.en: After the doctor's careful treatment, the patient improved daily.

examples.zh: 经过长时间的观察,科学家们得出了新的结论。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhǎng shí jiān de guān chá, kē xué jiā men dé chū le xīn de jié lùn。
examples.en: After long observation, the scientists reached a new conclusion.

examples.zh: 那条小路经过一片树林,一直通到山脚下。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiáo xiǎo lù jīng guò yī piàn shù lín, yì zhí tōng dào shān jiǎo xià。
examples.en: That path passes through a wood and leads to the mountain's foot.

examples.zh: 经过反复的试验和修改,产品的质量提高了不少。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò fǎn fù de shì yàn hé xiū gǎi, chǎn pǐn de zhì liàng tí gāo le bù shǎo。
examples.en: After repeated testing and revision, product quality improved a lot.

examples.zh: 经过这么多年的风风雨雨,他们的感情反而更深了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhè me duō nián de fēng fēng yǔ yǔ, tā men de gǎn qíng fǎn ér gēng shēn le。
examples.en: After so many years of storms, their bond only deepened.

examples.zh: 我们经过市中心的时候,正好赶上了下班高峰。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jīng guò shì zhōng xīn de shí hòu, zhèng hǎo gǎn shàng le xià bān gāo fēng。
examples.en: Passing downtown, we happened to hit the rush hour.

examples.zh: 经过一夜的思考,他终于做出了艰难的决定。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī yè de sī kǎo, tā zhōng yú zuò chū le jiān nán de jué dìng。
examples.en: After a night of thought, he finally made a hard decision.

examples.zh: 这件事经过他这么一解释,大家才恍然大悟。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jīng guò tā zhè me yī jiě shì, dà jiā cái huǎng rán dà wù。
examples.en: After his explanation, everyone suddenly understood.

examples.zh: 经过精心的准备,这场演出取得了圆满的成功。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò jīng xīn de zhǔn bèi, zhè chǎng yǎn chū qǔ de le yuán mǎn de chéng gōng。
examples.en: After careful preparation, the show was a complete success.

examples.zh: 河水经过几道弯,缓缓地流向远方的大海。
examples.pinyin: Hé shuǐ jīng guò jǐ dào wān, huǎn huǎn de liú xiàng yuǎn fāng de dà hǎi。
examples.en: The river winds through several bends toward the distant sea.

examples.zh: 经过一段时间的相处,我发现他其实很善良。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī duàn shí jiān de xiāng chǔ, wǒ fā xiàn tā qí shí hěn shàn liáng。
examples.en: After spending time together, I found he's actually very kind.

examples.zh: 经过严格的挑选,他终于被这家公司录用了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yán gé de tiāo xuǎn, tā zhōng yú bèi zhè jiā gōng sī lù yòng le。
examples.en: After strict selection, he was finally hired by this company.

examples.zh: 这封信经过很多人的手,才最终送到了他那里。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn jīng guò hěn duō rén de shǒu, cái zuì zhōng sòng dào le tā nà lǐ。
examples.en: This letter passed through many hands before reaching him.

examples.zh: 经过这场大病,他更加懂得珍惜眼前的一切。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhè chǎng dà bìng, tā gèng jiā dǒng de zhēn xī yǎn qián de yī qiè。
examples.en: After this serious illness, he cherishes everything before him more.

examples.zh: 经过一路的颠簸,我们终于到达了那个偏远的小村。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī lù de diān bǒ, wǒ men zhōng yú dào dá le nà ge piān yuǎn de xiǎo cūn。
examples.en: After a bumpy journey, we finally reached the remote village.

examples.zh: 经过老师的耐心指导,他的成绩有了明显的进步。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò lǎo shī de nài xīn zhǐ dǎo, tā de chéng jì yǒu le míng xiǎn de jìn bù。
examples.en: With the teacher's patient guidance, his grades improved markedly.

examples.zh: 我把事情的经过原原本本地告诉了大家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ shì qíng de jīng guò yuán yuán běn běn dì gào sù le dà jiā。
examples.en: I told everyone the whole course of events, just as it happened.

examples.zh: 经过一番努力,他们终于把走失的小狗找了回来。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī fān nǔ lì, tā men zhōng yú bǎ zǒu shī de xiǎo gǒu zhǎo le huí lái。
examples.en: After some effort, they finally found the lost puppy.

examples.zh: 经过这次教训,他做事比以前谨慎多了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhè cì jiào xùn, tā zuò shì bǐ yǐ qián jǐn shèn duō le。
examples.en: After this lesson, he's far more cautious than before.

title: "通过" ile "... yoluyla, ... aracılığıyla"
summary: "通过" (tōngguò) bir yöntemi/aracıyı gösterir: 通过努力 = çaba yoluyla; 通过朋友 = bir arkadaş aracılığıyla.
explanation: "通过" bir amaca ulaşmak için kullanılan YÖNTEMİ, aracı ya da aracıyı belirtir: "... yoluyla, ... aracılığıyla, ... sayesinde, ... ile". 通过努力,他改变了自己的命运 (Çaba yoluyla kaderini değiştirdi), 我是通过朋友认识他的 (Onu bir arkadaş aracılığıyla tanıdım), 通过这次活动,大家增进了了解(Bu etkinlik sayesinde birbirini daha iyi tanıdı). Cümle başında bir araç/yöntem çerçevesi kurar. "经过" ile farkı: "经过" bir SÜREÇTEN geçmeyi (aşama/deneyim), "通过" ise bir ARACI/yöntemi (bir şeyi kullanarak) vurgular. "通过" ayrıca "(sınav/onay) geçmek" fiili olarak da kullanılır: 通过考试 (sınavı geçmek), 提案通过了 (öneri kabul edildi). Türkçedeki "... yoluyla, ... aracılığıyla, ... sayesinde, ... ile" ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 他通过自己的不懈努力,最终实现了创业的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōng guò zì jǐ de bù xiè nǔ lì, zuì zhōng shí xiàn le chuàng yè de mèng xiǎng。
examples.en: Through his tireless effort, he finally realized his business dream.

examples.zh: 我是通过一个共同的朋友认识她的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì tōng guò yí gè gòng tóng de péng yǒu rèn shí tā de。
examples.en: I met her through a mutual friend.

examples.zh: 通过这次活动,同学之间的关系更加融洽了。
examples.pinyin: Tōng guò zhè cì huó dòng, tóng xué zhī jiān de guān xì gèng jiā róng qià le。
examples.en: Through this event, the students' relationships became more harmonious.

examples.zh: 我们可以通过多读书来开阔自己的眼界。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men kě yǐ tōng guò duō dú shū lái kāi kuò zì jǐ de yǎn jiè。
examples.en: We can broaden our horizons through reading more.

examples.zh: 通过反复练习,他的口语水平提高得很快。
examples.pinyin: Tōng guò fǎn fù liàn xí, tā de kǒu yǔ shuǐ píng tí gāo de hěn kuài。
examples.en: Through repeated practice, his speaking improved quickly.

examples.zh: 政府通过一系列措施来改善居民的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhèng fǔ tōng guò yī xì liè cuò shī lái gǎi shàn jū mín de shēng huó。
examples.en: The government improves residents' lives through a series of measures.

examples.zh: 经过几个月的复习,他顺利通过了那场重要的考试。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò jǐ gè yuè de fù xí, tā shùn lì tōng guò le nà chǎng zhòng yào de kǎo shì。
examples.en: After months of review, he passed that important exam smoothly.

examples.zh: 通过网络,人们可以很方便地了解世界各地的新闻。
examples.pinyin: Tōng guò wǎng luò, rén men kě yǐ hěn fāng biàn de liǎo jiě shì jiè gè dì de xīn wén。
examples.en: Through the internet, people can easily learn news from around the world.

examples.zh: 我们通过协商解决了分歧,避免了不必要的冲突。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men tōng guò xié shāng jiě jué le fēn qí, bì miǎn le bù bì yào de chōng tū。
examples.en: We resolved differences through negotiation, avoiding needless conflict.

examples.zh: 他通过写日记来记录自己每天的所思所想。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōng guò xiě rì jì lái jì lù zì jǐ měi tiān de suǒ sī suǒ xiǎng。
examples.en: He records his daily thoughts by keeping a diary.

examples.zh: 这个提案在会上通过了,大家都表示支持。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge tí àn zài huì shàng tōng guò le, dà jiā dōu biǎo shì zhī chí。
examples.en: This proposal passed at the meeting, with everyone's support.

examples.zh: 通过这件事,我看清了谁才是真正的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tōng guò zhè jiàn shì, wǒ kàn qīng le shuí cái shì zhēn zhèng de péng yǒu。
examples.en: Through this, I saw clearly who my true friends are.

examples.zh: 老师通过做实验,让抽象的知识变得生动易懂。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī tōng guò zuò shí yàn, ràng chōu xiàng de zhī shí biàn de shēng dòng yì dǒng。
examples.en: The teacher makes abstract knowledge vivid through experiments.

examples.zh: 你可以通过手机随时随地处理工作上的事情。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ tōng guò shǒu jī suí shí suí de chǔ lǐ gōng zuò shàng de shì qíng。
examples.en: You can handle work anytime, anywhere through your phone.

examples.zh: 通过和当地人交流,我们更加了解了这座城市。
examples.pinyin: Tōng guò hé dāng dì rén jiāo liú, wǒ men gèng jiā liǎo jiě le zhè zuò chéng shì。
examples.en: By talking with locals, we came to understand this city better.

examples.zh: 他通过卖自己种的蔬菜,渐渐改善了家里的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōng guò mài zì jǐ zhǒng de shū cài, jiàn jiàn gǎi shàn le jiā lǐ de shēng huó。
examples.en: By selling his own vegetables, he gradually improved his family's life.

examples.zh: 通过大量的调查,他们终于找到了问题的根源。
examples.pinyin: Tōng guò dà liàng de diào chá, tā men zhōng yú zhǎo dào le wèn tí de gēn yuán。
examples.en: Through extensive investigation, they found the root of the problem.

examples.zh: 我们希望通过合作实现互利共赢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men xī wàng tōng guò hé zuò shí xiàn hù lì gòng yíng。
examples.en: We hope to achieve mutual benefit through cooperation.

examples.zh: 通过坚持锻炼,他的身体一天比一天结实。
examples.pinyin: Tōng guò jiān chí duàn liàn, tā de shēn tǐ yī tiān bǐ yī tiān jiē shí。
examples.en: Through persistent exercise, his body grows sturdier by the day.

examples.zh: 这些资金将通过正规的渠道发放到每个人手中。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zī jīn jiāng tōng guò zhèng guī de qú dào fā fàng dào měi gè rén shǒu zhōng。
examples.en: These funds will be distributed to everyone through formal channels.

examples.zh: 孩子通过观察小动物,学到了很多课本上没有的知识。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi tōng guò guān chá xiǎo dòng wù, xué dào le hěn duō kè běn shàng méi yǒu de zhī shí。
examples.en: By observing animals, the child learned much beyond textbooks.

examples.zh: 他通过一次次失败,慢慢积累了宝贵的经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōng guò yī cì cì shī bài, màn màn jī lěi le bǎo guì de jīng yàn。
examples.en: Through repeated failures, he gradually gained valuable experience.

examples.zh: 通过这次谈话,我们消除了长久以来的误会。
examples.pinyin: Tōng guò zhè cì tán huà, wǒ men xiāo chú le cháng jiǔ yǐ lái de wù huì。
examples.en: Through this talk, we cleared up a long-standing misunderstanding.

examples.zh: 公司通过降低成本、提高效率来增强竞争力。
examples.pinyin: Gōng sī tōng guò jiàng dī chéng běn、 tí gāo xiào lǜ lái zēng qiáng jìng zhēng lì。
examples.en: The company boosts competitiveness by cutting costs and raising efficiency.

examples.zh: 我们要通过实际行动来证明自己的能力。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yào tōng guò shí jì xíng dòng lái zhèng míng zì jǐ de néng lì。
examples.en: We must prove our abilities through concrete action.

title: "来自" ile "...-den gelmek, ...-lı olmak"
summary: "来自" (láizì) bir kişinin/şeyin kaynağını/kökenini bildirir: 他来自北京 = O Pekinli (Pekin'den geliyor).
explanation: "来自" bir kişinin, şeyin ya da soyut bir şeyin KAYNAĞINI, geldiği yeri/kökeni bildirir: "...-den gelmek, ...-li olmak, kaynağı ...-dir". 这些学生来自世界各地 (Bu öğrenciler dünyanın dört bir yanından geliyor), 他来自一个普通的农村家庭 (Sıradan bir köylü ailesinden geliyor), 这份力量来自家人的支持 (Bu güç ailenin desteğinden geliyor). "来" (gelmek) + "自" (...-den) birleşiminden oluşur ve ardından doğrudan yer/kaynak gelir (araya "从" gerekmez). Somut yer (来自中国), soyut kaynak (来自内心) ya da nedensel köken için kullanılır; genelde biraz RESMÎ/yazılı tonu vardır. Türkçedeki "...-den gelmek, ...-li olmak, ...-den kaynaklanmak, kökeni ..." ifadelerine denk gelir; köken ve kaynak belirtmenin düzgün bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 参加这次夏令营的孩子来自全国各地。
examples.pinyin: Cān jiā zhè cì xià lìng yíng de hái zi lái zì quán guó gè dì。
examples.en: The children at this summer camp come from all over the country.

examples.zh: 他来自一个偏远的小山村,却凭努力走进了名牌大学。
examples.pinyin: Tā lái zì yí gè piān yuǎn de xiǎo shān cūn, què píng nǔ lì zǒu jìn le míng pái dà xué。
examples.en: He comes from a remote mountain village, yet reached a top university through effort.

examples.zh: 这些新鲜的水果全都来自当地的果园。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē xīn xiān de shuǐ guǒ quán dōu lái zì dāng dì de guǒ yuán。
examples.en: All this fresh fruit comes from local orchards.

examples.zh: 我们班的同学来自不同的国家,文化各不相同。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bān de tóng xué lái zì bù tóng de guó jiā, wén huà gè bù xiāng tóng。
examples.en: Our classmates come from different countries with different cultures.

examples.zh: 他成功的动力,主要来自家人无条件的支持。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéng gōng de dòng lì, zhǔ yào lái zì jiā rén wú tiáo jiàn de zhī chí。
examples.en: The drive behind his success comes mainly from his family's unconditional support.

examples.zh: 这位科学家来自一个世代从医的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kē xué jiā lái zì yí gè shì dài cóng yī de jiā tíng。
examples.en: This scientist comes from a family of physicians for generations.

examples.zh: 这封感谢信来自一位素不相识的陌生人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fēng gǎn xiè xìn lái zì yī wèi sù bù xiāng shí de mò shēng rén。
examples.en: This thank-you letter came from a complete stranger.

examples.zh: 真正的自信来自一次次战胜困难的经历。
examples.pinyin: Zhēn zhèng de zì xìn lái zì yī cì cì zhàn shèng kùn nán de jīng lì。
examples.en: True confidence comes from overcoming difficulties time and again.

examples.zh: 这批捐款来自社会各界热心人士的爱心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī juān kuǎn lái zì shè huì gè jiè rè xīn rén shì de ài xīn。
examples.en: This donation came from the kindness of caring people from all walks of life.

examples.zh: 他身上那股韧劲,或许来自小时候艰苦的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēn shàng nà gǔ rèn jìn, huò xǔ lái zì xiǎo shí hòu jiān kǔ de shēng huó。
examples.en: His tenacity perhaps comes from his hard childhood.

examples.zh: 这些珍贵的文物大多来自几千年前的古代。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhēn guì de wén wù dà duō lái zì jǐ qiān nián qián de gǔ dài。
examples.en: These precious relics mostly date from thousands of years ago.

examples.zh: 我的很多灵感都来自平时对生活的细心观察。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de hěn duō líng gǎn dōu lái zì píng shí duì shēng huó de xì xīn guān chá。
examples.en: Much of my inspiration comes from careful observation of daily life.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅的厨师来自四川,做的川菜特别正宗。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng de chú shī lái zì sì chuān, zuò de chuān cài tè bié zhèng zōng。
examples.en: This restaurant's chef is from Sichuan; his Sichuan food is authentic.

examples.zh: 温暖有时候来自一个陌生人小小的善意。
examples.pinyin: Wēn nuǎn yǒu shí hòu lái zì yí gè mò shēng rén xiǎo xiǎo de shàn yì。
examples.en: Warmth sometimes comes from a stranger's small kindness.

examples.zh: 参会的专家来自世界上多个知名的研究机构。
examples.pinyin: Cān huì de zhuān jiā lái zì shì jiè shàng duō gè zhī míng de yán jiū jī gòu。
examples.en: The attending experts come from several renowned research institutions.

examples.zh: 这道菜的独特风味来自一种特别的香料。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de dú tè fēng wèi lái zì yī zhǒng tè bié de xiāng liào。
examples.en: This dish's unique flavor comes from a special spice.

examples.zh: 他内心的平静来自多年读书养成的好习惯。
examples.pinyin: Tā nèi xīn de píng jìng lái zì duō nián dú shū yǎng chéng de hǎo xí guàn。
examples.en: His inner calm comes from good habits formed by years of reading.

examples.zh: 这些留学生来自五湖四海,却在这里成了好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē liú xué shēng lái zì wǔ hú sì hǎi, què zài zhè lǐ chéng le hǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: These international students come from all corners yet became good friends here.

examples.zh: 我们的快乐,很多时候来自帮助别人的过程。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men de kuài lè, hěn duō shí hòu lái zì bāng zhù bié rén de guò chéng。
examples.en: Our happiness often comes from the process of helping others.

examples.zh: 这条河的水来自远处高山上融化的积雪。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de shuǐ lái zì yuǎn chù gāo shān shàng róng huà de jī xuě。
examples.en: This river's water comes from melting snow on distant mountains.

examples.zh: 他对音乐的热爱,来自母亲从小的熏陶。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì yīn yuè de rè ài, lái zì mǔ qīn cóng xiǎo de xūn táo。
examples.en: His love of music comes from his mother's influence since childhood.

examples.zh: 这个古老的传说来自当地流传已久的民间故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge gǔ lǎo de chuán shuō lái zì dāng dì liú chuán yǐ jiǔ de mín jiān gù shì。
examples.en: This ancient legend comes from a long-told local folk tale.

examples.zh: 公司的活力主要来自一群充满创造力的年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Gōng sī de huó lì zhǔ yào lái zì yī qún chōng mǎn chuàng zào lì de nián qīng rén。
examples.en: The company's vitality comes mainly from a group of creative young people.

examples.zh: 面对困难时的勇气,往往来自身边人的鼓励。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì kùn nán shí de yǒng qì, wǎng wǎng lái zì shēn biān rén de gǔ lì。
examples.en: The courage to face difficulty often comes from those around us.

examples.zh: 这份礼物虽然不贵,却来自一份最真诚的心意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn lǐ wù suī rán bù guì, què lái zì yī fèn zuì zhēn chéng de xīn yì。
examples.en: Though the gift isn't expensive, it comes from the most sincere heart.

title: "算" ile "sayılır, ...-e girer"
pattern: Özne + 算 + Sıfat / İsim (+ 的)
summary: "算" (suàn) bir şeyi bir kategoriye/dereceye dâhil sayar: 这算便宜的 = Bu ucuz sayılır; 他算是我的老师 = O benim öğretmenim sayılır.
explanation: "算" bir şeyi/kişiyi belli bir kategoriye ya da dereceye DÂHİL SAYMAYI, öyle KABUL ETMEYİ bildirir: "...sayılır, ...-e girer, ...kabul edilir". 在我们班,他算是最高的 (Sınıfımızda en uzun sayılır), 这个价钱算便宜了 (Bu fiyat ucuz sayılır), 他算得上一位好老师 (İyi bir öğretmen sayılabilir). Çoğu zaman "算是" (sayılır), "算得上" (...-e layık sayılır) kalıplarında ve cümle sonunda "的" ile gelir. Bir yargı/değerlendirme yapar, kesin olmasa da bir sınıflandırma sunar. "算" ayrıca "hesaplamak" (算钱) ve "算了" (boş ver) anlamlarına da gelir. Bu konuda özellikle DEĞERLENDİRME/sınıflandırma işlevini ele alıyoruz. Türkçedeki "...sayılır, ...-e girer, ...kabul edilir, ...-e layık" ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 在我们这些人里,他的汉语算是说得最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ men zhè xiē rén lǐ, tā de hàn yǔ suàn shì shuō de zuì hǎo de。
examples.en: Among us, his Chinese is considered the best.

examples.zh: 这个价钱在市中心已经算很便宜的了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jià qián zài shì zhōng xīn yǐ jīng suàn hěn pián yi de le。
examples.en: This price is already considered cheap for the city center.

examples.zh: 虽然他年轻,但在这个行业里已经算是老手了。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán tā nián qīng, dàn zài zhè ge háng yè lǐ yǐ jīng suàn shì lǎo shǒu le。
examples.en: Though young, he's already an old hand in this industry.

examples.zh: 今天的天气算不错的,不冷也不热,很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān de tiān qì suàn bù cuò de, bù lěng yě bù rè, hěn shū fú。
examples.en: Today's weather is considered good, neither cold nor hot, comfortable.

examples.zh: 能在这么短的时间里做完,已经算很快了。
examples.pinyin: Néng zài zhè me duǎn de shí jiān lǐ zuò wán, yǐ jīng suàn hěn kuài le。
examples.en: Finishing in such a short time is already considered fast.

examples.zh: 这道菜的味道算可以,就是稍微咸了一点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de wèi dào suàn kě yǐ, jiù shì shāo wēi xián le yì diǎn。
examples.en: This dish's taste is passable, just slightly too salty.

examples.zh: 他为人踏实,算得上是一个值得信赖的朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā wéi rén tà shí, suàn de shàng shì yí gè zhí de xìn lài de péng yǒu。
examples.en: He's steady and can be counted as a trustworthy friend.

examples.zh: 这次考试考了八十分,在班里算中等水平。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì kǎo le bā shí fēn, zài bān lǐ suàn zhōng děng shuǐ píng。
examples.en: Scoring eighty on this exam is considered average in the class.

examples.zh: 我们家离学校不算远,走路也就十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā lí xué xiào bù suàn yuǎn, zǒu lù yě jiù shí fēn zhōng。
examples.en: Our home isn't considered far from school, a ten-minute walk.

examples.zh: 这台旧电脑虽然慢,但对付日常工作还算够用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jiù diàn nǎo suī rán màn, dàn duì fù rì cháng gōng zuò hái suàn gòu yòng。
examples.en: This old computer is slow, but still counts as enough for daily work.

examples.zh: 在这么多困难面前,这点小事根本不算什么。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè me duō kùn nán miàn qián, zhè diǎn xiǎo shì gēn běn bù suàn shén me。
examples.en: Amid so many difficulties, this trifle is nothing at all.

examples.zh: 他每天坚持读书,在同龄人里算是很自律的。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān jiān chí dú shū, zài tóng líng rén lǐ suàn shì hěn zì lǜ de。
examples.en: He reads daily; among peers he's considered very self-disciplined.

examples.zh: 这套房子采光好,户型也不错,算是很理想了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào fáng zi cǎi guāng hǎo, hù xíng yě bù cuò, suàn shì hěn lǐ xiǎng le。
examples.en: This apartment has good light and layout; it's considered ideal.

examples.zh: 论经验,他在公司里算是数一数二的。
examples.pinyin: Lùn jīng yàn, tā zài gōng sī lǐ suàn shì shǔ yī shǔ èr de。
examples.en: In terms of experience, he ranks among the very top in the company.

examples.zh: 能得到大家的认可,对他来说已经算很大的鼓励了。
examples.pinyin: Néng dé dào dà jiā de rèn kě, duì tā lái shuō yǐ jīng suàn hěn dà de gǔ lì le。
examples.en: Being recognized by all is already great encouragement for him.

examples.zh: 这家小店的东西不算贵,味道却相当地道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de dōng xī bù suàn guì, wèi dào què xiāng dāng dì dào。
examples.en: This shop's items aren't pricey, yet the taste is quite authentic.

examples.zh: 他脾气好,从不跟人计较,算是个老好人。
examples.pinyin: Tā pí qì hǎo, cóng bù gēn rén jì jiào, suàn shì gè lǎo hǎo rén。
examples.en: He's good-tempered and never quibbles; he's considered a nice guy.

examples.zh: 这条路虽然绕了点,但还算好走,不容易迷路。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù suī rán rào le diǎn, dàn hái suàn hǎo zǒu, bù róng yì mí lù。
examples.en: Though this road is a bit roundabout, it's still easy to follow.

examples.zh: 在我认识的人里,他算是最懂得感恩的一个。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ rèn shí de rén lǐ, tā suàn shì zuì dǒng de gǎn ēn de yí gè。
examples.en: Of the people I know, he's among the most grateful.

examples.zh: 这次旅行花的钱不算多,却玩得特别开心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng huā de qián bù suàn duō, què wán de tè bié kāi xīn。
examples.en: This trip didn't cost much, yet it was especially enjoyable.

examples.zh: 他做的这些贡献,足以算得上功劳很大了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de zhè xiē gòng xiàn, zú yǐ suàn de shàng gōng láo hěn dà le。
examples.en: The contributions he made can well be counted as significant.

examples.zh: 这本书虽然不厚,但内容算得上很有深度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū suī rán bù hòu, dàn nèi róng suàn de shàng hěn yǒu shēn dù。
examples.en: Though this book is thin, its content counts as quite deep.

examples.zh: 能坚持到现在还没放弃,你已经算很了不起了。
examples.pinyin: Néng jiān chí dào xiàn zài hái méi fàng qì, nǐ yǐ jīng suàn hěn liǎo bù qǐ le。
examples.en: Sticking it out without giving up, you're already quite remarkable.

examples.zh: 这点困难对他来说算不了什么,他很快就克服了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn kùn nán duì tā lái shuō suàn bù liǎo shén me, tā hěn kuài jiù kè fú le。
examples.en: This difficulty was nothing to him; he soon overcame it.

examples.zh: 论手艺,他在这条街上算是最出名的一位师傅了。
examples.pinyin: Lùn shǒu yì, tā zài zhè tiáo jiē shàng suàn shì zuì chū míng de yī wèi shī fù le。
examples.en: In craftsmanship, he's the most famous master on this street.

title: "来" ile eylem üstlenme (dummy fiil)
summary: "来" başka bir fiilin yerine geçip "bir işi üstlenmeyi" bildirir: 我来吧 = Ben yapayım; 让我来 = Bırak ben halledeyim.
explanation: "来" bazen somut "gelmek" anlamını yitirip, bir eylemi ÜSTLENMEYİ, bir işe girişmeyi bildiren bir "dummy" (yer tutucu) fiil olur — çoğu zaman asıl fiili söylemeden. 我来吧 (Bırak ben yapayım), 让我来试试 (Bir ben deneyeyim), 这件事由我来负责 (Bu işi ben üstleneyim), 咱们来玩个游戏 (Hadi bir oyun oynayalım). Bir işi kimin yapacağını belirtir ya da bir eyleme başlamak için nazik/canlı bir giriş sunar (来,咱们开始吧 = Hadi, başlayalım). Çoğu zaman "让...来" ya da "由...来" kalıbında gelir. Asıl fiil bağlamdan anlaşıldığında düşebilir (你累了,我来 = Yorulmuşsun, ben yaparım). Türkçedeki "ben yapayım, bırak ben halledeyim, hadi ...-elim, ...-i üstlenmek" gibi ifadelere denk gelir; bir işe girişmeyi ya da üstlenmeyi belirtir.

examples.zh: 这个箱子太重了,你别搬了,我来吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le, nǐ bié bān le, wǒ lái ba。
examples.en: This box is too heavy; don't lift it, let me do it.

examples.zh: 你歇一会儿,剩下的活儿让我来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiē yī huì er, shèng xià de huó er ràng wǒ lái。
examples.en: Take a rest; let me handle the rest of the work.

examples.zh: 这道菜有点儿难做,还是我来吧,你在旁边看着。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài yǒu diǎn ér nán zuò, hái shì wǒ lái ba, nǐ zài páng biān kàn zhe。
examples.en: This dish is a bit tricky; let me do it while you watch.

examples.zh: 大家别急,这件事就由我来负责协调。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā bié jí, zhè jiàn shì jiù yóu wǒ lái fù zé xié tiáo。
examples.en: Don't worry, everyone; I'll take charge of coordinating this.

examples.zh: 来,咱们先来做个自我介绍,互相认识一下。
examples.pinyin: Lái, zán men xiān lái zuò gè zì wǒ jiè shào, hù xiāng rèn shí yī xià。
examples.en: Come, let's first introduce ourselves and get acquainted.

examples.zh: 你不太熟悉这里,前面的路让我来带吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù tài shú xī zhè lǐ, qián miàn de lù ràng wǒ lái dài ba。
examples.en: You don't know it well here; let me lead the way ahead.

examples.zh: 这个游戏怎么玩?来,我来教你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge yóu xì zěn me wán? lái, wǒ lái jiào nǐ。
examples.en: How is this game played? Come, let me teach you.

examples.zh: 你嗓子不舒服就别唱了,这首歌我来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ sǎng zi bù shū fú jiù bié chàng le, zhè shǒu gē wǒ lái。
examples.en: If your throat's sore, don't sing; I'll take this song.

examples.zh: 客人来了,倒茶的事我来,你去准备点心。
examples.pinyin: Kè rén lái le, dào chá de shì wǒ lái, nǐ qù zhǔn bèi diǎn xīn。
examples.en: Guests are here; I'll pour the tea, you prepare snacks.

examples.zh: 这段话由谁来读?要不然还是我来吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn huà yóu shuí lái dú? yào bù rán hái shì wǒ lái ba。
examples.en: Who'll read this passage? Or shall I do it?

examples.zh: 你别动手了,弄脏了衣服可不好,我来收拾。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié dòng shǒu le, nòng zāng le yī fú kě bù hǎo, wǒ lái shōu shí。
examples.en: Don't do it yourself; you'll dirty your clothes, I'll clean up.

examples.zh: 来,大家把手牵起来,咱们一起做个游戏。
examples.pinyin: Lái, dà jiā bǎ shǒu qiān qǐ lái, zán men yì qǐ zuò gè yóu xì。
examples.en: Come, everyone join hands; let's play a game together.

examples.zh: 这么重要的发言,还是让有经验的老张来吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng yào de fā yán, hái shì ràng yǒu jīng yàn de lǎo zhāng lái ba。
examples.en: For such an important speech, let experienced Old Zhang do it.

examples.zh: 锅里的菜快糊了,快让我来翻一下。
examples.pinyin: Guō lǐ de cài kuài hú le, kuài ràng wǒ lái fān yī xià。
examples.en: The food in the pan is nearly burnt; let me turn it.

examples.zh: 你先坐下休息,接下来的事情我来处理。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zuò xià xiū xī, jiē xià lái de shì qíng wǒ lái chǔ lǐ。
examples.en: Sit and rest first; I'll handle what comes next.

examples.zh: 这些照片的整理工作,就交给我来做吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān de zhěng lǐ gōng zuò, jiù jiāo gěi wǒ lái zuò ba。
examples.en: Leave the sorting of these photos to me.

examples.zh: 来,咱们来分个工,这样效率会高一些。
examples.pinyin: Lái, zán men lái fēn gè gōng, zhè yàng xiào lǜ huì gāo yī xiē。
examples.en: Come, let's divide the work; it'll be more efficient.

examples.zh: 你不会用这个软件没关系,我来帮你操作。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bú huì yòng zhè ge ruǎn jiàn méi guān xì, wǒ lái bāng nǐ cāo zuò。
examples.en: It's fine if you can't use this software; I'll operate it for you.

examples.zh: 这次的开场白由你来说,压轴的部分我来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de kāi chǎng bái yóu nǐ lái shuō, yā zhòu de bù fèn wǒ lái。
examples.en: You give the opening remarks; I'll take the finale.

examples.zh: 孩子够不着高处的东西,还是我来拿吧。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi gòu bù zhe gāo chù de dōng xī, hái shì wǒ lái ná ba。
examples.en: The child can't reach high things; let me get them.

examples.zh: 大家都拿不定主意,那这个决定就由我来做。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu ná bù dìng zhǔ yì, nà zhè ge jué dìng jiù yóu wǒ lái zuò。
examples.en: Since no one can decide, I'll make this decision.

examples.zh: 你刚忙完,歇会儿,洗碗的事我来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāng máng wán, xiē huì er, xǐ wǎn de shì wǒ lái。
examples.en: You just finished; rest a bit, I'll do the dishes.

examples.zh: 来,咱们来算一算,这次一共花了多少钱。
examples.pinyin: Lái, zán men lái suàn yī suàn, zhè cì yī gòng huā le duō shǎo qián。
examples.en: Come, let's calculate how much we spent in total.

examples.zh: 这段路你开累了吧?接下来我来开车。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn lù nǐ kāi lèi le ba? jiē xià lái wǒ lái kāi chē。
examples.en: You must be tired from driving; I'll drive from here.

examples.zh: 有什么需要跑腿的杂事,尽管让我来。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me xū yào pǎo tuǐ de zá shì, jǐn guǎn ràng wǒ lái。
examples.en: For any errands that need running, just let me do them.

title: "不用" ile "...-e gerek yok"
summary: "不用" (búyòng) bir şeyin GEREKMEDİĞİNİ bildirir: 不用担心 = merak etmene gerek yok; 不用谢 = rica ederim (teşekküre gerek yok).
explanation: "不用" bir eylemin GEREKLİ OLMADIĞINI, ona gerek bulunmadığını bildirir: "...-e gerek yok, ...-mene gerek yok, gerekmez". 你不用来接我,我自己能回去 (Beni almaya gelmene gerek yok, kendim dönerim), 这件事不用告诉他 (Bunu ona söylemeye gerek yok), 不用客气 (rica ederim / lütfen çekinme). "要/得" (gereklilik) yapısının olumsuzudur: "必须/得"nin "gerekli" anlamının karşıtı "不用/不必"dir ("不得" değil). "不必" ile eş anlamlıdır; "不用" daha konuşma dilidir. Nazik reddetme ve rahatlatmalarda çok kullanılır (不用麻烦了 = zahmet etme). Türkçedeki "...-e gerek yok, gerekmez, ...-mene gerek yok, zahmet etme" ifadelerine denk gelir; gereksizliği belirtmenin temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 你不用担心我,我一个人完全能照顾好自己。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng dān xīn wǒ, wǒ yí gè rén wán quán néng zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ。
examples.en: Don't worry about me; I can take care of myself just fine.

examples.zh: 这点小事不用麻烦你了,我自己来就行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shì bù yòng má fán nǐ le, wǒ zì jǐ lái jiù xíng。
examples.en: No need to trouble you with this trifle; I'll handle it myself.

examples.zh: 你不用特意跑一趟,发个消息告诉我就可以了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng tè yì pǎo yī tàng, fā gè xiāo xī gào sù wǒ jiù kě yǐ le。
examples.en: You needn't make a special trip; just message me.

examples.zh: 时间还早,你不用这么着急,慢慢来。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān hái zǎo, nǐ bù yòng zhè me zhe jí, màn màn lái。
examples.en: It's still early; no need to rush, take your time.

examples.zh: 这件事你知道就好,不用告诉别人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ zhī dào jiù hǎo, bù yòng gào sù bié rén。
examples.en: Just keep this to yourself; no need to tell others.

examples.zh: 不用谢,这都是我应该做的,别客气。
examples.pinyin: Bù yòng xiè, zhè dōu shì wǒ yīng gāi zuò de, bié kè qì。
examples.en: You're welcome; it's just what I should do, don't mention it.

examples.zh: 你不用来接我,我认识路,自己坐车回去。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng lái jiē wǒ, wǒ rèn shí lù, zì jǐ zuò chē huí qù。
examples.en: You needn't pick me up; I know the way and can take the bus back.

examples.zh: 剩下的菜不用倒掉,晚上热一热还能吃。
examples.pinyin: Shèng xià de cài bù yòng dào diào, wǎn shàng rè yī rè hái néng chī。
examples.en: No need to throw away the leftovers; reheat them for dinner.

examples.zh: 你不用勉强自己,不想去就直接说。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng miǎn qiǎng zì jǐ, bù xiǎng qù jiù zhí jiē shuō。
examples.en: Don't force yourself; if you don't want to go, just say so.

examples.zh: 这么点儿路不用打车,走过去几分钟就到了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me diǎn er lù bù yòng dǎ chē, zǒu guò qù jǐ fēn zhōng jiù dào le。
examples.en: Such a short distance needs no taxi; a few minutes' walk gets there.

examples.zh: 你身体不舒服就好好休息,今天不用来上班了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēn tǐ bù shū fú jiù hǎo hǎo xiū xī, jīn tiān bù yòng lái shàng bān le。
examples.en: If you're unwell, rest well; you needn't come to work today.

examples.zh: 这些资料我已经准备好了,你不用再费心了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zī liào wǒ yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo le, nǐ bù yòng zài fèi xīn le。
examples.en: I've already prepared these materials; you needn't bother.

examples.zh: 不用买那么多东西,咱们两个人吃不了那么多。
examples.pinyin: Bù yòng mǎi nà me duō dōng xī, zán men liǎng gè rén chī bù liǎo nà me duō。
examples.en: No need to buy so much; the two of us can't finish it all.

examples.zh: 你不用向我道歉,这件事本来就不怪你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng xiàng wǒ dào qiàn, zhè jiàn shì běn lái jiù bù guài nǐ。
examples.en: You needn't apologize to me; this wasn't your fault anyway.

examples.zh: 这个道理很简单,不用我多说你也明白。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dào lǐ hěn jiǎn dān, bù yòng wǒ duō shuō nǐ yě míng bái。
examples.en: This is simple; you understand without me saying more.

examples.zh: 天气预报说今天不下雨,你不用带伞了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō jīn tiān bù xià yǔ, nǐ bù yòng dài sǎn le。
examples.en: The forecast says no rain today; you needn't bring an umbrella.

examples.zh: 你不用担心费用的问题,这次都由公司报销。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng dān xīn fèi yòng de wèn tí, zhè cì dōu yóu gōng sī bào xiāo。
examples.en: Don't worry about the cost; the company will reimburse it all.

examples.zh: 这件衣服在家穿,不用熨得那么平整。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú zài jiā chuān, bù yòng yùn de nà me píng zhěng。
examples.en: For wearing at home, this outfit needn't be ironed so flat.

examples.zh: 你不用一直守着我,去忙你自己的事吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng yì zhí shǒu zhe wǒ, qù máng nǐ zì jǐ de shì ba。
examples.en: You needn't keep watching over me; go do your own things.

examples.zh: 既然大家都清楚了,那就不用再开会讨论了。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán dà jiā dōu qīng chǔ le, nà jiù bù yòng zài kāi huì tǎo lùn le。
examples.en: Since everyone's clear, there's no need to hold another meeting.

examples.zh: 这点小伤不用去医院,贴个创可贴就行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shāng bù yòng qù yī yuàn, tiē gè chuàng kě tiē jiù xíng。
examples.en: This small cut needs no hospital; a bandage will do.

examples.zh: 你不用羡慕别人,你也有很多别人没有的优点。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng xiàn mù bié rén, nǐ yě yǒu hěn duō bié rén méi yǒu de yōu diǎn。
examples.en: Don't envy others; you too have merits others lack.

examples.zh: 剩下的路我认识,你不用送了,快回去吧。
examples.pinyin: Shèng xià de lù wǒ rèn shí, nǐ bù yòng sòng le, kuài huí qù ba。
examples.en: I know the rest of the way; don't see me off, go back.

examples.zh: 这么简单的操作,看一遍就会了,不用记笔记。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me jiǎn dān de cāo zuò, kàn yī biàn jiù huì le, bù yòng jì bǐ jì。
examples.en: Such simple steps you'll get after one look; no need to take notes.

examples.zh: 你不用什么都自己扛着,有困难跟大家说。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù yòng shén me dōu zì jǐ káng zhe, yǒu kùn nán gēn dà jiā shuō。
examples.en: You needn't shoulder everything alone; tell us your troubles.

title: "得" (děi) ile "...-meli, gerek"
summary: "得" (děi) bir gerekliliği/zorunluluğu bildirir: 我得走了 = Gitmem gerek; 你得注意身体 = Sağlığına dikkat etmelisin.
explanation: "得" (burada "děi" okunur, complement 得 = de ya da obtain 得 = dé ile karıştırılmamalı) bir GEREKLİLİĞİ, zorunluluğu ya da güçlü bir tahmini bildirir: "...-meli, ...-mem gerek, ...-mek zorunda". 时间不早了,我得走了 (Vakit geç oldu, gitmem gerek), 你得多喝水 (Daha çok su içmelisin), 这么大的工程得花不少钱 (Böyle büyük bir iş bir hayli para gerektirir). "要/应该"ye benzer ama "得" özellikle KAÇINILMAZ bir zorunluluğu, konuşma dilinde vurgular. ÖNEMLİ: "得"nin olumsuzu "不得" DEĞİLDİR; gereksizlik için "不用/不必" (bkz. ayrı konu) kullanılır. Yalnızca olumlu/gereklilik cümlelerinde "得" gelir. Türkçedeki "...-meli, ...-mem gerek, ...-mek zorunda, mecbur" ifadelerine denk gelir; günlük konuşmada zorunluluk bildirmenin en yaygın yoludur.

examples.zh: 时间不早了,我得赶紧回家了,不然赶不上末班车。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān bù zǎo le, wǒ děi gǎn jǐn huí jiā le, bù rán gǎn bù shàng mò bān chē。
examples.en: It's late; I must hurry home or I'll miss the last bus.

examples.zh: 你最近脸色不好,得好好检查一下身体了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì jìn liǎn sè bù hǎo, de hǎo hǎo jiǎn chá yī xià shēn tǐ le。
examples.en: You've looked unwell lately; you must get a proper checkup.

examples.zh: 这件事很重要,咱们得认真对待,不能马虎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòng yào, zán men děi rèn zhēn duì dài, bù néng mǎ hǔ。
examples.en: This matter is important; we must take it seriously, no carelessness.

examples.zh: 要想把汉语学好,你得每天坚持练习。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng bǎ hàn yǔ xué hǎo, nǐ děi měi tiān jiān chí liàn xí。
examples.en: To master Chinese, you must practice every day.

examples.zh: 这么远的路,开车至少得三个多小时。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me yuǎn de lù, kāi chē zhì shǎo de sān gè duō xiǎo shí。
examples.en: For such a long way, driving takes at least over three hours.

examples.zh: 明天要早起,今晚我们得早点睡。
examples.pinyin: Míng tiān yào zǎo qǐ, jīn wǎn wǒ men de zǎo diǎn shuì。
examples.en: We have to get up early tomorrow, so we must sleep early tonight.

examples.zh: 答应了别人的事,就得说到做到。
examples.pinyin: Dā yìng le bié rén de shì, jiù de shuō dào zuò dào。
examples.en: Once you've promised someone, you must keep your word.

examples.zh: 这么大的房子,打扫一遍得花大半天。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de fáng zi, dǎ sǎo yī biàn de huā dà bàn tiān。
examples.en: Cleaning such a big house takes most of a day.

examples.zh: 你要是想成功,就得付出比别人更多的努力。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì xiǎng chéng gōng, jiù de fù chū bǐ bié rén gèng duō de nǔ lì。
examples.en: If you want to succeed, you must work harder than others.

examples.zh: 孩子病了,妈妈今晚得守在他身边照顾。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi bìng le, mā mā jīn wǎn de shǒu zài tā shēn biān zhào gù。
examples.en: The child is ill; mom must stay by him tonight to care for him.

examples.zh: 这个项目要按时完成,大家这几天都得加班。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiàng mù yào àn shí wán chéng, dà jiā zhè jǐ tiān dōu de jiā bān。
examples.en: To finish this project on time, everyone must work overtime these days.

examples.zh: 过马路时你得看红绿灯,注意来往的车辆。
examples.pinyin: Guò mǎ lù shí nǐ de kàn hóng lǜ dēng, zhù yì lái wǎng de chē liàng。
examples.en: When crossing the road, you must watch the lights and traffic.

examples.zh: 天冷了,出门你得多穿点儿,别着凉。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, chū mén nǐ de duō chuān diǎn ér, bié zháo liáng。
examples.en: It's cold; you must dress warmly when going out to avoid chills.

examples.zh: 这道题有点难,我得再仔细想想才能做出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí yǒu diǎn nán, wǒ děi zài zǐ xì xiǎng xiǎng cái néng zuò chū lái。
examples.en: This problem is a bit hard; I must think carefully to solve it.

examples.zh: 要想赢这场比赛,我们全队都得拼尽全力。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng yíng zhè chǎng bǐ sài, wǒ men quán duì dōu de pīn jìn quán lì。
examples.en: To win this match, the whole team must give it their all.

examples.zh: 这些钱是大家凑的,我得一分不差地记清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē qián shì dà jiā còu de, wǒ děi yī fēn bù chà de jì qīng chǔ。
examples.en: This money was pooled by all; I must record it to the cent.

examples.zh: 你既然选择了这条路,就得坚持走下去。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì rán xuǎn zé le zhè tiáo lù, jiù de jiān chí zǒu xià qù。
examples.en: Since you chose this path, you must persist on it.

examples.zh: 客人马上要来了,咱们得赶紧把屋子收拾好。
examples.pinyin: Kè rén mǎ shàng yào lái le, zán men děi gǎn jǐn bǎ wū zi shōu shí hǎo。
examples.en: Guests are arriving soon; we must tidy up the room quickly.

examples.zh: 这么重要的会议,你无论如何都得参加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng yào de huì yì, nǐ wú lùn rú hé dōu de cān jiā。
examples.en: For such an important meeting, you must attend no matter what.

examples.zh: 身体是革命的本钱,再忙你也得注意休息。
examples.pinyin: Shēn tǐ shì gé mìng de běn qián, zài máng nǐ yě de zhù yì xiū xī。
examples.en: Health is the basis of everything; however busy, you must rest.

examples.zh: 这件事得跟父母商量商量,不能自己就定了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de gēn fù mǔ shāng liáng shāng liáng, bù néng zì jǐ jiù dìng le。
examples.en: This must be discussed with my parents; I can't decide alone.

examples.zh: 要想按时到达,我们最晚六点就得出发。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng àn shí dào dá, wǒ men zuì wǎn liù diǎn jiù dé chū fā。
examples.en: To arrive on time, we must leave by six at the latest.

examples.zh: 你欠别人的钱,早晚都得还,别一直拖着。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qiàn bié rén de qián, zǎo wǎn dōu de hái, bié yì zhí tuō zhe。
examples.en: You must repay what you owe sooner or later; don't keep putting it off.

examples.zh: 这么多作业,看样子我今晚又得熬夜了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō zuò yè, kàn yàng zi wǒ jīn wǎn yòu de áo yè le。
examples.en: With so much homework, it seems I must stay up again tonight.

examples.zh: 想把菜做得好吃,火候得掌握得恰到好处。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng bǎ cài zuò de hǎo chī, huǒ hòu de zhǎng wò de qià dào hǎo chù。
examples.en: To cook tasty food, you must control the heat just right.

title: "少" ile "daha az ...-mek"
summary: "少" (shǎo) bir fiilin önüne gelip "daha az ...-mek" der: 少吃 = daha az ye; 少说话 = az konuş. Karşıtı "多" (daha çok).
explanation: "少" bir fiilin önüne gelerek eylemin AZ/daha az yapılmasını bildirir: 少吃点儿 (biraz daha az ye), 少喝酒 (az içki iç), 少花钱 (daha az para harca). Karşıtı "多"dır (daha çok): 多吃蔬菜,少吃肉 (Çok sebze ye, az et ye). Sıklıkla bir öğüt, tavsiye ya da nazik uyarı biçiminde gelir ve ardından çoğu zaman bir miktar (点儿) eklenir. Emir kipinde "az ...-me" anlamı da verir: 少管闲事 (başkasının işine az karış / karışma). "少" ayrıca sıfat olarak "az" (人很少 = insan az) anlamına da gelir, ama fiil önündeki bu kullanım "daha az yapmak" eylemini anlatır. Türkçedeki "az ...-mek, daha az ...-mek, ...-mekten kaçınmak" ifadelerine denk gelir; ölçülü davranmayı öğütlemenin yaygın bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 为了健康,你应该多吃蔬菜,少吃油腻的东西。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le jiàn kāng, nǐ yīng gāi duō chī shū cài, shǎo chī yóu nì de dōng xī。
examples.en: For health, you should eat more vegetables and less greasy food.

examples.zh: 天气热,要多喝水,少喝含糖的饮料。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì rè, yào duō hē shuǐ, shǎo hē hán táng de yǐn liào。
examples.en: In hot weather, drink more water and fewer sugary drinks.

examples.zh: 你少熬夜,早点睡,身体才能慢慢好起来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shǎo áo yè, zǎo diǎn shuì, shēn tǐ cái néng màn màn hǎo qǐ lái。
examples.en: Stay up less and sleep early; only then will your health recover.

examples.zh: 这件事跟你没关系,你就少管闲事吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì gēn nǐ méi guān xì, nǐ jiù shǎo guǎn xián shì ba。
examples.en: This is none of your business; mind your own affairs.

examples.zh: 买东西要精打细算,能少花钱就少花钱。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi dōng xī yào jīng dǎ xì suàn, néng shǎo huā qián jiù shǎo huā qián。
examples.en: Shop wisely; spend as little as you can.

examples.zh: 开车的时候少看手机,注意安全最重要。
examples.pinyin: Kāi chē de shí hòu shǎo kàn shǒu jī, zhù yì ān quán zuì zhòng yào。
examples.en: Look at your phone less while driving; safety matters most.

examples.zh: 你脾气太急,以后遇事要少发火,多冷静。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pí qì tài jí, yǐ hòu yù shì yào shǎo fā huǒ, duō lěng jìng。
examples.en: You're too hot-tempered; get angry less and stay calm more.

examples.zh: 为了省电,没人的房间要少开灯。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le shěng diàn, méi rén de fáng jiān yào shǎo kāi dēng。
examples.en: To save electricity, keep lights off in empty rooms.

examples.zh: 他劝我少操点心,很多事情顺其自然就好。
examples.pinyin: Tā quàn wǒ shǎo cāo diǎn xīn, hěn duō shì qíng shùn qí zì rán jiù hǎo。
examples.en: He advised me to worry less and let things take their course.

examples.zh: 减肥期间,你得少吃甜食,多做运动。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn féi qī jiān, nǐ děi shǎo chī tián shí, duō zuò yùn dòng。
examples.en: While dieting, you must eat fewer sweets and exercise more.

examples.zh: 说话要多想想别人的感受,少说伤人的话。
examples.pinyin: Shuō huà yào duō xiǎng xiǎng bié rén de gǎn shòu, shǎo shuō shāng rén de huà。
examples.en: Consider others' feelings when speaking; say fewer hurtful things.

examples.zh: 你少跟那些不三不四的人来往,免得学坏。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shǎo gēn nà xiē bù sān bù sì de rén lái wǎng, miǎn de xué huài。
examples.en: Associate less with dubious people, lest you pick up bad habits.

examples.zh: 为了保护眼睛,孩子应该少看电视和手机。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le bǎo hù yǎn jīng, hái zi yīng gāi shǎo kàn diàn shì hé shǒu jī。
examples.en: To protect their eyes, children should watch less TV and fewer phones.

examples.zh: 路上少耽误一点儿时间,咱们还能赶上那趟车。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng shǎo dān wù yì diǎn ér shí jiān, zán men hái néng gǎn shàng nà tàng chē。
examples.en: Waste a little less time on the way and we can catch that bus.

examples.zh: 你少喝点儿酒吧,喝多了对身体不好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shǎo hē diǎn ér jiǔ bā, hē duō le duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo。
examples.en: Drink a bit less; too much is bad for your health.

examples.zh: 做事要脚踏实地,少说空话,多干实事。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shì yào jiǎo tà shí de, shǎo shuō kōng huà, duō gàn shí shì。
examples.en: Work down-to-earth; talk less and do more real work.

examples.zh: 为了不打扰邻居,晚上要少制造噪音。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le bù dǎ rǎo lín jū, wǎn shàng yào shǎo zhì zào zào yīn。
examples.en: To avoid disturbing neighbors, make less noise at night.

examples.zh: 他建议我们少走弯路,直接找专业的人帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiàn yì wǒ men shǎo zǒu wān lù, zhí jiē zhǎo zhuān yè de rén bāng máng。
examples.en: He suggested we take fewer detours and just ask professionals.

examples.zh: 你最近火气大,饮食上要清淡些,少吃辣。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì jìn huǒ qì dà, yǐn shí shàng yào qīng dàn xiē, shǎo chī là。
examples.en: You've been irritable lately; eat lighter and less spicy food.

examples.zh: 为了省钱,他平时能少买就少买,从不乱花。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le shěng qián, tā píng shí néng shǎo mǎi jiù shǎo mǎi, cóng bù luàn huā。
examples.en: To save money, he buys as little as possible and never wastes.

examples.zh: 上了年纪,盐要少放,清淡的饮食更健康。
examples.pinyin: Shàng le nián jì, yán yào shǎo fàng, qīng dàn de yǐn shí gèng jiàn kāng。
examples.en: With age, use less salt; a light diet is healthier.

examples.zh: 你少跟他计较,他也不是故意的,大度一点。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shǎo gēn tā jì jiào, tā yě bú shì gù yì de, dà dù yì diǎn。
examples.en: Quibble less with him; he didn't mean it, be magnanimous.

examples.zh: 为了保护环境,我们应该少用一次性的东西。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le bǎo hù huán jìng, wǒ men yīng gāi shǎo yòng yí cì xìng de dōng xī。
examples.en: To protect the environment, we should use fewer disposables.

examples.zh: 这段时间少出门,在家好好养病要紧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn shí jiān shǎo chū mén, zài jiā hǎo hǎo yǎng bìng yào jǐn。
examples.en: Go out less these days; recovering well at home is what matters.

examples.zh: 他总是提醒自己少抱怨,多想想解决的办法。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì tí xǐng zì jǐ shǎo bào yuàn, duō xiǎng xiǎng jiě jué de bàn fǎ。
examples.en: He always reminds himself to complain less and think of solutions.

title: "多" ile "daha çok ...-mek"
summary: "多" (duō) bir fiilin önüne gelip "daha çok ...-mek" der: 多吃 = çok ye; 多穿点 = kalın giyin. Karşıtı "少" (daha az).
explanation: "多" bir fiilin önüne gelerek eylemin ÇOK/daha çok yapılmasını bildirir: 多喝水 (çok su iç), 多运动 (çok hareket et), 多穿点儿 (kalın giyin — daha çok giy). Karşıtı "少"dır (daha az): 多吃蔬菜,少吃肉 (Çok sebze, az et ye). Sık sık bir öğüt/tavsiye biçiminde gelir ve ardından çoğu zaman bir miktar (点儿) eklenir: 多休息 (çok dinlen), 多注意 (daha dikkatli ol). Emir/rica kipinde "biraz daha ..." anlamı verir: 多包涵 (biraz hoş gör), 多关照 (kollayın). "多" ayrıca sıfat/derece belirteci olarak da kullanılır, ama fiil önündeki bu kullanım "daha çok yapmak" eylemini vurgular. Türkçedeki "çok ...-mek, daha çok ...-mek, biraz daha ..." ifadelerine denk gelir; olumlu bir alışkanlığı özendirmenin yaygın yoludur.

examples.zh: 天气干燥,你要多喝水,别等渴了才想起来。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì gān zào, nǐ yào duō hē shuǐ, bié děng kě le cái xiǎng qǐ lái。
examples.en: The weather's dry; drink more water, don't wait until you're thirsty.

examples.zh: 有空的时候多陪陪父母,别总把工作放在第一位。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu kòng de shí hòu duō péi péi fù mǔ, bié zǒng bǎ gōng zuò fàng zài dì yī wèi。
examples.en: When free, spend more time with your parents; don't always put work first.

examples.zh: 想把身体练好,就得多运动、多出汗。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng bǎ shēn tǐ liàn hǎo, jiù de duō yùn dòng、 duō chū hàn。
examples.en: To get fit, you must exercise more and sweat more.

examples.zh: 刚来的时候,你要多向老同事请教。
examples.pinyin: Gāng lái de shí hòu, nǐ yào duō xiàng lǎo tóng shì qǐng jiào。
examples.en: When you first arrive, ask the experienced colleagues more.

examples.zh: 天冷了,出门多穿件衣服,别冻着了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, chū mén duō chuān jiàn yī fú, bié dòng zhe le。
examples.en: It's cold; wear an extra layer out and don't freeze.

examples.zh: 学好一门语言,平时得多听、多说、多练。
examples.pinyin: Xué hǎo yī mén yǔ yán, píng shí de duō tīng、 duō shuō、 duō liàn。
examples.en: To master a language, you must listen, speak, and practice more.

examples.zh: 你最近太累了,应该多休息,别硬撑着。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zuì jìn tài lèi le, yīng gāi duō xiū xī, bié yìng chēng zhe。
examples.en: You've been too tired; rest more, don't push yourself.

examples.zh: 做菜的时候多放点儿蔬菜,营养会更均衡。
examples.pinyin: Zuò cài de shí hòu duō fàng diǎn ér shū cài, yíng yǎng huì gèng jūn héng。
examples.en: When cooking, add more vegetables for a more balanced diet.

examples.zh: 希望大家以后多多支持,多提宝贵意见。
examples.pinyin: Xī wàng dà jiā yǐ hòu duō duō zhī chí, duō tí bǎo guì yì jiàn。
examples.en: I hope you'll all support us more and offer valuable suggestions.

examples.zh: 遇到问题多动动脑筋,总能想出办法来。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào wèn tí duō dòng dòng nǎo jīn, zǒng néng xiǎng chū bàn fǎ lái。
examples.en: When facing problems, use your brain more and you'll find a way.

examples.zh: 你要多为别人着想,别只顾着自己。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào duō wèi bié rén zhuó xiǎng, bié zhǐ gù zhe zì jǐ。
examples.en: Think more of others; don't only care about yourself.

examples.zh: 趁着年轻,应该多出去走走,多看看这个世界。
examples.pinyin: Chèn zhe nián qīng, yīng gāi duō chū qù zǒu zǒu, duō kàn kàn zhè ge shì jiè。
examples.en: While young, you should travel more and see more of the world.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,你们做父母的要多点儿耐心。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hái xiǎo, nǐ men zuò fù mǔ de yào duō diǎn ér nài xīn。
examples.en: The child is young; you parents should have more patience.

examples.zh: 有什么做得不好的地方,还请您多包涵。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me zuò de bù hǎo de dì fāng, hái qǐng nín duō bāo hán。
examples.en: Please bear with us for anything we haven't done well.

examples.zh: 多读点儿好书,能让人变得更有涵养。
examples.pinyin: Duō dú diǎn ér hǎo shū, néng ràng rén biàn de gèng yǒu hán yǎng。
examples.en: Reading more good books makes a person more cultivated.

examples.zh: 身体是本钱,平时一定要多注意保养。
examples.pinyin: Shēn tǐ shì běn qián, píng shí yí dìng yào duō zhù yì bǎo yǎng。
examples.en: Health is capital; always take more care to maintain it.

examples.zh: 你多留个心眼儿,别轻易相信陌生人的话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duō liú gè xīn yǎn ér, bié qīng yì xiāng xìn mò shēng rén de huà。
examples.en: Be more careful; don't easily believe strangers' words.

examples.zh: 初来乍到,以后还请各位同事多多关照。
examples.pinyin: Chū lái zhà dào, yǐ hòu hái qǐng gè wèi tóng shì duō duō guān zhào。
examples.en: As a newcomer, I ask all colleagues to look out for me.

examples.zh: 想提高写作水平,就得多写、多改、多琢磨。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng tí gāo xiě zuò shuǐ píng, jiù de duō xiě、 duō gǎi、 duō zhuó mó。
examples.en: To improve writing, you must write, revise, and ponder more.

examples.zh: 大家多提提意见,这样我们才能不断改进。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā duō tí tí yì jiàn, zhè yàng wǒ men cái néng bù duàn gǎi jìn。
examples.en: Everyone please offer more feedback so we can keep improving.

examples.zh: 空闲的时候多陪孩子玩玩,他会特别开心。
examples.pinyin: Kòng xián de shí hòu duō péi hái zi wán wán, tā huì tè bié kāi xīn。
examples.en: When free, play more with the child; he'll be very happy.

examples.zh: 你多吃点儿,别客气,今天做的都是你爱吃的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duō chī diǎn ér, bié kè qì, jīn tiān zuò de dōu shì nǐ ài chī de。
examples.en: Eat more, don't be shy; today's dishes are all your favorites.

examples.zh: 路上多加小心,到了给家里打个电话报平安。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng duō jiā xiǎo xīn, dào le gěi jiā lǐ dǎ gè diàn huà bào píng ān。
examples.en: Be more careful on the road; call home when you arrive.

examples.zh: 平时多积累一些词汇,考试的时候就不慌了。
examples.pinyin: Píng shí duō jī lěi yī xiē cí huì, kǎo shì de shí hòu jiù bù huāng le。
examples.en: Accumulate more vocabulary daily and you won't panic in exams.

examples.zh: 生活中多一点儿宽容,人和人之间就少一点儿矛盾。
examples.pinyin: Shēng huó zhōng duō yì diǎn ér kuān róng, rén hé rén zhī jiān jiù shǎo yì diǎn ér máo dùn。
examples.en: A bit more tolerance in life means less conflict between people.

title: Süregelen eylem (tam biçim: 正在...着...呢)
pattern: 正在 + Fiil + 着 + 呢
summary: Bir eylemin TAM O ANDA sürdüğü "正在...(着)...呢" ile vurgulanır: 他正在睡觉呢 = O şu an uyuyor.
explanation: Bir eylemin TAM O ANDA sürmekte olduğunu (İngilizcedeki "-ing" gibi) vurgulamak için "正在 + fiil + (着) + 呢" kalıbı kullanılır. Bileşenler ayrı ayrı ya da birlikte gelebilir: "正在" (tam şu an), "着" (süreklilik eki), "呢" (durumu pekiştiren cümle-sonu parçacığı). 他正在打电话呢 (Şu an telefonla konuşuyor), 外面正下着雨呢 (Dışarıda yağmur yağıyor), 我正忙着做饭呢 (Yemek yapmakla meşgulüm). Vurgu derecesine göre bazıları düşebilir: 他睡觉呢 / 他正睡着呢 / 他正在睡觉 — hepsi süregelen eylemi anlatır. Olumsuzu "没(有)在..." ile kurulur. Bir eylemin şu anda ya da o anda devam ettiğini betimler. Türkçedeki "...-makta, ...-ıyor (tam şu an), ...-makla meşgul" ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 你小声点,孩子正在房间里睡觉呢,别吵醒他。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎo shēng diǎn, hái zi zhèng zài fáng jiān lǐ shuì jiào ne, bié chǎo xǐng tā。
examples.en: Keep it down; the child is sleeping in the room, don't wake him.

examples.zh: 我给他打电话的时候,他正在开车呢,没接。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gěi tā dǎ diàn huà de shí hòu, tā zhèng zài kāi chē ne, méi jiē。
examples.en: When I called him, he was driving and didn't answer.

examples.zh: 你看,外面正下着大雨呢,咱们再等一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, wài miàn zhèng xià zhe dà yǔ ne, zán men zài děng yī huì er ba。
examples.en: Look, it's pouring outside; let's wait a while longer.

examples.zh: 我进屋的时候,妈妈正忙着做晚饭呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìn wū de shí hòu, mā mā zhèng máng zhe zuò wǎn fàn ne。
examples.en: When I entered, mom was busy making dinner.

examples.zh: 别打扰他,他正在专心地写作业呢。
examples.pinyin: Bié dǎ rǎo tā, tā zhèng zài zhuān xīn de xiě zuò yè ne。
examples.en: Don't disturb him; he's concentrating on his homework.

examples.zh: 我们到的时候,大家正热烈地讨论着这个问题呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men dào de shí hòu, dà jiā zhèng rè liè de tǎo lùn zhe zhè ge wèn tí ne。
examples.en: When we arrived, everyone was discussing the issue heatedly.

examples.zh: 你找他?他正在会议室里开会呢,一会儿才出来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎo tā? tā zhèng zài huì yì shì lǐ kāi huì ne, yī huì er cái chū lái。
examples.en: Looking for him? He's in a meeting and won't be out for a while.

examples.zh: 窗外的小鸟正欢快地叫着呢,听起来真悦耳。
examples.pinyin: Chuāng wài de xiǎo niǎo zhèng huān kuài de jiào zhe ne, tīng qǐ lái zhēn yuè ěr。
examples.en: The birds outside are chirping cheerfully; it sounds lovely.

examples.zh: 我回来的时候,爷爷正坐在院子里晒太阳呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huí lái de shí hòu, yé yé zhèng zuò zài yuàn zi lǐ shài tài yáng ne。
examples.en: When I came back, grandpa was sitting in the yard in the sun.

examples.zh: 现在别去打扰她,她正在准备明天的考试呢。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài bié qù dǎ rǎo tā, tā zhèng zài zhǔn bèi míng tiān de kǎo shì ne。
examples.en: Don't bother her now; she's preparing for tomorrow's exam.

examples.zh: 你听,隔壁正放着音乐呢,声音还不小。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, gé bì zhèng fàng zhe yīn yuè ne, shēng yīn hái bù xiǎo。
examples.en: Listen, the neighbors are playing music, and quite loudly.

examples.zh: 我路过教室,看见他们正在上课呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lù guò jiào shì, kàn jiàn tā men zhèng zài shàng kè ne。
examples.en: Passing the classroom, I saw they were in class.

examples.zh: 锅里正炖着汤呢,香味都飘到院子里了。
examples.pinyin: Guō lǐ zhèng dùn zhe tāng ne, xiāng wèi dōu piāo dào yuàn zi lǐ le。
examples.en: Soup is stewing in the pot; the aroma drifts into the yard.

examples.zh: 你怎么突然来了?我正想着给你打电话呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me tū rán lái le? wǒ zhèng xiǎng zhe gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà ne。
examples.en: Why did you come suddenly? I was just thinking of calling you.

examples.zh: 孩子们正在操场上高高兴兴地做游戏呢。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi men zhèng zài cāo chǎng shàng gāo gāo xìng xìng de zuò yóu xì ne。
examples.en: The children are happily playing games on the field.

examples.zh: 我进门的时候,他正对着镜子整理领带呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìn mén de shí hòu, tā zhèng duì zhe jìng zi zhěng lǐ lǐng dài ne。
examples.en: When I came in, he was adjusting his tie in the mirror.

examples.zh: 别急,饭正在锅里热着呢,马上就好。
examples.pinyin: Bié jí, fàn zhèng zài guō lǐ rè zhe ne, mǎ shàng jiù hǎo。
examples.en: Don't rush; the food is warming in the pot and will be ready soon.

examples.zh: 这会儿他正忙得团团转呢,你有事等会儿再说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè huì er tā zhèng máng de tuán tuán zhuàn ne, nǐ yǒu shì děng huì er zài shuō。
examples.en: He's rushed off his feet right now; tell him later.

examples.zh: 我打开门,看见小猫正趴在沙发上睡着呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ kāi mén, kàn jiàn xiǎo māo zhèng pā zài shā fā shàng shuì zháo ne。
examples.en: I opened the door and saw the kitten sleeping on the sofa.

examples.zh: 外面正刮着大风呢,你出门一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn zhèng guā zhe dà fēng ne, nǐ chū mén yí dìng yào xiǎo xīn。
examples.en: It's blowing hard outside; be careful when you go out.

examples.zh: 你安静一下,老师正在讲重点呢,别错过了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ ān jìng yī xià, lǎo shī zhèng zài jiǎng zhòng diǎn ne, bié cuò guò le。
examples.en: Quiet down; the teacher is on the key points, don't miss them.

examples.zh: 我经过的时候,他们正在门口聊得起劲呢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīng guò de shí hòu, tā men zhèng zài mén kǒu liáo de qǐ jìn ne。
examples.en: As I passed, they were chatting animatedly at the door.

examples.zh: 这个时间他一般正在吃午饭呢,你晚点再联系他。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shí jiān tā yì bān zhèng zài chī wǔ fàn ne, nǐ wǎn diǎn zài lián xì tā。
