title: "怪不得/难怪" ile "demek ondan, ne diyeyim"
summary: "怪不得/难怪" bir gerçeği öğrenince "demek ondan, ne diyeyim, haklıymışım" der: 难怪他今天没来,原来病了 = Demek bu yüzden gelmemiş, meğer hastaymış.
explanation: "怪不得" ve "难怪" (eş anlamlı), bir gerçeği/sebebi öğrendikten sonra önceki bir GÖZLEMİN nedenini anladığını, artık şaşırmadığını bildirir: "demek ondan, ne diyeyim, o yüzdenmiş, haklıymışım". 难怪他这么高兴,原来是升职了 (Ne diyeyim bu kadar sevinmesine, meğer terfi etmiş), 外面这么冷,怪不得没什么人出门 (Dışarısı bu kadar soğuk, demek o yüzden kimse çıkmamış). Genelde önce sebep verilir sonra "怪不得/难怪 + gözlem" gelir, ya da tersine gözlem + sonra sebep (原来... ile). "怪不得" kelimesi kelimesine "suçlanamaz/şaşılmaz" demektir; şaşkınlığın çözülmesini, bir bilmecenin aydınlanmasını yansıtır. Çoğu zaman "原来" (meğer) ile birlikte gelir. Türkçedeki "demek ondan, ne diyeyim, o yüzdenmiş, haklıymışım, bak sen" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir sebep-sonuç aydınlanmasını anlatmanın doğal yoludur.

examples.zh: 原来你昨晚熬夜了,怪不得今天一直没精神。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái nǐ zuó wǎn áo yè le, guài bù de jīn tiān yì zhí méi jīng shén。
examples.en: So you stayed up last night; no wonder you've been listless today.

examples.zh: 难怪这家店天天排队,原来东西又好吃又便宜。
examples.pinyin: Nán guài zhè jiā diàn tiān tiān pái duì, yuán lái dōng xī yòu hǎo chī yòu pián yi。
examples.en: No wonder this shop has queues daily; the food's tasty and cheap.

examples.zh: 外面下这么大的雨,怪不得路上一个人都没有。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn xià zhè me dà de yǔ, guài bù de lù shàng yí gè rén dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: It's raining so hard; no wonder there's no one on the road.

examples.zh: 他从小在国外长大,难怪英语说得这么地道。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo zài guó wài zhǎng dà, nán guài yīng yǔ shuō de zhè me dì dào。
examples.en: He grew up abroad; no wonder his English is so authentic.

examples.zh: 原来今天是周末,怪不得地铁上这么空。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái jīn tiān shì zhōu mò, guài bù de dì tiě shàng zhè me kōng。
examples.en: So it's the weekend; no wonder the subway is so empty.

examples.zh: 他练了十几年琴,难怪弹得这么好听。
examples.pinyin: Tā liàn le shí jǐ nián qín, nán guài dàn de zhè me hǎo tīng。
examples.en: He's practiced piano for over ten years; no wonder he plays so well.

examples.zh: 原来空调坏了,怪不得屋里这么闷这么热。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái kōng tiáo huài le, guài bù de wū lǐ zhè me mèn zhè me rè。
examples.en: So the AC is broken; no wonder the room is so stuffy and hot.

examples.zh: 难怪他对这里这么熟,原来他在这儿住过好几年。
examples.pinyin: Nán guài tā duì zhè lǐ zhè me shú, yuán lái tā zài zhè ér zhù guò hǎo jǐ nián。
examples.en: No wonder he knows here so well; he lived here for years.

examples.zh: 你感冒了啊,怪不得说话声音这么哑。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gǎn mào le a, guài bù de shuō huà shēng yīn zhè me yǎ。
examples.en: Oh, you have a cold; no wonder your voice is so hoarse.

examples.zh: 原来他们是双胞胎,难怪长得一模一样。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái tā men shì shuāng bāo tāi, nán guài zhǎng de yī mú yī yàng。
examples.en: So they're twins; no wonder they look exactly alike.

examples.zh: 这道菜放了这么多辣椒,难怪辣得我直流眼泪。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài fàng le zhè me duō là jiāo, nán guài là de wǒ zhí liú yǎn lèi。
examples.en: This dish has so much chili; no wonder it made me tear up.

examples.zh: 原来今天是他生日,怪不得大家都来了。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái jīn tiān shì tā shēng rì, guài bù de dà jiā dōu lái le。
examples.en: So today is his birthday; no wonder everyone came.

examples.zh: 他每天坚持背单词,难怪词汇量这么大。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān jiān chí bèi dān cí, nán guài cí huì liàng zhè me dà。
examples.en: He memorizes words daily; no wonder his vocabulary is so large.

examples.zh: 原来路上堵车了,怪不得他迟到了这么久。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái lù shàng dǔ chē le, guài bù de tā chí dào le zhè me jiǔ。
examples.en: So there was traffic; no wonder he was so late.

examples.zh: 难怪这几天他闷闷不乐,原来是工作上出了点事。
examples.pinyin: Nán guài zhè jǐ tiān tā mèn mèn bù lè, yuán lái shì gōng zuò shàng chū le diǎn shì。
examples.en: No wonder he's been gloomy; something happened at work.

examples.zh: 你没吃早饭啊,怪不得饿得没力气了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ méi chī zǎo fàn a, guài bù de è de méi lì qì le。
examples.en: You skipped breakfast; no wonder you're weak from hunger.

examples.zh: 原来他是这方面的专家,难怪讲得头头是道。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái tā shì zhè fāng miàn de zhuān jiā, nán guài jiǎng de tóu tóu shì dào。
examples.en: So he's an expert here; no wonder he explains so clearly.

examples.zh: 这块表是名牌,怪不得这么贵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài biǎo shì míng pái, guài bù de zhè me guì。
examples.en: This watch is a famous brand; no wonder it's so expensive.

examples.zh: 难怪这里的空气这么好,原来周围全是森林。
examples.pinyin: Nán guài zhè lǐ de kōng qì zhè me hǎo, yuán lái zhōu wéi quán shì sēn lín。
examples.en: No wonder the air is so good here; it's surrounded by forest.

examples.zh: 原来他提前练习过很多遍,怪不得表演得那么自然。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái tā tí qián liàn xí guò hěn duō biàn, guài bù de biǎo yǎn de nà me zì rán。
examples.en: So he'd practiced many times; no wonder he performed so naturally.

examples.zh: 你把窗户开着睡的啊,难怪会着凉。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ chuāng hù kāi zhe shuì de a, nán guài huì zháo liáng。
examples.en: You slept with the window open; no wonder you caught a chill.

examples.zh: 原来今天商场打折,怪不得人这么多。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái jīn tiān shāng chǎng dǎ zhé, guài bù de rén zhè me duō。
examples.en: So the mall is having a sale; no wonder it's so crowded.

examples.zh: 他小时候学过画画,难怪画得这么有水平。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎo shí hòu xué guò huà huà, nán guài huà de zhè me yǒu shuǐ píng。
examples.en: He studied painting as a child; no wonder he paints so well.

examples.zh: 原来手机静音了,怪不得我一直没听到你的电话。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái shǒu jī jìng yīn le, guài bù de wǒ yì zhí méi tīng dào nǐ de diàn huà。
examples.en: So the phone was on silent; no wonder I didn't hear your call.

examples.zh: 难怪这条鱼这么新鲜,原来是今天早上刚打上来的。
examples.pinyin: Nán guài zhè tiáo yú zhè me xīn xiān, yuán lái shì jīn tiān zǎo shàng gāng dǎ shàng lái de。
examples.en: No wonder this fish is so fresh; it was caught this morning.

title: "一方面...一方面..." ile "bir yandan ... bir yandan ..."
summary: "一方面...(另)一方面..." bir şeyin iki yönünü/sebebini sıralar: 一方面为了赚钱,一方面为了积累经验 = Bir yandan para kazanmak, bir yandan tecrübe edinmek için.
explanation: "一方面...(另)一方面..." bir durumun, kararın ya da sebebin İKİ YÖNÜNÜ/açısını yan yana sıralar: "bir yandan ..., bir yandan (da) ...; hem ... hem ...". 他去打工,一方面是为了赚点钱,另一方面也是为了锻炼自己 (Çalışmaya gitti; bir yandan biraz para kazanmak, bir yandan da kendini geliştirmek için), 这样做一方面节省了时间,另一方面也提高了效率 (Böyle yapmak bir yandan zaman kazandırdı, bir yandan verimi artırdı). İki yön çoğu zaman birbirini tamamlar (aynı yöne çalışan iki sebep) ya da bir konunun iki farklı yüzünü gösterir. İkinci kısımda "另" (diğer) eklenebilir. Bir kararın çok yönlü gerekçesini ya da bir durumun karmaşıklığını dengeli biçimde açıklar. Türkçedeki "bir yandan ..., bir yandan (da) ...; hem ... hem de ...; bir açıdan ..., bir açıdan ..." ifadelerine denk gelir; çok yönlü bir durumu ya da gerekçeyi anlatmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 他坚持每天跑步,一方面是为了健康,一方面也是为了减压。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiān chí měi tiān pǎo bù, yì fāng miàn shì wèi le jiàn kāng, yì fāng miàn yě shì wèi le jiǎn yā。
examples.en: He runs daily, partly for health and partly to relieve stress.

examples.zh: 搬到这个城市,一方面是因为工作,另一方面也是为了离家近一点。
examples.pinyin: Bān dào zhè ge chéng shì, yì fāng miàn shì yīn wèi gōng zuò, lìng yì fāng miàn yě shì wèi le lí jiā jìn yì diǎn。
examples.en: Moving here was partly for work and partly to be closer to home.

examples.zh: 多参加社团活动,一方面能交到朋友,一方面能锻炼能力。
examples.pinyin: Duō cān jiā shè tuán huó dòng, yì fāng miàn néng jiāo dào péng yǒu, yì fāng miàn néng duàn liàn néng lì。
examples.en: Joining clubs helps make friends and hone abilities.

examples.zh: 他不太爱说话,一方面是性格内向,一方面也是不太自信。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù tài ài shuō huà, yì fāng miàn shì xìng gé nèi xiàng, yì fāng miàn yě shì bù tài zì xìn。
examples.en: He's quiet, partly from being introverted and partly from low confidence.

examples.zh: 这样安排,一方面照顾了大家的时间,另一方面也提高了效率。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yàng ān pái, yì fāng miàn zhào gù le dà jiā de shí jiān, lìng yì fāng miàn yě tí gāo le xiào lǜ。
examples.en: This arrangement suits everyone's time and also raises efficiency.

examples.zh: 父母反对他出国,一方面是舍不得,一方面也是担心他照顾不好自己。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ fǎn duì tā chū guó, yì fāng miàn shì shě bù de, yì fāng miàn yě shì dān xīn tā zhào gù bù hǎo zì jǐ。
examples.en: His parents opposed his going abroad partly out of reluctance and partly worry.

examples.zh: 我选择这份工作,一方面待遇不错,另一方面也有发展空间。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xuǎn zé zhè fèn gōng zuò, yì fāng miàn dài yù bù cuò, lìng yì fāng miàn yě yǒu fā zhǎn kōng jiān。
examples.en: I chose this job partly for good pay and partly for growth potential.

examples.zh: 多读书,一方面能增长见识,另一方面也能让人心静。
examples.pinyin: Duō dú shū, yì fāng miàn néng zēng zhǎng jiàn shí, lìng yì fāng miàn yě néng ràng rén xīn jìng。
examples.en: Reading builds knowledge and also calms the mind.

examples.zh: 他之所以成功,一方面靠努力,另一方面也离不开机遇。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhī suǒ yǐ chéng gōng, yì fāng miàn kào nǔ lì, lìng yì fāng miàn yě lí bù kāi jī yù。
examples.en: His success owes to effort on one hand and opportunity on the other.

examples.zh: 这次活动,一方面是为了宣传,一方面也是为了回馈顾客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huó dòng, yì fāng miàn shì wèi le xuān chuán, yì fāng miàn yě shì wèi le huí kuì gù kè。
examples.en: This event is partly for promotion and partly to thank customers.

examples.zh: 学好汉语,一方面要多听多说,另一方面也要多读多写。
examples.pinyin: Xué hǎo hàn yǔ, yì fāng miàn yào duō tīng duō shuō, lìng yì fāng miàn yě yào duō dú duō xiě。
examples.en: Mastering Chinese needs both listening/speaking and reading/writing.

examples.zh: 他决定辞职,一方面是身体吃不消,另一方面也想多陪家人。
examples.pinyin: Tā jué dìng cí zhí, yì fāng miàn shì shēn tǐ chī bù xiāo, lìng yì fāng miàn yě xiǎng duō péi jiā rén。
examples.en: He resigned partly due to poor health and partly to be with family.

examples.zh: 这件事我很为难,一方面不想拒绝你,一方面又确实做不到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ hěn wéi nán, yì fāng miàn bù xiǎng jù jué nǐ, yì fāng miàn yòu què shí zuò bú dào。
examples.en: I'm torn: I don't want to refuse you, yet I truly can't do it.

examples.zh: 提前准备,一方面能减少失误,另一方面也能让人更从容。
examples.pinyin: Tí qián zhǔn bèi, yì fāng miàn néng jiǎn shǎo shī wù, lìng yì fāng miàn yě néng ràng rén gèng cóng róng。
examples.en: Preparing early reduces mistakes and also brings composure.

examples.zh: 这座城市吸引我,一方面是气候宜人,一方面是节奏比较慢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéng shì xī yǐn wǒ, yì fāng miàn shì qì hòu yí rén, yì fāng miàn shì jié zòu bǐ jiào màn。
examples.en: This city appeals to me partly for its climate and partly its slow pace.

examples.zh: 他答应帮忙,一方面是出于同情,另一方面也是看在老朋友的面子上。
examples.pinyin: Tā dā yìng bāng máng, yì fāng miàn shì chū yú tóng qíng, lìng yì fāng miàn yě shì kàn zài lǎo péng yǒu de miàn zi shàng。
examples.en: He agreed to help partly out of sympathy and partly for an old friend's sake.

examples.zh: 坚持写日记,一方面能记录生活,另一方面也能练习写作。
examples.pinyin: Jiān chí xiě rì jì, yì fāng miàn néng jì lù shēng huó, lìng yì fāng miàn yě néng liàn xí xiě zuò。
examples.en: Keeping a diary records life and also practices writing.

examples.zh: 这个决定不好做,一方面关系到未来,一方面也影响到家人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jué dìng bù hǎo zuò, yì fāng miàn guān xì dào wèi lái, yì fāng miàn yě yǐng xiǎng dào jiā rén。
examples.en: This decision is hard: it concerns the future and affects family too.

examples.zh: 政府修这条路,一方面方便了出行,另一方面也带动了当地经济。
examples.pinyin: Zhèng fǔ xiū zhè tiáo lù, yì fāng miàn fāng biàn le chū xíng, lìng yì fāng miàn yě dài dòng liǎo dàng dì jīng jì。
examples.en: Building this road eases travel and boosts the local economy.

examples.zh: 他学做饭,一方面是想照顾家人,另一方面也是一种乐趣。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué zuò fàn, yì fāng miàn shì xiǎng zhào gù jiā rén, lìng yì fāng miàn yě shì yī zhǒng lè qù。
examples.en: He learned to cook partly to care for family and partly for enjoyment.

examples.zh: 这次旅行让我印象深刻,一方面风景美,另一方面人也很热情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lǚ xíng ràng wǒ yìn xiàng shēn kè, yì fāng miàn fēng jǐng měi, lìng yì fāng miàn rén yě hěn rè qíng。
examples.en: This trip impressed me: beautiful scenery and warm people.

examples.zh: 我劝他慢慢来,一方面是怕他太累,一方面也是欲速则不达。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ quàn tā màn màn lái, yì fāng miàn shì pà tā tài lèi, yì fāng miàn yě shì yù sù zé bù dá。
examples.en: I urged him to slow down, fearing fatigue and knowing haste fails.

examples.zh: 这种做法有争议,一方面有人支持,另一方面也有人反对。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zuò fǎ yǒu zhēng yì, yì fāng miàn yǒu rén zhī chí, lìng yì fāng miàn yě yǒu rén fǎn duì。
examples.en: This approach is controversial: some support it, others oppose it.

examples.zh: 他保持沉默,一方面是不想争辩,另一方面也是在观察情况。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎo chí chén mò, yì fāng miàn shì bù xiǎng zhēng biàn, lìng yì fāng miàn yě shì zài guān chá qíng kuàng。
examples.en: He stayed silent partly to avoid arguing and partly to observe.

examples.zh: 坚持早起,一方面能拥有更多时间,另一方面也有益于健康。
examples.pinyin: Jiān chí zǎo qǐ, yì fāng miàn néng yōng yǒu gèng duō shí jiān, lìng yì fāng miàn yě yǒu yì yú jiàn kāng。
examples.en: Rising early gives more time and benefits health too.

title: "等(到)...再/就..." ile "...-e kadar bekleyip ..."
pattern: 等(到) + Zaman / Olay，Özne + 再 / 就 ...
summary: "等(到)...再/就..." bir olayı beklemeyi ve o olduktan sonra bir şey yapmayı bildirir: 等雨停了再走 = Yağmur dinene kadar bekle, sonra git.
explanation: "等(到)...再/就..." bir eylemin, başka bir olay/zaman GERÇEKLEŞENE KADAR ERTELENDİĞİNİ ve o olduktan sonra yapılacağını bildirir: "...-e kadar bekleyip (sonra) ..., ... olunca ...". Kalıp: 等(到) + koşul/olay，(özne) + 再/就 + eylem. 等他回来我们再吃饭 (O dönene kadar bekleyip öyle yemek yeriz), 等到放假,我就回老家 (Tatil olunca hemen memlekete dönerim). "等" bir olayı beklemeyi, "再" o olaydan SONRA yapılacak (ertelenmiş) eylemi, "就" ise o olay olunca HEMEN yapılacak eylemi bağlar. "到" isteğe bağlıdır ama belirli bir noktaya kadar beklemeyi vurgular. Bir eylemin bir koşula bağlı olarak sonraya bırakıldığını anlatır. Türkçedeki "...-e kadar bekleyip ..., ... olunca ..., ...-dıktan sonra ..." ifadelerine denk gelir; ertelenmiş, koşula bağlı eylemleri anlatmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 外面还下着雨,等雨停了我们再出发吧。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn hái xià zhe yǔ, děng yǔ tíng le wǒ men zài chū fā ba。
examples.en: It's still raining; let's set off after the rain stops.

examples.zh: 你先别急着下结论,等了解清楚了再说。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bié jí zhe xià jié lùn, děng liǎo jiě qīng chǔ le zài shuō。
examples.en: Don't rush to conclude; wait until you understand clearly.

examples.zh: 等孩子睡着了,我再把今天的家务收拾一下。
examples.pinyin: Děng hái zi shuì zháo le, wǒ zài bǎ jīn tiān de jiā wù shōu shí yī xià。
examples.en: Once the child is asleep, I'll tidy up today's chores.

examples.zh: 这件事等他回来我们再一起商量,别自己定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì děng tā huí lái wǒ men zài yì qǐ shāng liáng, bié zì jǐ dìng。
examples.en: Let's discuss this together when he's back; don't decide alone.

examples.zh: 等到春天来了,咱们就一起去郊外踏青。
examples.pinyin: Děng dào chūn tiān lái le, zán men jiù yì qǐ qù jiāo wài tà qīng。
examples.en: When spring comes, we'll go for a spring outing together.

examples.zh: 你先把身体养好,工作的事等好了再考虑。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ shēn tǐ yǎng hǎo, gōng zuò de shì děng hǎo le zài kǎo lǜ。
examples.en: Get your health back first; think about work once you're well.

examples.zh: 等吃完饭,我再陪你去逛逛街,不着急。
examples.pinyin: Děng chī wán fàn, wǒ zài péi nǐ qù guàng guàng jiē, bù zháo jí。
examples.en: After we eat, I'll go shopping with you; no rush.

examples.zh: 这道题现在讲你也不懂,等学了后面的再回来看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí xiàn zài jiǎng nǐ yě bù dǒng, děng xué le hòu miàn de zài huí lái kàn。
examples.en: You won't get this problem now; revisit it after learning more.

examples.zh: 等到发工资那天,我就把欠你的钱还上。
examples.pinyin: Děng dào fā gōng zī nà tiān, wǒ jiù bǎ qiàn nǐ de qián hái shàng。
examples.en: On payday, I'll repay the money I owe you.

examples.zh: 天太黑了,等天亮了我们再继续赶路吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài hēi le, děng tiān liàng le wǒ men zài jì xù gǎn lù ba。
examples.en: It's too dark; let's continue the journey at daybreak.

examples.zh: 你先去忙你的,等我这边弄完了就去找你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān qù máng nǐ de, děng wǒ zhè biān nòng wán le jiù qù zhǎo nǐ。
examples.en: Go handle your things; I'll find you once I finish here.

examples.zh: 这些照片先存着,等有时间了再慢慢整理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān xiān cún zhe, děng yǒu shí jiān le zài màn màn zhěng lǐ。
examples.en: Save these photos for now; sort them slowly when there's time.

examples.zh: 等到那些花都开了,这个院子一定特别漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Děng dào nà xiē huā dōu kāi le, zhè ge yuàn zi yí dìng tè bié piào liàng。
examples.en: When all those flowers bloom, this yard will be beautiful.

examples.zh: 你别催了,等我把话说完你再发表意见。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié cuī le, děng wǒ bǎ huà shuō wán nǐ zài fā biǎo yì jiàn。
examples.en: Stop rushing; give your view after I finish speaking.

examples.zh: 等这阵子忙完了,我一定好好陪你出去玩几天。
examples.pinyin: Děng zhè zhèn zi máng wán le, wǒ yí dìng hǎo hǎo péi nǐ chū qù wán jǐ tiān。
examples.en: Once this busy spell is over, I'll take you out for a few days.

examples.zh: 这个问题比较复杂,等我查清楚了再答复你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí bǐ jiào fù zá, děng wǒ chá qīng chǔ le zài dá fù nǐ。
examples.en: This question is complex; I'll reply once I've checked it.

examples.zh: 等到孩子长大懂事了,他自然会理解父母的苦心。
examples.pinyin: Děng dào hái zi zhǎng dà dǒng shì le, tā zì rán huì lǐ jiě fù mǔ de kǔ xīn。
examples.en: When the child grows up, he'll naturally understand his parents.

examples.zh: 你先坐下歇会儿,等缓过来了咱们再走。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zuò xià xiē huì er, děng huǎn guò lái le zán men zài zǒu。
examples.en: Sit and rest a while; we'll go once you've caught your breath.

examples.zh: 等到疫情过去,我们就一起去那个向往已久的地方。
examples.pinyin: Děng dào yì qíng guò qù, wǒ men jiù yì qǐ qù nà ge xiàng wǎng yǐ jiǔ de dì fāng。
examples.en: When the epidemic is over, we'll go to that long-awaited place.

examples.zh: 现在人太多了,等人少一点儿咱们再去买票。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài rén tài duō le, děng rén shǎo yì diǎn ér zán men zài qù mǎi piào。
examples.en: It's too crowded now; we'll buy tickets when it's less busy.

examples.zh: 你先把基础打好,等基础牢了再学难的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bǎ jī chǔ dǎ hǎo, děng jī chǔ láo le zài xué nán de。
examples.en: Build a solid foundation first, then learn the hard parts.

examples.zh: 等到过年的时候,一家人就能团团圆圆地在一起了。
examples.pinyin: Děng dào guò nián de shí hòu, yī jiā rén jiù néng tuán tuán yuán yuán de zài yì qǐ le。
examples.en: At New Year, the whole family can gather happily together.

examples.zh: 这件衣服现在别买,等打折的时候再买更划算。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú xiàn zài bié mǎi, děng dǎ zhé de shí hòu zài mǎi gèng huá suàn。
examples.en: Don't buy this now; it's cheaper to buy when it's on sale.

examples.zh: 你先冷静一下,等气消了咱们再好好谈。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān lěng jìng yī xià, děng qì xiāo le zán men zài hǎo hǎo tán。
examples.en: Calm down first; we'll talk properly once your anger fades.

examples.zh: 等到万事俱备,我们就可以正式开始了。
examples.pinyin: Děng dào wàn shì jù bèi, wǒ men jiù kě yǐ zhèng shì kāi shǐ le。
examples.en: When everything is ready, we can officially begin.

title: "常常" ile "经常" farkı
summary: "常常" ve "经常" ikisi de "sık sık" demektir; "经常" düzenli bir alışkanlığı, "常常" ise tekrarlanan olayları vurgular ve olumsuzu farklıdır.
explanation: "常常" ve "经常" büyük ölçüde eş anlamlıdır ("sık sık, çoğu zaman") ve çoğu cümlede birbirinin yerine geçer: 我常常/经常去图书馆 (Sık sık kütüphaneye giderim). İnce farklar: (1) "经常" DÜZENLİ, alışkanlık hâline gelmiş bir sıklığı vurgular ve sıfat gibi de kullanılabilir (他是经常迟到的人); "常常" ise sadece olayların TEKRARINI belirtir. (2) OLUMSUZLUK: "常常"ın olumsuzu genelde "不常" (sık değil) biçimindedir; "不常常" pek denmez. "经常" ise "不经常" olarak olumsuzlanabilir. (3) "经常" biraz daha resmî/yazılı, "常常" biraz daha konuşma dilidir. Geçmiş bir dönemdeki tekrarlar için ikisi de kullanılır. Türkçedeki "sık sık, çoğu zaman, sıkça" ifadelerine denk gelir; bu konu iki eş anlamlı zarfın kullanım farklarını gösterir.

examples.zh: 我经常去那家书店,老板都认识我了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīng cháng qù nà jiā shū diàn, lǎo bǎn dōu rèn shí wǒ le。
examples.en: I often go to that bookstore; the owner knows me now.

examples.zh: 小时候,爷爷常常带我去河边钓鱼。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo shí hòu, yé yé cháng cháng dài wǒ qù hé biān diào yú。
examples.en: As a child, grandpa often took me fishing by the river.

examples.zh: 他工作很忙,经常加班到很晚才回家。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōng zuò hěn máng, jīng cháng jiā bān dào hěn wǎn cái huí jiā。
examples.en: He's busy with work and often works overtime until late.

examples.zh: 这种小事我常常忘,你可得多提醒我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xiǎo shì wǒ cháng cháng wàng, nǐ kě de duō tí xǐng wǒ。
examples.en: I often forget such small things; do remind me more.

examples.zh: 她经常锻炼,所以身体一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīng cháng duàn liàn, suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ yì zhí hěn hǎo。
examples.en: She exercises regularly, so her health has always been good.

examples.zh: 我们以前常常在一起玩,现在却很少见面了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men yǐ qián cháng cháng zài yì qǐ wán, xiàn zài què hěn shǎo jiàn miàn le。
examples.en: We used to play together often, but now we rarely meet.

examples.zh: 他不常出门,一有空就喜欢待在家里看书。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù cháng chū mén, yī yǒu kòng jiù xǐ huān dài zài jiā lǐ kàn shū。
examples.en: He doesn't go out often; when free he likes reading at home.

examples.zh: 这条路上经常堵车,你最好换一条路走。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù shàng jīng cháng dǔ chē, nǐ zuì hǎo huàn yī tiáo lù zǒu。
examples.en: This road often jams; you'd better take another route.

examples.zh: 妈妈常常唠叨,其实都是为了我们好。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā cháng cháng láo dāo, qí shí dōu shì wèi le wǒ men hǎo。
examples.en: Mom often nags, but it's all for our good.

examples.zh: 他经常出差,一个月有一半时间不在家。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīng cháng chū chāi, yí gè yuè yǒu yí bàn shí jiān bù zài jiā。
examples.en: He often travels for work, away half the month.

examples.zh: 下雨天,我常常喜欢躲在家里听音乐。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ tiān, wǒ cháng cháng xǐ huān duǒ zài jiā lǐ tīng yīn yuè。
examples.en: On rainy days I often like to stay in and listen to music.

examples.zh: 这个牌子的产品质量不错,我经常买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge pái zi de chǎn pǐn zhì liàng bù cuò, wǒ jīng cháng mǎi。
examples.en: This brand's products are good quality; I buy them often.

examples.zh: 他不经常联系我,可每次联系都特别贴心。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù jīng cháng lián xì wǒ, kě měi cì lián xì dōu tè bié tiē xīn。
examples.en: He doesn't contact me often, but each time it's very thoughtful.

examples.zh: 小区里的老人常常聚在一起下棋、聊天。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo qū lǐ de lǎo rén cháng cháng jù zài yì qǐ xià qí、 liáo tiān。
examples.en: The elderly in the neighborhood often gather to play chess and chat.

examples.zh: 由于经常熬夜,他的身体一天不如一天。
examples.pinyin: Yóu yú jīng cháng áo yè, tā de shēn tǐ yī tiān bù rú yī tiān。
examples.en: Because of frequent late nights, his health worsens by the day.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅我们经常来,菜的味道从没让人失望过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng wǒ men jīng cháng lái, cài de wèi dào cóng méi ràng rén shī wàng guò。
examples.en: We often come to this restaurant; the food never disappoints.

examples.zh: 我常常想起小时候在乡下度过的那些日子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng cháng xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu zài xiāng xià dù guò de nà xiē rì zi。
examples.en: I often recall the days I spent in the countryside as a child.

examples.zh: 他经常帮助邻居,大家都很喜欢这个热心人。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīng cháng bāng zhù lín jū, dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huān zhè ge rè xīn rén。
examples.en: He often helps neighbors; everyone likes this warm-hearted man.

examples.zh: 这种天气,他常常提醒我们出门要多穿点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tiān qì, tā cháng cháng tí xǐng wǒ men chū mén yào duō chuān diǎn。
examples.en: In this weather he often reminds us to dress warmly when out.

examples.zh: 因为经常练习,他弹钢琴的水平提高得很快。
examples.pinyin: Yīn wèi jīng cháng liàn xí, tā tán gāng qín de shuǐ píng tí gāo de hěn kuài。
examples.en: Because he practices often, his piano skill improved quickly.

examples.zh: 我们不常见面,可友谊却一点儿也没变淡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bù cháng jiàn miàn, kě yǒu yì què yì diǎn ér yě méi biàn dàn。
examples.en: We don't meet often, yet our friendship hasn't faded at all.

examples.zh: 他经常一个人去旅行,享受那份自由和宁静。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīng cháng yí gè rén qù lǚ xíng, xiǎng shòu nà fèn zì yóu hé níng jìng。
examples.en: He often travels alone, enjoying the freedom and calm.

examples.zh: 孩子常常问一些让大人也答不上来的问题。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi cháng cháng wèn yī xiē ràng dà rén yě dá bù shàng lái de wèn tí。
examples.en: The child often asks questions even adults can't answer.

examples.zh: 这几年他经常回老家,陪伴日渐年迈的父母。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián tā jīng cháng huí lǎo jiā, péi bàn rì jiàn nián mài de fù mǔ。
examples.en: In recent years he often returns home to be with his aging parents.

examples.zh: 下班以后,他常常绕到公园走一走再回家。
examples.pinyin: Xià bān yǐ hòu, tā cháng cháng rào dào gōng yuán zǒu yī zǒu zài huí jiā。
examples.en: After work, he often walks through the park before going home.

title: "刚" ile "刚才" farkı
summary: "刚" bir ZARFTIR (fiil önünde, "az önce/henüz"); "刚才" bir ZAMAN sözcüğüdür ("demin, az önce", tek başına durabilir).
explanation: "刚" ve "刚才" ikisi de yakın geçmişi anlatır ama dilbilgisel türleri farklıdır. "刚" bir ZARFTIR: doğrudan fiilin önünde durur, "henüz, daha yeni, az önce" der ve olayın konuşma anına çok yakın gerçekleştiğini vurgular: 我刚到家 (Daha yeni eve geldim), 他刚走 (Az önce gitti). Öznenin ardında, fiilin önündedir. "刚才" ise bir ZAMAN sözcüğüdür (isim gibi): "demin, az önce" — belirli bir yakın geçmiş ANI gösterir, tek başına durabilir ve cümlede öznenin önüne ya da ardına gelebilir: 刚才谁给我打电话了? (Demin bana kim aradı?), 我刚才没听清楚 (Az önce iyi duyamadım). Ayrıca "刚才"ın olumsuzu "没" ile olur (刚才没...), ama "刚" ile bir olumsuz eylem pek anlatılmaz. Kısaca: "刚" = fiil önünde zarf (yenilik), "刚才" = geçmiş bir anı gösteren zaman sözcüğü. Türkçedeki "yeni, henüz" (刚) ile "demin, az önce" (刚才) ayrımına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 我刚到公司,还没来得及喝口水就开始忙了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dào gōng sī, hái méi lái de jí hē kǒu shuǐ jiù kāi shǐ máng le。
examples.en: I just got to the office and started working before I could even sip water.

examples.zh: 刚才有人来找你,你不在,他留了个电话号码。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái yǒu rén lái zhǎo nǐ, nǐ bù zài, tā liú le gè diàn huà hào mǎ。
examples.en: Someone came looking for you just now; you were out, so he left a number.

examples.zh: 他刚出门,你现在追出去也许还能追上。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng chū mén, nǐ xiàn zài zhuī chū qù yě xǔ hái néng zhuī shàng。
examples.en: He just left; if you go after him now you might still catch up.

examples.zh: 对不起,刚才我在开会,没能及时接你的电话。
examples.pinyin: Duì bù qǐ, gāng cái wǒ zài kāi huì, méi néng jí shí jiē nǐ de diàn huà。
examples.en: Sorry, I was in a meeting just now and couldn't answer your call.

examples.zh: 这饭刚做好,还热气腾腾的,快趁热吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fàn gāng zuò hǎo, hái rè qì téng téng de, kuài chèn rè chī。
examples.en: The food's just been made and is steaming hot; eat it while it's hot.

examples.zh: 刚才那阵风好大,把窗户都吹开了。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nà zhèn fēng hǎo dà, bǎ chuāng hù dōu chuī kāi le。
examples.en: That gust just now was so strong it blew the window open.

examples.zh: 孩子刚睡着,你们说话声音小一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi gāng shuì zháo, nǐ men shuō huà shēng yīn xiǎo yì diǎn ér。
examples.en: The child just fell asleep; keep your voices down.

examples.zh: 你刚才说的那家餐厅,具体叫什么名字?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāng cái shuō de nà jiā cān tīng, jù tǐ jiào shén me míng zì?
examples.en: The restaurant you mentioned just now — what's its name exactly?

examples.zh: 我刚看完这本书,正想找人聊聊里面的内容。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng kàn wán zhè běn shū, zhèng xiǎng zhǎo rén liáo liáo lǐ miàn de nèi róng。
examples.en: I just finished this book and want to discuss its content with someone.

examples.zh: 刚才我一时糊涂,把你的名字都叫错了,真不好意思。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái wǒ yī shí hú tú, bǎ nǐ de míng zì dōu jiào cuò le, zhēn bù hǎo yì sī。
examples.en: I got muddled just now and called you the wrong name; sorry.

examples.zh: 天刚亮,鸟儿就在窗外欢快地叫了起来。
examples.pinyin: Tiān gāng liàng, niǎo ér jiù zài chuāng wài huān kuài de jiào le qǐ lái。
examples.en: As soon as it dawned, the birds began chirping cheerfully outside.

examples.zh: 你刚才去哪儿了?我找了你半天也没找到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāng cái qù nǎ ér le? wǒ zhǎo le nǐ bàn tiān yě méi zhǎo dào。
examples.en: Where did you go just now? I looked for you for ages.

examples.zh: 我刚认识他不久,对他的脾气还不太了解。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng rèn shí tā bù jiǔ, duì tā de pí qì hái bù tài liǎo jiě。
examples.en: I only just met him; I don't know his temper well yet.

examples.zh: 刚才那道题我没听懂,老师能再讲一遍吗?
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nà dào tí wǒ méi tīng dǒng, lǎo shī néng zài jiǎng yī biàn ma?
examples.en: I didn't understand that problem just now; can the teacher repeat it?

examples.zh: 雨刚停,地上还湿着,你出门小心点儿别滑倒。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ gāng tíng, de shàng hái shī zhe, nǐ chū mén xiǎo xīn diǎn ér bié huá dào。
examples.en: The rain just stopped and the ground's wet; mind you don't slip.

examples.zh: 刚才电话里太吵,咱们现在慢慢说。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái diàn huà lǐ tài chǎo, zán men xiàn zài màn màn shuō。
examples.en: It was too noisy on the phone just now; let's talk slowly now.

examples.zh: 他刚搬来这个小区,还不太熟悉周围的环境。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng bān lái zhè ge xiǎo qū, hái bù tài shú xī zhōu wéi de huán jìng。
examples.en: He just moved to this neighborhood and isn't familiar with the area yet.

examples.zh: 你刚才是不是想说什么?怎么又不说了?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ gāng cái shì bú shì xiǎng shuō shén me? zěn me yòu bù shuō le?
examples.en: Were you about to say something just now? Why did you stop?

examples.zh: 水刚烧开,你等它凉一凉再喝,别烫着。
examples.pinyin: Shuǐ gāng shāo kāi, nǐ děng tā liàng yī liàng zài hē, bié tàng zhe。
examples.en: The water just boiled; let it cool before drinking, don't scald yourself.

examples.zh: 刚才我路过书店,顺便给你买了本你想要的书。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái wǒ lù guò shū diàn, shùn biàn gěi nǐ mǎi le běn nǐ xiǎng yào de shū。
examples.en: Passing the bookstore just now, I bought you the book you wanted.

examples.zh: 他刚毕业,工作经验还不多,需要多锻炼。
examples.pinyin: Tā gāng bì yè, gōng zuò jīng yàn hái bù duō, xū yào duō duàn liàn。
examples.en: He just graduated with little work experience; he needs more training.

examples.zh: 刚才那个消息把大家都吓了一跳,现在还没缓过来。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nà ge xiāo xī bǎ dà jiā dōu xià le yī tiào, xiàn zài hái méi huǎn guò lái。
examples.en: That news just now startled everyone; we still haven't recovered.

examples.zh: 我刚起床,头发还乱着呢,你等我收拾一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng qǐ chuáng, tóu fà hái luàn zhe ne, nǐ děng wǒ shōu shí yī xià。
examples.en: I just got up with my hair a mess; wait while I tidy up.

examples.zh: 刚才你没在,所以我把东西交给了你同事。
examples.pinyin: Gāng cái nǐ méi zài, suǒ yǐ wǒ bǎ dōng xī jiāo gěi le nǐ tóng shì。
examples.en: You weren't here just now, so I handed the things to your colleague.

examples.zh: 电影刚开始,你来得正好,一点儿都没错过。
examples.pinyin: Diàn yǐng gāng kāi shǐ, nǐ lái de zhèng hǎo, yì diǎn ér dōu méi cuò guò。
examples.en: The movie just started; you came at the right time and missed nothing.

title: "有点儿" ile "一点儿" farkı
pattern: 有点儿 + Sıfat (öncesi) / Sıfat + 一点儿 (sonrası)
summary: "有点儿" sıfattan ÖNCE gelir ve genelde olumsuz "biraz" der (有点儿贵 = biraz pahalı); "一点儿" sıfattan SONRA gelir ve kıyas/istek bildirir (便宜一点儿 = biraz daha ucuz).
explanation: "有点儿" ve "一点儿" sık karıştırılır. "有点儿" (有点) bir SIFATIN ÖNÜNE gelir ve neredeyse her zaman İSTENMEYEN/olumsuz bir durumu "biraz" diye bildirir: 今天有点儿冷 (Bugün biraz soğuk), 这件衣服有点儿贵 (Bu giysi biraz pahalı), 我有点儿累 (Biraz yorgunum). "一点儿" (一点) ise bir SIFATTAN SONRA gelir ve bir KIYAS ya da İSTEK bildirir ("biraz daha ..."): 便宜一点儿 (biraz daha ucuz), 你快一点儿 (biraz daha hızlı ol), 声音大一点儿 (sesi biraz aç). Kısaca: "有点儿 + sıfat" = mevcut durumdan şikâyet (biraz fazla ...); "sıfat + 一点儿" = değişiklik/kıyas isteği (biraz daha ...). Ayrıca "一点儿" bir isimden önce "az miktar" da bildirir: 一点儿水 (biraz su). Türkçedeki "biraz (fazla)" (有点儿) ile "biraz daha" (一点儿) ayrımına denk gelir; en yaygın öğrenci hatalarından biridir.

examples.zh: 这件衣服我很喜欢,就是有点儿贵,能便宜一点儿吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú wǒ hěn xǐ huān, jiù shì yǒu diǎn ér guì, néng pián yi yì diǎn ér ma?
examples.en: I like this outfit, but it's a bit pricey; could it be a little cheaper?

examples.zh: 今天有点儿冷,你多穿一点儿衣服再出门。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān yǒu diǎn ér lěng, nǐ duō chuān yì diǎn ér yī fú zài chū mén。
examples.en: It's a bit cold today; put on a bit more clothing before going out.

examples.zh: 这道菜有点儿淡,再加一点儿盐味道会更好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài yǒu diǎn ér dàn, zài jiā yì diǎn ér yán wèi dào huì gèng hǎo。
examples.en: This dish is a bit bland; a little more salt would improve it.

examples.zh: 我最近有点儿累,想找个周末好好休息一下。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì jìn yǒu diǎn ér lèi, xiǎng zhǎo gè zhōu mò hǎo hǎo xiū xī yī xià。
examples.en: I've been a bit tired lately; I want a weekend to rest well.

examples.zh: 你说话声音有点儿小,能不能大一点儿?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō huà shēng yīn yǒu diǎn ér xiǎo, néng bù néng dà yī diǎn ér?
examples.en: Your voice is a bit soft; could you speak a bit louder?

examples.zh: 这个房间有点儿暗,咱们把窗帘拉开一点儿吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fáng jiān yǒu diǎn ér àn, zán men bǎ chuāng lián lā kāi yì diǎn ér ba。
examples.en: This room is a bit dark; let's open the curtains a little.

examples.zh: 他今天好像有点儿不高兴,你去问问怎么了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīn tiān hǎo xiàng yǒu diǎn ér bù gāo xìng, nǐ qù wèn wèn zěn me le。
examples.en: He seems a bit unhappy today; go ask what's wrong.

examples.zh: 这条裤子有点儿长,你能帮我改短一点儿吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo kù zi yǒu diǎn ér zhǎng, nǐ néng bāng wǒ gǎi duǎn yì diǎn ér ma?
examples.en: These trousers are a bit long; can you shorten them a little?

examples.zh: 路上有点儿堵,你耐心一点儿,一会儿就好了。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng yǒu diǎn ér dǔ, nǐ nài xīn yì diǎn ér, yī huì er jiù hǎo le。
examples.en: There's a bit of traffic; be a little patient, it'll clear soon.

examples.zh: 我对这方面有点儿了解,不过懂得还不够多。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè fāng miàn yǒu diǎn ér liǎo jiě, bù guò dǒng de hái bù gòu duō。
examples.en: I know a bit about this area, but not enough.

examples.zh: 汤有点儿烫,你等它凉一点儿再喝。
examples.pinyin: Tāng yǒu diǎn ér tàng, nǐ děng tā liáng yì diǎn ér zài hē。
examples.en: The soup is a bit hot; wait until it cools a little to drink.

examples.zh: 这几天他工作有点儿忙,你别打扰他太多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān tā gōng zuò yǒu diǎn ér máng, nǐ bié dǎ rǎo tā tài duō。
examples.en: He's a bit busy with work these days; don't disturb him too much.

examples.zh: 字写得有点儿乱,你写工整一点儿好不好?
examples.pinyin: Zì xiě de yǒu diǎn ér luàn, nǐ xiě gōng zhěng yì diǎn ér hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.en: Your writing is a bit messy; could you write a little neater?

examples.zh: 这个包有点儿重,你能不能拿轻一点儿的?
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bāo yǒu diǎn ér zhòng, nǐ néng bù néng ná qīng yì diǎn ér de?

examples.zh: 外面有点儿吵,咱们把门关上,安静一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn yǒu diǎn ér chǎo, zán men bǎ mén guān shàng, ān jìng yì diǎn ér。

examples.zh: 他普通话说得有点儿快,你能说慢一点儿吗?
examples.pinyin: Tā pǔ tōng huà shuō de yǒu diǎn ér kuài, nǐ néng shuō màn yì diǎn ér ma?

examples.zh: 我今天有点儿感冒,想多喝一点儿热水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān yǒu diǎn ér gǎn mào, xiǎng duō hē yì diǎn ér rè shuǐ。
examples.en: I have a bit of a cold today; I want to drink a little more hot water.

examples.zh: 这个决定有点儿仓促,咱们最好再慎重一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jué dìng yǒu diǎn ér cāng cù, zán men zuì hǎo zài shèn zhòng yì diǎn ér。
examples.en: This decision is a bit hasty; we'd best be a little more careful.

examples.zh: 孩子最近有点儿贪玩,你得对他严格一点儿。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zuì jìn yǒu diǎn ér tān wán, nǐ děi duì tā yán gé yì diǎn ér。
examples.en: The child's been a bit playful lately; you should be a little stricter.

examples.zh: 这块蛋糕有点儿甜,给我切小一点儿的一块就行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài dàn gāo yǒu diǎn ér tián, gěi wǒ qiè xiǎo yì diǎn ér de yī kuài jiù xíng。
examples.en: This cake is a bit sweet; a smaller piece will do for me.

examples.zh: 他的态度有点儿冷淡,不过熟悉了就好一点儿了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tài dù yǒu diǎn ér lěng dàn, bù guò shú xī le jiù hǎo yì diǎn ér le。
examples.en: His manner is a bit cold, but it improves once you know him.

examples.zh: 这个时间去有点儿早,咱们晚一点儿出发吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shí jiān qù yǒu diǎn ér zǎo, zán men wǎn yì diǎn ér chū fā ba。

examples.zh: 我心里有点儿紧张,你能陪我一起进去吗?

examples.en: I'm a bit nervous; could you go in with me?

examples.zh: 这双鞋有点儿紧,有没有大一点儿的号码?
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié yǒu diǎn ér jǐn, yǒu méi yǒu dà yī diǎn ér de hào mǎ?
examples.en: These shoes are a bit tight; is there a slightly larger size?

examples.zh: 最近开销有点儿大,以后得节省一点儿了。
examples.pinyin: Zuì jìn kāi xiāo yǒu diǎn ér dà, yǐ hòu de jié shěng yì diǎn ér le。
examples.en: Expenses have been a bit high lately; I should be a little more frugal.

title: "会" / "能" / "可以" farkı
summary: "会" öğrenilmiş beceriyi, "能" fiziksel/koşulsal imkânı ve dereceyi, "可以" izni bildirir — üçü de "...-ebilmek" ama farklı açılardan.
explanation: Bu üç yardımcı fiil de "...-ebilmek" der ama farklı açıları vurgular. "会": ÖĞRENME sonucu kazanılan beceri ("...mayı bilmek") ve gelecek olasılığı — 我会游泳 (Yüzmeyi bilirim), 明天会下雨 (Yarın yağmur yağabilir). "能": bir eylemin FİZİKSEL/koşulsal olarak mümkün olması ya da bir DERECEYE ulaşma — 我今天很忙,不能来 (Bugün meşgulüm, gelemem), 他一分钟能打一百个字 (Dakikada yüz karakter yazabilir), 病好了,能吃饭了 (İyileşti, yemek yiyebiliyor). "可以": İZİN/uygunluk — 这里可以拍照吗? (Burada fotoğraf çekilebilir mi?), 你可以走了 (Gidebilirsin). Örtüşmeler olur: beceriyle "会/能" (我会/能开车), izinle "能/可以" (可以/能进来吗?). İnce ayrım: "会" öğrenilmiş yeti, "能" koşulsal imkân/kapasite, "可以" izin. Olumsuzlar: 不会 (bilmemek), 不能 (imkânsız/yasak), 不可以 (izin yok). Türkçedeki "...mayı bilmek / ...-ebilmek (imkân) / ...-ebilmek (izin)" ayrımlarına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 他会说三种语言,可是现在嗓子哑了,不能说话。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì shuō sān zhǒng yǔ yán, kě shì xiàn zài sǎng zi yǎ le, bù néng shuō huà。

examples.zh: 请问,这里可以停车吗?我找了半天车位。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng wèn, zhè lǐ kě yǐ tíng chē ma? wǒ zhǎo le bàn tiān chē wèi。
examples.en: Excuse me, can I park here? I've been looking for a spot.

examples.zh: 我会开车,可是今天喝了酒,不能开。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì kāi chē, kě shì jīn tiān hē le jiǔ, bù néng kāi。
examples.en: I can drive, but I drank today, so I can't drive.

examples.zh: 你的病还没好,暂时还不能吃太油腻的东西。

examples.zh: 孩子五岁就会背很多古诗,大家都夸他聪明。

examples.zh: 这个会议室现在没人用,你们可以在这儿讨论。

examples.zh: 他一口气能跑十公里,体力真是好得惊人。
examples.pinyin: Tā yì kǒu qì néng pǎo shí gōng lǐ, tǐ lì zhēn shì hǎo de jīng rén。

examples.zh: 你会不会用这个软件?不会的话我可以教你。

examples.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雪,你出门可要小心。

examples.en: The forecast says it'll snow tomorrow; be careful when out.

examples.zh: 这里是图书馆,不可以大声说话,请安静一点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ shì tú shū guǎn, bù kě yǐ dà shēng shuō huà, qǐng ān jìng yì diǎn。

examples.zh: 我今天能帮你搬家,不过下午三点以后才有空。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān néng bāng nǐ bān jiā, bù guò xià wǔ sān diǎn yǐ hòu cái yǒu kòng。
examples.en: I can help you move today, but only after three in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 她会做很多种点心,而且每一种都做得特别好。
examples.pinyin: Tā huì zuò hěn duō zhǒng diǎn xīn, ér qiě měi yī zhǒng dōu zuò de tè bié hǎo。

examples.zh: 请问我可以看看这件衣服吗?我想试一下。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng wèn wǒ kě yǐ kàn kàn zhè jiàn yī fú ma? wǒ xiǎng shì yī xià。

examples.zh: 他病刚好,还不能做剧烈运动,只能慢慢散步。

examples.zh: 你会包饺子吗?今天咱们一起动手包一顿。

examples.zh: 这些座位是留给老人的,年轻人不可以随便坐。

examples.zh: 经过练习,他现在能用汉语进行简单的交流了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò liàn xí, tā xiàn zài néng yòng hàn yǔ jìn xíng jiǎn dān de jiāo liú le。
examples.en: After practice, he can now hold simple conversations in Chinese.

examples.zh: 你要是有事,可以提前跟老师请假。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì yǒu shì, kě yǐ tí qián gēn lǎo shī qǐng jià。
examples.en: If you have something on, you can ask the teacher for leave in advance.

examples.zh: 这么重的东西,我一个人搬不动,你能帮我一把吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng de dōng xī, wǒ yí gè rén bān bù dòng, nǐ néng bāng wǒ yī bǎ ma?
examples.en: This is too heavy for me alone; can you give me a hand?

examples.zh: 他从小就会画画,长大后成了一名有名的画家。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù huì huà huà, zhǎng dà hòu chéng le yī míng yǒu míng de huà jiā。
examples.en: He could draw since childhood and became a famous painter.

examples.zh: 现在还早,商店没开门,我们还不能进去。
examples.pinyin: Xiàn zài hái zǎo, shāng diàn méi kāi mén, wǒ men hái bù néng jìn qù。
examples.en: It's early; the shop isn't open, so we can't go in yet.

examples.zh: 你可以把手机借我用一下吗?我的没电了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ bǎ shǒu jī jiè wǒ yòng yī xià ma? wǒ de méi diàn le。
examples.en: Can I borrow your phone? Mine's out of battery.

examples.zh: 虽然他年纪大了,可是还能自己照顾自己。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán tā nián jì dà le, kě shì hái néng zì jǐ zhào gù zì jǐ。
examples.en: Though he's old, he can still take care of himself.

examples.zh: 我不会做这道菜,不过我可以照着菜谱试试。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú huì zuò zhè dào cài, bù guò wǒ kě yǐ zhào zhe cài pǔ shì shì。
examples.en: I can't make this dish, but I can try following a recipe.

examples.zh: 这个座位有人吗?我可以坐这儿吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zuò wèi yǒu rén ma? wǒ kě yǐ zuò zhè ér ma?
examples.en: Is this seat taken? May I sit here?

title: "还是" ile "或者" farkı
summary: "还是" seçenek sunan SORULARDA kullanılır (你去还是我去?); "或者" düz İFADELERDE "veya" der (你或者我去都行).
explanation: "还是" ve "或者" ikisi de iki seçeneği bağlar ama farklı cümle türlerinde kullanılır. "还是" bir SEÇENEK SORUSUNDA ("... mı yoksa ... mı?") gelir; dinleyiciden bir seçim ister: 你喝茶还是喝咖啡? (Çay mı kahve mi içersin?), 我们今天去还是明天去? (Bugün mü yarın mı gidelim?). "或者" ise DÜZ (soru olmayan) İFADELERDE "veya, ya da" der; bir seçim istemez, seçenekten bahseder: 你或者他去都可以 (Ya sen ya o gitse olur), 我想喝点茶或者咖啡 (Biraz çay ya da kahve içmek isterim). Kısaca: SORUDA 还是, İFADEDE 或者. "还是" ayrıca "en iyisi/yine de" (öneri) anlamına da gelir (bkz. ayrı konu); bir dolaylı soruda (我不知道去还是不去) yine "还是" kullanılır çünkü bir seçim söz konusudur. Türkçedeki "...mı yoksa ...mı?" (还是, soru) ile "veya, ya da" (或者, ifade) ayrımına denk gelir; en sık öğrenci hatalarından biridir.

examples.zh: 你今天想吃米饭还是面条?我这就去准备。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jīn tiān xiǎng chī mǐ fàn hái shì miàn tiáo? wǒ zhè jiù qù zhǔn bèi。
examples.en: Do you want rice or noodles today? I'll go prepare it.

examples.zh: 周末我们可以去爬山,或者在家看看电影,都行。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò wǒ men kě yǐ qù pá shān, huò zhě zài jiā kàn kàn diàn yǐng, dōu xíng。
examples.en: This weekend we can go hiking or watch movies at home, either's fine.

examples.zh: 咱们是坐地铁去还是打车去?你觉得哪个方便?
examples.pinyin: Zán men shì zuò dì tiě qù hái shì dǎ chē qù? nǐ jué de nǎ ge fāng biàn?
examples.en: Shall we take the subway or a taxi? Which do you think is easier?

examples.zh: 你要是渴了,冰箱里有水或者果汁,自己拿。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì kě le, bīng xiāng lǐ yǒu shuǐ huò zhě guǒ zhī, zì jǐ ná。
examples.en: If you're thirsty, there's water or juice in the fridge; help yourself.

examples.zh: 这件事你打算自己解决,还是需要我帮忙?
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ dǎ suàn zì jǐ jiě jué, hái shì xū yào wǒ bāng máng?
examples.en: Do you plan to solve this yourself, or do you need my help?

examples.zh: 有问题你可以问老师或者查一下资料,都能弄明白。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèn tí nǐ kě yǐ wèn lǎo shī huò zhě chá yī xià zī liào, dōu néng nòng míng bái。
examples.en: For questions you can ask the teacher or check references; either clears it up.

examples.zh: 你是喜欢住在城里,还是喜欢住在乡下?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì xǐ huān zhù zài chéng lǐ, hái shì xǐ huān zhù zài xiāng xià?
examples.en: Do you prefer living in the city or the countryside?

examples.zh: 这份文件你可以打印出来或者直接发到我邮箱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn wén jiàn nǐ kě yǐ dǎ yìn chū lái huò zhě zhí jiē fā dào wǒ yóu xiāng。
examples.en: You can print this document or send it straight to my email.

examples.zh: 我们明天出发,还是后天出发,你定个时间吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men míng tiān chū fā, hái shì hòu tiān chū fā, nǐ dìng gè shí jiān ba。
examples.en: Do we leave tomorrow or the day after? You set the time.

examples.zh: 生日礼物我打算送她一本书或者一条围巾。
examples.pinyin: Shēng rì lǐ wù wǒ dǎ suàn sòng tā yī běn shū huò zhě yī tiáo wéi jīn。
examples.en: For her birthday I'll give her a book or a scarf.

examples.zh: 你觉得这个方案好,还是那个方案好?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jué de zhè ge fāng àn hǎo, hái shì nà ge fāng àn hǎo?
examples.en: Do you think this plan is better, or that one?

examples.zh: 你随时可以来找我,今天或者明天都没问题。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ suí shí kě yǐ lái zhǎo wǒ, jīn tiān huò zhě míng tiān dōu méi wèn tí。
examples.en: You can come to me anytime; today or tomorrow is fine.

examples.zh: 你是想现在就走,还是再多待一会儿?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì xiǎng xiàn zài jiù zǒu, hái shì zài duō dài yī huì er?
examples.en: Do you want to leave now, or stay a while longer?

examples.zh: 累的时候听听音乐或者出去散散步都能放松。
examples.pinyin: Lèi de shí hòu tīng tīng yīn yuè huò zhě chū qù sàn sàn bù dōu néng fàng sōng。
examples.en: When tired, listening to music or taking a walk both help you relax.

examples.zh: 这道题的答案是第一个还是第二个,你确定了吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí de dá àn shì dì yí gè hái shì dì èr gè, nǐ què dìng le ma?
examples.en: Is the answer to this problem the first or the second? Are you sure?

examples.zh: 周末你要么在家休息,或者跟我们一起出去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò nǐ yào me zài jiā xiū xī, huò zhě gēn wǒ men yì qǐ chū qù wán。
examples.en: This weekend you can either rest at home or come out with us.

examples.zh: 你打算学英语还是学法语?两种语言都很有用。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ suàn xué yīng yǔ hái shì xué fǎ yǔ? liǎng zhǒng yǔ yán dōu hěn yǒu yòng。
examples.en: Do you plan to learn English or French? Both are useful.

examples.zh: 这些旧东西你可以送人或者卖掉,别一直堆着。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē jiù dōng xī nǐ kě yǐ sòng rén huò zhě mài diào, bié yì zhí duī zhe。
examples.en: You can give these old things away or sell them; don't keep piling them.

examples.zh: 咱们是先吃饭还是先看电影?时间上都来得及。
examples.pinyin: Zán men shì xiān chī fàn hái shì xiān kàn diàn yǐng? shí jiān shàng dōu lái de jí。
examples.en: Shall we eat first or watch the movie first? There's time for either.

examples.zh: 你有什么困难,可以找我或者找小李,我们都能帮你。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shén me kùn nán, kě yǐ zhǎo wǒ huò zhě zhǎo xiǎo lǐ, wǒ men dōu néng bāng nǐ。
examples.en: For any difficulty, find me or Xiao Li; we can both help.

examples.zh: 你是要热的还是要凉的?我给你倒一杯。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shì yào rè de hái shì yào liáng de? wǒ gěi nǐ dào yī bēi。
examples.en: Do you want it hot or cold? I'll pour you a cup.

examples.zh: 这几天你有空的话,今天或者明天来我家坐坐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān nǐ yǒu kòng de huà, jīn tiān huò zhě míng tiān lái wǒ jiā zuò zuò。
examples.en: If you're free these days, come over today or tomorrow.

examples.zh: 我们是走这条路还是那条路?哪条更近一些?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men shì zǒu zhè tiáo lù hái shì nà tiáo lù? nǎ tiáo gèng jìn yī xiē?
examples.en: Shall we take this road or that one? Which is closer?

examples.zh: 你可以用现金或者手机支付,两种方式都可以。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yǐ yòng xiàn jīn huò zhě shǒu jī zhī fù, liǎng zhǒng fāng shì dōu kě yǐ。
examples.en: You can pay by cash or phone; both ways work.

examples.zh: 你决定好了没有,是留下来还是跟我们一起走?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jué dìng hǎo le méi yǒu, shì liú xià lái hái shì gēn wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu?
examples.en: Have you decided — stay here or come with us?

title: "人家" ile "别人" farkı
summary: "别人" tarafsız "başkaları, diğerleri" demektir; "人家" ise çoğu zaman belirli bir kişiyi/grubu ya da (samimi/sitemli) "ben"i gösterir.
explanation: "别人" ve "人家" ikisi de "başkaları" anlamına gelebilir ama kullanımları farklıdır. "别人": TARAFSIZ, genel "başka insanlar, diğerleri, el âlem": 别人的事你少管 (Başkalarının işine az karış), 这是别人的东西 (Bu, başkasının eşyası). "人家": üç kullanımı var — (1) BELİRLİ bir kişi/grup, bağlamdan bilinen "o(nlar), o kişi": 人家已经等你半天了 (O, seni yarım saattir bekliyor); (2) "başkaları" (别人 gibi ama daha samimi/duygusal): 你看人家多努力 (Bak başkaları ne kadar çalışkan); (3) KENDİNİ üçüncü şahıs gibi anmak — çoğu zaman nazlanma/sitem tonuyla "ben (canım)": 人家还等着你呢 (Ben seni bekliyorum ya!). "人家" duygusal renk, yakınlık ya da sitem taşır; "别人" nötrdür. Türkçedeki tarafsız "başkaları" (别人) ile bağlama göre "o kişi / el âlem / ben (nazlı)" (人家) ayrımına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 别人的意见你可以听听,但最后还得自己拿主意。
examples.pinyin: Bié rén de yì jiàn nǐ kě yǐ tīng tīng, dàn zuì hòu hái de zì jǐ ná zhǔ yì。
examples.en: You can hear others' opinions, but in the end you must decide yourself.

examples.zh: 你看人家小王,工作又努力,对人又客气。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn rén jiā xiǎo wáng, gōng zuò yòu nǔ lì, duì rén yòu kè qì。
examples.en: Look at Xiao Wang: hardworking and polite to everyone.

examples.zh: 这是别人的东西,没经过同意不能随便动。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì bié rén de dōng xī, méi jīng guò tóng yì bù néng suí biàn dòng。
examples.en: This is someone else's; don't touch it without permission.

examples.zh: 人家好心帮你,你怎么连一句谢谢都不说?
examples.pinyin: Rén jiā hǎo xīn bāng nǐ, nǐ zěn me lián yī jù xiè xiè dōu bù shuō?
examples.en: They kindly helped you; how can you not even say thanks?

examples.zh: 做事要有自己的想法,不能总是跟着别人跑。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shì yào yǒu zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ, bù néng zǒng shì gēn zhe bié rén pǎo。
examples.en: Have your own ideas; don't always follow others.

examples.zh: 你快点儿吧,人家都等你半天了,别让人家着急。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kuài diǎn ér ba, rén jiā dōu děng nǐ bàn tiān le, bié ràng rén jiā zháo jí。
examples.en: Hurry up; they've been waiting for you ages, don't keep them anxious.

examples.zh: 别人能做到的事,只要努力,你也一定能做到。
examples.pinyin: Bié rén néng zuò dào de shì, zhǐ yào nǔ lì, nǐ yě yí dìng néng zuò dào。
examples.en: What others can do, with effort you can do too.

examples.zh: 你别老拿自己跟别人比,每个人都有自己的节奏。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié lǎo ná zì jǐ gēn bié rén bǐ, měi gè rén dōu yǒu zì jǐ de jié zòu。
examples.en: Stop comparing yourself to others; everyone has their own pace.

examples.zh: 人家辛辛苦苦做了一桌菜,你多少也得尝几口。
examples.pinyin: Rén jiā xīn xīn kǔ kǔ zuò le yī zhuō cài, nǐ duō shǎo yě de cháng jǐ kǒu。
examples.en: They painstakingly cooked a whole table; do try at least a few bites.

examples.zh: 背后议论别人可不是什么好习惯,你以后别这样了。
examples.pinyin: Bèi hòu yì lùn bié rén kě bú shì shén me hǎo xí guàn, nǐ yǐ hòu bié zhè yàng le。
examples.en: Gossiping about others isn't a good habit; don't do it anymore.

examples.zh: 你看人家孩子多懂事,再看看你,真让人操心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn rén jiā hái zi duō dǒng shì, zài kàn kàn nǐ, zhēn ràng rén cāo xīn。
examples.en: Look how sensible their child is; then look at you — so worrying.

examples.zh: 别人怎么看我并不重要,重要的是我自己问心无愧。
examples.pinyin: Bié rén zěn me kàn wǒ bìng bú zhòng yào, zhòng yào de shì wǒ zì jǐ wèn xīn wú kuì。
examples.en: How others see me doesn't matter; what matters is my clear conscience.

examples.zh: 人家一片好意请你吃饭,你怎么好意思拒绝呢?
examples.pinyin: Rén jiā yī piàn hǎo yì qǐng nǐ chī fàn, nǐ zěn me hǎo yì si jù jué ne?
examples.en: They kindly invited you to dinner; how can you refuse?

examples.zh: 你自己的事情自己做,别总是麻烦别人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zì jǐ de shì qíng zì jǐ zuò, bié zǒng shì má fán bié rén。
examples.en: Do your own things; don't always trouble others.

examples.zh: 人家远道而来看你,你却连门都不开,太不像话了。
examples.pinyin: Rén jiā yuǎn dào ér lái kàn nǐ, nǐ què lián mén dōu bù kāi, tài bù xiàng huà le。
examples.en: They came all this way to see you, yet you won't even open the door.

examples.zh: 每个人的情况不一样,别人的经验不一定适合你。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de qíng kuàng bù yí yàng, bié rén de jīng yàn bù yí dìng shì hé nǐ。
examples.en: Everyone's situation differs; others' experience may not suit you.

examples.zh: 你别欺负人家小,人家可比你懂事多了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié qī fù rén jiā xiǎo, rén jiā kě bǐ nǐ dǒng shì duō le。
examples.en: Don't bully them for being small; they're far more sensible than you.

examples.zh: 这种私人的问题,别问别人,不太礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng sī rén de wèn tí, bié wèn bié rén, bù tài lǐ mào。
examples.en: Don't ask others such personal questions; it's not polite.

examples.zh: 人家忙了一整天,回到家你就别再使唤人家了。
examples.pinyin: Rén jiā máng le yī zhěng tiān, huí dào jiā nǐ jiù bié zài shǐ huàn rén jiā le。
examples.en: They were busy all day; don't order them around at home.

examples.zh: 别人给你提意见,是为你好,你别不高兴。
examples.pinyin: Bié rén gěi nǐ tí yì jiàn, shì wèi nǐ hǎo, nǐ bié bù gāo xìng。
examples.en: When others give you advice, it's for your good; don't be upset.

examples.zh: 你看人家两口子,几十年了还这么恩爱。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn rén jiā liǎng kǒu zi, jǐ shí nián le hái zhè me ēn ài。
examples.en: Look at that couple: still so loving after decades.

examples.zh: 这么晚了打扰别人休息可不好,咱们改天再去吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le dǎ rǎo bié rén xiū xī kě bù hǎo, zán men gǎi tiān zài qù ba。
examples.en: Disturbing others' rest this late isn't nice; let's go another day.

examples.zh: 人家好不容易帮你解决了难题,你可得记着这份情。
examples.pinyin: Rén jiā hǎo bù róng yì bāng nǐ jiě jué le nán tí, nǐ kě de jì zhe zhè fèn qíng。
examples.en: They went to great lengths to solve your problem; remember their kindness.

examples.zh: 别人的生活方式,我们应该尊重,不该指手画脚。
examples.pinyin: Bié rén de shēng huó fāng shì, wǒ men yīng gāi zūn zhòng, bù gāi zhǐ shǒu huà jiǎo。
examples.en: We should respect others' lifestyles, not criticize them.

examples.zh: 你怎么把人家的秘密说出去了?这样很伤感情的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zěn me bǎ rén jiā de mì mì shuō chū qù le? zhè yàng hěn shāng gǎn qíng de。
examples.en: How could you reveal their secret? That really hurts the friendship.

title: "之间" ile "中间" farkı
pattern: A 和 B 之间 / A 和 B 中间 / ...的中间
summary: "之间" iki (ya da çok) taraf ARASINDAKİ ilişkiyi/aralığı soyut anlatır (朋友之间); "中间" ise somut ORTA/orta nokta ya da iki şeyin tam arasını gösterir.
explanation: "之间" ve "中间" ikisi de "arasında" anlamı taşır ama farklıdır. "之间": İKİ ya da daha çok taraf ARASINDAKİ ilişkiyi, aralığı ya da mesafeyi — çoğu zaman SOYUT — belirtir; "A 和 B 之间" kalıbında gelir: 朋友之间要互相信任 (Dostlar birbirine güvenmeli), 两座城市之间的距离 (İki şehir arasındaki mesafe), 三点到五点之间 (Saat üçle beş arası). Genelde "之间" tek başına bir konum (içi) göstermez; bir aralığı/ilişkiyi anlatır ve biraz resmîdir. "中间": SOMUT olarak bir şeyin ORTASINI, merkezini ya da iki nesnenin tam arasındaki YERİ gösterir: 坐在中间 (ortada otur), 桌子的中间 (masanın ortası), 他站在两个人中间 (İki kişinin ortasında durdu). "中间" ayrıca bir sürecin "ortasında/esnasında" anlamına da gelebilir. Kısaca: "之间" soyut ilişki/aralık (A ile B arasında), "中间" somut orta nokta/merkez. Türkçedeki "arasında (ilişki/aralık)" (之间) ile "ortasında, ortada, tam arasında" (中间) ayrımına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 朋友之间应该互相信任、互相帮助。
examples.pinyin: Péng yǒu zhī jiān yīng gāi hù xiāng xìn rèn、 hù xiāng bāng zhù。
examples.en: Between friends there should be mutual trust and help.

examples.zh: 请你坐在他们两个人中间,好帮忙翻译。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zuò zài tā men liǎng gè rén zhōng jiān, hǎo bāng máng fān yì。
examples.en: Please sit between the two of them to help translate.

examples.zh: 这两座城市之间有一条又宽又长的高速公路。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zuò chéng shì zhī jiān yǒu yī tiáo yòu kuān yòu zhǎng de gāo sù gōng lù。
examples.en: Between these two cities runs a wide, long highway.

examples.zh: 花园的中间有一个圆圆的小水池,特别漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Huā yuán de zhōng jiān yǒu yí gè yuán yuán de xiǎo shuǐ chí, tè bié piào liàng。
examples.en: In the middle of the garden is a round little pond, very pretty.

examples.zh: 父母和孩子之间的沟通非常重要。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ hé hái zi zhī jiān de gōu tōng fēi cháng zhòng yào。
examples.en: Communication between parents and children is very important.

examples.zh: 他把桌子搬到了房间的中间,方便大家围坐。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhuō zi bān dào le fáng jiān de zhōng jiān, fāng biàn dà jiā wéi zuò。
examples.en: He moved the table to the middle of the room for everyone to sit around.

examples.zh: 我一般在下午三点到五点之间有空,你可以那时候来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì bān zài xià wǔ sān diǎn dào wǔ diǎn zhī jiān yǒu kòng, nǐ kě yǐ nà shí hòu lái。
examples.en: I'm usually free between three and five in the afternoon; come then.

examples.zh: 这张全家福里,爷爷奶奶坐在最中间。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng quán jiā fú lǐ, yé yé nǎi nǎi zuò zài zuì zhōng jiān。
examples.en: In this family photo, grandpa and grandma sit right in the middle.

examples.zh: 同事之间难免会有一些小小的摩擦。
examples.pinyin: Tóng shì zhī jiān nán miǎn huì yǒu yī xiē xiǎo xiǎo de mó cā。
examples.en: Between colleagues, minor friction is inevitable.

examples.zh: 这条路的中间画着一条长长的白线。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù de zhōng jiān huà zhe yī tiáo cháng cháng de bái xiàn。
examples.en: Down the middle of this road runs a long white line.

examples.zh: 师生之间建立起了深厚的感情。
examples.pinyin: Shī shēng zhī jiān jiàn lì qǐ le shēn hòu de gǎn qíng。
examples.en: A deep bond formed between the teacher and the students.

examples.zh: 那棵大树正好长在两家院子的中间。
examples.pinyin: Nà kē dà shù zhèng hǎo zhǎng zài liǎng jiā yuàn zi de zhōng jiān。
examples.en: That big tree grows right in the middle between the two yards.

examples.zh: 这两件事之间其实有着很密切的联系。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì zhī jiān qí shí yǒu zhe hěn mì qiè de lián xì。
examples.en: Between these two matters there's actually a close connection.

examples.zh: 请把这盆花放在窗台的中间,那儿采光最好。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè pén huā fàng zài chuāng tái de zhōng jiān, nà ér cǎi guāng zuì hǎo。
examples.en: Please put this flower in the middle of the windowsill, where the light's best.

examples.zh: 国家之间应该加强交流,和平相处。
examples.pinyin: Guó jiā zhī jiān yīng gāi jiā qiáng jiāo liú, hé píng xiāng chǔ。
examples.en: Between nations there should be more exchange and peaceful coexistence.

examples.zh: 会开到一半,中间他出去接了个电话。
examples.pinyin: Huì kāi dào yí bàn, zhōng jiān tā chū qù jiē le gè diàn huà。
examples.en: Halfway through the meeting, he stepped out to take a call.

examples.zh: 兄弟姐妹之间要多一些包容和理解。
examples.pinyin: Xiōng dì jiě mèi zhī jiān yào duō yī xiē bāo róng hé lǐ jiě。
examples.en: Between siblings there should be more tolerance and understanding.

examples.zh: 操场的中间是一片平整的草地,四周是跑道。
examples.pinyin: Cāo chǎng de zhōng jiān shì yī piàn píng zhěng de cǎo dì, sì zhōu shì pǎo dào。
examples.en: In the middle of the field is flat grass, with a track around it.

examples.zh: 这两个数字之间还差好几百呢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè shù zì zhī jiān hái chà hǎo jǐ bǎi ne。
examples.en: Between these two figures there's a difference of several hundred.

examples.zh: 他把最重要的那句话写在了信纸的中间。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zuì zhòng yào de nà jù huà xiě zài le xìn zhǐ de zhōng jiān。
examples.en: He wrote the most important sentence in the middle of the letter.

examples.zh: 邻里之间要和睦相处,互相多照应。
examples.pinyin: Lín lǐ zhī jiān yào hé mù xiāng chǔ, hù xiāng duō zhào yìng。
examples.en: Between neighbors there should be harmony and mutual care.

examples.zh: 你看,月亮正好挂在两座山峰的中间。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, yuè liàng zhèng hǎo guà zài liǎng zuò shān fēng de zhōng jiān。
examples.en: Look, the moon hangs right between the two peaks.

examples.zh: 这两种观点之间存在着很大的分歧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng guān diǎn zhī jiān cún zài zhe hěn dà de fēn qí。
examples.en: Between these two viewpoints there's a big divergence.

examples.zh: 孩子挤在爸爸妈妈中间,睡得又香又甜。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi jǐ zài bà bà mā mā zhōng jiān, shuì de yòu xiāng yòu tián。
examples.en: The child, snuggled between mom and dad, slept soundly and sweetly.

examples.zh: 理想和现实之间,往往有一段不小的距离。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎng hé xiàn shí zhī jiān, wǎng wǎng yǒu yī duàn bù xiǎo de jù lí。
examples.en: Between ideals and reality there's often quite a gap.

title: "离" ile "从" farkı
pattern: 离 (iki nokta arası mesafe) / 从 (başlangıç noktası)
summary: "离" iki nokta arasındaki MESAFEYİ/uzaklığı belirtir (A 离 B 很近); "从" ise bir hareketin/sürenin BAŞLANGIÇ noktasını verir (从这儿出发).
explanation: "离" ve "从" ikisi de yer/zamanla ilgili edatlardır ama işlevleri farklıdır. "离": iki nokta arasındaki MESAFEYİ/uzaklığı (yer ya da zaman) belirtir — "...-e uzaklıkta": 我家离学校很近 (Evim okula çok yakın), 离考试还有三天 (Sınava daha üç gün var). Hareket bildirmez, iki referans arasındaki ARALIĞI ölçer. "从": bir hareketin, eylemin ya da sürenin BAŞLANGIÇ noktasını gösterir — "...-den (itibaren)": 我从家出发 (Evden yola çıktım), 从早上到晚上 (sabahtan akşama), 从这里往前走 (buradan ileri git). Bir başlangıç noktası verir ve çoğu zaman bir bitiş (到) ile eşleşir. Kısaca: "离" iki nokta arası uzaklık (durağan ölçüm), "从" bir hareketin/sürenin çıkış noktası. "从...到..." (...-den ...-e) ve "离...远/近" (...-e uzak/yakın) tipik kalıplardır. Türkçedeki "...-e uzaklıkta / ...-e yakın" (离) ile "...-den (itibaren), ...-den başlayarak" (从) ayrımına denk gelir; öğrencilerin sık karıştırdığı bir çifttir.

examples.zh: 我家离公司很近,从家走到公司只要十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lí gōng sī hěn jìn, cóng jiā zǒu dào gōng sī zhǐ yào shí fēn zhōng。
examples.en: My home is close to the office; walking there takes just ten minutes.

examples.zh: 从这里到火车站不远,可是离机场就比较远了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè lǐ dào huǒ chē zhàn bù yuǎn, kě shì lí jī chǎng jiù bǐ jiào yuǎn le。
examples.en: From here to the station isn't far, but it's rather far to the airport.

examples.zh: 离放假还有一个星期,同学们从现在就开始盼着了。
examples.pinyin: Lí fàng jià hái yǒu yí gè xīng qī, tóng xué men cóng xiàn zài jiù kāi shǐ pàn zhe le。
examples.en: There's a week until the holiday; the students are looking forward already.

examples.zh: 超市离我家不远,我每天从家出发走着去买菜。
examples.pinyin: Chāo shì lí wǒ jiā bù yuǎn, wǒ měi tiān cóng jiā chū fā zǒu zhe qù mǎi cài。
examples.en: The supermarket is near my home; I walk there from home to shop daily.

examples.zh: 从北京到上海,两座城市之间离得挺远的。
examples.pinyin: Cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi, liǎng zuò chéng shì zhī jiān lí de tǐng yuǎn de。
examples.en: From Beijing to Shanghai — the two cities are quite far apart.

examples.zh: 这条路从村口一直修到山下,离县城越来越近了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù cóng cūn kǒu yì zhí xiū dào shān xià, lí xiàn chéng yuè lái yuè jìn le。
examples.en: This road runs from the village to the mountain's foot, ever nearer the county town.

examples.zh: 离考试没几天了,他从早到晚都在复习。
examples.pinyin: Lí kǎo shì méi jǐ tiān le, tā cóng zǎo dào wǎn dōu zài fù xí。
examples.en: With few days to the exam, he reviews from morning to night.

examples.zh: 那家医院离得太远,从这儿坐车过去要一个多小时。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yī yuàn lí de tài yuǎn, cóng zhè ér zuò chē guò qù yào yí gè duō xiǎo shí。
examples.en: That hospital is too far; by car from here it takes over an hour.

examples.zh: 从你家到我家,中间隔着一条河,离得不算近。
examples.pinyin: Cóng nǐ jiā dào wǒ jiā, zhōng jiàn gé zhe yī tiáo hé, lí de bù suàn jìn。
examples.en: From your home to mine, a river lies between; it's not close.

examples.zh: 学校离地铁站很近,从地铁站出来走两步就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xué xiào lí dì tiě zhàn hěn jìn, cóng dì tiě zhàn chū lái zǒu liǎng bù jiù dào le。
examples.en: The school is near the subway; a couple of steps from the exit and you're there.

examples.zh: 从上午九点到下午五点,银行一直开着门。
examples.pinyin: Cóng shàng wǔ jiǔ diǎn dào xià wǔ wǔ diǎn, yín háng yì zhí kāi zhe mén。
examples.en: From nine a.m. to five p.m., the bank stays open.

examples.zh: 他的老家离这儿有上千公里,从这儿坐飞机也要好几个小时。
examples.pinyin: Tā de lǎo jiā lí zhè ér yǒu shàng qiān gōng lǐ, cóng zhè ér zuò fēi jī yě yào hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: His hometown is over a thousand kilometers away; even by plane it's hours.

examples.zh: 离下班还有半个小时,他从抽屉里拿出资料继续看。
examples.pinyin: Lí xià bān hái yǒu bàn gè xiǎo shí, tā cóng chōu tì lǐ ná chū zī liào jì xù kàn。
examples.en: Half an hour until off-work, he took papers from the drawer to keep reading.

examples.zh: 从这个路口往右拐,那家书店离得就不远了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè ge lù kǒu wǎng yòu guǎi, nà jiā shū diàn lí de jiù bù yuǎn le。
examples.en: Turn right at this intersection, and the bookstore isn't far.

examples.zh: 我们的座位离舞台很近,从这里能清楚地看到演员。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men de zuò wèi lí wǔ tái hěn jìn, cóng zhè lǐ néng qīng chǔ de kàn dào yǎn yuán。
examples.en: Our seats are close to the stage; from here we can clearly see the actors.

examples.zh: 从春天到秋天,这个公园离不开辛勤园丁的照料。
examples.pinyin: Cóng chūn tiān dào qiū tiān, zhè ge gōng yuán lí bù kāi xīn qín yuán dīng de zhào liào。
examples.en: From spring to autumn, this park depends on the diligent gardeners' care.

examples.zh: 他家离海边很近,从窗户就能看见蓝蓝的大海。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā lí hǎi biān hěn jìn, cóng chuāng hù jiù néng kàn jiàn lán lán de dà hǎi。
examples.en: His home is near the sea; from the window you can see the blue ocean.

examples.zh: 离目的地还有很长的路,我们从清晨就出发了。
examples.pinyin: Lí mù dì de hái yǒu hěn zhǎng de lù, wǒ men cóng qīng chén jiù chū fā le。
examples.en: There's a long way to the destination; we set off at dawn.

examples.zh: 这两个村子离得很近,从这个村到那个村走路就行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè cūn zi lí de hěn jìn, cóng zhè ge cūn dào nà ge cūn zǒu lù jiù xíng。
examples.en: These two villages are close; you can walk from one to the other.

examples.zh: 从今天算起,离他回国就只剩下三天了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jīn tiān suàn qǐ, lí tā huí guó jiù zhǐ shèng xià sān tiān le。
examples.en: Counting from today, there are only three days until he returns home.

examples.zh: 停车场离电影院很近,从车里出来走几步就进去了。
examples.pinyin: Tíng chē chǎng lí diàn yǐng yuàn hěn jìn, cóng chē lǐ chū lái zǒu jǐ bù jiù jìn qù le。
examples.en: The lot is near the cinema; a few steps from the car and you're inside.

examples.zh: 从山脚到山顶路途遥远,山顶离云好像很近。
examples.pinyin: Cóng shān jiǎo dào shān dǐng lù tú yáo yuǎn, shān dǐng lí yún hǎo xiàng hěn jìn。
examples.en: From the foot to the summit is a long way; the peak seems close to the clouds.

examples.zh: 我们从早上一直逛到中午,离约定的时间还早。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men cóng zǎo shàng yì zhí guàng dào zhōng wǔ, lí yuē dìng de shí jiān hái zǎo。
examples.en: We strolled from morning to noon; it's still early for the appointed time.

examples.zh: 他的座位离门口最近,所以每次从教室出去他都是第一个。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zuò wèi lí mén kǒu zuì jìn, suǒ yǐ měi cì cóng jiào shì chū qù tā dōu shì dì yí gè。
examples.en: His seat is nearest the door, so he's always first out of the classroom.

examples.zh: 从这儿到那座桥并不远,可是那座桥离对岸还挺远的。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè ér dào nà zuò qiáo bìng bù yuǎn, kě shì nà zuò qiáo lí duì àn hái tǐng yuǎn de。
examples.en: From here to that bridge isn't far, but the bridge is far from the opposite bank.

title: "以后" ile "的时候" farkı
summary: "以后" bir olaydan SONRAKİ zamanı gösterir (下课以后 = dersten sonra); "的时候" ise bir olayın SIRASINDA/-ken olan zamanı gösterir (下课的时候 = ders biterken).
explanation: "以后" ve "的时候" ikisi de zaman belirtir ama farklı anları gösterir. "...以后": bir olayın/zamanın ARDINDAN gelen zamanı belirtir — "...-den sonra, ...-dıktan sonra": 下课以后我们去吃饭 (Dersten sonra yemeğe gideriz), 他走以后,我才发现钱包丢了 (O gittikten sonra cüzdanımı kaybettiğimi fark ettim). Olay TAMAMLANDIKTAN sonraki zamanı gösterir. "...的时候": bir olayın/durumun OLDUĞU/sürdüğü sırayı belirtir — "...-dığı zaman, ...-ırken, ...-ınca": 下课的时候,大家都很开心 (Ders biterken/bittiğinde herkes sevinir), 我小的时候住在乡下 (Küçükken kırsalda otururdum). Eylemin SIRASINDAKİ ya da gerçekleştiği andaki durumu gösterir. Kısaca: "以后" = ondan SONRA (art zamanlı), "的时候" = o SIRADA / o AN (eş zamanlı). Aynı fiil ikisiyle farklı anlam verir: 走以后 (gittikten sonra) vs 走的时候 (giderken). Türkçedeki "...-den sonra" (以后) ile "...-dığı zaman, ...-ırken" (的时候) ayrımına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 下课以后我们一起去食堂吃饭,下课的时候别忘了叫我。
examples.pinyin: Xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men yì qǐ qù shí táng chī fàn, xià kè de shí hòu bié wàng le jiào wǒ。
examples.en: After class let's eat at the canteen together; call me when class ends.

examples.zh: 毕业以后他去了外地工作,上学的时候他成绩一直很好。
examples.pinyin: Bì yè yǐ hòu tā qù le wài dì gōng zuò, shàng xué de shí hòu tā chéng jì yì zhí hěn hǎo。
examples.en: After graduating he worked away; during school his grades were always good.

examples.zh: 我到家以后给你打电话,坐车的时候信号不太好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào jiā yǐ hòu gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà, zuò chē de shí hòu xìn hào bù tài hǎo。
examples.en: I'll call you after I get home; the signal's poor while riding.

examples.zh: 吃完饭以后咱们去散步,吃饭的时候别看手机。
examples.pinyin: Chī wán fàn yǐ hòu zán men qù sàn bù, chī fàn de shí hòu bié kàn shǒu jī。
examples.en: After eating let's take a walk; don't look at your phone while eating.

examples.zh: 下班以后他喜欢去健身房,工作的时候他非常专注。
examples.pinyin: Xià bān yǐ hòu tā xǐ huān qù jiàn shēn fáng, gōng zuò de shí hòu tā fēi cháng zhuān zhù。
examples.en: After work he likes the gym; at work he's very focused.

examples.zh: 放假以后我打算回老家,上课的时候可没时间。
examples.pinyin: Fàng jià yǐ hòu wǒ dǎ suàn huí lǎo jiā, shàng kè de shí hòu kě méi shí jiān。
examples.en: After the holiday starts I'll go home; there's no time during classes.

examples.zh: 他走了以后,我才想起来还有话没跟他说,他走的时候太匆忙了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒu le yǐ hòu, wǒ cái xiǎng qǐ lái hái yǒu huà méi gēn tā shuō, tā zǒu de shí hòu tài cōng máng le。
examples.en: Only after he left did I recall unsaid words; he left in such a hurry.

examples.zh: 结婚以后他们搬到了城里,谈恋爱的时候常常一起看电影。
examples.pinyin: Jié hūn yǐ hòu tā men bān dào le chéng lǐ, tán liàn ài de shí hòu cháng cháng yì qǐ kàn diàn yǐng。
examples.en: After marrying they moved to the city; while dating they often watched movies.

examples.zh: 看完这部电影以后我久久不能平静,看的时候好几次都哭了。
examples.pinyin: Kàn wán zhè bù diàn yǐng yǐ hòu wǒ jiǔ jiǔ bù néng píng jìng, kàn de shí hòu hǎo jǐ cì dōu kū le。
examples.en: After the movie I couldn't calm down; while watching I cried several times.

examples.zh: 退休以后爷爷开始学画画,年轻的时候他根本没这个机会。
examples.pinyin: Tuì xiū yǐ hòu yé yé kāi shǐ xué huà huà, nián qīng de shí hòu tā gēn běn méi zhè ge jī huì。
examples.en: After retiring grandpa took up painting; when young he had no chance.

examples.zh: 下雨以后空气特别清新,下雨的时候我喜欢待在家里听雨声。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ yǐ hòu kōng qì tè bié qīng xīn, xià yǔ de shí hòu wǒ xǐ huān dài zài jiā lǐ tīng yǔ shēng。
examples.en: After rain the air is fresh; when it rains I like to stay in and listen.

examples.zh: 认识他以后我的生活变了很多,刚认识的时候我们还有点儿陌生。
examples.pinyin: Rèn shí tā yǐ hòu wǒ de shēng huó biàn le hěn duō, gāng rèn shí de shí hòu wǒ men hái yǒu diǎn ér mò shēng。
examples.en: After meeting him my life changed a lot; when we first met we were still strangers.

examples.zh: 考试以后他轻松了很多,考试的时候他紧张得手心都是汗。
examples.pinyin: Kǎo shì yǐ hòu tā qīng sōng le hěn duō, kǎo shì de shí hòu tā jǐn zhāng dé shǒu xīn dōu shì hàn。
examples.en: After the exam he relaxed a lot; during it his palms sweated with nerves.

examples.zh: 搬家以后离公司近多了,搬家的时候朋友们都来帮忙了。
examples.pinyin: Bān jiā yǐ hòu lí gōng sī jìn duō le, bān jiā de shí hòu péng yǒu men dōu lái bāng máng le。
examples.en: After moving it's much closer to work; friends helped when we moved.

examples.zh: 天黑以后街上的灯都亮了,天快黑的时候我们才往回走。
examples.pinyin: Tiān hēi yǐ hòu jiē shàng de dēng dōu liàng le, tiān kuài hēi de shí hòu wǒ men cái wǎng huí zǒu。
examples.en: After dark the streetlights came on; we headed back as it grew dark.

examples.zh: 孩子长大以后就懂事多了,他小的时候可调皮了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhǎng dà yǐ hòu jiù dǒng shì duō le, tā xiǎo de shí hòu kě tiáo pí le。
examples.en: After growing up the child became much more sensible; he was naughty when little.

examples.zh: 下过雪以后,整个世界都变白了,下雪的时候孩子们最高兴。
examples.pinyin: Xià guò xuě yǐ hòu, zhěng gè shì jiè dōu biàn bái le, xià xuě de shí hòu hái zi men zuì gāo xìng。
examples.en: After it snows the whole world turns white; children are happiest when it snows.

examples.zh: 他出国以后,我们只能通过网络联系,他在国内的时候我们常常见面。
examples.pinyin: Tā chū guó yǐ hòu, wǒ men zhǐ néng tōng guò wǎng luò lián xì, tā zài guó nèi de shí hòu wǒ men cháng cháng jiàn miàn。
examples.en: After he went abroad we could only chat online; at home we often met.

examples.zh: 我复习完以后就早早睡了,复习的时候我一直开着台灯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fù xí wán yǐ hòu jiù zǎo zǎo shuì le, fù xí de shí hòu wǒ yì zhí kāi zhe tái dēng。
examples.en: After reviewing I slept early; while reviewing I kept the lamp on.

examples.zh: 春节以后大家又开始忙碌起来,过春节的时候到处都张灯结彩。
examples.pinyin: Chūn jié yǐ hòu dà jiā yòu kāi shǐ máng lù qǐ lái, guò chūn jié de shí hòu dào chù dōu zhāng dēng jié cǎi。
examples.en: After the festival everyone got busy again; during it everywhere was decorated.

examples.zh: 生病以后他更注意身体了,生病的时候是家人一直在照顾他。
examples.pinyin: Shēng bìng yǐ hòu tā gèng zhù yì shēn tǐ le, shēng bìng de shí hòu shì jiā rén yì zhí zài zhào gù tā。
examples.en: After illness he minds his health more; family cared for him while he was sick.

examples.zh: 下班以后路上特别堵,快下班的时候大家就开始收拾东西了。
examples.pinyin: Xià bān yǐ hòu lù shàng tè bié dǔ, kuài xià bān de shí hòu dà jiā jiù kāi shǐ shōu shí dōng xī le。
examples.en: After work the roads jam; near quitting time everyone starts packing up.

examples.zh: 学会游泳以后我就爱上了大海,学游泳的时候可没少喝水。
examples.pinyin: Xué huì yóu yǒng yǐ hòu wǒ jiù ài shàng le dà hǎi, xué yóu yǒng de shí hòu kě méi shǎo hē shuǐ。
examples.en: After learning to swim I fell for the sea; while learning I swallowed a lot of water.

examples.zh: 他答应以后就一直记在心里,答应的时候他是认真的。
examples.pinyin: Tā dā yìng yǐ hòu jiù yì zhí jì zài xīn lǐ, dā yìng de shí hòu tā shì rèn zhēn de。
examples.en: After promising he kept it in mind; when he promised he was sincere.

examples.zh: 天亮以后我们继续赶路,天没亮的时候山里特别冷。
examples.pinyin: Tiān liàng yǐ hòu wǒ men jì xù gǎn lù, tiān méi liàng de shí hòu shān lǐ tè bié lěng。
examples.en: After daybreak we continued; before dawn the mountains were very cold.

title: "得不得了" ile aşırı derece
summary: "...得不得了" (de bùdéliǎo) bir niteliğin AŞIRI, dayanılmaz derecede olduğunu bildirir: 热得不得了 = dayanılmaz sıcak; 高兴得不得了 = deli gibi sevinçli.
explanation: "得不得了" bir sıfatın ya da duygu fiilinin ardına gelip o niteliğin AŞIRI, olağanüstü, neredeyse dayanılmaz bir derecede olduğunu bildirir: "son derece, aşırı, ...-den deli gibi, ...-den öleyazmak". 今天热得不得了 (Bugün dayanılmaz sıcak), 孩子高兴得不得了 (Çocuk deli gibi sevindi), 我饿得不得了 (Açlıktan ölüyorum). Bir DERECE TÜMLECİdir: fiil/sıfat + 得 + 不得了. "极了"dan daha da güçlü, çoğu zaman abartılı ve konuşma diline özgü bir vurgu taşır. "不得了" kelimesi kelimesine "iş çığırından çıkmış, başa çıkılamaz" demektir; buradaki kullanımı bir niteliği uç noktaya taşır. Genelde olumsuz ya da güçlü duygu durumlarında (热, 冷, 累, 疼, 急, 高兴) kullanılır. Türkçedeki "son derece, aşırı, ...-den ölmek/bitmek, deli gibi" abartılarına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 今天太阳特别毒,晒得人热得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān tài yáng tè bié dú, shài de rén rè de bù de le。
examples.en: The sun is scorching today; it's unbearably hot.

examples.zh: 听说自己考上了第一志愿,她高兴得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Tīng shuō zì jǐ kǎo shàng le dì yī zhì yuàn, tā gāo xìng de bù de le。
examples.en: Hearing she got into her first-choice school, she was overjoyed.

examples.zh: 忙了一整天,他累得不得了,一坐下就睡着了。
examples.pinyin: Máng le yī zhěng tiān, tā lèi de bù de le, yī zuò xià jiù shuì zháo le。
examples.en: Busy all day, he was so exhausted he fell asleep as soon as he sat.

examples.zh: 孩子发着高烧,妈妈急得不得了,连夜送他去了医院。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi fā zhe gāo shāo, mā mā jí de bù de le, lián yè sòng tā qù le yī yuàn。
examples.en: The child had a high fever; mom was frantic and rushed him to the hospital at night.

examples.zh: 这道菜辣得不得了,我吃了一口就受不了了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài là de bù de le, wǒ chī le yī kǒu jiù shòu bù liǎo le。
examples.en: This dish is unbearably spicy; one bite and I couldn't take it.

examples.zh: 好久没见的老朋友突然来访,他激动得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn de lǎo péng yǒu tū rán lái fǎng, tā jī dòng de bù de le。
examples.en: An old friend suddenly visited, and he was beside himself with joy.

examples.zh: 那几天冷得不得了,河面上都结了厚厚的冰。
examples.pinyin: Nà jǐ tiān lěng de bù de le, hé miàn shàng dōu jié le hòu hòu de bīng。
examples.en: Those days were bitterly cold; thick ice formed on the river.

examples.zh: 丢了心爱的东西,小女孩伤心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Diū le xīn ài de dōng xī, xiǎo nǚ hái shāng xīn de bù de le。
examples.en: Losing her beloved thing, the little girl was terribly sad.

examples.zh: 这个消息一传出去,全村的人都高兴得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāo xī yī chuán chū qù, quán cūn de rén dōu gāo xìng de bù de le。
examples.en: Once the news spread, the whole village was overjoyed.

examples.zh: 他牙疼得不得了,一晚上都没睡好觉。
examples.pinyin: Tā yá téng de bù de le, yī wǎn shàng dōu méi shuì hǎo jué。
examples.en: His toothache was unbearable; he didn't sleep well all night.

examples.zh: 演出太精彩了,观众们激动得不得了,掌声不断。
examples.pinyin: Yǎn chū tài jīng cǎi le, guān zhòng men jī dòng de bù de le, zhǎng shēng bù duàn。
examples.en: The show was superb; the audience was thrilled, applauding endlessly.

examples.zh: 等了这么久他还不来,大家都急得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Děng le zhè me jiǔ tā hái bù lái, dà jiā dōu jí de bù de le。
examples.en: He still hadn't come after so long; everyone was terribly anxious.

examples.zh: 这些天忙得不得了,我连吃饭的时间都没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē tiān máng de bù de le, wǒ lián chī fàn de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: These days I've been terribly busy, with no time even to eat.

examples.zh: 看到孩子平安回来,一家人都高兴得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào hái zi píng ān huí lái, yī jiā rén dōu gāo xìng de bù de le。
examples.en: Seeing the child return safe, the whole family was overjoyed.

examples.zh: 那天的风大得不得了,把院子里的花盆都吹倒了。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiān de fēng dà de bù de le, bǎ yuàn zi lǐ de huā pén dōu chuī dào le。
examples.en: The wind that day was terribly strong, knocking over the flowerpots.

examples.zh: 他饿得不得了,一口气吃了三大碗饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā è de bù de le, yì kǒu qì chī le sān dà wǎn fàn。
examples.en: He was so starving he ate three big bowls of rice in one go.

examples.zh: 听到那个坏消息,她担心得不得了,饭都吃不下。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào nà ge huài xiāo xī, tā dān xīn de bù de le, fàn dōu chī bù xià。
examples.en: Hearing the bad news, she was so worried she couldn't eat.

examples.zh: 这个地方吵得不得了,根本没法安静地看书。

title: "得很" ile "epeyce, oldukça"
summary: "...得很" (de hěn) bir niteliği güçlendirir: 好得很 = çok iyi; 忙得很 = epeyce meşgul. "很..."ın ardıl (postposed) biçimidir.
explanation: "得很" bir sıfatın ya da duygu fiilinin ARDINA gelip o niteliği güçlendirir: "çok, epeyce, oldukça, bir hayli". 这里安静得很 (Burası çok sessiz), 他最近忙得很 (Son zamanlarda epey meşgul), 这道菜好吃得很 (Bu yemek çok lezzetli). "很 + sıfat" (öntakılı) ile aynı "çok" anlamını verir ama "得很" sıfattan SONRA gelir ve konuşma dilinde daha vurgulu, canlı bir tondur. Bir DERECE TÜMLECİdir: sıfat + 得 + 很. "极了" ve "得不得了" kadar abartılı değildir; "很"in biraz daha vurgulu, sonradan gelen bir çeşididir. Genelde olumlu ya da nötr niteliklerle de kullanılır (好得很, 舒服得很, 清楚得很). Türkçedeki "çok, epeyce, oldukça, bir hayli" derecelendirmelerine denk gelir; "很"e göre daha konuşma diline ait, vurgulu bir alternatiftir.

title: "...了(一)点儿" ile "biraz fazla"
summary: "Sıfat + 了 + 一点儿" bir niteliğin (istenmeyen biçimde) BİRAZ FAZLA olduğunu bildirir: 这件衣服大了点儿 = Bu giysi biraz büyük geldi (fazla büyük).
explanation: "Sıfat + 了 + (一)点儿" bir niteliğin bir ölçütü aşarak BİRAZ FAZLA/gereğinden çok olduğunu, çoğu zaman ŞİKÂYET tonuyla bildirir: "biraz fazla ..., ...-cesi biraz kaçmış". 这双鞋大了点儿 (Bu ayakkabı biraz büyük geldi), 菜咸了一点儿 (Yemek biraz tuzlu olmuş), 你来得早了点儿 (Biraz erken geldin). "了" bir standarttan sapmayı (değişimi/aşımı), "(一)点儿" ise bu sapmanın küçük olduğunu belirtir; birlikte "olması gerekenden biraz fazla" derler. Bu, "有点儿 + sıfat" (öntakılı, biraz ...) ile yakındır ama "...了点儿" özellikle bir BEKLENTİYİ/ölçütü aşan fazlalığı vurgular (bir referansa göre fazla). Genelde istenmeyen bir durumu belirtir. Türkçedeki "biraz fazla ..., ...-cesi biraz kaçmış, gereğinden biraz ..." ifadelerine denk gelir.

title: "有的是" ile "bol bol, sürüsüne bereket"
summary: "有的是" (yǒudeshì) bir şeyin BOL BOL, istenildiği kadar olduğunu vurgular: 时间有的是 = Vakit bol; 机会有的是 = Fırsat çok.
explanation: "有的是" bir şeyin ÇOK BOL, istenildiği kadar, tükenmez ölçüde bulunduğunu vurgular: "bol bol, sürüsüne bereket, ne kadar istersen o kadar, dünya kadar". 别急,时间有的是 (Acele etme, vakit bol), 这种小事,办法有的是 (Böyle küçük şeyin çaresi çoktur), 有的是人愿意帮你 (Sana yardım etmek isteyen sürüyle insan var). Kalıp: (konu) + 有的是 + isim, ya da 有的是 + isim (yüklem başında). "很多"dan daha vurgulu, güven veren ya da rahatlatan bir tondur; çoğu zaman "merak etme, bu konuda sıkıntı yok" hissi taşır. "有" (var) + "的是" pekiştiriciyle kurulur. Türkçedeki "bol bol, sürüsüne bereket, dünya kadar, ne kadar istersen, eksik olmaz" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir şeyin bolluğunu vurgulamanın canlı bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 这点困难算什么,克服困难的办法有的是。

examples.zh: 咱们村靠海,新鲜的海鲜有的是,便宜得很。

examples.zh: 你别灰心,只要人还在,重新开始的机会有的是。

examples.zh: 这条街上卖小吃的店有的是,咱们随便挑一家。

examples.zh: 想跟他合作的公司有的是,他根本不愁没生意。

examples.en: Don't think it's boring; this city has plenty of fun places.

title: "都"nun ileri kullanımları
summary: "都" temelde "hepsi" der ama ayrıca "...bile" (强调), "çoktan/artık" (都...了) ve genelleme pekiştirmesi gibi ileri işlevler taşır.
explanation: "都" temel anlamı "hepsi, tümü"dür (大家都来了 = Herkes geldi), ama HSK4 düzeyinde birkaç ileri kullanımı vardır: (1) "...bile" (连...都... vurgusu, çoğu zaman "连" düşerek): 这个道理三岁孩子都懂 (Bunu üç yaşındaki çocuk bile bilir), 他忙得连饭都没吃 (Yemek yemeyecek kadar meşguldü). (2) "都...了" ile "çoktan, artık, ...-mış bile" (şaşkınlık/sitem): 都十二点了,你怎么还不睡? (Saat on iki olmuş, hâlâ neden yatmadın?). (3) Soru sözcüğü + 都 ile genelleme: 谁都知道 (herkes bilir), 什么都不怕 (hiçbir şeyden korkmaz). (4) Kapsamı öznenin ÖNÜNDEKİ öğeye bağlar — "都" her zaman kapsadığı çoğul/genel öğeden SONRA, yüklemden önce gelir. Bu ileri kullanımlar "都"yu sıradan "hepsi"nin ötesine taşır: vurgu, zaman ve genelleme. Türkçedeki "...bile, çoktan/artık, hepsi, her ..." karşılıklarına bağlama göre denk gelir.
