title: "还"nın ileri kullanımları
summary: "还" temelde "hâlâ/ayrıca" der; ileri düzeyde "neyse ki (还好)", beklenmedik onaylama (还真...), abartılı sitem (还...呢) ve "üstelik" işlevleri taşır.
explanation: "还"nın temel anlamları "hâlâ" (还在睡) ve "ayrıca/bir de" (还要买) dışında, ileri düzeyde birkaç ince kullanımı vardır: (1) İDARE EDER/neyse ki — "还好/还行/还可以" (fena değil), 这次考得还不错 (bu sefer fena olmadı). (2) BEKLENMEDİK ONAYLAMA — "还真..." (gerçekten de, meğer): 别说,他做的菜还真好吃 (İnan, yaptığı yemek gerçekten de lezzetli). (3) SİTEM/alay — "还...呢" (bir de ... diyorsun / ... da olacaksın): 你还老师呢,这都不知道? (Bir de öğretmensin, bunu bilmiyor musun?). (4) BEKLENTİ ÜSTÜ — "还" bir şeyin beklenenden fazla/iyi olduğunu vurgular: 他比我还高 (benden bile uzun). Bu kullanımlar bağlama ve tonlamaya bağlıdır; ortak nokta "还"nın bir beklentiyle karşılaştırma ya da ek katması. Türkçedeki "hâlâ, ayrıca, neyse ki, gerçekten de, bir de ... diyorsun, üstelik" karşılıklarına bağlama göre denk gelir.

examples.zh: 这次考试考得还不错,比我预想的好多了。

examples.zh: 别说,他随手做的这道菜还真挺好吃的。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái dà xué shēng ne, lián zhè me jiǎn dān de cháng shí dōu bù dǒng?
examples.en: You're a university student, yet you don't even know this basic fact?

examples.zh: 都这么晚了,他居然还在办公室加班呢。
examples.pinyin: Dōu zhè me wǎn le, tā jū rán hái zài bàn gōng shì jiā bān ne。

examples.zh: 这家小店看着不起眼,东西还挺全的。

examples.zh: 你还说不累呢,眼睛都快睁不开了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái shuō bù lèi ne, yǎn jīng dōu kuài zhēng bù kāi le。
examples.en: You say you're not tired, yet you can barely keep your eyes open.

examples.zh: 试了半天,这个老办法还真管用,一下就解决了。
examples.pinyin: Shì le bàn tiān, zhè ge lǎo bàn fǎ hái zhēn guǎn yòng, yī xià jiù jiě jué le。

examples.zh: 他人不错,工作能力也还可以,值得培养。
examples.pinyin: Tā rén bù cuò, gōng zuò néng lì yě hái kě yǐ, zhí de péi yǎng。
examples.en: He's a good person and his abilities are decent too; worth cultivating.

examples.zh: 你还当哥哥呢,怎么能跟弟弟抢东西吃?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái dāng gē gē ne, zěn me néng gēn dì di qiǎng dōng xī chī?

examples.zh: 我以为他会拒绝,没想到他还真答应了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐ wéi tā huì jù jué, méi xiǎng dào tā hái zhēn dā yìng le。
examples.en: I thought he'd refuse, but he actually agreed.

examples.zh: 这么冷的天,他还坚持每天早上出去跑步呢。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me lěng de tiān, tā hái jiān chí měi tiān zǎo shàng chū qù pǎo bù ne。
examples.en: In such cold weather, he still runs outside every morning.

examples.zh: 你还笑呢,这么严重的事你怎么一点都不着急?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái xiào ne, zhè me yán zhòng de shì nǐ zěn me yì diǎn dōu bù zháo jí?
examples.en: You're still laughing? How can you not worry about something so serious?

examples.zh: 这个牌子的东西还行,用了这么久也没出过问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge pái zi de dōng xī hái xíng, yòng le zhè me jiǔ yě méi chū guò wèn tí。
examples.en: This brand's products are okay; no problems after all this use.

examples.zh: 别看他年纪小,懂的道理还真不少。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn tā nián jì xiǎo, dǒng de dào lǐ hái zhēn bù shǎo。
examples.en: Don't be fooled by his age; he actually knows quite a lot.

examples.zh: 都当爸爸的人了,你怎么还这么爱玩游戏呢?
examples.pinyin: Dōu dāng bà bà de rén le, nǐ zěn me hái zhè me ài wán yóu xì ne?

examples.zh: 我劝了他半天,他还是坚持自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ quàn le tā bàn tiān, tā hái shì jiān chí zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ。
examples.en: I advised him for a while, but he still stuck to his own idea.

examples.zh: 这道题看着难,做起来还挺简单的。

examples.en: This problem looks hard, but it's actually quite simple to do.

examples.zh: 尝了一口,这自己泡的茶味道还挺不错。
examples.pinyin: Cháng le yī kǒu, zhè zì jǐ pào de chá wèi dào hái tǐng bù cuò。
examples.en: One sip, and this self-brewed tea tastes pretty good.

examples.zh: 时间还早呢,你别着急,再坐一会儿。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān hái zǎo ne, nǐ bié zháo jí, zài zuò yī huì er。

examples.zh: 这么大的人了,你怎么还跟小孩子似的?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yuán yǐ wéi zhè tiáo lù hěn yuǎn, zǒu qǐ lái hái tǐng jìn de。
examples.en: I thought this road was far, but walking it's actually quite close.

examples.zh: 你还好意思说呢,那件事到现在还没办好。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hái hǎo yì si shuō ne, nà jiàn shì dào xiàn zài hái méi bàn hǎo。
examples.en: You still have the nerve to bring it up? That matter's still unfinished.

examples.zh: 这个方法听起来简单,效果还真出乎意料地好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fāng fǎ tīng qǐ lái jiǎn dān, xiào guǒ hái zhēn chū hū yì liào de hǎo。
examples.en: This method sounds simple, but the effect is unexpectedly good.

examples.zh: 都这个岁数了,他学起新东西来还挺快的。
examples.pinyin: Dōu zhè ge suì shù le, tā xué qǐ xīn dōng xī lái hái tǐng kuài de。
examples.en: At his age, he still learns new things quite quickly.

title: "总"nun ileri kullanımları
pattern: 总 + Fiil Öbeği / 总会 / 总得
summary: "总" hem "hep/sürekli" (总是) hem de "eninde sonunda, nihayetinde" (总会/总归) ve "ne olursa olsun ... gerek" (总得) anlamları taşır.
explanation: "总" birkaç ileri işlev taşır: (1) "总是" gibi SÜREKLİLİK/tekrar — "hep, sürekli, daima": 他总喜欢开玩笑 (Hep şaka yapmayı sever). (2) EMİNLİK/kaçınılmazlık — "总会/总要/总归" ile "eninde sonunda, nihayetinde mutlaka": 困难总会过去的 (Zorluklar eninde sonunda geçer), 事情总有解决的办法 (Her şeyin bir çözümü mutlaka vardır). (3) GEREKLİLİK — "总得/总要" ile "ne olursa olsun ...-mek gerek, hiç değilse": 人总得吃饭 (İnsan yemek yemek zorunda), 你总得给我个理由吧 (Hiç değilse bir sebep söylemelisin). (4) TAHMİN — "总" bir alt sınır tahmini verir: 这条鱼总有三斤重 (Bu balık en az üç jin çeker). Ortak fikir: "总" bir kaçınılmazlığı, sürekliliği ya da asgari beklentiyi vurgular. Türkçedeki "hep, eninde sonunda, nihayetinde, ne olursa olsun ...-meli, hiç değilse, en az" karşılıklarına bağlama göre denk gelir.

examples.zh: 你放心,只要努力,困难总会过去的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, zhǐ yào nǔ lì, kùn nán zǒng huì guò qù de。
examples.en: Rest assured; with effort, difficulties will eventually pass.

examples.zh: 他这个人总爱把简单的事情想得很复杂。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè ge rén zǒng ài bǎ jiǎn dān de shì qíng xiǎng de hěn fù zá。
examples.en: He always tends to overcomplicate simple things.

examples.zh: 再大的问题,咱们一起想,总会有办法的。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà de wèn tí, zán men yì qǐ xiǎng, zǒng huì yǒu bàn fǎ de。
examples.en: However big the problem, thinking together, we'll surely find a way.

examples.zh: 你总得吃点儿东西吧,饿着肚子怎么行。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒng de chī diǎn ér dōng xī ba, è zhe dǔ zi zěn me xíng。
examples.en: You have to eat something; you can't go hungry.

examples.zh: 孩子总有长大的一天,父母不可能陪他一辈子。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zǒng yǒu zhǎng dà de yī tiān, fù mǔ bù kě néng péi tā yī bèi zi。
examples.en: The child will grow up one day; parents can't accompany him forever.

examples.zh: 这条鱼不小,总有三四斤重。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo yú bù xiǎo, zǒng yǒu sān sì jīn zhòng。
examples.en: This fish isn't small; it's at least three or four jin.

examples.zh: 你总不能一辈子都靠别人吧,得学会独立。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒng bù néng yī bèi zi dōu kào bié rén ba, de xué huì dú lì。
examples.en: You can't rely on others your whole life; learn to be independent.

examples.zh: 天气再冷,人总得出门工作、生活。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì zài lěng, rén zǒng dé chū mén gōng zuò、 shēng huó。
examples.en: However cold it gets, people still have to go out to work and live.

examples.zh: 他总是第一个到公司,最后一个离开。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì dì yí gè dào gōng sī, zuì hòu yí gè lí kāi。
examples.en: He's always the first to arrive at the office and the last to leave.

examples.zh: 你别灰心,机会总会有的,关键是做好准备。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié huī xīn, jī huì zǒng huì yǒu de, guān jiàn shì zuò hǎo zhǔn bèi。
examples.en: Don't lose heart; chances will come; the key is to be ready.

examples.zh: 这件事总得有个人负责,不能一直拖着。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zǒng de yǒu gè rén fù zé, bù néng yì zhí tuō zhe。
examples.en: Someone has to take charge of this; it can't drag on.

examples.zh: 努力过后,付出总会有回报,你要有信心。
examples.pinyin: Nǔ lì guò hòu, fù chū zǒng huì yǒu huí bào, nǐ yào yǒu xìn xīn。
examples.en: After effort, it will always be rewarded; have confidence.

examples.zh: 他总喜欢在背后帮助别人,却从不声张。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒng xǐ huān zài bèi hòu bāng zhù bié rén, què cóng bù shēng zhāng。
examples.en: He always likes to help others behind the scenes without making a fuss.

examples.zh: 你总得告诉我原因,不然我怎么帮你?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒng de gào sù wǒ yuán yīn, bù rán wǒ zěn me bāng nǐ?
examples.en: You have to tell me the reason, or how can I help you?

examples.zh: 路是人走出来的,只要肯走,总能到达。
examples.pinyin: Lù shì rén zǒu chū lái de, zhǐ yào kěn zǒu, zǒng néng dào dá。
examples.en: Paths are made by walking; keep walking and you'll arrive.

examples.zh: 这么多年了,他总忘不了家乡的那口老井。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián le, tā zǒng wàng bù liǎo jiā xiāng de nà kǒu lǎo jǐng。
examples.en: After all these years, he can never forget the old well in his hometown.

examples.zh: 再忙,一天三顿饭总还是要好好吃的。
examples.pinyin: Zài máng, yī tiān sān dùn fàn zǒng hái shì yào hǎo hǎo chī de。
examples.en: However busy, you should still eat three proper meals a day.

examples.zh: 孩子总有一天会理解父母的良苦用心。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zǒng yǒu yī tiān huì lǐ jiě fù mǔ de liáng kǔ yòng xīn。
examples.en: One day the child will understand his parents' painstaking care.

examples.zh: 你总不能因为一次失败就彻底放弃吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒng bù néng yīn wèi yī cì shī bài jiù chè dǐ fàng qì ba。
examples.en: You can't give up completely just because of one failure.

examples.zh: 这点小事,他总要亲自过问,一点都不马虎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo shì, tā zǒng yào qīn zì guò wèn, yì diǎn dōu bù mǎ hǔ。
examples.en: For such trifles, he always checks personally, never careless.

examples.zh: 天下没有不散的宴席,朋友总有分别的时候。
examples.pinyin: Tiān xià méi yǒu bù sàn de yàn xí, péng yǒu zǒng yǒu fēn bié de shí hòu。
examples.en: No feast lasts forever; friends must part sometime.

examples.zh: 这么大的工程,总得花上好几年才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de gōng chéng, zǒng de huā shàng hǎo jǐ nián cái néng wán chéng。
examples.en: Such a big project will surely take several years to finish.

examples.zh: 你总是这么替别人着想,也该多为自己想想。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zǒng shì zhè me tì bié rén zhuó xiǎng, yě gāi duō wèi zì jǐ xiǎng xiǎng。
examples.en: You always think of others; you should think more of yourself too.

examples.zh: 生活总有起起落落,重要的是保持乐观。
examples.pinyin: Shēng huó zǒng yǒu qǐ qǐ luò luò, zhòng yào de shì bǎo chí lè guān。
examples.en: Life always has ups and downs; what matters is staying optimistic.

examples.zh: 再难的日子,一家人在一起总能熬过去。
examples.pinyin: Zài nán de rì zi, yī jiā rén zài yì qǐ zǒng néng áo guò qù。
examples.en: However hard the days, together as a family we can always get through.

title: "看来" ile durum değerlendirme
pattern: 看来 + Yargı / 在 + Kişi + 看来
summary: "看来" (kànlái) gözleme dayalı bir yargı/çıkarım bildirir: 看来今天要下雨 = Görünüşe göre bugün yağmur yağacak. "在...看来" = ...-e göre.
explanation: "看来" bir durumdan çıkarılan bir YARGIYI/tahmini bildirir: "görünüşe göre, anlaşılan, öyle görünüyor ki". Cümlenin başında ya da öznenin ardında gelir: 看来他今天不会来了 (Anlaşılan bugün gelmeyecek), 天这么黑,看来要下暴雨了 (Hava karardı, görünüşe göre sağanak gelecek). Gözleme/kanıta dayalı, çoğu zaman kesin olmayan bir sonuç bildirir. Ayrı bir kalıp "在 + kişi + 看来" = "...-e göre, ...-in gözünde": 在我看来,这个方案完全可行 (Bana göre bu plan tamamen uygulanabilir), 在大家看来,他是个可靠的人 (Herkesin gözünde güvenilir biridir). Bu ikinci kalıp bir kişinin BAKIŞ AÇISINI/görüşünü tanıtır. "看起来" (dış görünüş) ile yakındır ama "看来" daha çok mantıksal çıkarım/kanaat, "看起来" ise duyusal izlenim vurgular. Türkçedeki "görünüşe göre, anlaşılan, öyle görünüyor ki" (看来) ve "...-e göre, ...-in gözünde" (在...看来) ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 天这么阴,看来一会儿就要下雨了,咱们快回去吧。
examples.pinyin: Tiān zhè me yīn, kàn lái yī huì er jiù yào xià yǔ le, zán men kuài huí qù ba。
examples.en: The sky's so overcast; it'll rain soon, let's hurry back.

examples.zh: 他到现在还没来,看来是被什么事耽误了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào xiàn zài hái méi lái, kàn lái shì bèi shén me shì dān wù le。
examples.en: He's still not here; it seems something held him up.

examples.zh: 在我看来,这件事并没有你想的那么复杂。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ kàn lái, zhè jiàn shì bìng méi yǒu nǐ xiǎng de nà me fù zá。
examples.en: In my view, this matter isn't as complex as you think.

examples.zh: 这些菜都快凉了,看来他今天是不回来吃饭了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē cài dōu kuài liáng le, kàn lái tā jīn tiān shì bù huí lái chī fàn le。
examples.en: The food's gone cold; it seems he won't come back for dinner.

examples.zh: 看来这次的计划得改一改,原来的安排行不通。
examples.pinyin: Kàn lái zhè cì de jì huà de gǎi yī gǎi, yuán lái de ān pái xíng bù tōng。
examples.en: It seems the plan needs changing; the original arrangement won't work.

examples.zh: 在孩子看来,爸爸妈妈无所不能,什么都会。
examples.pinyin: Zài hái zi kàn lái, bà bà mā mā wú suǒ bù néng, shén me dū huì。
examples.en: In the child's eyes, mom and dad are all-powerful and can do anything.

examples.zh: 大家都同意了,看来这件事就这么定下来了。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu tóng yì le, kàn lái zhè jiàn shì jiù zhè me dìng xià lái le。
examples.en: Everyone agreed; it seems the matter is thus settled.

examples.zh: 他脸色这么难看,看来是遇到什么烦心事了。
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎn sè zhè me nán kàn, kàn lái shì yù dào shén me fán xīn shì le。
examples.en: His face looks so grim; it seems he's run into something upsetting.

examples.zh: 在专家看来,这个问题的解决还需要一段时间。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuān jiā kàn lái, zhè ge wèn tí de jiě jué hái xū yào yī duàn shí jiān。
examples.en: In the experts' view, solving this problem will take more time.

examples.zh: 车票都卖光了,看来我们只能改坐明天的车了。
examples.pinyin: Chē piào dōu mài guāng le, kàn lái wǒ men zhǐ néng gǎi zuò míng tiān de chē le。
examples.en: The tickets are sold out; it seems we can only take tomorrow's.

examples.zh: 他准备得这么充分,看来这次是志在必得。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǔn bèi de zhè me chōng fèn, kàn lái zhè cì shì zhì zài bì de。
examples.en: He's prepared so thoroughly; it seems he's determined to win this time.

examples.zh: 在我看来,做人诚实比什么都重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ kàn lái, zuò rén chéng shí bǐ shén me dōu zhòng yào。
examples.en: In my view, being honest matters more than anything.

examples.zh: 路上这么堵,看来我们要迟到了,得给对方说一声。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng zhè me dǔ, kàn lái wǒ men yào chí dào le, de gěi duì fāng shuō yī shēng。
examples.en: The traffic's so bad; it seems we'll be late, let's inform them.

examples.zh: 他连着打了好几个哈欠,看来是昨晚没睡好。
examples.pinyin: Tā lián zhe dǎ le hǎo jǐ gè hā qiàn, kàn lái shì zuó wǎn méi shuì hǎo。
examples.en: He's yawned several times; it seems he slept poorly last night.

examples.zh: 在很多人看来,他是个不折不扣的工作狂。
examples.pinyin: Zài hěn duō rén kàn lái, tā shì gè bù zhé bù kòu de gōng zuò kuáng。
examples.en: In many people's eyes, he's an out-and-out workaholic.

examples.zh: 试了这么多次都不行,看来这个方法确实有问题。
examples.pinyin: Shì le zhè me duō cì dōu bù xíng, kàn lái zhè ge fāng fǎ què shí yǒu wèn tí。
examples.en: It failed so many times; it seems this method really has issues.

examples.zh: 看来我小看这道题了,它比我想的要难得多。
examples.pinyin: Kàn lái wǒ xiǎo kàn zhè dào tí le, tā bǐ wǒ xiǎng de yào nán de duō。
examples.en: It seems I underestimated this problem; it's much harder than I thought.

examples.zh: 在老师看来,这个学生虽然调皮,但很有潜力。
examples.pinyin: Zài lǎo shī kàn lái, zhè ge xué shēng suī rán tiáo pí, dàn hěn yǒu qián lì。
examples.en: In the teacher's view, this student is naughty but has great potential.

examples.zh: 大家的反应这么热烈,看来这次活动很成功。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā de fǎn yìng zhè me rè liè, kàn lái zhè cì huó dòng hěn chéng gōng。
examples.en: The response was so enthusiastic; it seems the event was a success.

examples.zh: 他好几天都闷闷不乐,看来是心里有事。
examples.pinyin: Tā hǎo jǐ tiān dōu mèn mèn bù lè, kàn lái shì xīn lǐ yǒu shì。
examples.en: He's been gloomy for days; it seems something's on his mind.

examples.zh: 在我看来,与其抱怨,不如想办法解决问题。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ kàn lái, yǔ qí bào yuàn, bù rú xiǎng bàn fǎ jiě jué wèn tí。
examples.en: In my view, rather than complain, better find a solution.

examples.zh: 看来这场雨一时半会儿停不了,咱们先在这儿避避。
examples.pinyin: Kàn lái zhè chǎng yǔ yī shí bàn huì er tíng bù liǎo, zán men xiān zài zhè ér bì bì。
examples.en: It seems this rain won't stop soon; let's shelter here for now.

examples.zh: 他把话说得这么绝,看来是真的下定决心了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ huà shuō de zhè me jué, kàn lái shì zhēn de xià dìng jué xīn le。
examples.en: He spoke so firmly; it seems he's truly made up his mind.

examples.zh: 在外人看来风光无限,其实其中的辛苦只有自己知道。
examples.pinyin: Zài wài rén kàn lái fēng guāng wú xiàn, qí shí qí zhōng de xīn kǔ zhǐ yǒu zì jǐ zhī dào。
examples.en: To outsiders it looks glorious, but only he knows the hardship.

examples.zh: 看来这个消息是真的,不然他不会这么激动。
examples.pinyin: Kàn lái zhè ge xiāo xī shì zhēn de, bù rán tā bú huì zhè me jī dòng。
examples.en: It seems the news is true, or he wouldn't be so excited.

title: "只好" ile çaresiz tercih
summary: "只好" (zhǐhǎo) başka çare olmadığı için bir şeyi yapmayı bildirir: 没赶上车,只好走回去 = Otobüsü kaçırdım, mecburen yürüyerek döndüm.
explanation: "只好" (ya da "只能") başka bir seçenek KALMADIĞI için, mecburen/çaresizce bir şeyi yapmayı bildirir: "mecburen, ister istemez, başka çare kalmayınca, ...-mek zorunda kalmak". 商店关门了,我们只好空手回去 (Dükkân kapalıydı, eli boş dönmek zorunda kaldık), 他不肯听劝,大家只好由他去了 (Öğüt dinlemedi, herkes ona bırakmak zorunda kaldı). Genelde önce bir engel/olumsuz koşul verilir, ardından "只好 + o durumda kalan tek seçenek" gelir. İstemeden, gönülsüzce yapılan bir tercih tonu taşır. "只能" ile eş anlamlıdır; "只好" biraz daha "çaresizlikten böyle oldu" vurgusu taşır. Türkçedeki "mecburen, ister istemez, çaresiz, ...-mekten başka çare kalmamak, zorunda kalmak" ifadelerine denk gelir; dış koşulların dayattığı bir seçimi anlatmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 末班车已经开走了,我们只好打车回家。
examples.pinyin: Mò bān chē yǐ jīng kāi zǒu le, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo dǎ chē huí jiā。
examples.en: The last bus had left, so we had no choice but to take a taxi home.

examples.zh: 外面突然下起了大雨,我们只好取消了郊游计划。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn tū rán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo qǔ xiāo le jiāo yóu jì huà。
examples.en: It suddenly poured, so we had to cancel the outing.

examples.zh: 他执意要走,大家怎么劝都没用,只好由他去了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhí yì yào zǒu, dà jiā zěn me quàn dōu méi yòng, zhǐ hǎo yóu tā qù le。
examples.en: He insisted on leaving; no persuasion worked, so we let him be.

examples.zh: 店里没有我要的号码,我只好买了大一号的。
examples.pinyin: Diàn lǐ méi yǒu wǒ yào de hào mǎ, wǒ zhǐ hǎo mǎi le dà yī hào de。
examples.en: The store didn't have my size, so I had to buy one size up.

examples.zh: 那本书已经卖完了,我只好在网上订了一本。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn shū yǐ jīng mài wán le, wǒ zhǐ hǎo zài wǎng shàng dìng le yī běn。
examples.en: The book was sold out, so I had to order one online.

examples.zh: 停电了,电脑用不了,他只好用手写完了报告。
examples.pinyin: Tíng diàn le, diàn nǎo yòng bù liǎo, tā zhǐ hǎo yòng shǒu xiě wán le bào gào。
examples.en: The power went out and the computer was down, so he wrote the report by hand.

examples.zh: 对方不肯让步,谈判只好暂时中止。
examples.pinyin: Duì fāng bù kěn ràng bù, tán pàn zhǐ hǎo zàn shí zhōng zhǐ。
examples.en: The other side wouldn't yield, so the talks had to be suspended.

examples.zh: 时间实在来不及了,我们只好放弃了最后一个景点。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān shí zài lái bù jí le, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo fàng qì le zuì hòu yí gè jǐng diǎn。
examples.en: There really wasn't time, so we had to skip the last attraction.

examples.zh: 孩子病了,她只好向公司请了几天假。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi bìng le, tā zhǐ hǎo xiàng gōng sī qǐng le jǐ tiān jiǎ。
examples.en: The child was ill, so she had to take a few days off work.

examples.zh: 路被大水冲断了,我们只好绕很远的一段路。
examples.pinyin: Lù bèi dà shuǐ chōng duàn le, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo rào hěn yuǎn de yī duàn lù。
examples.en: The road was washed out, so we had to take a long detour.

examples.zh: 材料还没到,今天的工作只好先停一停。
examples.pinyin: Cái liào hái méi dào, jīn tiān de gōng zuò zhǐ hǎo xiān tíng yī tíng。
examples.en: The materials hadn't arrived, so today's work had to pause.

examples.zh: 他忘了带钥匙,只好在门口等家人回来。
examples.pinyin: Tā wàng le dài yào shi, zhǐ hǎo zài mén kǒu děng jiā rén huí lái。
examples.en: He forgot his keys, so he had to wait at the door for family.

examples.zh: 大家意见不统一,最后只好投票决定。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā yì jiàn bù tǒng yī, zuì hòu zhǐ hǎo tóu piào jué dìng。
examples.en: Opinions differed, so in the end we had to decide by voting.

examples.zh: 航班取消了,他们只好在机场附近找了家旅馆住下。
examples.pinyin: Háng bān qǔ xiāo le, tā men zhǐ hǎo zài jī chǎng fù jìn zhǎo le jiā lǚ guǎn zhù xià。
examples.en: The flight was canceled, so they had to find a hotel near the airport.

examples.zh: 我实在说不过他,只好点头同意了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shí zài shuō bù guò tā, zhǐ hǎo diǎn tóu tóng yì le。
examples.en: I really couldn't out-argue him, so I had to nod in agreement.

examples.zh: 食堂的饭菜卖光了,他只好饿着肚子回了宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Shí táng de fàn cài mài guāng le, tā zhǐ hǎo è zhe dǔ zi huí le sù shè。
examples.en: The canteen was out of food, so he went back to the dorm hungry.

examples.zh: 既然你们都反对,那这个方案只好作罢了。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán nǐ men dōu fǎn duì, nà zhè ge fāng àn zhǐ hǎo zuò bà le。
examples.en: Since you all object, this plan will have to be dropped.

examples.zh: 他一个人忙不过来,只好请人来帮忙。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí gè rén máng bù guò lái, zhǐ hǎo qǐng rén lái bāng máng。
examples.en: He couldn't handle it alone, so he had to hire help.

examples.zh: 天太黑,又找不到路,我们只好原地等到天亮。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tài hēi, yòu zhǎo bú dào lù, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo yuán de děng dào tiān liàng。
examples.en: It was too dark to find the way, so we had to wait for dawn.

examples.zh: 原来的老师病了,学校只好临时找人代课。
examples.pinyin: Yuán lái de lǎo shī bìng le, xué xiào zhǐ hǎo lín shí zhǎo rén dài kè。
examples.en: The original teacher fell ill, so the school had to find a substitute.

examples.zh: 钱不够了,他只好把心爱的手表卖了。
examples.pinyin: Qián bù gòu le, tā zhǐ hǎo bǎ xīn ài de shǒu biǎo mài le。
examples.en: Short of money, he had to sell his beloved watch.

examples.zh: 会议室被占用了,我们只好改在走廊里商量。
examples.pinyin: Huì yì shì bèi zhàn yòng le, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo gǎi zài zǒu láng lǐ shāng liáng。
examples.en: The meeting room was taken, so we had to discuss in the hallway.

examples.zh: 既然误了火车,那也没办法,只好等下一趟了。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán wù le huǒ chē, nà yě méi bàn fǎ, zhǐ hǎo děng xià yī tàng le。
examples.en: Having missed the train, there was no choice but to wait for the next.

examples.zh: 他不接电话，我只好亲自跑一趟去找他。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù jiē diàn huà， wǒ zhǐ hǎo qīn zì pǎo yī tàng qù zhǎo tā。
examples.en: He wouldn't answer the phone, so I had to go find him in person.

examples.zh: 剩下的活儿实在做不完,只好留到明天再说。
examples.pinyin: Shèng xià de huó er shí zài zuò bù wán, zhǐ hǎo liú dào míng tiān zài shuō。
examples.en: The remaining work really couldn't be finished, so it had to wait till tomorrow.

title: "可" pekiştirme zarfı
summary: "可" (kě) bir ifadeyi güçlü biçimde pekiştirir: 这可太好了 = Bu gerçekten harika!; 你可要小心 = Sakın ha, dikkatli ol.
explanation: "可" bir zarf olarak bir ifadeye GÜÇLÜ vurgu, pekiştirme katar (bağlaç "可是"deki "ama"dan farklı). İşlevleri: (1) Sıfat/duyguyu güçlendirir, çoğu zaman "可...了" kalıbında: 今天可冷了 (Bugün amma soğuk!), 这可不容易 (Bu hiç de kolay değil). (2) Bir uyarı/rica/kararlılığı pekiştirir: 你可别忘了 (Sakın unutma ha!), 这次可要好好准备 (Bu sefer iyi hazırlanmalısın mutlaka). (3) Bir gerçeği/karşı çıkışı vurgular: 我可没说过这话 (Ben böyle bir şey kesinlikle demedim), 他可不是好惹的 (O hiç de öyle sıradan biri değil). Genelde konuşma dilinde, duygusal vurgu için kullanılır ve tonlamayla desteklenir. "可"nın kattığı vurgu "gerçekten, sahiden, amma da, sakın, kesinlikle" gibi çeşitli Türkçe pekiştirmelerle karşılanır. Türkçedeki "amma, sahiden, gerçekten, sakın ha, kesinlikle, hiç de" gibi vurguların işlevine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 今天可冷了,你出门一定要多穿点儿衣服。
examples.pinyin: Jīn tiān kě lěng le, nǐ chū mén yí dìng yào duō chuān diǎn ér yī fú。
examples.en: It's really cold today; be sure to dress warmly when you go out.

examples.zh: 这件事你可千万别告诉别人,答应我。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì nǐ kě qiān wàn bié gào sù bié rén, dā yìng wǒ。
examples.en: You absolutely must not tell anyone about this; promise me.

examples.zh: 好不容易见一次面,这次你可不能再走了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo bù róng yì jiàn yī cì miàn, zhè cì nǐ kě bù néng zài zǒu le。
examples.en: We rarely get to meet; this time you really can't leave again.

examples.zh: 他做的红烧肉可好吃了,你一定要尝尝。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò de hóng shāo ròu kě hǎo chī le, nǐ yí dìng yào cháng cháng。
examples.en: His braised pork is really delicious; you must try it.

examples.zh: 这道题可把我难住了,想了半天也没做出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí kě bǎ wǒ nán zhù le, xiǎng le bàn tiān yě méi zuò chū lái。
examples.en: This problem really stumped me; I couldn't solve it after ages.

examples.zh: 你可要记住今天的教训,以后别再犯了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yào jì zhù jīn tiān de jiào xùn, yǐ hòu bié zài fàn le。
examples.en: You must remember today's lesson and never make the mistake again.

examples.zh: 这条路我可熟了,你跟着我走保证不会迷路。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ kě shú le, nǐ gēn zhe wǒ zǒu bǎo zhèng bú huì mí lù。
examples.en: I know this road really well; follow me and you won't get lost.

examples.zh: 这场雨下得可大了,一出门就浑身湿透了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yǔ xià de kě dà le, yī chū mén jiù hún shēn shī tòu le。
examples.en: The rain fell really hard; you'd get soaked the moment you step out.

examples.zh: 我可没说过这样的话,你别冤枉我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kě méi shuō guò zhè yàng de huà, nǐ bié yuān wǎng wǒ。
examples.en: I never said such a thing; don't wrongly accuse me.

examples.zh: 这孩子可聪明了,一教就会,让人省心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè hái zi kě cōng míng liǎo, yī jiào jiù huì, ràng rén shěng xīn。
examples.en: This child is really smart; he learns instantly, so easy.

examples.zh: 你可别小看他,他的本事大着呢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě bié xiǎo kàn tā, tā de běn shì dà zhe ne。
examples.en: Don't underestimate him; he's really quite capable.

examples.zh: 这次机会可难得了,你一定要好好把握。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jī huì kě nán de le, nǐ yí dìng yào hǎo hǎo bǎ wò。
examples.en: This chance is really rare; you must seize it well.

examples.zh: 外面的风可大了,把院子里的花盆都吹倒了。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn de fēng kě dà le, bǎ yuàn zi lǐ de huā pén dōu chuī dào le。
examples.en: The wind outside is really strong; it knocked over the flowerpots.

examples.zh: 那地方可远了,坐车都要好几个小时。
examples.pinyin: Nà dì fāng kě yuǎn le, zuò chē dōu yào hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí。
examples.en: That place is really far; even by car it takes hours.

examples.zh: 你可要说话算话,答应了就不能反悔。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě yào shuō huà suàn huà, dā yìng le jiù bù néng fǎn huǐ。
examples.en: You really must keep your word; once promised, no going back.

examples.zh: 这本书可有意思了,我一口气看到了半夜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū kě yǒu yì si le, wǒ yì kǒu qì kàn dào le bàn yè。
examples.en: This book is really interesting; I read until midnight in one go.

examples.zh: 他脾气可倔了,认准的事九头牛都拉不回。
examples.pinyin: Tā pí qì kě jué le, rèn zhǔn de shì jiǔ tóu niú dōu lā bù huí。
examples.en: He's really stubborn; once set, nothing can turn him back.

examples.zh: 这些天可把我忙坏了,连喘口气的时间都没有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē tiān kě bǎ wǒ máng huài le, lián chuǎn kǒu qì de shí jiān dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: These days really wore me out; no time even to catch my breath.

examples.zh: 你可别再熬夜了,身体是自己的,要爱惜。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě bié zài áo yè le, shēn tǐ shì zì jǐ de, yào ài xī。
examples.en: You really must stop staying up; your body is your own, cherish it.

examples.zh: 这顿饭可丰盛了,满满地摆了一大桌子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dùn fàn kě fēng shèng le, mǎn mǎn de bǎi le yī dà zhuō zi。
examples.en: This meal is really lavish; a whole table piled full.

examples.zh: 那次经历可把我吓坏了,现在想起来还后怕。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì jīng lì kě bǎ wǒ xià huài le, xiàn zài xiǎng qǐ lái hái hòu pà。
examples.en: That experience really scared me; recalling it still frightens me.

examples.zh: 你可算来了,我都等你一个多小时了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kě suàn lái le, wǒ dōu děng nǐ yí gè duō xiǎo shí le。
examples.en: You've finally come; I've waited over an hour for you.

examples.zh: 这个消息可让全家人高兴坏了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāo xī kě ràng quán jiā rén gāo xìng huài le。
examples.en: This news made the whole family really happy.

examples.zh: 他对工作可认真了,再小的细节也不放过。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gōng zuò kě rèn zhēn le, zài xiǎo de xì jié yě bù fàng guò。
examples.en: He's really serious about work; he misses no detail, however small.

examples.zh: 这地方的风景可美了,来一次绝对不后悔。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dì fāng de fēng jǐng kě měi le, lái yī cì jué duì bù hòu huǐ。
examples.en: The scenery here is really beautiful; you won't regret coming.

title: "毕竟" ile "ne de olsa, sonuçta"
summary: "毕竟" (bìjìng) bir gerçeği/gerekçeyi vurgular: 他毕竟还是个孩子 = Ne de olsa daha çocuk.
explanation: "毕竟" değişmez bir gerçeği ya da özü hatırlatarak bir yargıyı gerekçelendirir: "ne de olsa, sonuçta, nihayetinde, her şeye rağmen". 他毕竟年纪大了,不能太劳累 (Ne de olsa yaşlandı, çok yorulmamalı), 这件事虽然难,但毕竟还有希望 (Zor olsa da sonuçta hâlâ umut var), 毕竟是第一次,做得不好也可以理解 (Sonuçta ilk kez, iyi olmaması anlaşılır). "毕竟" bir durumun temel/değişmez gerçeğini öne sürerek bir hoşgörü, açıklama ya da sonuç sunar; çoğu zaman "her ne olursa olsun, temelde durum bu" fikrini taşır. Cümle başında ya da öznenin ardında gelir. "到底" (nihayetinde) ile yakındır ama "毕竟" özellikle bir gerekçe/özü hatırlatır. Türkçedeki "ne de olsa, sonuçta, nihayetinde, her şeye rağmen, en nihayetinde" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir yargıyı temel bir gerçekle desteklemenin doğal yoludur.

examples.zh: 你别怪他,他毕竟还是个孩子,不懂事很正常。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié guài tā, tā bì jìng hái shì gè hái zi, bù dǒng shì hěn zhèng cháng。
examples.en: Don't blame him; he's a child after all, so being naive is normal.

examples.zh: 这次没成功没关系,毕竟这是我们第一次尝试。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì méi chéng gōng méi guān xì, bì jìng zhè shì wǒ men dì yī cì cháng shì。
examples.en: It's okay we didn't succeed; after all, it was our first attempt.

examples.zh: 他虽然退休了,可毕竟是老专家,经验非常丰富。
examples.pinyin: Tā suī rán tuì xiū le, kě bì jìng shì lǎo zhuān jiā, jīng yàn fēi cháng fēng fù。
examples.en: Though retired, he's a veteran expert after all, with rich experience.

examples.zh: 再好的朋友也要保持分寸,毕竟距离产生美。
examples.pinyin: Zài hǎo de péng yǒu yě yào bǎo chí fēn cùn, bì jìng jù lí chǎn shēng měi。
examples.en: Even good friends need boundaries; distance makes the heart fonder.

examples.zh: 你多担待他一点,毕竟他刚来,对这里还不熟悉。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ duō dān dài tā yì diǎn, bì jìng tā gāng lái, duì zhè lǐ hái bù shú xī。
examples.en: Bear with him a little; after all, he's new and unfamiliar here.

examples.zh: 这件衣服虽然贵,但毕竟质量好,能穿很多年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú suī rán guì, dàn bì jìng zhì liàng hǎo, néng chuān hěn duō nián。
examples.en: This outfit is pricey, but the quality's good after all; it lasts years.

examples.zh: 他现在很风光,可毕竟是靠自己一步步努力来的。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàn zài hěn fēng guāng, kě bì jìng shì kào zì jǐ yí bù bù nǔ lì lái de。
examples.en: He's glorious now, but it all came from his own gradual effort.

examples.zh: 话虽这么说,毕竟是自己的孩子,哪能真不管呢?
examples.pinyin: Huà suī zhè me shuō, bì jìng shì zì jǐ de hái zi, nǎ néng zhēn bù guǎn ne?
examples.en: Say what you will, he's your own child; how could you truly ignore him?

examples.zh: 这个办法有风险,但毕竟是目前最可行的选择。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge bàn fǎ yǒu fēng xiǎn, dàn bì jìng shì mù qián zuì kě xíng de xuǎn zé。
examples.en: This method has risks, but it's the most feasible choice for now.

examples.zh: 你别太苛求他,毕竟他也是一片好心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié tài kē qiú tā, bì jìng tā yě shì yī piàn hǎo xīn。
examples.en: Don't be too harsh on him; he meant well, after all.

examples.zh: 虽然赢了比赛,可毕竟对手实力有限,不能太得意。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán yíng le bǐ sài, kě bì jìng duì shǒu shí lì yǒu xiàn, bù néng tài dé yì。
examples.en: We won, but the opponent was weak; don't get too pleased.

examples.zh: 他毕竟在这个行业干了三十年,眼光很独到。
examples.pinyin: Tā bì jìng zài zhè ge háng yè gàn le sān shí nián, yǎn guāng hěn dú dào。
examples.en: He's worked in this field for thirty years after all; his eye is keen.

examples.zh: 再舍不得也得让孩子独立,毕竟他总要长大。
examples.pinyin: Zài shě bù de yě de ràng hái zi dú lì, bì jìng tā zǒng yào zhǎng dà。
examples.en: However reluctant, you must let the child be independent; he must grow up.

examples.zh: 这点小误会算不了什么,毕竟你们是多年的老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhè diǎn xiǎo wù huì suàn bù liǎo shén me, bì jìng nǐ men shì duō nián de lǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: This little misunderstanding is nothing; you're old friends after all.

examples.zh: 虽然那里条件艰苦,但毕竟是他生长的故乡。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán nà lǐ tiáo jiàn jiān kǔ, dàn bì jìng shì tā shēng zhǎng de gù xiāng。
examples.en: Though conditions there are hard, it's his native hometown after all.

examples.zh: 他做事有时冲动,但毕竟心地善良,值得交往。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì yǒu shí chōng dòng, dàn bì jìng xīn de shàn liáng, zhí de jiāo wǎng。
examples.en: He can be impulsive, but he's kind-hearted after all, worth befriending.

examples.zh: 这次任务很重,但毕竟大家齐心,总能完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì rèn wù hěn zhòng, dàn bì jìng dà jiā qí xīn, zǒng néng wán chéng。
examples.en: This task is heavy, but with everyone united, it can be done.

examples.zh: 你不必太自责,毕竟当时的情况谁也没料到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù bì tài zì zé, bì jìng dāng shí de qíng kuàng shuí yě méi liào dào。
examples.en: Don't blame yourself too much; no one foresaw the situation.

examples.zh: 新手上路难免紧张,毕竟熟能生巧,慢慢就好了。
examples.pinyin: Xīn shǒu shàng lù nán miǎn jǐn zhāng, bì jìng shú néng shēng qiǎo, màn màn jiù hǎo le。
examples.en: Beginners are inevitably nervous; practice makes perfect, it'll get better.

examples.zh: 他毕竟见多识广,遇到问题总能想出办法。
examples.pinyin: Tā bì jìng jiàn duō shí guǎng, yù dào wèn tí zǒng néng xiǎng chū bàn fǎ。
examples.en: He's experienced after all; he always finds a solution to problems.

examples.zh: 这份工作再累,毕竟收入稳定,他舍不得辞。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōng zuò zài lèi, bì jìng shōu rù wěn dìng, tā shě bù de cí。
examples.en: However tiring this job is, the income's stable, so he won't quit.

examples.zh: 孩子考得不理想,可毕竟尽力了,你别再批评了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi kǎo de bù lǐ xiǎng, kě bì jìng jìn lì le, nǐ bié zài pī píng le。
examples.en: The child didn't do well, but tried his best; stop criticizing.

examples.zh: 网上的说法不能全信,毕竟眼见才为实。
examples.pinyin: Wǎng shàng de shuō fǎ bù néng quán xìn, bì jìng yǎn jiàn cái wèi shí。
examples.en: Don't fully trust online claims; seeing is believing, after all.

examples.zh: 虽然分开多年,可毕竟是亲兄弟,血浓于水。
examples.pinyin: Suī rán fēn kāi duō nián, kě bì jìng shì qīn xiōng dì, xuè nóng yú shuǐ。
examples.en: Though apart for years, they're real brothers; blood is thicker than water.

examples.zh: 这座老房子该修了,毕竟已经住了几十年。

title: "差点没" ile "az kalsın ...-yordu / ucu ucuna"
summary: "差点没" ilginç bir kalıptır: istenmeyen olayda "差点没VP" = az kalsın oluyordu (ama olmadı); istenen olayda ise "差点没VP" = ucu ucuna oldu.
explanation: "差点没" (chàdiǎn méi) "差点"in "没"lu biçimidir ve şaşırtıcı bir mantık taşır: (1) İSTENMEYEN bir olayla, "差点" ve "差点没" AYNI anlama gelir — "az kalsın oluyordu (ama olmadı)": 我差点没摔倒 = 我差点摔倒 (Az kalsın düşüyordum, ama düşmedim). Buradaki "没" anlamı değiştirmez, sadece pekiştirir. (2) İSTENEN/olması arzu edilen bir olayla ise, "差点没VP" = "ucu ucuna oldu, az kalsın olmuyordu (ama oldu)": 我差点没赶上车 (Az kalsın yetişemiyordum — ama yetiştim), 差点没考上 (Az kalsın giremiyordum — ama girdim). Bu ince ayrım (istenmeyen olayda olmadı, istenen olayda ucu ucuna oldu) HSK4'ün en zorlayıcı noktalarından biridir. Türkçedeki "az kalsın ...-yordu, ramak kaldı, ucu ucuna, kıl payı" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir olayın kıl payıyla olmasını/olmamasını anlatır.

title: "反正" ile "nasıl olsa, zaten"
summary: "反正" (fǎnzheng) bir sonucun koşullardan bağımsız olduğunu bildirir: 反正我不去 = Nasıl olsa ben gitmiyorum; 反正也没事,你就来吧 = Zaten bir şey yok, gelsene.
explanation: "反正" bir sonucun/kararın koşullar ne olursa olsun DEĞİŞMEYECEĞİNİ ya da bir gerekçenin zaten geçerli olduğunu vurgular: "nasıl olsa, zaten, her hâlükârda, ne olursa olsun". İki tipik kullanımı: (1) Kararlılık/değişmezlik — 你怎么说都行,反正我不同意 (Ne dersen de, ben nasıl olsa katılmıyorum). (2) Bir gerekçeyi "zaten" ile pekiştirme — 反正你也顺路,就帮我带一下吧 (Zaten yolun üstü, şunu da getiriver). Çoğu zaman "不管...反正..." (... olursa olsun, nasıl olsa ...) biçiminde gelir: 不管天气怎么样,反正我们都要出发 (Hava nasıl olursa olsun, biz her hâlükârda yola çıkacağız). Konuşmacının bir sonuca güvenini, aldırışsızlığını ya da bir gerekçenin kesinliğini yansıtır. Türkçedeki "nasıl olsa, zaten, her hâlükârda, ne olursa olsun, ne de olsa" ifadelerine denk gelir; koşuldan bağımsız bir sonucu ya da hazır bir gerekçeyi vurgulamanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 这点钱你先拿着用,反正我暂时也用不上。

examples.zh: 剩下的这些菜别倒了,反正明天还能热着吃。

examples.zh: 反正闲着也是闲着,不如出去走走,散散心。

examples.zh: 不管别人怎么看,反正我觉得这样做是对的。
examples.pinyin: Bù guǎn bié rén zěn me kàn, fǎn zhèng wǒ jué de zhè yàng zuò shì duì de。

examples.zh: 你今天来不来都行,反正我一直在家。

examples.zh: 这条路虽然远点,但反正不堵车,还是走这条吧。

examples.zh: 说什么都晚了,反正事情已经发生了,后悔也没用。

examples.zh: 你别客气,多拿点儿,反正家里还有很多。

examples.zh: 反正迟早都要做,不如现在就把它做完。
examples.pinyin: Fǎn zhèng chí zǎo dōu yào zuò, bù rú xiàn zài jiù bǎ tā zuò wán。

examples.zh: 不管这次成不成,反正我们已经尽力争取了。

examples.zh: 你就放心去吧,反正家里有我照顾着。

examples.zh: 这些旧书你要就拿去,反正放着也是占地方。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē jiù shū nǐ yào jiù ná qù, fǎn zhèng fàng zhe yě shì zhàn dì fāng。

examples.zh: 他怎么劝我都没用,反正我主意已定。

examples.zh: 反正路过银行,我就顺便把钱取了。

title: "尽量" ile "elden geldiğince, mümkün olduğunca"
summary: "尽量" (jǐnliàng) "elden geldiğince, mümkün olduğunca" der: 你尽量早点来 = Elinden geldiğince erken gel.
explanation: "尽量" bir eylemi ELDEN GELDİĞİNCE, mümkün olan en yüksek ölçüde yapmaya çalışmayı bildirir: "elden geldiğince, mümkün olduğunca, olabildiğince, gücünün yettiğince". Fiilin önünde gelir: 你尽量多休息 (Elinden geldiğince çok dinlen), 我尽量赶在天黑前回来 (Karanlık basmadan dönmeye çalışırım), 说话尽量小声一点 (Mümkün olduğunca alçak sesle konuş). Bir çabayı, gayreti gösterir ama kesin bir garanti vermez — "elimden geleni yaparım" tonu taşır. Ricalarda ve söz vermelerde çok kullanılır. "尽力" (bütün gücüyle) ile yakındır; "尽量" bir dereceyi/ölçüyü mümkün olduğunca yükseltmeyi, "尽力" ise bütün gücünü ortaya koymayı vurgular. Türkçedeki "elden geldiğince, mümkün olduğunca, olabildiğince, elimden geleni yaparım" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir çabayı ölçülü ama içten biçimde ifade etmenin yoludur.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ jǐn liàng zài xià bān qián bǎ zhè fèn bào gào xiě wán, nǐ fàng xīn。
examples.en: I'll try to finish this report before work ends; rest assured.

examples.zh: 路上不太好走,你开车尽量慢一点,注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Lù shàng bù tài hǎo zǒu, nǐ kāi chē jǐn liàng màn yì diǎn, zhù yì ān quán。
examples.en: The road isn't easy; drive as slowly as you can and stay safe.

examples.zh: 孩子睡着了,大家说话尽量小声一点。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi shuì zháo le, dà jiā shuō huà jǐn liàng xiǎo shēng yì diǎn。
examples.en: The child is asleep; everyone please keep your voices as low as possible.

examples.zh: 为了健康,平时尽量少吃油腻和过咸的食物。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le jiàn kāng, píng shí jǐn liàng shǎo chī yóu nì hé guò xián de shí wù。
examples.en: For health, try to eat as little greasy and salty food as possible.

examples.zh: 我尽量抽时间去看你,不过最近实在太忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jǐn liàng chōu shí jiān qù kàn nǐ, bù guò zuì jìn shí zài tài máng。
examples.en: I'll try to make time to see you, but I've been really busy lately.

examples.zh: 写文章的时候,尽量用简单明了的句子。
examples.pinyin: Xiě wén zhāng de shí hòu, jǐn liàng yòng jiǎn dān míng liǎo de jù zi。
examples.en: When writing, use sentences as simple and clear as possible.

examples.zh: 既然答应了别人,就尽量说到做到。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán dā yìng le bié rén, jiù jǐn liàng shuō dào zuò dào。
examples.en: Since you promised someone, try your best to follow through.

examples.zh: 天气冷了,出门尽量多穿点,别着凉了。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì lěng le, chū mén jǐn liàng duō chuān diǎn, bié zháo liáng le。
examples.en: It's cold; wear as much as you can when out, don't catch a chill.

examples.zh: 这件事尽量别让老人知道,免得他们担心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jǐn liàng bié ràng lǎo rén zhī dào, miǎn de tā men dān xīn。
examples.en: Try not to let the elderly know about this, lest they worry.

examples.zh: 时间紧张,大家尽量提高效率,争取按时完成。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān jǐn zhāng, dà jiā jǐn liàng tí gāo xiào lǜ, zhēng qǔ àn shí wán chéng。
examples.en: Time is tight; everyone try to work efficiently and finish on time.

examples.zh: 你有什么困难尽量提出来,我们一起想办法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shén me kùn nán jǐn liàng tí chū lái, wǒ men yì qǐ xiǎng bàn fǎ。
examples.en: Raise whatever difficulties you have; we'll figure them out together.

examples.zh: 为了不打扰邻居,晚上尽量不要制造太大的噪音。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le bù dǎ rǎo lín jū, wǎn shàng jǐn liàng bú yào zhì zào tài dà de zào yīn。
examples.en: To avoid disturbing neighbors, try not to make too much noise at night.

examples.zh: 我尽量满足你们的要求,不过有些确实做不到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jǐn liàng mǎn zú nǐ men de yāo qiú, bù guò yǒu xiē què shí zuò bú dào。
examples.en: I'll try to meet your requests, but some truly can't be done.

examples.zh: 学一门语言,平时要尽量多听多说多练。
examples.pinyin: Xué yī mén yǔ yán, píng shí yào jǐn liàng duō tīng duō shuō duō liàn。
examples.en: Learning a language, try to listen, speak, and practice as much as possible.

examples.zh: 买东西的时候,尽量货比三家,别冲动消费。
examples.pinyin: Mǎi dōng xī de shí hòu, jǐn liàng huò bǐ sān jiā, bié chōng dòng xiāo fèi。
examples.en: When shopping, compare a few shops and avoid impulse buying.

examples.zh: 既然来了,就尽量放松,好好享受这次假期。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán lái le, jiù jǐn liàng fàng sōng, hǎo hǎo xiǎng shòu zhè cì jià qī。
examples.en: Since you've come, relax as much as you can and enjoy the holiday.

examples.zh: 回答问题的时候,尽量说得具体一些,别太笼统。
examples.pinyin: Huí dá wèn tí de shí hòu, jǐn liàng shuō de jù tǐ yī xiē, bié tài lǒng tǒng。
examples.en: When answering, be as specific as possible, not too vague.

examples.zh: 为了赶时间,我们尽量抄近路走。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le gǎn shí jiān, wǒ men jǐn liàng chāo jìn lù zǒu。
examples.en: To save time, we took the shortest route we could.

examples.zh: 你身体不好,以后尽量别熬夜了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēn tǐ bù hǎo, yǐ hòu jǐn liàng bié áo yè le。
examples.en: Your health isn't good; try not to stay up late from now on.

examples.zh: 有意见尽量当面说清楚,别在背后议论。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yì jiàn jǐn liàng dāng miàn shuō qīng chǔ, bié zài bèi hòu yì lùn。
examples.en: Air your opinions to one's face as much as possible, don't gossip behind backs.

examples.zh: 这些贵重物品,你尽量随身带着,别乱放。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē guì zhòng wù pǐn, nǐ jǐn liàng suí shēn dài zhe, bié luàn fàng。
examples.en: Keep these valuables on you as much as you can; don't leave them around.

examples.zh: 我尽量赶在会议开始之前到,不让大家等我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jǐn liàng gǎn zài huì yì kāi shǐ zhī qián dào, bù ràng dà jiā děng wǒ。
examples.en: I'll try to arrive before the meeting starts so no one waits.

examples.zh: 照顾病人,饮食上要尽量清淡、有营养。
examples.pinyin: Zhào gù bìng rén, yǐn shí shàng yào jǐn liàng qīng dàn、 yǒu yíng yǎng。
examples.en: In caring for a patient, keep the diet as light and nutritious as possible.

examples.zh: 遇到分歧的时候,双方尽量心平气和地沟通。
examples.pinyin: Yù dào fēn qí de shí hòu, shuāng fāng jǐn liàng xīn píng qì hé de gōu tōng。
examples.en: When disagreements arise, both sides should communicate as calmly as possible.

examples.zh: 时间有限,发言尽量简短,把重点说清楚就行。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān yǒu xiàn, fā yán jǐn liàng jiǎn duǎn, bǎ zhòng diǎn shuō qīng chǔ jiù xíng。
examples.en: Time is limited; keep speeches as brief as possible, just make the point clear.

title: "甚至" ile "hatta, bile"
summary: "甚至" (shènzhì) en uç bir örneği vurgular: 他忙得甚至忘了吃饭 = O kadar meşguldü ki yemeği bile unuttu.
explanation: "甚至" bir dizideki EN UÇ, en beklenmedik ya da en aşırı örneği öne çıkarıp "hatta, dahası, ...-e kadar, ... bile" der ve böylece söylenenin ne derece ileri gittiğini vurgular: 他很努力,甚至连周末都不休息 (Çok çalışkan, hatta hafta sonu bile dinlenmiyor), 这道题太难了,甚至老师也一时做不出来 (Bu soru öyle zor ki hatta öğretmen bile bir anda çözemedi). Bir öğeyi (isim, fiil, cümle) vurgulayarak bir artışın/dizinin en uç noktasını gösterir; çoğu zaman "连...都/也" ile birlikte gelir (甚至连...都...). Önceki ifadeyi daha da ileri götüren bir ekleme bildirir. Türkçedeki "hatta, dahası, ...-e kadar, ... bile" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir durumun uç bir örnekle ne kadar ileri gittiğini vurgulamanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 他工作起来非常投入,甚至连吃饭都忘了。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōng zuò qǐ lái fēi cháng tóu rù, shèn zhì lián chī fàn dōu wàng le。
examples.en: He's so absorbed in work that he even forgets to eat.

examples.zh: 这个消息传得很快,甚至连隔壁村的人都知道了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāo xī chuán de hěn kuài, shèn zhì lián gé bì cūn de rén dōu zhī dào le。
examples.en: The news spread so fast that even the next village knew.

examples.zh: 他很少发脾气,甚至在最困难的时候也很冷静。

examples.zh: 那本书很受欢迎,甚至被翻译成了十几种语言。

examples.zh: 他学得特别快,甚至比教他的老师还厉害。

examples.zh: 他忙得连轴转,甚至好几天都没能好好睡一觉。

examples.zh: 她对工作非常认真,甚至休假的时候也放心不下。

examples.zh: 他记忆力惊人,甚至能记住每个人的生日。
examples.pinyin: Tā jì yì lì jīng rén, shèn zhì néng jì zhù měi gè rén de shēng rì。
examples.en: His memory is amazing; he can even recall everyone's birthday.

examples.zh: 这个孩子很懂事,甚至会主动帮妈妈做家务。

examples.en: This child is so sensible he even helps mom with chores on his own.

examples.zh: 他为了省钱,甚至连一瓶水都舍不得买。

examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng bǐ sài tài jīng cǎi le, shèn zhì lián bù xǐ huān yùn dòng de rén dōu kàn de rù mí。

examples.zh: 他的汉语说得很地道,甚至能听懂很多方言。

examples.zh: 这种技术非常先进,甚至可以在黑暗中工作。

examples.en: This technology is so advanced it can even work in the dark.

examples.zh: 他太紧张了,甚至把准备好的台词全忘了。
examples.pinyin: Tā tài jǐn zhāng le, shèn zhì bǎ zhǔn bèi hǎo de tái cí quán wàng le。

examples.zh: 这家餐厅生意火爆,甚至要提前一个星期订位。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng shēng yì huǒ bào, shèn zhì yào tí qián yí gè xīng qī dìng wèi。
examples.en: This restaurant is so busy you even have to book a week ahead.

examples.zh: 他对家乡的感情很深,甚至连口音都一直没变。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì jiā xiāng de gǎn qíng hěn shēn, shèn zhì lián kǒu yīn dōu yì zhí méi biàn。
examples.en: His feelings for home run deep; even his accent never changed.

examples.zh: 这场大雪下得很大,甚至压断了不少树枝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà xuě xià de hěn dà, shèn zhì yā duàn le bù shǎo shù zhī。
examples.en: This snow fell so heavily it even snapped many branches.

examples.zh: 他做事非常细心,甚至连标点符号都不放过。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì fēi cháng xì xīn, shèn zhì lián biāo diǎn fú hào dōu bù fàng guò。
examples.en: He's so meticulous he doesn't even overlook punctuation.

examples.zh: 那位老人身体很好,甚至还能自己下地干活。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo rén shēn tǐ hěn hǎo, shèn zhì hái néng zì jǐ xià de gàn huó。
examples.en: That old man is so healthy he can even work the fields himself.

examples.zh: 这件事让他很受打击,甚至一度想要放弃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì ràng tā hěn shòu dǎ jī, shèn zhì yí dù xiǎng yào fàng qì。
examples.en: This dealt him a blow; he even thought of giving up at one point.

examples.zh: 他的画很受欢迎,甚至有人愿意出高价收藏。
examples.pinyin: Tā de huà hěn shòu huān yíng, shèn zhì yǒu rén yuàn yì chū gāo jià shōu cáng。
examples.en: His paintings are so popular some even pay high prices to collect them.

examples.zh: 这个软件功能很强大,甚至能自动翻译多国语言。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge ruǎn jiàn gōng néng hěn qiáng dà, shèn zhì néng zì dòng fān yì duō guó yǔ yán。
examples.en: This software is so powerful it can even auto-translate many languages.

examples.zh: 他为了照顾病人,甚至把自己累病了。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi le zhào gù bìng rén, shèn zhì bǎ zì jǐ lèi bìng le。
examples.en: In caring for the patient, he even fell ill from exhaustion.

title: "尽管" ile "çekinmeden / her ne kadar"
pattern: 尽管 + Fiil / 尽管 ...，还是 ...
summary: "尽管" (jǐnguǎn) iki anlam taşır: "çekinmeden, gönül rahatlığıyla ..." (尽管说) ve "her ne kadar ... yine de ..." (尽管...还是...).
explanation: "尽管" iki farklı işlev taşır: (1) BİR FİİLİN ÖNÜNDE zarf olarak "çekinmeden, gönül rahatlığıyla, hiç sakınmadan" der ve bir ricayı/izni cömertçe sunar: 有什么问题尽管问 (Ne sorun varsa çekinmeden sor), 需要帮忙尽管说 (Yardım lazımsa gönül rahatlığıyla söyle). (2) BAĞLAÇ olarak "her ne kadar, ...-e rağmen" — çoğu zaman "尽管...还是/但是..." biçiminde bir taviz-zıtlık kurar: 尽管天气很冷,他还是坚持晨跑 (Hava çok soğuk olsa da yine de sabah koşusunu sürdürdü). İkinci anlamda "虽然"e benzer ama "尽管" biraz daha güçlü/resmî bir taviz bildirir. Hangi anlamda olduğunu yapı belirler: tek başına fiil önünde = "çekinmeden"; ikinci bir zıt cümleyle = "her ne kadar". Türkçedeki "çekinmeden, gönül rahatlığıyla" (izin) ve "her ne kadar ... yine de ..., ...-e rağmen" (taviz) ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 有什么需要帮忙的,你尽管开口,别客气。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me xū yào bāng máng de, nǐ jǐn guǎn kāi kǒu, bié kè qì。
examples.en: If you need any help, feel free to ask; don't be shy.

examples.zh: 这些书你尽管拿去看,看完了再还给我就行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē shū nǐ jǐn guǎn ná qù kàn, kàn wán le zài huán gěi wǒ jiù xíng。
examples.en: Feel free to take these books to read; return them when done.

examples.zh: 尽管外面下着大雨,他还是准时赶到了会场。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn wài miàn xià zhe dà yǔ, tā hái shì zhǔn shí gǎn dào le huì chǎng。
examples.en: Although it was pouring outside, he still arrived at the venue on time.

examples.zh: 你有什么想法尽管说,我们一起讨论讨论。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shén me xiǎng fǎ jǐn guǎn shuō, wǒ men yì qǐ tǎo lùn tǎo lùn。
examples.en: Share whatever ideas you have; let's discuss them together.

examples.zh: 尽管大家都劝他休息,他还是坚持把工作做完。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn dà jiā dōu quàn tā xiū xī, tā hái shì jiān chí bǎ gōng zuò zuò wán。
examples.en: Although everyone urged him to rest, he insisted on finishing the work.

examples.zh: 菜还有很多,你们尽管吃,别不好意思。
examples.pinyin: Cài hái yǒu hěn duō, nǐ men jǐn guǎn chī, bié bù hǎo yì sī。
examples.en: There's plenty of food; help yourselves, don't be shy.

examples.zh: 尽管困难重重,他们还是没有放弃最初的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn kùn nán chóng chóng, tā men hái shì méi yǒu fàng qì zuì chū de mèng xiǎng。
examples.en: Despite many difficulties, they never gave up their original dream.

examples.zh: 如果觉得价钱不合适,你尽管还价,别客气。
examples.pinyin: Rú guǒ jué de jià qián bù hé shì, nǐ jǐn guǎn huán jià, bié kè qì。
examples.en: If you feel the price is off, feel free to bargain.

examples.zh: 尽管年纪大了,爷爷还是每天坚持读书看报。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn nián jì dà le, yé yé hái shì měi tiān jiān chí dú shū kàn bào。
examples.en: Although he's old, grandpa still reads books and papers every day.

examples.zh: 这里的东西你尽管用,就当在自己家一样。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de dōng xī nǐ jǐn guǎn yòng, jiù dāng zài zì jǐ jiā yī yàng。
examples.en: Feel free to use anything here; treat it like your own home.

examples.zh: 尽管这条路又远又难走,我们还是坚持走了下去。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn zhè tiáo lù yòu yuǎn yòu nán zǒu, wǒ men hái shì jiān chí zǒu le xià qù。
examples.en: Although this road was far and rough, we persisted.

examples.zh: 有意见你尽管提,我们一定认真考虑。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yì jiàn nǐ jǐn guǎn tí, wǒ men yí dìng rèn zhēn kǎo lǜ。
examples.en: Feel free to raise objections; we'll seriously consider them.

examples.zh: 尽管他解释了很多遍,大家还是有些不太理解。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn tā jiě shì le hěn duō biàn, dà jiā hái shì yǒu xiē bù tài lǐ jiě。
examples.en: Although he explained many times, people still didn't quite understand.

examples.zh: 你尽管放心去忙,家里的事有我照应着。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐn guǎn fàng xīn qù máng, jiā lǐ de shì yǒu wǒ zhào yìng zhe。
examples.en: Go handle your business with a free mind; I'll look after home.

examples.zh: 尽管收入不高,他还是坚持每月资助山区的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn shōu rù bù gāo, tā hái shì jiān chí měi yuè zī zhù shān qū de hái zi。
examples.en: Although his income is low, he still supports mountain children monthly.

examples.zh: 有什么困难尽管来找我,我一定尽力帮你。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me kùn nán jǐn guǎn lái zhǎo wǒ, wǒ yí dìng jìn lì bāng nǐ。
examples.en: Come to me with any difficulty; I'll do my best to help.

examples.zh: 尽管大家都不看好,他还是坚持了自己的选择。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn dà jiā dōu bù kàn hǎo, tā hái shì jiān chí le zì jǐ de xuǎn zé。
examples.en: Although no one was optimistic, he stuck to his choice.

examples.zh: 这里的水果新鲜又便宜,你们尽管挑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de shuǐ guǒ xīn xiān yòu pián yi, nǐ men jǐn guǎn tiāo。
examples.en: The fruit here is fresh and cheap; pick as you please.

examples.zh: 尽管已经很晚了,他还是把今天的任务全部完成了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn yǐ jīng hěn wǎn le, tā hái shì bǎ jīn tiān de rèn wù quán bù wán chéng le。
examples.en: Although it was very late, he still finished all of today's tasks.

examples.zh: 你尽管试,做坏了也没关系,重要的是敢于尝试。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐn guǎn shì, zuò huài le yě méi guān xì, zhòng yào de shì gǎn yú cháng shì。
examples.en: Feel free to try; it's fine if it fails, what matters is daring to try.

examples.zh: 尽管身体不太舒服,她还是坚持给学生上完了课。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn shēn tǐ bù tài shū fú, tā hái shì jiān chí gěi xué shēng shàng wán le kè。
examples.en: Although unwell, she insisted on finishing the class for her students.

examples.zh: 有什么不懂的地方,你尽管问,我很乐意解答。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu shén me bù dǒng de dì fāng, nǐ jǐn guǎn wèn, wǒ hěn lè yì jiě dá。
examples.en: Feel free to ask anything you don't understand; I'm glad to explain.

examples.zh: 尽管遭遇了不少挫折,他对未来还是充满信心。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn zāo yù le bù shǎo cuò zhé, tā duì wèi lái hái shì chōng mǎn xìn xīn。
examples.en: Despite many setbacks, he remains full of confidence in the future.

examples.zh: 这些工具你尽管用,用完放回原处就行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē gōng jù nǐ jǐn guǎn yòng, yòng wán fàng huí yuán chù jiù xíng。
examples.en: Feel free to use these tools; just put them back when done.

examples.zh: 尽管前路充满未知,他们还是勇敢地出发了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn qián lù chōng mǎn wèi zhī, tā men hái shì yǒng gǎn de chū fā le。
examples.en: Although the road ahead was uncertain, they set off bravely.

title: "不得不" ile "...-mek zorunda kalmak"
summary: "不得不" (bùdébù) çaresizce bir şeyi yapmak zorunda kalmayı bildirir: 我不得不承认自己错了 = Hatalı olduğumu kabul etmek zorunda kaldım.
explanation: "不得不" ikili olumsuzluk (不 + 得不) yoluyla güçlü bir MECBURİYET bildirir: "...-mek zorunda kalmak, mecburen ...-mek, istemeye istemeye ...-mek". Fiilin önünde gelir: 天太晚了,我不得不打车回家 (Çok geç oldu, taksiye binmek zorunda kaldım), 为了照顾生病的母亲,她不得不辞去工作 (Hasta annesine bakmak için işten ayrılmak zorunda kaldı). Dış koşulların dayattığı, gönülsüzce yapılan bir eylemi anlatır; "只好" ile yakındır ama "不得不" ikili olumsuzluğun kattığı güçlü bir kaçınılmazlık/zorunluluk vurgusu taşır. "得" (děi, gereklilik) yapısının daha vurgulu, "başka çare yok" biçimidir. Türkçedeki "...-mek zorunda kalmak, mecburen, istemeye istemeye, ...-maktan başka çare olmamak" ifadelerine denk gelir; kaçınılmaz bir mecburiyeti anlatmanın güçlü bir yoludur.

examples.zh: 由于突然停电,今天的活动不得不临时取消。
examples.pinyin: Yóu yú tū rán tíng diàn, jīn tiān de huó dòng bù de bù lín shí qǔ xiāo。
examples.en: Due to a sudden power cut, today's event had to be canceled.

examples.zh: 为了照顾生病的父亲,他不得不推迟了出国的计划。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le zhào gù shēng bìng de fù qīn, tā bù de bù tuī chí le chū guó de jì huà。
examples.en: To care for his sick father, he had to postpone his plan to go abroad.

examples.zh: 看到大家都这么坚持,我也不得不改变了原来的看法。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào dà jiā dōu zhè me jiān chí, wǒ yě bù de bù gǎi biàn le yuán lái de kàn fǎ。
examples.en: Seeing everyone so insistent, I had to change my original view.

examples.zh: 外面的雨越下越大,我们不得不在屋檐下躲了很久。
examples.pinyin: Wài miàn de yǔ yuè xià yuè dà, wǒ men bù de bù zài wū yán xià duǒ le hěn jiǔ。
examples.en: The rain grew heavier, so we had to shelter under the eaves for long.

examples.zh: 面对这么多确凿的证据,他不得不承认了错误。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì zhè me duō què záo de zhèng jù, tā bù de bù chéng rèn le cuò wù。
examples.en: Faced with so much solid evidence, he had to admit his mistake.

examples.zh: 因为航班延误,他们不得不在机场过了一夜。
examples.pinyin: Yīn wèi háng bān yán wù, tā men bù de bù zài jī chǎng guò le yī yè。
examples.en: Because of the flight delay, they had to spend the night at the airport.

examples.zh: 由于资金不足,这个项目不得不暂时搁置。
examples.pinyin: Yóu yú zī jīn bù zú, zhè ge xiàng mù bù de bù zàn shí gē zhì。
examples.en: Due to insufficient funds, the project had to be shelved for now.

examples.zh: 孩子哭闹得太厉害,妈妈不得不放下手里的活儿去哄他。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi kū nào de tài lì hài, mā mā bù de bù fàng xià shǒu lǐ de huó er qù hǒng tā。
examples.en: The child cried so hard that mom had to put down her work to soothe him.

examples.zh: 时间实在来不及了,我们不得不放弃最后一个景点。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān shí zài lái bù jí le, wǒ men bù de bù fàng qì zuì hòu yí gè jǐng diǎn。
examples.en: There really wasn't time, so we had to skip the last attraction.

examples.zh: 他说的话很有道理,我不得不佩服他的眼光。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà hěn yǒu dào lǐ, wǒ bù de bù pèi fú tā de yǎn guāng。
examples.en: What he said made sense; I had to admire his insight.

examples.zh: 因为下大雪,原定的比赛不得不推迟到下周。
examples.pinyin: Yīn wèi xià dà xuě, yuán dìng de bǐ sài bù de bù tuī chí dào xià zhōu。
examples.en: Because of heavy snow, the scheduled match had to be postponed to next week.

examples.zh: 公司经营困难,老板不得不裁掉了一部分员工。
examples.pinyin: Gōng sī jīng yíng kùn nán, lǎo bǎn bù de bù cái diào le yī bù fèn yuán gōng。
examples.en: The company struggled, so the boss had to lay off some staff.

examples.zh: 为了赶上末班车,我们不得不加快了脚步。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le gǎn shàng mò bān chē, wǒ men bù de bù jiā kuài le jiǎo bù。
examples.en: To catch the last bus, we had to quicken our pace.

examples.zh: 面对现实的压力,他不得不放弃了自己的爱好。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì xiàn shí de yā lì, tā bù de bù fàng qì le zì jǐ de ài hào。
examples.en: Facing real pressure, he had to give up his hobby.

examples.zh: 既然大家意见不一致,我们不得不重新讨论方案。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán dà jiā yì jiàn bù yī zhì, wǒ men bù de bù chóng xīn tǎo lùn fāng àn。
examples.en: Since opinions differed, we had to discuss the plan again.

examples.zh: 因为身体的原因,这位老运动员不得不退役了。
examples.pinyin: Yīn wèi shēn tǐ de yuán yīn, zhè wèi lǎo yùn dòng yuán bù de bù tuì yì le。
examples.en: For health reasons, this veteran athlete had to retire.

examples.zh: 眼看天就要黑了,我们不得不结束了这次登山。
examples.pinyin: Yǎn kàn tiān jiù yào hēi le, wǒ men bù de bù jié shù le zhè cì dēng shān。
examples.en: As it was getting dark, we had to end the climb.

examples.zh: 由于原材料涨价,产品的价格不得不做出调整。
examples.pinyin: Yóu yú yuán cái liào zhǎng jià, chǎn pǐn de jià gé bù de bù zuò chū tiáo zhěng。
examples.en: Due to rising material costs, the product price had to be adjusted.

examples.zh: 他生病住院,不得不请了一个多月的长假。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēng bìng zhù yuàn, bù de bù qǐng le yí gè duō yuè de cháng jià。
examples.en: He was hospitalized and had to take over a month of leave.

examples.zh: 为了不让家人担心,他不得不隐瞒了真实的病情。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le bù ràng jiā rén dān xīn, tā bù de bù yǐn mán le zhēn shí de bìng qíng。
examples.en: So his family wouldn't worry, he had to hide his true condition.

examples.zh: 那条路正在施工,我们不得不绕道而行。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiáo lù zhèng zài shī gōng, wǒ men bù de bù rào dào ér xíng。
examples.en: That road was under construction, so we had to take a detour.

examples.zh: 由于对方一再拖延,这笔生意不得不告吹。
examples.pinyin: Yóu yú duì fāng yī zài tuō yán, zhè bǐ shēng yì bù de bù gào chuī。
examples.en: Due to the other side's repeated delays, the deal had to fall through.

examples.zh: 孩子到了上学的年龄,他们不得不搬到城里去住。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi dào le shàng xué de nián líng, tā men bù de bù bān dào chéng lǐ qù zhù。
examples.en: The child reached school age, so they had to move to the city.

examples.zh: 面对众人的期待,他不得不硬着头皮上台发言。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì zhòng rén de qī dài, tā bù de bù yìng zhe tóu pí shàng tái fā yán。
examples.en: Facing everyone's expectations, he had to steel himself and speak on stage.

examples.zh: 因为经费有限,这次研究不得不缩小了规模。
examples.pinyin: Yīn wèi jīng fèi yǒu xiàn, zhè cì yán jiū bù de bù suō xiǎo le guī mó。
examples.en: Due to limited funds, this research had to be scaled down.

title: "到底" ile "ne oldu, sonunda, bir türlü"
summary: "到底" (dàodǐ) sorularda sabırsız "ne oldu, hangisi, kim ki" vurgusu; düz cümlede "sonunda, nihayet" ya da "ne de olsa" anlamı taşır.
explanation: "到底" birkaç işlev taşır: (1) SORULARDA sabırsızlık/ısrar — "bir türlü, ne oldu, hangisi ki, kim ki": 你到底去不去? (Gidiyor musun gitmiyor musun, karar ver!), 这到底是怎么回事? (Bu da ne demek oluyor?). ÖNEMLİ: "到底"li soru "吗" ALMAZ (zaten pekiştirilmiş bir sorudur); olumlu-olumsuz (去不去) ya da soru sözcüğü ile gelir. (2) DÜZ cümlede "sonunda, nihayet" (bir sürecin sonucu): 经过努力,他到底还是成功了 (Çabaların ardından sonunda başardı). (3) "ne de olsa, sonuçta" (毕竟'e yakın): 他到底是长辈,你要尊重他 (Ne de olsa büyüğün, ona saygı göstermelisin). Kelime kelime "dibe kadar" demektir; ısrarla bir sonuca/gerçeğe ulaşma fikrini taşır. Türkçedeki "bir türlü, ne oldu, sonunda, nihayet, ne de olsa" karşılıklarına bağlama göre denk gelir; sabırsız soru ve nihai sonuç anlatmanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 你到底想不想去,给个准话,别一直犹豫。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù, gěi gè zhǔn huà, bié yì zhí yóu yù。
examples.en: Do you want to go or not? Give a firm answer, stop hesitating.

examples.zh: 这件事到底是谁做的,你必须跟我说清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dào dǐ shì shuí zuò de, nǐ bì xū gēn wǒ shuō qīng chǔ。
examples.en: Who exactly did this? You must tell me clearly.

examples.zh: 经过一年的努力,他到底还是考上了理想的大学。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī nián de nǔ lì, tā dào dǐ hái shì kǎo shàng le lǐ xiǎng de dà xué。
examples.en: After a year of effort, he finally got into his dream university.

examples.zh: 你到底在担心什么?有什么话就直接说出来。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ zài dān xīn shén me? yǒu shén me huà jiù zhí jiē shuō chū lái。
examples.en: What on earth are you worried about? Just say it directly.

examples.zh: 他到底是过来人,几句话就说到了问题的关键。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào dǐ shì guò lái rén, jǐ jù huà jiù shuō dào le wèn tí de guān jiàn。
examples.en: He's been through it, after all; a few words hit the heart of the matter.

examples.zh: 我们讨论了半天,到底也没得出一个结论。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men tǎo lùn le bàn tiān, dào dǐ yě méi dé chū yí gè jié lùn。
examples.en: We discussed for a long while but reached no conclusion in the end.

examples.zh: 这道题到底应该怎么解,你能给我讲讲吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí dào dǐ yīng gāi zěn me jiě, nǐ néng gěi wǒ jiǎng jiǎng ma?
examples.en: How exactly should this problem be solved? Can you explain?

examples.zh: 折腾了这么久,事情到底还是解决了,大家都松了口气。
examples.pinyin: Zhē teng le zhè me jiǔ, shì qíng dào dǐ hái shì jiě jué le, dà jiā dōu sōng le kǒu qì。
examples.en: After all the fuss, the matter was finally solved, to everyone's relief.

examples.zh: 你到底站在哪一边?总得有个明确的态度吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ zhàn zài nǎ yī biān? zǒng de yǒu gè míng què de tài dù ba。
examples.en: Whose side are you on, really? You must have a clear stance.

examples.zh: 他到底是有经验,处理起这种事来得心应手。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào dǐ shì yǒu jīng yàn, chǔ lǐ qǐ zhè zhǒng shì lái de xīn yìng shǒu。
examples.en: He's experienced, after all; he handles such things with ease.

examples.zh: 这么晚了他到底去哪儿了?怎么还不回来?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn le tā dào dǐ qù nǎ ér le? zěn me hái bù huí lái?
examples.en: Where on earth did he go this late? Why isn't he back?

examples.zh: 经过反复修改,这篇文章到底让他满意了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò fǎn fù xiū gǎi, zhè piān wén zhāng dào dǐ ràng tā mǎn yì le。
examples.en: After repeated revisions, he was finally satisfied with the article.

examples.zh: 你到底听懂了没有?听懂了就点点头。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ tīng dǒng le méi yǒu? tīng dǒng le jiù diǎn diǎn tóu。
examples.en: Did you actually understand? Nod if you did.

examples.zh: 孩子到底还小,做错了事你别太严厉。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi dào dǐ hái xiǎo, zuò cuò liǎo shì nǐ bié tài yán lì。
examples.en: The child is young, after all; don't be too harsh when he errs.

examples.zh: 这场比赛到底谁赢谁输,现在还很难说。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐ sài dào dǐ shuí yíng shuí shū, xiàn zài hái hěn nán shuō。
examples.en: Who will win or lose this match is still hard to say.

examples.zh: 他到底为什么突然辞职,谁也不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào dǐ wèi shén me tū rán cí zhí, shuí yě bù qīng chǔ。
examples.en: Why exactly he suddenly resigned, no one is clear about.

examples.zh: 坚持了这么多年,他到底实现了自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Jiān chí le zhè me duō nián, tā dào dǐ shí xiàn le zì jǐ de mèng xiǎng。
examples.en: Having persevered for years, he finally realized his dream.

examples.zh: 你到底要买哪一件?店都快关门了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ yào mǎi nǎ yī jiàn? diàn dōu kuài guān mén le。
examples.en: Which one are you actually buying? The shop's about to close.

examples.zh: 他到底年轻,恢复得很快,没几天就活蹦乱跳了。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào dǐ nián qīng, huī fù de hěn kuài, méi jǐ tiān jiù huó bèng luàn tiào le。
examples.en: He's young, after all; he recovered fast and was lively in days.

examples.zh: 这件事到底该不该告诉他,我一直拿不定主意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dào dǐ gāi bù gāi gào sù tā, wǒ yì zhí ná bù dìng zhǔ yì。
examples.en: Whether to tell him this, I really can't decide.

examples.zh: 经历了那么多波折,他们到底走到了一起。
examples.pinyin: Jīng lì le nà me duō bō zhé, tā men dào dǐ zǒu dào le yì qǐ。
examples.en: After so many twists, they finally came together.

examples.zh: 你到底有没有把我的话放在心上?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dào dǐ yǒu méi yǒu bǎ wǒ de huà fàng zài xīn shàng?
examples.en: Have you actually taken my words to heart?

examples.zh: 这个谜团到底还是被他解开了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge mí tuán dào dǐ hái shì bèi tā jiě kāi le。
examples.en: This mystery was finally unraveled by him.

examples.zh: 大家吵来吵去,到底也没弄明白问题出在哪儿。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā chǎo lái chǎo qù, dào dǐ yě méi nòng míng bái wèn tí chū zài nǎ ér。
examples.en: Everyone argued, but in the end no one figured out where the problem was.

examples.zh: 他到底是自己的亲人,再生气也不能不管。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào dǐ shì zì jǐ de qīn rén, zài shēng qì yě bù néng bù guǎn。
examples.en: He's your own family, after all; however angry, you can't ignore him.

title: "究竟" ile "aslında, tam olarak"
summary: "究竟" (jiūjìng) bir sorudaki merakı/araştırmayı pekiştirir: 这究竟是怎么回事? = Bu tam olarak ne demek oluyor?
explanation: "究竟" bir soruyu pekiştirip gerçeği DERİNLEMESİNE öğrenme merakını/ısrarını bildirir: "tam olarak, aslında, esasen, bir bakalım ne". "到底"nin soru kullanımıyla çok yakındır ama "究竟" biraz daha RESMÎ/ciddi bir araştırma tonu taşır: 这件事究竟是谁的责任? (Bu işin sorumluluğu tam olarak kimde?), 我想弄清楚事情究竟是怎么发生的 (Olayın tam olarak nasıl olduğunu anlamak istiyorum). Genelde soru sözcükleriyle (谁, 什么, 怎么, 为什么, 哪个) ya da olumlu-olumsuz sorularla gelir ve "吗" ALMAZ. Ayrıca dolaylı sorularda (弄清楚...究竟...) gerçeği araştırma anlamı taşır. İsim olarak "özü, aslı" anlamına da gelir (问个究竟 = aslını sormak). Türkçedeki "tam olarak, aslında, esasen, gerçekte, bir bakalım ne" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir gerçeği kararlılıkla araştırmanın, resmî/ciddi bir merakla sormanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 这件事的真相究竟是什么,我们必须调查清楚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì de zhēn xiàng jiū jìng shì shén me, wǒ men bì xū diào chá qīng chǔ。
examples.en: What exactly is the truth of this matter? We must investigate it.

examples.zh: 你究竟为什么要这样做?能给我一个解释吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiū jìng wèi shén me yào zhè yàng zuò? néng gěi wǒ yí gè jiě shì ma?
examples.en: Why exactly did you do this? Can you give me an explanation?

examples.zh: 我一直想不明白,他究竟是从哪里得到这个消息的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yì zhí xiǎng bù míng bái, tā jiū jìng shì cóng nǎ lǐ dé dào zhè ge xiāo xī de。
examples.en: I keep wondering exactly where he got this news.

examples.zh: 这个问题究竟有没有解决的办法,请专家给个意见。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèn tí jiū jìng yǒu méi yǒu jiě jué de bàn fǎ, qǐng zhuān jiā gěi gè yì jiàn。
examples.en: Is there actually a solution to this? Please, an expert opinion.

examples.zh: 大家都想知道,这次实验究竟能不能成功。
examples.pinyin: Dà jiā dōu xiǎng zhī dào, zhè cì shí yàn jiū jìng néng bù néng chéng gōng。
examples.en: Everyone wants to know whether this experiment can actually succeed.

examples.zh: 你倒是说说,这件事究竟错在哪里。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎo shì shuō shuō, zhè jiàn shì jiū jìng cuò zài nǎ lǐ。
examples.en: Do tell — exactly where did this go wrong?

examples.zh: 我很好奇,他究竟是用什么方法在这么短时间里学会的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hào qí, tā jiū jìng shì yòng shén me fāng fǎ zài zhè me duǎn shí jiān lǐ xué huì de。
examples.en: I'm curious exactly how he learned it in such a short time.

examples.zh: 这两个方案究竟哪个更合适,我们再仔细比较一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè fāng àn jiū jìng nǎ ge gèng hé shì, wǒ men zài zǐ xì bǐ jiào yī xià。
examples.en: Which of these two plans is actually better? Let's compare carefully.

examples.zh: 面对大家的追问,他始终没说出事情的究竟。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì dà jiā de zhuī wèn, tā shǐ zhōng méi shuō chū shì qíng de jiū jìng。
examples.en: Faced with everyone's questioning, he never revealed the whole truth.

examples.zh: 你能不能告诉我,这一切究竟是怎么开始的?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng gào sù wǒ, zhè yī qiè jiū jìng shì zěn me kāi shǐ de?
examples.en: Can you tell me exactly how all this began?

examples.zh: 这笔钱究竟花到哪里去了,账目上一点儿也看不出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián jiū jìng huā dào nǎ lǐ qù le, zhàng mù shàng yì diǎn ér yě kàn bù chū lái。
examples.en: Where exactly did this money go? The accounts show nothing.

examples.zh: 我实在想弄清楚,问题的根源究竟在哪里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shí zài xiǎng nòng qīng chǔ, wèn tí de gēn yuán jiū jìng zài nǎ lǐ。
examples.en: I really want to figure out exactly where the problem's root lies.

examples.zh: 这么多年了,那件事的真相究竟如何,至今仍是个谜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián le, nà jiàn shì de zhēn xiàng jiū jìng rú hé, zhì jīn réng shì gè mí。

examples.zh: 你究竟站在谁那一边,今天必须表明态度。

examples.zh: 大家都在猜测,他究竟为什么会突然改变主意。

examples.zh: 这幅画究竟出自谁手,专家们至今争论不休。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà jiū jìng chū zì shuí shǒu, zhuān jiā men zhì jīn zhēng lùn bù xiū。

examples.zh: 我很想知道,这个决定究竟是经过深思熟虑的吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng zhī dào, zhè ge jué dìng jiū jìng shì jīng guò shēn sī shú lǜ de ma?

examples.zh: 面对记者,他终于说出了事情的究竟。

examples.en: Facing the reporters, he finally told the whole truth.

examples.zh: 你究竟同意还是不同意,请给个明确的答复。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiū jìng tóng yì hái shì bù tóng yì, qǐng gěi gè míng què de dá fù。

examples.zh: 这种药究竟有没有效果,还需要进一步的验证。

title: "干脆" ile "düpedüz, direkt, en iyisi"
summary: "干脆" (gāncuì) tereddüdü bırakıp kesin/direkt bir çözümü bildirir: 与其等着,不如干脆自己去 = Beklemektense en iyisi düpedüz kendin git.
explanation: "干脆" tereddüdü, yarım tedbirleri bırakıp DOĞRUDAN, kesin bir yol seçmeyi bildirir: "düpedüz, en iyisi, direkt, madem öyle bir çırpıda". Bir zarf olarak bir çözüm/karar önerir: 这么麻烦,咱们干脆别去了 (Bu kadar zahmetliyse en iyisi hiç gitmeyelim), 与其修来修去,干脆买个新的 (Tamir edip durmaktansa düpedüz yenisini al). Genelde "与其...干脆/不如..." ya da bir zorluk belirtildikten sonra "干脆 + kesin çözüm" biçiminde gelir. Bir işi yarım yamalak yapmaktansa kökten, net bir biçimde halletme fikrini taşır; çoğu zaman bir sabırsızlık ya da kararlılık tonu vardır. Ayrıca sıfat olarak "net, dobra, kararlı" anlamına da gelir (他说话很干脆 = dobra konuşur). Türkçedeki "düpedüz, en iyisi, direkt, madem öyle, bir çırpıda, keskin bir kararla" ifadelerine denk gelir; kararsızlığı bırakıp kesin bir çözüme yönelmenin yoludur.

examples.pinyin: Zhè me diǎn er lù, yǔ qí děng chē, bù rú gān cuì zǒu guò qù。

examples.zh: 这台旧电脑老出毛病,干脆换台新的算了。

examples.zh: 大家都到得差不多了,干脆现在就开始吧。

examples.zh: 反正今天也做不完了,干脆明天再一口气做完。

examples.zh: 他做事很干脆,从不拖泥带水,让人放心。

examples.zh: 既然大家都不方便,干脆把聚会改到周末吧。

examples.zh: 这条路太堵了,咱们干脆绕另一条路走。

examples.zh: 与其零零散散地学,不如干脆报个班系统地学。

examples.zh: 既然你这么喜欢,干脆送给你好了。

examples.zh: 这些旧衣服留着也没用,干脆都捐出去吧。

examples.zh: 既然误了这班车,干脆在附近吃点东西再等下一班。

examples.zh: 这个问题争来争去也没结果,干脆投票决定。

examples.zh: 反正闲着也是闲着,干脆把房间彻底打扫一遍。

examples.zh: 与其修修补补,干脆把整面墙重新刷一遍。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ qí xiū xiū bǔ bǔ, gān cuì bǎ zhěng miàn qiáng chóng xīn shuā yī biàn。
examples.en: Rather than patch it up, just repaint the whole wall.

examples.zh: 既然你们都想去,那我干脆也跟着一起去吧。

examples.zh: 这道题太费时间,干脆先跳过去,做后面的。

examples.zh: 他见劝不动我,干脆不再说什么了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiàn quàn bù dòng wǒ, gān cuì bù zài shuō shén me le。

examples.zh: 既然已经来了,干脆多待几天,好好玩玩再走。

title: "几乎" ile "neredeyse, az kalsın"
summary: "几乎" (jīhū) "neredeyse, hemen hemen, az kalsın" der: 我几乎每天都跑步 = Neredeyse her gün koşarım.
explanation: "几乎" bir durumun bir noktaya ÇOK YAKIN olduğunu ya da bir eylemin az kalsın gerçekleştiğini bildirir: "neredeyse, hemen hemen, az kalsın, hemen hemen tamamı". Fiil/sıfat/miktarın önünde gelir: 这本书我几乎看完了 (Bu kitabı neredeyse bitirdim), 他激动得几乎说不出话 (Heyecandan neredeyse konuşamadı), 几乎所有人都同意 (Neredeyse herkes kabul etti). "几乎" bir sınıra yaklaşmayı (ama tam ulaşmamayı) vurgular. Çoğu zaman "几乎+都" (neredeyse hepsi), "几乎没/不" (neredeyse hiç) kalıplarında gelir. "差不多" ile yakındır ama "几乎" biraz daha vurgulu/yazılı; ayrıca "几乎" olumsuzla "neredeyse hiç" der (几乎没时间). Bazen "几乎要...了" biçiminde "az kalsın olacaktı" anlamı da verir. Türkçedeki "neredeyse, hemen hemen, az kalsın, hemen hepsi/hiç" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir sınıra yaklaşmayı anlatmanın temel yoludur.

examples.zh: 这个消息传得很快,几乎全公司的人都知道了。

examples.zh: 他激动得几乎说不出话来,只是一个劲儿地流泪。

examples.zh: 最近工作太忙,我几乎没有时间陪家人。
examples.pinyin: Zuì jìn gōng zuò tài máng, wǒ jī hū méi yǒu shí jiān péi jiā rén。

examples.zh: 这两幅画看起来几乎一模一样,很难分辨。

examples.en: These two paintings look almost identical; hard to tell apart.

examples.zh: 经过一夜的大雨,河水几乎漫过了堤坝。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò yī yè de dà yǔ, hé shuǐ jī hū màn guò le dī bà。
examples.en: After a night of heavy rain, the river nearly overflowed the dam.

examples.zh: 他学得特别快,几乎一学就会,让老师很惊讶。
examples.pinyin: Tā xué de tè bié kuài, jī hū yī xué jiù huì, ràng lǎo shī hěn jīng yà。
examples.en: He learns so fast, almost getting it instantly, amazing the teacher.

examples.zh: 那天雾特别大,几乎看不清前面的路。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiān wù tè bié dà, jī hū kàn bù qīng qián miàn de lù。
examples.en: The fog was so thick that day you could barely see the road ahead.

examples.zh: 这道题太难了,几乎没有几个人能做出来。

examples.en: This problem is so hard that hardly anyone can solve it.

examples.zh: 他每天坚持锻炼,几乎从不间断。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān jiān chí duàn liàn, jī hū cóng bù jiàn duàn。
examples.en: He exercises daily and almost never misses a day.

examples.zh: 听到那个坏消息,她几乎当场就哭了出来。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào nà ge huài xiāo xī, tā jī hū dāng chǎng jiù kū le chū lái。
examples.en: Hearing the bad news, she almost cried on the spot.

examples.zh: 这本词典收录的词几乎涵盖了日常所有的表达。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn cí diǎn shōu lù de cí jī hū hán gài le rì cháng suǒ yǒu de biǎo dá。
examples.en: This dictionary covers almost all everyday expressions.

examples.zh: 由于常年在外,他几乎错过了孩子的整个童年。
examples.pinyin: Yóu yú cháng nián zài wài, tā jī hū cuò guò le hái zi de zhěng gè tóng nián。
examples.en: Being away for years, he nearly missed the child's entire childhood.

examples.zh: 这场比赛太激烈了,双方几乎打成了平手。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐ sài tài jī liè le, shuāng fāng jī hū dǎ chéng le píng shǒu。
examples.en: The match was so intense the two sides nearly ended in a draw.

examples.zh: 他家的书堆得到处都是,几乎没有下脚的地方。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiā de shū duī dé dào chù dōu shì, jī hū méi yǒu xià jiǎo de dì fāng。
examples.en: His home is piled with books, with almost no place to step.

examples.zh: 经过反复练习,他几乎能把整篇课文背下来了。

examples.en: After repeated practice, he can almost recite the whole text.

examples.zh: 那次事故太危险了,他几乎丢了性命。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì shì gù tài wēi xiǎn le, tā jī hū diū le xìng mìng。
examples.en: That accident was so dangerous he nearly lost his life.

examples.zh: 这种野花几乎在山里到处都能看到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yě huā jī hū zài shān lǐ dào chù dōu néng kàn dào。
examples.en: This wildflower can be seen almost everywhere in the mountains.

examples.zh: 忙了一整天,他几乎连一口水都没喝上。
examples.pinyin: Máng le yī zhěng tiān, tā jī hū lián yī kǒu shuǐ dōu méi hē shàng。
examples.en: Busy all day, he barely got even a sip of water.

examples.zh: 这两个双胞胎的性格几乎完全相反。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè shuāng bāo tāi de xìng gé jī hū wán quán xiāng fǎn。
examples.en: These twins have almost completely opposite personalities.

examples.zh: 他说的这番话,几乎让在场的每个人都很感动。

examples.en: His words moved nearly everyone present.

examples.zh: 由于长时间没有下雨,地里的庄稼几乎都旱死了。

examples.zh: 这家老店几十年了,味道几乎一点儿都没变。

examples.zh: 那段日子太苦了,他几乎撑不下去了。
