title: "再也不...了" ile "bir daha asla ...-mem"
pattern: Özne + 再也 + 不 / 没 + Fiil + 了
summary: "再也不/没...了" bir şeyin bir daha ASLA olmayacağını/olmadığını bildirir: 我再也不去那家店了 = O dükkâna bir daha asla gitmem.
explanation: "再也不...了" ve "再也没...了" bir eylemin bir daha ASLA gerçekleşmeyeceğini (gelecek) ya da hiç gerçekleşmediğini (geçmiş) güçlü biçimde bildirir: "再也" "bir daha (asla)" vurgusunu, olumsuzluk + cümle-sonu "了" ise kesin bitişi verir. (1) GELECEK niyet — "再也不...了": 我再也不熬夜了 (Bir daha asla gece geç saate kadar oturmam), 他发誓再也不抽烟了 (Bir daha asla sigara içmeyeceğine yemin etti). (2) GEÇMİŞ/hiç olmama — "再也没...了": 那次分别以后,我再也没见过他 (O ayrılıktan sonra onu bir daha hiç görmedim). "再" (tekrar) + "也" (bile) pekiştirmesiyle "asla bir daha" anlamı doğar. Güçlü bir kararlılık, pişmanlık ya da kesin bir son bildirir. Türkçedeki "bir daha asla ...-mem/...-medim, artık hiç ...-mem" ifadelerine denk gelir; kesin bir vazgeçişi ya da bitmiş bir durumu anlatmanın güçlü yoludur.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅服务太差了,我再也不来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cān tīng fú wù tài chà le, wǒ zài yě bù lái le。
examples.en: The service here is terrible; I'll never come again.

examples.zh: 经过那次教训,他发誓再也不酒后开车了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò nà cì jiào xùn, tā fā shì zài yě bù jiǔ hòu kāi chē le。
examples.en: After that lesson, he swore never to drink and drive again.

examples.zh: 自从他搬走以后,我们就再也没见过面。
examples.pinyin: Zì cóng tā bān zǒu yǐ hòu, wǒ men jiù zài yě méi jiàn guò miàn。
examples.en: Since he moved away, we've never met again.

examples.zh: 我再也不相信他的话了,他已经骗了我好几次。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài yě bù xiāng xìn tā de huà le, tā yǐ jīng piàn le wǒ hǎo jǐ cì。
examples.en: I'll never believe his words again; he's deceived me several times.

examples.zh: 那件事以后,他再也没提起过当年的伤心事。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì yǐ hòu, tā zài yě méi tí qǐ guò dàng nián de shāng xīn shì。
examples.en: After that, he never brought up the sad past again.

examples.zh: 这次考试考砸了,我下决心再也不偷懒了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì kǎo zá le, wǒ xià jué xīn zài yě bù tōu lǎn le。
examples.en: I failed this exam and resolved never to slack off again.

examples.zh: 那只小猫走丢以后,就再也没有回来过。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhǐ xiǎo māo zǒu diū yǐ hòu, jiù zài yě méi yǒu huí lái guò。
examples.en: After the kitten got lost, it never came back.

examples.zh: 被辣得直流眼泪以后,他说再也不吃那么辣的菜了。
examples.pinyin: Bèi là de zhí liú yǎn lèi yǐ hòu, tā shuō zài yě bù chī nà me là de cài le。
examples.en: After being brought to tears by the spice, he vowed never to eat it again.

examples.zh: 经历过那场大病,他再也不敢忽视自己的健康了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng lì guò nà chǎng dà bìng, tā zài yě bù gǎn hū shì zì jǐ de jiàn kāng le。
examples.en: After that serious illness, he never dared neglect his health again.

examples.zh: 奶奶去世以后,那间老屋就再也没有人住过了。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi qù shì yǐ hòu, nà jiān lǎo wū jiù zài yě méi yǒu rén zhù guò le。
examples.en: After grandma passed, no one ever lived in the old house again.

examples.zh: 我再也不会因为别人的一句话而轻易改变主意了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài yě bú huì yīn wèi bié rén de yī jù huà ér qīng yì gǎi biàn zhǔ yì le。
examples.en: I'll never easily change my mind over someone's words again.

examples.zh: 那次吵架以后,他们两个人再也没有说过话。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì chǎo jià yǐ hòu, tā men liǎng gè rén zài yě méi yǒu shuō guò huà。
examples.en: After that quarrel, the two of them never spoke again.

examples.zh: 被骗过一次以后,他再也不会随便相信陌生人了。
examples.pinyin: Bèi piàn guò yī cì yǐ hòu, tā zài yě bú huì suí biàn xiāng xìn mò shēng rén le。
examples.en: Having been deceived once, he'll never casually trust strangers again.

examples.zh: 自从那年离开,他就再也没回过那个小村子。
examples.pinyin: Zì cóng nà nián lí kāi, tā jiù zài yě méi huí guò nà ge xiǎo cūn zi。
examples.en: Since leaving that year, he never returned to that little village.

examples.zh: 我发誓,以后再也不把重要的事情拖到最后了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fā shì, yǐ hòu zài yě bù bǎ zhòng yào de shì qíng tuō dào zuì hòu le。
examples.en: I swear I'll never put off important things to the last minute again.

examples.zh: 那本书借出去以后,就再也没还回来。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn shū jiè chū qù yǐ hòu, jiù zài yě méi hái huí lái。
examples.en: After that book was lent out, it was never returned.

examples.zh: 经过这件事,他再也不敢小看任何一个对手了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zhè jiàn shì, tā zài yě bù gǎn xiǎo kàn rèn hé yí gè duì shǒu le。
examples.en: After this, he never dared underestimate any opponent again.

examples.zh: 孩子长大离家后,家里就再也没有以前那么热闹了。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi zhǎng dà lí jiā hòu, jiā lǐ jiù zài yě méi yǒu yǐ qián nà me rè nào le。
examples.en: After the child grew up and left, the home was never as lively.

examples.zh: 我再也不会让你一个人承受这么多了,有我陪着你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài yě bú huì ràng nǐ yí gè rén chéng shòu zhè me duō le, yǒu wǒ péi zhe nǐ。
examples.en: I'll never let you bear so much alone again; I'm here with you.

examples.zh: 那次失败让他明白,机会一旦错过就再也不会有了。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì shī bài ràng tā míng bái, jī huì yí dàn cuò guò jiù zài yě bú huì yǒu le。
examples.en: That failure taught him that a missed chance never comes again.

examples.zh: 戒烟以后,他再也没有碰过一根烟。
examples.pinyin: Jiè yān yǐ hòu, tā zài yě méi yǒu pèng guò yī gēn yān。
examples.en: Since quitting, he's never touched a single cigarette again.

examples.zh: 被那部电影感动以后,我再也忘不了那个结局。
examples.pinyin: Bèi nà bù diàn yǐng gǎn dòng yǐ hòu, wǒ zài yě wàng bù liǎo nà ge jié jú。
examples.en: After being moved by that movie, I could never forget the ending.

examples.zh: 经历过分离的痛苦,他们再也不愿意分开了。
examples.pinyin: Jīng lì guò fèn lí de tòng kǔ, tā men zài yě bù yuàn yì fēn kāi le。
examples.en: Having suffered the pain of separation, they never wanted to part again.

examples.zh: 那次以后,他再也没有迟到过,变得非常守时。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì yǐ hòu, tā zài yě méi yǒu chí dào guò, biàn de fēi cháng shǒu shí。
examples.en: After that, he was never late again and became very punctual.

examples.zh: 我再也不想过那种提心吊胆的日子了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài yě bù xiǎng guò nà zhǒng tí xīn diào dǎn de rì zi le。
examples.en: I never want to live those anxious, fearful days again.

title: "曾经" ile "bir zamanlar, vaktiyle"
summary: "曾经" (céngjīng) geçmişte bir zamanlar yaşanmış bir deneyimi bildirir: 我曾经去过那里 = Bir zamanlar oraya gitmiştim.
explanation: "曾经" geçmişte BİR ZAMANLAR gerçekleşmiş, artık sona ermiş bir eylemi/durumu bildirir: "bir zamanlar, vaktiyle, eskiden bir ara, ...-mişliği var". Fiilin önünde gelir ve çoğu zaman fiilden sonra deneyim eki "过" ile birlikte kullanılır: 他曾经在这里工作过 (Bir zamanlar burada çalışmışlığı var), 我曾经也年轻过 (Ben de bir zamanlar gençtim). Uzak ya da tamamlanmış bir geçmişe vurgu yapar ve bugünle bir kopukluk/karşıtlık ima eder (o zaman öyleydi, şimdi değil). "过" tek başına da deneyim bildirir ama "曾经" bunu daha edebî, vurgulu ve "bir zamanlar" nostaljisiyle güçlendirir. Olumsuzu "不曾/未曾" (hiç ...-medi) ya da "没曾经" değil, doğrudan "没...过" ile yapılır. Türkçedeki "bir zamanlar, vaktiyle, eskiden bir ara, ...-mişliği var" ifadelerine denk gelir; geçmişteki bir deneyimi anlatmanın edebî, vurgulu yoludur.

examples.zh: 他曾经在国外留学多年,见识非常广。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng jīng zài guó wài liú xué duō nián, jiàn shí fēi cháng guǎng。
examples.en: He once studied abroad for years and is very worldly.

examples.zh: 这座城市曾经十分繁华,如今却安静了许多。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéng shì céng jīng shí fēn fán huá, rú jīn què ān jìng le xǔ duō。
examples.en: This city was once very prosperous but is now much quieter.

examples.zh: 我曾经也怀着满腔的热情,想要改变世界。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ céng jīng yě huái zhe mǎn qiāng de rè qíng, xiǎng yào gǎi biàn shì jiè。
examples.en: I once, too, was full of passion, wanting to change the world.

examples.zh: 这片土地曾经是一片荒地,现在盖满了高楼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn tǔ dì céng jīng shì yī piàn huāng de, xiàn zài gài mǎn le gāo lóu。
examples.en: This land was once wasteland; now it's covered with tall buildings.

examples.zh: 他曾经答应过我,一定会回来看我们。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng jīng dā yìng guò wǒ, yí dìng huì huí lái kàn wǒ men。
examples.en: He once promised me he would come back to see us.

examples.zh: 这位老人曾经是一名出色的医生,救过很多人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo rén céng jīng shì yī míng chū sè de yī shēng, jiù guò hěn duō rén。
examples.en: This old man was once an excellent doctor who saved many.

examples.zh: 我们曾经一起度过了一段难忘的时光。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men céng jīng yì qǐ dù guò le yī duàn nán wàng de shí guāng。
examples.en: We once spent an unforgettable time together.

examples.zh: 这条河曾经清澈见底,现在却被污染得很严重。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé céng jīng qīng chè jiàn dǐ, xiàn zài què bèi wū rǎn de hěn yán zhòng。
examples.en: This river was once crystal clear but is now heavily polluted.

examples.zh: 他曾经也失败过很多次,但从来没有放弃。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng jīng yě shī bài guò hěn duō cì, dàn cóng lái méi yǒu fàng qì。
examples.en: He once failed many times too, but never gave up.

examples.zh: 我曾经在这家书店买过一本影响我一生的书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ céng jīng zài zhè jiā shū diàn mǎi guò yī běn yǐng xiǎng wǒ yī shēng de shū。
examples.en: I once bought a book here that influenced my whole life.

examples.zh: 那位歌手曾经红极一时,如今已经很少露面了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi gē shǒu céng jīng hóng jí yī shí, rú jīn yǐ jīng hěn shǎo lòu miàn le。
examples.en: That singer was once hugely popular but now rarely appears.

examples.zh: 小时候,我曾经梦想着长大后当一名科学家。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo shí hòu, wǒ céng jīng mèng xiǎng zhe zhǎng dà hòu dāng yī míng kē xué jiā。
examples.en: As a child, I once dreamed of becoming a scientist.

examples.zh: 这座老桥曾经是连接两岸唯一的通道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo qiáo céng jīng shì lián jiē liǎng àn wéi yī de tōng dào。
examples.en: This old bridge was once the only link between the two banks.

examples.zh: 他们曾经是最好的朋友,后来却因为误会疏远了。
examples.pinyin: Tā men céng jīng shì zuì hǎo de péng yǒu, hòu lái què yīn wèi wù huì shū yuǎn le。
examples.en: They were once best friends but grew apart over a misunderstanding.

examples.zh: 我曾经养过一只很聪明的狗,可惜后来生病死了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ céng jīng yǎng guò yī zhī hěn cōng míng de gǒu, kě xī hòu lái shēng bìng sǐ le。
examples.en: I once kept a very clever dog, but sadly it later fell ill and died.

examples.zh: 这位作家曾经获得过很多重要的文学奖项。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuò jiā céng jīng huò de guò hěn duō zhòng yào de wén xué jiǎng xiàng。
examples.en: This writer once won many important literary awards.

examples.zh: 这里曾经发生过一件让所有人都难忘的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ céng jīng fā shēng guò yī jiàn ràng suǒ yǒu rén dōu nán wàng de shì。
examples.en: Something unforgettable once happened here.

examples.zh: 他曾经为了梦想放弃了稳定的工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng jīng wèi le mèng xiǎng fàng qì le wěn dìng de gōng zuò。
examples.en: He once gave up a stable job for his dream.

examples.zh: 我曾经以为自己做不到,后来才发现是自己想多了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ céng jīng yǐ wéi zì jǐ zuò bú dào, hòu lái cái fā xiàn shì zì jǐ xiǎng duō le。
examples.en: I once thought I couldn't do it, only to find I'd overthought it.

examples.zh: 那段艰苦的岁月,曾经磨炼了他坚强的意志。
examples.pinyin: Nà duàn jiān kǔ de suì yuè, céng jīng mó liàn le tā jiān qiáng de yì zhì。
examples.en: Those hard years once tempered his strong will.

examples.zh: 这座村庄曾经因为盛产茶叶而远近闻名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò cūn zhuāng céng jīng yīn wèi shèng chǎn chá yè ér yuǎn jìn wén míng。
examples.en: This village was once famous far and wide for its tea.

examples.zh: 我们曾经无话不谈,如今却渐渐没了联系。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men céng jīng wú huà bù tán, rú jīn què jiàn jiàn méi le lián xì。
examples.en: We once talked about everything, but gradually lost touch.

examples.zh: 他曾经在这个舞台上留下了许多精彩的表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng jīng zài zhè ge wǔ tái shàng liú xià le xǔ duō jīng cǎi de biǎo yǎn。
examples.en: He once left many wonderful performances on this stage.

examples.zh: 这些照片记录了他们曾经共同奋斗的日子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān jì lù le tā men céng jīng gòng tóng fèn dòu de rì zi。
examples.en: These photos record the days they once struggled together.

examples.zh: 我曾经许下的诺言,至今仍然记在心里。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ céng jīng xǔ xià de nuò yán, zhì jīn réng rán jì zài xīn lǐ。
examples.en: The promise I once made, I still keep in my heart.

title: "本来" ile "aslında, başlangıçta, zaten"
summary: "本来" (běnlái) başlangıçtaki durumu/planı bildirir: 我本来想去,后来有事没去成 = Aslında gitmek istiyordum, sonra işim çıktı gidemedim.
explanation: "本来" bir şeyin BAŞLANGIÇTAKİ, aslındaki durumunu ya da planını bildirir ve çoğu zaman sonradan değiştiğini ima eder: "aslında, başlangıçta, en baştan, zaten, doğası gereği". İki kullanımı: (1) DEĞİŞEN PLAN — 我本来打算今天走,可是临时改变了主意 (Aslında bugün gidecektim ama fikrimi değiştirdim). Çoğu zaman "本来...,后来/可是..." ile bir zıtlık kurar. (2) ZATEN/doğası gereği — bir gerçeğin başından beri öyle olduğunu vurgular: 这件事本来就不怪你 (Bu iş zaten senin suçun değildi), 他本来就不爱说话 (Zaten pek konuşkan biri değildir). İlk anlamda geçmiş plan ile şimdiki durum arasındaki farkı, ikincisinde ise değişmez bir gerçeği belirtir. "原来" ile yakındır ama "本来" başlangıç durumunu/planını, "原来" ise yeni fark edilen gerçeği vurgular. Türkçedeki "aslında, başlangıçta, en baştan, zaten, doğası gereği" ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 我本来打算周末去爬山,后来因为下雨取消了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái dǎ suàn zhōu mò qù pá shān, hòu lái yīn wèi xià yǔ qǔ xiāo le。
examples.en: I originally planned to hike on the weekend, but canceled due to rain.

examples.zh: 这件事本来就不怪你,你不用一直自责。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì běn lái jiù bù guài nǐ, nǐ bù yòng yì zhí zì zé。
examples.en: This wasn't your fault to begin with; stop blaming yourself.

examples.zh: 他本来想自己修,可发现问题太复杂,还是请了师傅。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn lái xiǎng zì jǐ xiū, kě fā xiàn wèn tí tài fù zá, hái shì qǐng le shī fù。
examples.en: He meant to fix it himself, but it was too complex, so he called a repairman.

examples.zh: 我本来对他印象不错,可这件事让我改变了看法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái duì tā yìn xiàng bù cuò, kě zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ gǎi biàn le kàn fǎ。
examples.en: I originally had a good impression of him, but this changed my view.

examples.zh: 这道题本来很简单,是你把它想复杂了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí běn lái hěn jiǎn dān, shì nǐ bǎ tā xiǎng fù zá le。
examples.en: This problem was simple to begin with; you overcomplicated it.

examples.zh: 我们本来约好一起去的,结果他临时有事来不了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men běn lái yuē hǎo yì qǐ qù de, jié guǒ tā lín shí yǒu shì lái bù liǎo。
examples.en: We'd agreed to go together, but he had something come up.

examples.zh: 他本来就身体不好,这次又累病了。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn lái jiù shēn tǐ bù hǎo, zhè cì yòu lèi bìng le。
examples.en: He was already in poor health, and now he's fallen ill from fatigue.

examples.zh: 我本来想给你一个惊喜,没想到被你提前发现了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái xiǎng gěi nǐ yí gè jīng xǐ, méi xiǎng dào bèi nǐ tí qián fā xiàn le。
examples.en: I meant to surprise you, but you found out early.

examples.zh: 这间屋子本来是书房,后来改成了孩子的卧室。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān wū zi běn lái shì shū fáng, hòu lái gǎi chéng le hái zi de wò shì。
examples.en: This room was originally a study, later turned into the child's bedroom.

examples.zh: 你本来就有能力做好,只是缺少一点自信。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ běn lái jiù yǒu néng lì zuò hǎo, zhǐ shì quē shǎo yì diǎn zì xìn。
examples.en: You were always capable of doing well; you just lacked a little confidence.

examples.zh: 我本来不想麻烦你,可实在没有别的办法了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái bù xiǎng má fán nǐ, kě shí zài méi yǒu bié de bàn fǎ le。
examples.en: I didn't want to trouble you, but there was really no other way.

examples.zh: 天气预报本来说今天晴,结果下起了大雨。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào běn lái shuō jīn tiān qíng, jié guǒ xià qǐ le dà yǔ。
examples.en: The forecast originally said sunny today, but it rained hard.

examples.zh: 这些钱本来是留着应急的,现在只好先拿出来用了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē qián běn lái shì liú zhe yìng jí de, xiàn zài zhǐ hǎo xiān ná chū lái yòng le。
examples.en: This money was kept for emergencies; now it has to be used.

examples.zh: 他本来性格很内向,这几年变得开朗多了。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn lái xìng gé hěn nèi xiàng, zhè jǐ nián biàn de kāi lǎng duō le。
examples.en: He was originally introverted, but has become much more outgoing.

examples.zh: 我本来以为这件事很难,做起来才发现并不复杂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái yǐ wéi zhè jiàn shì hěn nán, zuò qǐ lái cái fā xiàn bìng bù fù zá。
examples.en: I originally thought this was hard, but doing it, it wasn't complex.

examples.zh: 这条路本来很窄,后来拓宽了不少。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù běn lái hěn zhǎi, hòu lái tuò kuān le bù shǎo。
examples.en: This road was originally narrow but was later widened considerably.

examples.zh: 你本来就该早点告诉我,现在才说来不及了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ běn lái jiù gāi zǎo diǎn gào sù wǒ, xiàn zài cái shuō lái bù jí le。
examples.en: You should have told me earlier to begin with; it's too late now.

examples.zh: 我们本来计划旅行一个星期,后来提前回来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men běn lái jì huà lǚ xíng yí gè xīng qī, hòu lái tí qián huí lái le。
examples.en: We originally planned a week's trip but came back early.

examples.zh: 他本来答应得好好的,临了却又反悔了。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn lái dā yìng de hǎo hǎo de, lín liǎo què yòu fǎn huǐ le。
examples.en: He'd agreed just fine at first, but backed out at the last moment.

examples.zh: 这件衣服本来是白色的,洗了几次就变旧了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yī fú běn lái shì bái sè de, xǐ le jǐ cì jiù biàn jiù le。
examples.en: This outfit was originally white, but faded after a few washes.

examples.zh: 我本来还有很多话想说,见了面却什么也说不出来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái hái yǒu hěn duō huà xiǎng shuō, jiàn le miàn què shén me yě shuō bù chū lái。
examples.en: I had much to say, but on meeting couldn't say anything.

examples.zh: 这个位置本来是留给你的,你怎么坐到后面去了?
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge wèi zhì běn lái shì liú gěi nǐ de, nǐ zěn me zuò dào hòu miàn qù le?
examples.en: This seat was saved for you; why did you sit in the back?

examples.zh: 他本来就是个热心人,帮别人从来不计较。
examples.pinyin: Tā běn lái jiù shì gè rè xīn rén, bāng bié rén cóng lái bù jì jiào。
examples.en: He was always a warm-hearted person, helping others without ever counting the cost.

examples.zh: 我本来还担心他不适应,没想到他很快就习惯了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ běn lái hái dān xīn tā bù shì yīng, méi xiǎng dào tā hěn kuài jiù xí guàn le。
examples.en: I was worried he wouldn't adapt, but he got used to it quickly.

examples.zh: 事情本来可以处理得更好,可惜错过了最佳时机。
examples.pinyin: Shì qíng běn lái kě yǐ chǔ lǐ de gèng hǎo, kě xī cuò guò le zuì jiā shí jī。
examples.en: This could have been handled better, but the best chance was missed.

title: "再三" ile "defalarca, ısrarla"
summary: "再三" (zàisān) bir eylemin defalarca, ısrarla tekrarlandığını bildirir: 他再三叮嘱我要小心 = Bana defalarca dikkatli olmamı tembihledi.
explanation: "再三" (kelimesi kelimesine "iki üç kez") bir eylemin DEFALARCA, tekrar tekrar, ısrarla yapıldığını bildirir: "defalarca, tekrar tekrar, ısrarla, üstüne basa basa". Fiilin önünde gelir ve genelde uyarı, rica, teşekkür, düşünme gibi eylemlerle kullanılır: 我再三考虑,还是决定放弃 (Defalarca düşündüm, yine de vazgeçmeye karar verdim), 他再三请求,我只好答应了 (Israrla rica edince kabul etmek zorunda kaldım), 老师再三强调这个问题的重要性 (Öğretmen bu konunun önemini defalarca vurguladı). Bir eylemin ısrarla, önem verilerek yinelendiğini gösterir; resmî/yazılı bir tonu vardır. "一再" ile eş anlamlıdır. "再三" özellikle sözlü ısrarı (叮嘱, 强调, 请求, 表示, 考虑) anlatan fiillerle sık gelir. Türkçedeki "defalarca, tekrar tekrar, ısrarla, üstüne basa basa, ta baştan sona" ifadelerine denk gelir; ısrarlı bir tekrarı vurgulamanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 妈妈再三叮嘱我,过马路的时候一定要小心。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zài sān dīng zhǔ wǒ, guò mǎ lù de shí hòu yí dìng yào xiǎo xīn。
examples.en: Mom repeatedly told me to be careful when crossing the road.

examples.zh: 我再三考虑之后,还是决定接受这份工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài sān kǎo lǜ zhī hòu, hái shì jué dìng jiē shòu zhè fèn gōng zuò。
examples.en: After thinking it over many times, I decided to take the job.

examples.zh: 在他的再三请求下,我最终答应了帮他这个忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài tā de zài sān qǐng qiú xià, wǒ zuì zhōng dā yìng le bāng tā zhè ge máng。
examples.en: At his repeated request, I finally agreed to help him.

examples.zh: 老师再三强调,考试的时候一定不能作弊。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī zài sān qiáng diào, kǎo shì de shí hòu yí dìng bù néng zuò bì。
examples.en: The teacher stressed again and again that there must be no cheating.

examples.zh: 他再三表示感谢,说这份恩情他一辈子都不会忘。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài sān biǎo shì gǎn xiè, shuō zhè fèn ēn qíng tā yī bèi zi dōu bú huì wàng。
examples.en: He thanked us repeatedly, saying he'd never forget the kindness.

examples.zh: 尽管我再三解释,他还是没能理解我的意思。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn wǒ zài sān jiě shì, tā hái shì méi néng lǐ jiě wǒ de yì si。
examples.en: Although I explained repeatedly, he still didn't grasp my meaning.

examples.zh: 经过再三权衡,公司最终选择了更稳妥的方案。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zài sān quán héng, gōng sī zuì zhōng xuǎn zé le gèng wěn tuǒ de fāng àn。
examples.en: After repeated weighing, the company chose the safer plan.

examples.zh: 我再三提醒他别忘了带证件,结果他还是忘了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài sān tí xǐng tā bié wàng le dài zhèng jiàn, jié guǒ tā hái shì wàng le。
examples.en: I reminded him repeatedly to bring his documents, yet he forgot.

examples.zh: 在大家的再三挽留下,他决定再多住几天。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà jiā de zài sān wǎn liú xià, tā jué dìng zài duō zhù jǐ tiān。
examples.en: At everyone's repeated urging to stay, he decided to stay a few more days.

examples.zh: 他再三保证,这次一定会按时把工作完成。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài sān bǎo zhèng, zhè cì yí dìng huì àn shí bǎ gōng zuò wán chéng。
examples.en: He assured us repeatedly that he'd finish the work on time this time.

examples.zh: 面对记者的再三追问,他始终没有正面回答。
examples.pinyin: Miàn duì jì zhě de zài sān zhuī wèn, tā shǐ zhōng méi yǒu zhèng miàn huí dá。
examples.en: Faced with reporters' repeated questioning, he never answered directly.

examples.zh: 父母再三嘱咐我,在外面要照顾好自己。
examples.pinyin: Fù mǔ zài sān zhǔ fù wǒ, zài wài miàn yào zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ。
examples.en: My parents repeatedly urged me to take good care of myself away from home.

examples.zh: 经过再三思量,他终于鼓起勇气说出了实情。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zài sān sī liàng, tā zhōng yú gǔ qǐ yǒng qì shuō chū le shí qíng。
examples.en: After much deliberation, he finally worked up the courage to tell the truth.

examples.zh: 我再三劝他戒烟,他嘴上答应,却总是做不到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài sān quàn tā jiè yān, tā zuǐ shàng dā yìng, què zǒng shì zuò bú dào。
examples.en: I urged him repeatedly to quit smoking; he agrees but never manages.

examples.zh: 在我们的再三邀请下,他终于同意来家里做客。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ men de zài sān yāo qǐng xià, tā zhōng yú tóng yì lái jiā lǐ zuò kè。
examples.en: At our repeated invitation, he finally agreed to visit our home.

examples.zh: 老板再三交代,接待客户时一定要热情周到。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo bǎn zài sān jiāo dài, jiē dài kè hù shí yí dìng yào rè qíng zhōu dào。
examples.en: The boss instructed repeatedly to be warm and attentive with clients.

examples.zh: 他再三向大家道歉,为自己的失误感到十分惭愧。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài sān xiàng dà jiā dào qiàn, wèi zì jǐ de shī wù gǎn dào shí fēn cán kuì。
examples.en: He apologized to everyone repeatedly, deeply ashamed of his mistake.

examples.zh: 尽管医生再三叮嘱,他还是没能按时吃药。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn yī shēng zài sān dīng zhǔ, tā hái shì méi néng àn shí chī yào。
examples.en: Despite the doctor's repeated reminders, he failed to take his medicine on time.

examples.zh: 经过再三比较,我最后还是选了这个牌子。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò zài sān bǐ jiào, wǒ zuì hòu hái shì xuǎn le zhè ge pái zi。
examples.en: After comparing again and again, I still chose this brand.

examples.zh: 他再三强调,这件事一定要保密,不能让别人知道。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài sān qiáng diào, zhè jiàn shì yí dìng yào bǎo mì, bù néng ràng bié rén zhī dào。
examples.en: He stressed repeatedly that this must be kept secret.

examples.zh: 在他的再三坚持下,我们只好按他的意思去做。
examples.pinyin: Zài tā de zài sān jiān chí xià, wǒ men zhǐ hǎo àn tā de yì si qù zuò。
examples.en: At his repeated insistence, we had to do as he wished.

examples.zh: 我再三确认过了,时间和地点都没有记错。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài sān què rèn guò le, shí jiān hé dì diǎn dōu méi yǒu jì cuò。
examples.en: I've confirmed repeatedly; the time and place are both correct.

examples.zh: 尽管前辈再三告诫,他还是走了一些弯路。
examples.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn qián bèi zài sān gào jiè, tā hái shì zǒu le yī xiē wān lù。
examples.en: Despite the elder's repeated warnings, he still took some detours.

examples.zh: 她再三表示,一定会把这件事办得妥妥当当。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài sān biǎo shì, yí dìng huì bǎ zhè jiàn shì bàn de tuǒ tuǒ dàng dāng。
examples.en: She repeatedly said she'd handle the matter perfectly.

examples.zh: 在大家的再三鼓励下,他终于重新振作了起来。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà jiā de zài sān gǔ lì xià, tā zhōng yú chóng xīn zhèn zuò le qǐ lái。
examples.en: With everyone's repeated encouragement, he finally pulled himself together.

title: "简直" ile "resmen, adeta, düpedüz"
summary: "简直" (jiǎnzhí) abartılı bir betimlemeyi pekiştirir: 这简直太不可思议了 = Bu resmen inanılmaz!
explanation: "简直" bir durumun neredeyse abartılı derecede uç noktada olduğunu vurgular: "resmen, adeta, düpedüz, tam anlamıyla, sanki". Bir yargı/betimlemeyi abartarak güçlendirir: 这个消息简直让人不敢相信 (Bu haber resmen inanılası değil), 他跑得简直像风一样快 (Adeta rüzgâr gibi hızlı koşuyor), 这里的风景简直美极了 (Buranın manzarası tam anlamıyla harika). Çoğu zaman bir benzetme (简直像...一样) ya da uç bir sıfat/ifadeyle gelir ve konuşmacının güçlü şaşkınlığını, hayranlığını ya da abartısını yansıtır. "简直" söyleneni "neredeyse gerçek dışı derecede" öne çıkarır. Türkçedeki "resmen, adeta, düpedüz, tam anlamıyla, sanki, hakikaten" abartı pekiştirmelerine denk gelir; güçlü bir duyguyu ya da abartılı bir değerlendirmeyi ifade etmenin yoludur.

examples.zh: 这里的夜景简直美得像一幅画,让人舍不得离开。
examples.pinyin: Zhè lǐ de yè jǐng jiǎn zhí měi de xiàng yī fú huà, ràng rén shě bù de lí kāi。
examples.en: The night view here is simply like a painting; you can't bear to leave.

examples.zh: 听到自己中奖的消息,他简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
examples.pinyin: Tīng dào zì jǐ zhòng jiǎng de xiāo xī, tā jiǎn zhí bù gǎn xiāng xìn zì jǐ de ěr duǒ。
examples.en: Hearing he'd won, he simply couldn't believe his ears.

examples.zh: 这道菜太好吃了,简直是我吃过最美味的一道。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài tài hǎo chī le, jiǎn zhí shì wǒ chī guò zuì měi wèi de yī dào。
examples.en: This dish is so good it's simply the most delicious I've ever had.

examples.zh: 他的记忆力简直惊人,看一遍就能全记住。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jì yì lì jiǎn zhí jīng rén, kàn yī biàn jiù néng quán jì zhù。
examples.en: His memory is simply astonishing; one read and he remembers it all.

examples.zh: 这么冷的天你还穿这么少,简直是拿身体开玩笑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me lěng de tiān nǐ hái chuān zhè me shǎo, jiǎn zhí shì ná shēn tǐ kāi wán xiào。
examples.en: Dressed so lightly in such cold, you're simply gambling with your health.

examples.zh: 他跑得简直像一阵风,一转眼就不见了。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de jiǎn zhí xiàng yī zhèn fēng, yī zhuǎn yǎn jiù bú jiàn le。
examples.en: He ran simply like a gust of wind, gone in a blink.

examples.zh: 这个孩子聪明得简直不像这个年纪的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge hái zi cōng míng de jiǎn zhí bù xiàng zhè ge nián jì de hái zi。
examples.en: This child is so smart he simply doesn't seem his age.

examples.zh: 那天的场面简直太混乱了,谁的话都听不清。
examples.pinyin: Nà tiān de chǎng miàn jiǎn zhí tài hùn luàn le, shéi de huà dōu tīng bù qīng。
examples.en: The scene that day was simply chaotic; you couldn't hear anyone.

examples.zh: 他把房间收拾得简直一尘不染,让人惊叹。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ fáng jiān shōu shí de jiǎn zhí yī chén bù rǎn, ràng rén jīng tàn。
examples.en: He cleaned the room simply spotless, to everyone's amazement.

examples.zh: 这两个人长得简直一模一样,我根本分不出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gè rén zhǎng de jiǎn zhí yī mú yī yàng, wǒ gēn běn fèn bù chū lái。
examples.en: These two look simply identical; I can't tell them apart at all.

examples.zh: 这么简单的错误你都犯,简直太不应该了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me jiǎn dān de cuò wù nǐ dōu fàn, jiǎn zhí tài bù yīng gāi le。
examples.en: Making such a simple mistake is simply inexcusable.

examples.zh: 站在山顶往下看,那景色简直令人窒息。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shān dǐng wǎng xià kàn, nà jǐng sè jiǎn zhí lìng rén zhì xī。
examples.en: Looking down from the summit, the view is simply breathtaking.

examples.zh: 他一天能读三本书,速度简直快得吓人。
examples.pinyin: Tā yī tiān néng dú sān běn shū, sù dù jiǎn zhí kuài de xià rén。
examples.en: He can read three books a day; his speed is simply frightening.

examples.zh: 这个消息传得简直比风还快,一下午就传遍了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāo xī chuán de jiǎn zhí bǐ fēng hái kuài, yī xià wǔ jiù chuán biàn le。
examples.en: The news spread simply faster than the wind, all over in an afternoon.

examples.zh: 孩子第一次做的饭虽然简单,可在我看来简直是山珍海味。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi dì yī cì zuò de fàn suī rán jiǎn dān, kě zài wǒ kàn lái jiǎn zhí shì shān zhēn hǎi wèi。
examples.en: The child's first meal was simple, but to me it was simply a feast.

examples.zh: 那场大雨下得简直像天塌下来一样。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng dà yǔ xià de jiǎn zhí xiàng tiān tā xià lái yī yàng。
examples.en: That downpour fell simply as if the sky were falling.

examples.zh: 他工作起来简直不要命,常常忙到深夜。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōng zuò qǐ lái jiǎn zhí bú yào mìng, cháng cháng máng dào shēn yè。
examples.en: He works simply as if his life doesn't matter, often until late night.

examples.zh: 这价格简直贵得离谱,谁会花这么多钱买它?
examples.pinyin: Zhè jià gé jiǎn zhí guì de lí pǔ, shuí huì huā zhè me duō qián mǎi tā?
examples.en: This price is simply outrageously high; who'd pay so much?

examples.zh: 看到多年不见的老友,她激动得简直说不出话来。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào duō nián bú jiàn de lǎo yǒu, tā jī dòng de jiǎn zhí shuō bù chū huà lái。
examples.en: Seeing an old friend after years, she was simply too moved to speak.

examples.zh: 这台老机器居然还能用,简直是个奇迹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái lǎo jī qì jū rán hái néng yòng, jiǎn zhí shì gè qí jì。
examples.en: This old machine still works — it's simply a miracle.

examples.zh: 他画的画简直跟真的一样,让人叹为观止。
examples.pinyin: Tā huà de huà jiǎn zhí gēn zhēn de yī yàng, ràng rén tàn wéi guān zhǐ。
examples.en: His paintings are simply lifelike, leaving people in awe.

examples.zh: 那几天忙得简直连喘气的工夫都没有。
examples.pinyin: Nà jǐ tiān máng de jiǎn zhí lián chuǎn qì de gōng fu dōu méi yǒu。
examples.en: Those days were so busy I simply had no time to breathe.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会你都放弃,简直太可惜了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo de jī huì nǐ dōu fàng qì, jiǎn zhí tài kě xī le。
examples.en: Giving up such a good chance is simply a great pity.

examples.zh: 他的态度简直判若两人,前后差别太大了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tài dù jiǎn zhí pàn ruò liǎng rén, qián hòu chā bié tài dà le。
examples.en: His attitude simply changed completely; the difference was huge.

examples.zh: 这孩子懂事得简直让人心疼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè hái zi dǒng shì de jiǎn zhí ràng rén xīn téng。
examples.en: This child is so sensible it simply breaks your heart.

title: "一向" ile "öteden beri, hep"
summary: "一向" (yīxiàng) geçmişten bugüne değişmeyen bir alışkanlığı/özelliği bildirir: 他一向很守时 = O öteden beri dakiktir.
explanation: "一向" geçmişten bugüne DEĞİŞMEDEN süregelen bir alışkanlığı, tutumu ya da özelliği bildirir: "öteden beri, hep, eskiden beri, her zaman". Yüklemin (fiil/sıfat) önünde gelir: 他一向不喜欢麻烦别人 (Öteden beri başkasını rahatsız etmekten hoşlanmaz), 这里的冬天一向很冷 (Buranın kışı hep soğuk olmuştur), 她做事一向认真负责 (İşini hep ciddiyet ve sorumlulukla yapar). Uzun süredir değişmeyen, istikrarlı bir durumu vurgular; genelde bir kişinin karakterini ya da bir yerin/şeyin sabit özelliğini anlatır. "从来" ile yakındır ama "一向" hem olumlu hem olumsuz cümlede rahatça kullanılır ve "süreklilik/istikrar" fikrini öne çıkarır ("从来" çoğu zaman olumsuzla gelir). "总是"ye de yakındır ama "一向" daha uzun, köklü bir süreklilik bildirir. Türkçedeki "öteden beri, hep, eskiden beri, her zaman, baştan beri" ifadelerine denk gelir; köklü, değişmez bir özelliği anlatmanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 他一向很守时,今天迟到肯定是遇到了什么急事。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí xiàng hěn shǒu shí, jīn tiān chí dào kěn dìng shì yù dào le shén me jí shì。
examples.en: He's always punctual; being late today must mean an emergency.

examples.zh: 我们家一向注重孩子的教育,再苦也不能苦孩子。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā yí xiàng zhù zhòng hái zi de jiào yù, zài kǔ yě bù néng kǔ hái zi。
examples.en: Our family has always valued the children's education, whatever the cost.

examples.zh: 这位老师一向对学生很严格,却也很关心他们。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shī yí xiàng duì xué shēng hěn yán gé, què yě hěn guān xīn tā men。
examples.en: This teacher has always been strict with students, yet very caring too.

examples.zh: 他做事一向认真负责,交给他的任务从没出过差错。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì yí xiàng rèn zhēn fù zé, jiāo gěi tā de rèn wù cóng méi chū guò chā cuò。
examples.en: He's always been conscientious; tasks given to him never go wrong.

examples.zh: 她一向不爱张扬,做了好事也从不声张。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí xiàng bù ài zhāng yáng, zuò le hǎo shì yě cóng bù shēng zhāng。
examples.en: She's always been unassuming, never boasting even of good deeds.

examples.zh: 这一带一向治安很好,晚上出门也很安全。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yī dài yí xiàng zhì ān hěn hǎo, wǎn shàng chū mén yě hěn ān quán。
examples.en: This area has always been safe; going out at night is fine too.

examples.zh: 他为人一向低调,很少在人前谈论自己的成就。
examples.pinyin: Tā wéi rén yí xiàng dī diào, hěn shǎo zài rén qián tán lùn zì jǐ de chéng jiù。
examples.en: He's always kept a low profile, rarely discussing his achievements.

examples.zh: 我一向不太喜欢热闹的地方,更爱安静。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yí xiàng bù tài xǐ huān rè nào de dì fāng, gèng ài ān jìng。
examples.en: I've never much liked noisy places; I prefer quiet.

examples.zh: 这家老店的东西一向货真价实,从不缺斤少两。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǎo diàn de dōng xī yí xiàng huò zhēn jià shí, cóng bù quē jīn shǎo liǎng。
examples.en: This old shop's goods have always been genuine, never short-weighted.

examples.zh: 父亲一向沉默寡言,可对我们的爱从不曾少过。
examples.pinyin: Fù qīn yí xiàng chén mò guǎ yán, kě duì wǒ men de ài cóng bù céng shǎo guò。
examples.en: Father has always been a man of few words, yet his love never lessened.

examples.zh: 他身体一向很好,很少感冒生病。
examples.pinyin: Tā shēn tǐ yí xiàng hěn hǎo, hěn shǎo gǎn mào shēng bìng。
examples.en: His health has always been good; he rarely catches colds.

examples.zh: 我们之间一向坦诚相待,有什么话都直说。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men zhī jiān yí xiàng tǎn chéng xiāng dài, yǒu shén me huà dōu zhí shuō。
examples.en: We've always been honest with each other, saying whatever's on our minds.

examples.zh: 这个地区一向以盛产茶叶而闻名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dì qū yí xiàng yǐ shèng chǎn chá yè ér wén míng。
examples.en: This region has always been famous for producing tea.

examples.zh: 他花钱一向很有分寸,该省的省,该花的花。
examples.pinyin: Tā huā qián yí xiàng hěn yǒu fēn cùn, gāi shěng de shěng, gāi huā de huā。
examples.en: He's always been measured with money, saving and spending as needed.

examples.zh: 奶奶一向勤俭持家,一分钱都不肯浪费。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi yí xiàng qín jiǎn chí jiā, yī fēn qián dōu bù kěn làng fèi。
examples.en: Grandma has always run the home frugally, never wasting a cent.

examples.zh: 他对朋友一向讲义气,谁有困难都愿意帮。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì péng yǒu yí xiàng jiǎng yì qì, shuí yǒu kùn nán dōu yuàn yì bāng。
examples.en: He's always been loyal to friends, willing to help anyone in trouble.

examples.zh: 这家公司一向重视产品质量,深受顾客信赖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī yí xiàng zhòng shì chǎn pǐn zhì liàng, shēn shòu gù kè xìn lài。
examples.en: This company has always valued product quality, trusted by customers.

examples.zh: 她一向很有主见,不会轻易被别人左右。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí xiàng hěn yǒu zhǔ jiàn, bú huì qīng yì bèi bié rén zuǒ yòu。
examples.en: She's always been strong-minded, not easily swayed by others.

examples.zh: 这条河的水一向清澈,是村民重要的水源。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de shuǐ yí xiàng qīng chè, shì cūn mín zhòng yào de shuǐ yuán。
examples.en: This river's water has always been clear, a vital source for the villagers.

examples.zh: 他一向说话算话,答应的事从来不会食言。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí xiàng shuō huà suàn huà, dā yìng de shì cóng lái bú huì shí yán。
examples.en: He's always kept his word; he never goes back on a promise.

examples.zh: 我们班的学习气氛一向很浓,大家都很上进。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men bān de xué xí qì fēn yí xiàng hěn nóng, dà jiā dōu hěn shàng jìn。
examples.en: Our class has always had a strong study atmosphere; everyone strives.

examples.zh: 这位医生一向医术高明,态度也十分和蔼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yī shēng yí xiàng yī shù gāo míng, tài dù yě shí fēn hé ǎi。
examples.en: This doctor has always been highly skilled and very kind.

examples.zh: 他一向不太善于表达,可心里却什么都明白。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí xiàng bù tài shàn yú biǎo dá, kě xīn lǐ què shén me dōu míng bái。
examples.en: He's never been good at expressing himself, yet he understands everything.

examples.zh: 我们家一向以和为贵,很少发生争吵。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men jiā yí xiàng yǐ hé wèi guì, hěn shǎo fā shēng zhēng chǎo。
examples.en: Our family has always prized harmony; quarrels are rare.

examples.zh: 他做学问一向严谨,容不得半点马虎。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò xué wèn yí xiàng yán jǐn, róng bù de bàn diǎn mǎ hǔ。
examples.en: He's always been rigorous in scholarship, tolerating no carelessness.

title: "千万" ile "sakın, ne olursa olsun"
summary: "千万" (qiānwàn) güçlü bir uyarı/rica bildirir: 你千万别忘了 = Sakın unutma!; 千万要小心 = Ne olursa olsun dikkatli ol.
explanation: "千万" bir uyarıyı, ricayı ya da hatırlatmayı ÇOK GÜÇLÜ biçimde pekiştirir: "sakın, ne olursa olsun, mutlaka, aman". Çoğu zaman "千万别/不要" (sakın ...-me) ya da "千万要" (ne olursa olsun ...-meli) biçiminde gelir: 你千万别把这件事告诉他 (Sakın bunu ona söyleme!), 路上千万要注意安全 (Yolda aman dikkatli ol), 这件事千万不能马虎 (Bu iş sakın baştan savma yapılmamalı). Kelime kelime "bin on bin" (çok büyük sayı) demektir ve bu abartıyla uyarının aciliyetini/önemini vurgular. Genelde ciddi bir uyarı, önemli bir hatırlatma ya da içten bir rica bildirir; konuşmacının kaygısını/samimiyetini yansıtır. Türkçedeki "sakın, aman, ne olursa olsun, mutlaka" güçlü uyarı ifadelerine denk gelir; önemli bir uyarıyı ya da ricayı vurgulamanın en yaygın yoludur.

examples.zh: 这件事很重要,你千万别忘了,一定要记在心上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì hěn zhòng yào, nǐ qiān wàn bié wàng le, yí dìng yào jì zài xīn shàng。
examples.en: This is important; don't forget it — keep it firmly in mind.

examples.zh: 一个人在外面,千万要照顾好自己,注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Yí gè rén zài wài miàn, qiān wàn yào zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ, zhù yì ān quán。
examples.en: On your own away from home, be sure to take care and stay safe.

examples.zh: 这是个秘密,你千万不要告诉任何人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì gè mì mì, nǐ qiān wàn bú yào gào sù rèn hé rén。
examples.en: This is a secret; don't tell anyone at all.

examples.zh: 过马路的时候千万要小心,别看手机。
examples.pinyin: Guò mǎ lù de shí hòu qiān wàn yào xiǎo xīn, bié kàn shǒu jī。
examples.en: When crossing the road, be extra careful and don't look at your phone.

examples.zh: 药一定要按时吃,千万不能想起来才吃。
examples.pinyin: Yào yí dìng yào àn shí chī, qiān wàn bù néng xiǎng qǐ lái cái chī。
examples.en: Take the medicine on time; don't only take it when you remember.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会,你千万要抓住,别再犹豫了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo de jī huì, nǐ qiān wàn yào zhuā zhù, bié zài yóu yù le。
examples.en: Such a good chance — be sure to seize it, don't hesitate.

examples.zh: 天气预报说有大雨,你出门千万记得带伞。
examples.pinyin: Tiān qì yù bào shuō yǒu dà yǔ, nǐ chū mén qiān wàn jì de dài sǎn。
examples.en: The forecast says heavy rain; be sure to take an umbrella.

examples.zh: 这些贵重物品你千万要保管好,别弄丢了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē guì zhòng wù pǐn nǐ qiān wàn yào bǎo guǎn hǎo, bié nòng diū le。
examples.en: Be sure to keep these valuables safe; don't lose them.

examples.zh: 面试的时候千万别紧张,把自己最好的状态拿出来。
examples.pinyin: Miàn shì de shí hòu qiān wàn bié jǐn zhāng, bǎ zì jǐ zuì hǎo de zhuàng tài ná chū lái。
examples.en: Don't be nervous in the interview; show your best self.

examples.zh: 这条路很陡,你开车千万要慢一点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù hěn dǒu, nǐ kāi chē qiān wàn yào màn yì diǎn。
examples.en: This road is steep; be sure to drive slowly.

examples.zh: 孩子还小,你们千万不能对他太严厉。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hái xiǎo, nǐ men qiān wàn bù néng duì tā tài yán lì。
examples.en: The child is young; you mustn't be too harsh with him.

examples.zh: 这件事关系重大,你千万要三思而后行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì guān xì zhòng dà, nǐ qiān wàn yào sān sī ér hòu xíng。
examples.en: This matter is significant; be sure to think carefully before acting.

examples.zh: 我把钥匙交给你了,你千万别再弄丢了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ yào shi jiāo gěi nǐ le, nǐ qiān wàn bié zài nòng diū le。
examples.en: I've given you the keys; be sure not to lose them again.

examples.zh: 天冷了,老人和孩子千万要多穿点儿衣服。
examples.pinyin: Tiān lěng le, lǎo rén hé hái zi qiān wàn yào duō chuān diǎn ér yī fú。
examples.en: It's cold; the old and young must be sure to dress warmly.

examples.zh: 这道菜有点烫,你千万小心别烫着嘴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài yǒu diǎn tàng, nǐ qiān wàn xiǎo xīn bié tàng zhe zuǐ。
examples.en: This dish is a bit hot; be careful not to burn your mouth.

examples.zh: 你答应了别人的事,千万要说到做到。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dā yìng le bié rén de shì, qiān wàn yào shuō dào zuò dào。
examples.en: Whatever you promised, be sure to follow through.

examples.zh: 走山路的时候千万要跟紧,别一个人乱跑。
examples.pinyin: Zǒu shān lù de shí hòu qiān wàn yào gēn jǐn, bié yí gè rén luàn pǎo。
examples.en: On mountain trails, stay close and don't wander off alone.

examples.zh: 这是最后一次机会了,你千万不要错过。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì zuì hòu yī cì jī huì le, nǐ qiān wàn bú yào cuò guò。
examples.en: This is the last chance; be sure not to miss it.

examples.zh: 借来的书千万要爱惜,别弄脏或者弄坏了。
examples.pinyin: Jiè lái de shū qiān wàn yào ài xī, bié nòng zāng huò zhě nòng huài le。
examples.en: Be sure to cherish the borrowed book; don't dirty or damage it.

examples.zh: 你身体不好,以后千万别再熬夜了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shēn tǐ bù hǎo, yǐ hòu qiān wàn bié zài áo yè le。
examples.en: Your health is poor; from now on be sure not to stay up late.

examples.zh: 这件事千万要保密,一旦泄露就麻烦了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì qiān wàn yào bǎo mì, yí dàn xiè lòu jiù má fán le。
examples.en: This must be kept secret; leaking it would cause trouble.

examples.zh: 出远门在外,钱和证件千万要分开放。
examples.pinyin: Chū yuǎn mén zài wài, qián hé zhèng jiàn qiān wàn yào fēn kāi fàng。
examples.en: Traveling far, be sure to keep money and documents separate.

examples.zh: 你千万别小看他,他的实力可不容小觑。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qiān wàn bié xiǎo kàn tā, tā de shí lì kě bù róng xiǎo qù。
examples.en: Don't underestimate him at all; his ability is not to be dismissed.

examples.zh: 这次考试千万要认真,机会难得,别马虎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎo shì qiān wàn yào rèn zhēn, jī huì nán de, bié mǎ hǔ。
examples.en: Be sure to take this exam seriously; the chance is rare, no carelessness.

examples.zh: 不管遇到什么困难,你千万不要轻易放弃。
examples.pinyin: Bù guǎn yù dào shén me kùn nán, nǐ qiān wàn bú yào qīng yì fàng qì。
examples.en: Whatever difficulty you face, be sure never to give up easily.

title: "顺便" ile "bu arada, hazır ...-mişken"
summary: "顺便" (shùnbiàn) esas bir işi yaparken yol üstünde başka bir işi de yapmayı bildirir: 你出去的时候顺便把垃圾扔了 = Çıkarken bu arada çöpü de at.
explanation: "顺便" bir asıl eylemi yaparken, o eylemin FIRSATINDAN/yolundan yararlanarak ikinci bir işi de yapmayı bildirir: "bu arada, hazır ...-mişken, yolu gelmişken, sırası gelmişken". İkinci fiil öbeğinin önünde gelir: 我去超市,顺便帮你买点儿水果 (Markete gidiyorum, bu arada sana biraz meyve alırım), 你回来的时候顺便把信取一下 (Dönerken hazır mektubu da al). İkinci iş, birinci işin "yan ürünü" gibidir — ek çaba gerektirmez, aynı fırsattan yararlanır. Genelde bir rica ya da öneri biçiminde gelir. "顺便" iki eylemin aynı gidiş/fırsat içinde birleştiğini vurgular. Türkçedeki "bu arada, hazır ...-mişken, yolu gelmişken, sırası gelmişken, bir taşla iki kuş" ifadelerine denk gelir; bir işi yaparken başka bir işi de halletmeyi anlatmanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 你去楼下拿快递的时候,顺便帮我把垃圾扔了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù lóu xià ná kuài dì de shí hòu, shùn biàn bāng wǒ bǎ lā jī rēng le。
examples.en: When you get the parcel downstairs, take out the trash for me too.

examples.zh: 我正好要去银行,顺便帮你把这笔钱也存了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng hǎo yào qù yín háng, shùn biàn bāng nǐ bǎ zhè bǐ qián yě cún le。
examples.en: I happen to be going to the bank; I'll deposit this money for you too.

examples.zh: 既然路过书店,我就顺便进去看看有没有新书。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán lù guò shū diàn, wǒ jiù shùn biàn jìn qù kàn kàn yǒu méi yǒu xīn shū。
examples.en: Since I passed the bookstore, I stepped in to check for new books.

examples.zh: 你去厨房的时候,顺便帮我倒杯水,好吗?
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù chú fáng de shí hòu, shùn biàn bāng wǒ dào bēi shuǐ, hǎo ma?
examples.en: When you go to the kitchen, pour me a glass of water too, okay?

examples.zh: 我下班顺路,顺便就把孩子从学校接回来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xià bān shùn lù, shùn biàn jiù bǎ hái zi cóng xué xiào jiē huí lái le。
examples.en: It's on my way home, so I picked up the child from school too.

examples.zh: 出去散步的时候,他顺便把小区的信箱看了一眼。
examples.pinyin: Chū qù sàn bù de shí hòu, tā shùn biàn bǎ xiǎo qū de xìn xiāng kàn le yī yǎn。
examples.en: While out walking, he took a glance at the mailbox too.

examples.zh: 我去菜市场买菜,顺便打听了一下那家店的消息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cài shì chǎng mǎi cài, shùn biàn dǎ tīng le yī xià nà jiā diàn de xiāo xī。
examples.en: Going to the market, I also asked about that shop's news.

examples.zh: 你要是去邮局,顺便帮我寄一下这封信。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào shì qù yóu jú, shùn biàn bāng wǒ jì yī xià zhè fēng xìn。
examples.en: If you're going to the post office, mail this letter for me too.

examples.zh: 既然来都来了,顺便去旁边那个公园转转吧。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán lái dōu lái le, shùn biàn qù páng biān nà ge gōng yuán zhuǎn zhuǎn ba。
examples.en: Since we're already here, let's stroll through that park nearby too.

examples.zh: 他每天送孩子上学,顺便就把早点买回来了。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān sòng hái zi shàng xué, shùn biàn jiù bǎ zǎo diǎn mǎi huí lái le。
examples.en: He takes the child to school daily and buys breakfast on the way too.

examples.zh: 我去还书,顺便又借了两本关于历史的书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù huán shū, shùn biàn yòu jiè le liǎng běn guān yú lì shǐ de shū。
examples.en: Returning books, I also borrowed two on history.

examples.zh: 你洗菜的时候,顺便把这几个水果也洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐ cài de shí hòu, shùn biàn bǎ zhè jǐ gè shuǐ guǒ yě xǐ yī xǐ。
examples.en: While washing the vegetables, wash these fruits too.

examples.zh: 既然你要去那边,顺便替我看看店铺开门没有。
examples.pinyin: Jì rán nǐ yào qù nà biān, shùn biàn tì wǒ kàn kàn diàn pù kāi mén méi yǒu。
examples.en: Since you're going that way, check if the shop is open for me.

examples.zh: 周末回老家,他顺便看望了几位多年不见的老朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhōu mò huí lǎo jiā, tā shùn biàn kàn wàng le jǐ wèi duō nián bú jiàn de lǎo péng yǒu。
examples.en: Going home on the weekend, he also visited some old friends.

examples.zh: 我出门倒垃圾,顺便呼吸了一下外面的新鲜空气。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chū mén dào lā jī, shùn biàn hū xī le yī xià wài miàn de xīn xiān kōng qì。

examples.zh: 你去药店的时候,顺便帮我买一盒感冒药。

examples.zh: 既然在市中心办事,顺便就把年货也置办齐了。

examples.zh: 他每天遛狗,顺便就把楼下的报纸取上来了。

examples.en: He walks the dog daily and brings up the newspaper too.

examples.zh: 你去接水的时候,顺便看看饮水机是不是没水了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù jiē shuǐ de shí hòu, shùn biàn kàn kàn yǐn shuǐ jī shì bú shì méi shuǐ le。
examples.en: When you get water, check if the dispenser is empty too.

examples.zh: 我去趟卫生间,顺便把手也洗了,马上就回来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù tàng wèi shēng jiān, shùn biàn bǎ shǒu yě xǐ le, mǎ shàng jiù huí lái。
examples.en: I'll use the restroom and wash my hands too; back soon.

examples.zh: 既然顺路,我就顺便把你要的资料给你带过来了。

examples.zh: 妈妈去买菜,顺便帮邻居家也捎了些东西回来。

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xià lóu de shí hòu, shùn biàn bāng wǒ kàn kàn xìn xiāng lǐ yǒu méi yǒu xìn。

examples.zh: 既然大家都在,顺便就把下个月的安排也商量一下吧。

examples.en: Since everyone's here, let's also discuss next month's plans.

examples.zh: 他去修车,顺便把车里里外外都清洗了一遍。

examples.en: Getting the car fixed, he also cleaned it inside and out.

title: "再不...就..." ile son uyarı
titleEn: Expressing a last chance with "zaibu... jiu..."
pattern: 再不 + Fiil，就 + (kötü sonuç) + 了
summary: "再不...就...了" bir son uyarı bildirir: 你再不走就迟到了 = Şimdi gitmezsen geç kalacaksın.
explanation: "再不...就...了" bir eylem HEMEN/artık yapılmazsa istenmeyen bir sonucun kaçınılmaz olacağını bildiren bir SON UYARIdır: "artık ...-mezsen ...-cek, şimdi ...-mezsen ...". Kalıp: 再不 + fiil，(özne) + 就 + sonuç + 了. 你再不出发就赶不上火车了 (Şimdi çıkmazsan treni kaçıracaksın), 再不下雨,庄稼就要旱死了 (Yağmur yağmazsa ekinler kuruyacak), 你再不好好学习,就要落后了 (İyi çalışmazsan geride kalacaksın). "再不" "bir daha/artık ...-mezse" koşulunu, "就...了" ise kaçınılmaz olumsuz sonucu bildirir. Bir aciliyet, sabırsızlık ya da uyarı tonu taşır; "vakit daralıyor, harekete geç" mesajı verir. Türkçedeki "artık ...-mezsen ...-cek, şimdi ...-mezsen geç kalırsın, yoksa ..." son uyarı kalıplarına denk gelir; bir fırsatın kaçmak üzere olduğunu vurgulamanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 你再不快点儿,电影就要开始了,咱们该迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù kuài diǎn ér, diàn yǐng jiù yào kāi shǐ le, zán men gāi chí dào le。
examples.en: If you don't hurry, the movie will start and we'll be late.

examples.zh: 这些菜再不吃就凉了,大家快趁热吃吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē cài zài bù chī jiù liáng le, dà jiā kuài chèn rè chī ba。
examples.en: If we don't eat soon the food will get cold; eat while it's hot.

examples.zh: 你再不好好复习,这次考试恐怕就要不及格了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù hǎo hǎo fù xí, zhè cì kǎo shì kǒng pà jiù yào bù jí gé le。
examples.en: If you don't review well, you might fail this exam.

examples.zh: 这本书你再不还,图书馆就要收罚款了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū nǐ zài bù hái, tú shū guǎn jiù yào shōu fá kuǎn le。

examples.zh: 孩子再不睡觉,明天早上就该起不来了。

examples.zh: 你再不锻炼,身体就会越来越差的。

examples.zh: 我再不走的话,家里人就该担心了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài bù zǒu de huà, jiā lǐ rén jiù gāi dān xīn le。
examples.en: If I don't leave soon, my family will start to worry.

examples.zh: 这个机会你再不抓住,以后可就没有了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge jī huì nǐ zài bù zhuā zhù, yǐ hòu kě jiù méi yǒu le。
examples.en: If you don't seize this chance, it won't come again.

examples.zh: 你再不给花浇水,它们都要枯死了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù gěi huā jiāo shuǐ, tā men dōu yào kū sǐ le。
examples.en: If you don't water the flowers, they'll all wither and die.

examples.zh: 再不改掉这个坏习惯,迟早会吃大亏的。

examples.zh: 你再不接电话,我可就要亲自跑一趟了。

examples.en: If you don't answer the phone, I'll have to come in person.

examples.zh: 这件事再不解决,矛盾就会越来越深。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zài bù jiě jué, máo dùn jiù huì yuè lái yuè shēn。

examples.zh: 再不出门,我们就要错过日出了,快走吧。
examples.pinyin: Zài bù chū mén, wǒ men jiù yào cuò guò rì chū le, kuài zǒu ba。

examples.zh: 你再不省着点花,这个月的生活费就不够了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù shěng zhe diǎn huā, zhè ge yuè de shēng huó fèi jiù bù gòu le。
examples.en: If you don't spend more sparingly, this month's money won't last.

examples.zh: 这块蛋糕再不放进冰箱,天这么热就要坏了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài dàn gāo zài bù fàng jìn bīng xiāng, tiān zhè me rè jiù yào huài le。

examples.zh: 你再不认真起来,这门课就要重修了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù rèn zhēn qǐ lái, zhè mén kè jiù yào chóng xiū le。
examples.en: If you don't get serious, you'll have to retake this course.

examples.zh: 再不动身,天黑之前我们就下不了山了。
examples.pinyin: Zài bù dòng shēn, tiān hēi zhī qián wǒ men jiù xià bù liǎo shān le。

examples.zh: 你再不道歉,他可能就真的生气了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù dào qiàn, tā kě néng jiù zhēn de shēng qì le。
examples.en: If you don't apologize, he might really get angry.

examples.zh: 这些照片再不整理,时间长了就都找不到了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān zài bù zhěng lǐ, shí jiān zhǎng le jiù dōu zhǎo bú dào le。
examples.en: If these photos aren't sorted, in time you won't find them.

examples.zh: 你再不做决定,好房子就要被别人买走了。

examples.zh: 你再不听劝,吃亏的可就是你自己了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài bù tīng quàn, chī kuī de kě jiù shì nǐ zì jǐ le。
examples.en: If you don't heed advice, it's you who'll suffer.

title: "恐怕" ile "korkarım, galiba"
summary: "恐怕" (kǒngpà) endişeyle bir tahmin bildirir: 恐怕要下雨了 = Korkarım yağmur yağacak; 他恐怕来不了了 = Galiba gelemeyecek.
explanation: "恐怕" istenmeyen bir sonuca dair ENDİŞELİ bir tahmini bildirir: "korkarım, galiba, sanırım (ne yazık ki), muhtemelen". Cümle başında ya da öznenin ardında gelir: 天这么黑,恐怕要下大雨了 (Hava karardı, korkarım sağanak gelecek), 这么晚了,他恐怕不会来了 (Bu kadar geç oldu, galiba gelmeyecek), 这件事恐怕没那么简单 (Bu iş galiba o kadar basit değil). Konuşmacının olumsuz bir olasılıktan duyduğu kaygıyı, çekinceyi yansıtır; salt tarafsız bir tahmin değil, istenmeyen bir sonuca dair endişe taşır. Ayrıca nazikçe kötü bir haber verirken ya da bir ricayı yumuşatırken de kullanılır: 这个忙我恐怕帮不了 (Bu konuda ne yazık ki yardım edemem). "可能/也许" tarafsız olasılık bildirirken, "恐怕" olumsuz + endişeli bir renk taşır. Türkçedeki "korkarım, galiba (ne yazık ki), maalesef, sanırım" ifadelerine denk gelir; endişeli bir tahmin ya da nazik bir olumsuz haber vermenin yoludur.

examples.zh: 天色这么暗,恐怕一会儿就要下大雨了。

examples.en: The sky's so dark; I'm afraid it'll pour soon.

examples.zh: 都这么晚了,他恐怕今天是不会来了。
examples.pinyin: Dōu zhè me wǎn le, tā kǒng pà jīn tiān shì bú huì lái le。
examples.en: It's so late; I'm afraid he won't come today.

examples.zh: 这件事恐怕没有我们想的那么容易解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì kǒng pà méi yǒu wǒ men xiǎng de nà me róng yì jiě jué。
examples.en: I'm afraid this won't be as easy to solve as we thought.

examples.zh: 这个忙我恐怕帮不上,实在超出了我的能力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge máng wǒ kǒng pà bāng bù shàng, shí zài chāo chū le wǒ de néng lì。
examples.en: I'm afraid I can't help with this; it's beyond my ability.

examples.zh: 按现在的进度,恐怕很难按时完成任务。
examples.pinyin: Àn xiàn zài de jìn dù, kǒng pà hěn nán àn shí wán chéng rèn wù。
examples.en: At this pace, I'm afraid it'll be hard to finish on time.

examples.zh: 他脸色这么难看,恐怕是身体出了什么问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎn sè zhè me nán kàn, kǒng pà shì shēn tǐ chū le shén me wèn tí。
examples.en: His face looks so bad; I'm afraid something's wrong with his health.

examples.zh: 这么大的雪,航班恐怕又要延误了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me dà de xuě, háng bān kǒng pà yòu yào yán wù le。
examples.en: With such heavy snow, I'm afraid the flights will be delayed again.

examples.zh: 这道题太难了,恐怕全班没几个人能做出来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí tài nán le, kǒng pà quán bān méi jǐ gè rén néng zuò chū lái。
examples.en: This problem is so hard; I'm afraid few in the class can do it.

examples.zh: 再不出发,我们恐怕就赶不上那趟火车了。
examples.pinyin: Zài bù chū fā, wǒ men kǒng pà jiù gǎn bù shàng nà tàng huǒ chē le。
examples.en: If we don't leave, I'm afraid we'll miss that train.

examples.zh: 这么贵重的东西,他恐怕不会轻易送人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me guì zhòng de dōng xī, tā kǒng pà bú huì qīng yì sòng rén。
examples.en: Such a valuable thing — I'm afraid he won't give it away easily.

examples.zh: 照这样下去,这个月的预算恐怕要超支了。
examples.pinyin: Zhào zhè yàng xià qù, zhè ge yuè de yù suàn kǒng pà yào chāo zhī le。
examples.en: At this rate, I'm afraid this month's budget will be overspent.

examples.zh: 他已经好几天没消息了,恐怕是遇到了什么麻烦。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ jīng hǎo jǐ tiān méi xiāo xī le, kǒng pà shì yù dào le shén me má fán。
examples.en: He's had no word for days; I'm afraid he's run into trouble.

examples.zh: 这么复杂的问题,恐怕一时半会儿解决不了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me fù zá de wèn tí, kǒng pà yī shí bàn huì er jiě jué bù liǎo。
examples.en: Such a complex problem — I'm afraid it won't be solved quickly.

examples.zh: 你要的那本书,书店里恐怕早就卖完了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào de nà běn shū, shū diàn lǐ kǒng pà zǎo jiù mài wán le。
examples.en: The book you want — I'm afraid the store sold out long ago.

examples.zh: 他伤得不轻,恐怕得住院观察一段时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā shāng de bù qīng, kǒng pà de zhù yuàn guān chá yī duàn shí jiān。
examples.en: He's badly hurt; I'm afraid he'll need to stay in hospital a while.

examples.zh: 这么晚打扰您,恐怕不太合适,还是明天再说吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me wǎn dǎ rǎo nín, kǒng pà bù tài hé shì, hái shì míng tiān zài shuō ba。
examples.en: Bothering you this late is hardly appropriate; let's talk tomorrow.

examples.zh: 看这情形,今天的会议恐怕要开到很晚了。
examples.pinyin: Kàn zhè qíng xíng, jīn tiān de huì yì kǒng pà yào kāi dào hěn wǎn le。
examples.en: Judging by this, I'm afraid today's meeting will run late.

examples.zh: 这些钱恐怕不够买房子,咱们还得再想办法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē qián kǒng pà bù gòu mǎi fáng zi, zán men hái de zài xiǎng bàn fǎ。
examples.en: This money is hardly enough for a house; we need another plan.

examples.zh: 他那么固执,你去劝他恐怕也没什么用。
examples.pinyin: Tā nà me gù zhí, nǐ qù quàn tā kǒng pà yě méi shén me yòng。
examples.en: He's so stubborn; I'm afraid persuading him won't help much.

examples.zh: 再拖下去,恐怕连最后的机会也要失去了。
examples.pinyin: Zài tuō xià qù, kǒng pà lián zuì hòu de jī huì yě yào shī qù le。
examples.en: If we delay further, I'm afraid we'll lose even the last chance.

examples.zh: 这种老式的零件,现在恐怕很难买到了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng lǎo shì de líng jiàn, xiàn zài kǒng pà hěn nán mǎi dào le。
examples.en: This old-style part — I'm afraid it's hard to find now.

examples.zh: 看他的样子,这件事恐怕另有隐情。
examples.pinyin: Kàn tā de yàng zi, zhè jiàn shì kǒng pà lìng yǒu yǐn qíng。
examples.en: By the look of him, I'm afraid there's more to this than meets the eye.

examples.zh: 这么重的担子,他一个人恐怕扛不下来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me zhòng de dàn zi, tā yí gè rén kǒng pà káng bù xià lái。
examples.en: Such a heavy burden — I'm afraid he can't shoulder it alone.

examples.zh: 时间太紧了,准备得这么仓促,恐怕效果不会太好。
examples.pinyin: Shí jiān tài jǐn le, zhǔn bèi de zhè me cāng cù, kǒng pà xiào guǒ bú huì tài hǎo。
examples.en: Time's too tight; prepared so hastily, I'm afraid it won't go well.

examples.zh: 你现在去找他,他恐怕已经睡下了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiàn zài qù zhǎo tā, tā kǒng pà yǐ jīng shuì xià le。
examples.en: If you go to him now, I'm afraid he's already gone to bed.

title: "好(不)容易" ile "güç bela, zar zor"
summary: İlginç bir şekilde "好容易" ve "好不容易" AYNI anlama gelir: "güç bela, zar zor, bin bir zorlukla": 好不容易才买到票 = Zar zor bilet bulabildim.
explanation: "好不容易" ve (daha az yaygın) "好容易" — ilginç bir şekilde İKİSİ DE aynı anlama gelir: bir şeyi büyük ZORLUKLA, güç bela başarmak — "zar zor, güç bela, bin bir zorlukla, ancak". "好不容易"deki "不" anlamı değiştirmez (deyimsel bir pekiştirmedir). Fiilin önünde gelir ve çoğu zaman "才" ile birlikte: 我好不容易才把他劝住 (Onu zar zor sakinleştirebildim), 排了两个小时队,好不容易才买到票 (İki saat kuyrukta bekleyip ancak bilet bulabildim), 好容易盼到放假,却又生病了 (Güç bela tatile kavuştum, ama bu kez hastalandım). Bir çabanın büyük zorlukla, epey uğraşla sonuç verdiğini vurgular; çoğu zaman ardından bir hayal kırıklığı ya da çabanın boşa gitmesi de gelebilir. Türkçedeki "zar zor, güç bela, bin bir zorlukla, ancak, güçlükle" ifadelerine denk gelir; büyük bir çabayla elde edilen bir sonucu anlatmanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 排了整整两个小时的队,我好不容易才买到票。
examples.pinyin: Pái le zhěng zhěng liǎng gè xiǎo shí de duì, wǒ hǎo bù róng yì cái mǎi dào piào。
examples.en: After queuing two whole hours, I barely managed to get a ticket.

examples.zh: 好不容易把孩子哄睡了,一个电话又把他吵醒了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo bù róng yì bǎ hái zi hǒng shuì le, yí gè diàn huà yòu bǎ tā chǎo xǐng le。
examples.en: I'd just got the child to sleep when a call woke him again.

examples.zh: 我好不容易才找到这个地方,这里实在太偏僻了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo bù róng yì cái zhǎo dào zhè ge dì fāng, zhè lǐ shí zài tài piān pì le。
examples.en: I had great trouble finding this place; it's so remote.

examples.zh: 试了很多次,他好不容易才把那道难题解开。
examples.pinyin: Shì le hěn duō cì, tā hǎo bù róng yì cái bǎ nà dào nán tí jiě kāi。
examples.en: After many tries, he finally cracked the tough problem.

examples.zh: 好不容易盼到了周末,却又要加班,真让人扫兴。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo bù róng yì pàn dào le zhōu mò, què yòu yào jiā bān, zhēn ràng rén sǎo xìng。
examples.en: I'd looked forward to the weekend, only to have to work overtime.

examples.zh: 挤了半天,我好不容易才上了那趟拥挤的公交车。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ le bàn tiān, wǒ hǎo bù róng yì cái shàng le nà tàng yōng jǐ de gōng jiāo chē。
examples.en: After much squeezing, I barely got onto the crowded bus.

examples.zh: 他好不容易攒够了钱,买下了自己的第一套房子。
examples.pinyin: Tā hǎo bù róng yì zǎn gòu le qián, mǎi xià le zì jǐ de dì yī tào fáng zi。
examples.en: He finally saved enough and bought his first home.

examples.zh: 好不容易联系上他,他却说自己已经在外地了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo bù róng yì lián xì shàng tā, tā què shuō zì jǐ yǐ jīng zài wài dì le。
examples.en: I finally reached him, only for him to say he was already away.

examples.zh: 走了那么远的山路,我们好不容易才到了山顶。
examples.pinyin: Zǒu le nà me yuǎn de shān lù, wǒ men hǎo bù róng yì cái dào le shān dǐng。
examples.en: After such a long mountain trek, we finally reached the summit.

examples.zh: 这份工作我好不容易才找到,一定要好好珍惜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōng zuò wǒ hǎo bù róng yì cái zhǎo dào, yí dìng yào hǎo hǎo zhēn xī。
examples.en: I found this job with great difficulty; I must cherish it.

examples.zh: 大雨里等了半天,好不容易才打到一辆出租车。
examples.pinyin: Dà yǔ lǐ děng le bàn tiān, hǎo bù róng yì cái dǎ dào yī liàng chū zū chē。
examples.en: Waiting in the rain, I finally managed to hail a taxi.

examples.zh: 他好不容易戒了烟,可没坚持多久又抽上了。
examples.pinyin: Tā hǎo bù róng yì jiè le yān, kě méi jiān chí duō jiǔ yòu chōu shàng le。
examples.en: He quit smoking with great effort, but soon started again.

examples.zh: 好不容易凑齐了人,可又有一个人临时有事来不了。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo bù róng yì còu qí le rén, kě yòu yǒu yí gè rén lín shí yǒu shì lái bù liǎo。
examples.en: I'd barely gathered everyone when one had something come up.

examples.zh: 这幅画他好不容易才画完,却不小心弄脏了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà tā hǎo bù róng yì cái huà wán, què bù xiǎo xīn nòng zāng le。
examples.en: He finally finished this painting, only to accidentally smudge it.

examples.zh: 我好不容易挤出一点时间,想好好陪陪家人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo bù róng yì jǐ chū yì diǎn shí jiān, xiǎng hǎo hǎo péi péi jiā rén。
examples.en: I finally squeezed out some time to spend with my family.

examples.zh: 经过反复练习,他好不容易才学会了游泳。
examples.pinyin: Jīng guò fǎn fù liàn xí, tā hǎo bù róng yì cái xué huì le yóu yǒng。
examples.en: After repeated practice, he finally learned to swim.

examples.zh: 那本绝版书,我跑了好几家店好不容易才买到。
examples.pinyin: Nà běn jué bǎn shū, wǒ pǎo le hǎo jǐ jiā diàn hǎo bù róng yì cái mǎi dào。
examples.en: That out-of-print book — I ran to several shops to finally get it.

examples.zh: 好不容易熬过了最艰难的时期,生活总算好了起来。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo bù róng yì áo guò le zuì jiān nán de shí qī, shēng huó zǒng suàn hǎo le qǐ lái。
examples.en: Having barely survived the hardest times, life finally improved.

examples.zh: 孩子好不容易考上了理想的学校,全家人都很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi hǎo bù róng yì kǎo shàng le lǐ xiǎng de xué xiào, quán jiā rén dōu hěn gāo xìng。
examples.en: The child finally got into his dream school, to the whole family's joy.

examples.zh: 我们好不容易约好时间,他却又临时改了主意。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ men hǎo bù róng yì yuē hǎo shí jiān, tā què yòu lín shí gǎi le zhǔ yì。
examples.en: We finally set a time, only for him to change his mind.

examples.zh: 他好不容易鼓起勇气,把心里话说了出来。
examples.pinyin: Tā hǎo bù róng yì gǔ qǐ yǒng qì, bǎ xīn lǐ huà shuō le chū lái。
examples.en: He finally worked up the courage to speak his heart.

examples.zh: 忙了一整天,好不容易能坐下来喝口热茶。
examples.pinyin: Máng le yī zhěng tiān, hǎo bù róng yì néng zuò xià lái hē kǒu rè chá。
examples.en: After a busy day, I could finally sit down for a cup of hot tea.

examples.zh: 那么大的雾,司机好不容易才把车安全开到了目的地。
examples.pinyin: Nà me dà de wù, sī jī hǎo bù róng yì cái bǎ chē ān quán kāi dào le mù dì de。
examples.en: In such fog, the driver barely got the car safely to the destination.

examples.zh: 我好不容易才把这些资料整理好,你可别弄乱了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo bù róng yì cái bǎ zhè xiē zī liào zhěng lǐ hǎo, nǐ kě bié nòng luàn le。
examples.en: I sorted these materials with great effort; don't mess them up.

examples.zh: 好不容易见上一面,大家都有说不完的话。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo bù róng yì jiàn shàng yí miàn, dà jiā dōu yǒu shuō bù wán de huà。
examples.en: Finally getting to meet, everyone had endless things to say.

title: "白" ile "boşuna, bedavaya"
summary: "白" (bái) bir fiilin önünde "boşuna, boş yere" (çaba boşa gitti) ya da "bedavaya" der: 白跑一趟 = boşuna bir gidiş; 白吃 = beleşe yemek.
explanation: "白" bir fiilin önüne gelip iki anlam verir: (1) BOŞUNA/boş yere — bir çabanın karşılıksız kaldığını, boşa gittiğini bildirir: 我白等了一个小时 (Bir saat boşuna bekledim), 你这些话都白说了,他根本不听 (Bu sözlerin hepsi boşa gitti, hiç dinlemiyor), 白忙了一天 (Bir gün boş yere uğraştım). (2) BEDAVAYA/karşılıksız — bir şeyi hiçbir bedel ödemeden almak/yapmak: 白吃白住 (beleşe yiyip kalmak), 这钱可不能白拿 (Bu parayı boşuna/karşılıksız alamam). Bağlam hangi anlamı belirler; her ikisi de "karşılıksızlık" fikrini taşır — çabanın karşılığı yok (boşuna) ya da bedeli yok (bedava). Konuşmacı çoğu zaman bir hayal kırıklığı ya da haksızlık hissi taşır. Türkçedeki "boşuna, boş yere, nafile" (çaba) ve "bedavaya, beleşe, karşılıksız" (bedel) anlamlarına denk gelir.

examples.zh: 我在门口白等了一个多小时,他根本就没来。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài mén kǒu bái děng le yí gè duō xiǎo shí, tā gēn běn jiù méi lái。
examples.en: I waited over an hour at the door in vain; he never came.

examples.zh: 这些道理我说了半天,全都白说了,他一句也听不进去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē dào lǐ wǒ shuō le bàn tiān, quán dōu bái shuō le, tā yī jù yě tīng bù jìn qù。
examples.en: I explained for ages, all in vain; he heard not a word.

examples.zh: 忙活了一整天,结果方案没通过,真是白忙了。
examples.pinyin: Máng huó le yī zhěng tiān, jié guǒ fāng àn méi tōng guò, zhēn shì bái máng le。
examples.en: Busy all day, only for the plan to be rejected — all wasted effort.

examples.zh: 要不是你提醒,我今天就白跑这一趟了。
examples.pinyin: Yào bú shì nǐ tí xǐng, wǒ jīn tiān jiù bái pǎo zhè yī tàng le。
examples.en: If not for your reminder, today's trip would've been for nothing.

examples.zh: 他辛辛苦苦种的菜被虫子吃光了,一年的辛苦白费了。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīn xīn kǔ kǔ zhǒng de cài bèi chóng zi chī guāng le, yī nián de xīn kǔ bái fèi le。
examples.en: His painstakingly grown vegetables were eaten by bugs; a year wasted.

examples.zh: 这钱你可不能白拿,总得为大家做点什么。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qián nǐ kě bù néng bái ná, zǒng de wèi dà jiā zuò diǎn shén me。
examples.en: You can't take this money for nothing; you must do something in return.

examples.zh: 要是不好好复习,之前的努力就都白费了。
examples.pinyin: Yào shì bù hǎo hǎo fù xí, zhī qián de nǔ lì jiù dōu bái fèi le。
examples.en: If you don't review well, all your earlier effort will be wasted.

examples.zh: 他白白浪费了这么好的机会,现在后悔也来不及了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bái bái làng fèi le zhè me hǎo de jī huì, xiàn zài hòu huǐ yě lái bù jí le。
examples.en: He wasted such a good chance for nothing; it's too late to regret now.

examples.zh: 这么好的建议你不听,我不是白提了吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo de jiàn yì nǐ bù tīng, wǒ bú shì bái tí le ma?
examples.en: You ignore such good advice; didn't I suggest it for nothing?

examples.zh: 排了那么久的队,票却卖光了,时间全白搭了。
examples.pinyin: Pái le nà me jiǔ de duì, piào què mài guāng le, shí jiān quán bái dā le。
examples.en: After queuing so long, tickets sold out; the time was all wasted.

examples.zh: 你放心,你为大家做的这些事绝不会白做。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng xīn, nǐ wèi dà jiā zuò de zhè xiē shì jué bú huì bái zuò。
examples.en: Rest assured; what you've done for everyone won't be in vain.

examples.zh: 他以为能占点便宜,结果白高兴了一场。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ wéi néng zhàn diǎn pián yi, jié guǒ bái gāo xìng le yī cháng。
examples.en: He thought he'd gain an advantage, but rejoiced for nothing.

examples.zh: 这么多年的书都白读了吗?连这点道理都不懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō nián de shū dōu bái dú le ma? lián zhè diǎn dào lǐ dōu bù dǒng。
examples.en: Were all those years of study for nothing? You don't even get this.

examples.zh: 我特意赶来,他却不在,这一趟算是白来了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tè yì gǎn lái, tā què bù zài, zhè yī tàng suàn shì bái lái le。
examples.en: I rushed over, but he wasn't in; the trip was for nothing.

examples.zh: 别人的帮助不能白受,我们要懂得感恩和回报。
examples.pinyin: Bié rén de bāng zhù bù néng bái shòu, wǒ men yào dǒng de gǎn ēn hé huí bào。
examples.en: Others' help can't be taken for free; we should be grateful and repay.

examples.zh: 准备了那么久的发言,因为时间不够白准备了。
examples.pinyin: Zhǔn bèi le nà me jiǔ de fā yán, yīn wèi shí jiān bù gòu bái zhǔn bèi le。
examples.en: The speech I prepared so long went to waste for lack of time.

examples.zh: 你这一番苦心没有白费,孩子终于懂事了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhè yī fān kǔ xīn méi yǒu bái fèi, hái zi zhōng yú dǒng shì le。
examples.en: Your painstaking effort wasn't in vain; the child finally grew sensible.

examples.zh: 天天在这儿白吃白喝,我实在过意不去。
examples.pinyin: Tiān tiān zài zhè ér bái chī bái hē, wǒ shí zài guò yì bù qù。
examples.en: Eating and drinking here for free every day, I really feel bad.

examples.zh: 要是最后失败了,岂不是白折腾了一场?
examples.pinyin: Yào shì zuì hòu shī bài le, qǐ bù shì bái zhē teng le yī cháng?
examples.en: If it fails in the end, wasn't all the trouble for nothing?

examples.zh: 他的一片好意被人误解,真是白白受了委屈。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yī piàn hǎo yì bèi rén wù jiě, zhēn shì bái bái shòu le wěi qū。
examples.en: His kindness was misunderstood; he was wronged for nothing.

examples.zh: 这么好的东西被扔掉,实在太可惜,白白浪费了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè me hǎo de dōng xī bèi rēng diào, shí zài tài kě xī, bái bái làng fèi le。
examples.en: Throwing away such good things is a pity; wasted for nothing.

examples.zh: 我提前把资料都准备好了,没想到会议取消,白准备了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tí qián bǎ zī liào dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le, méi xiǎng dào huì yì qǔ xiāo, bái zhǔn bèi le。
examples.en: I prepared all the materials early, but the meeting was canceled — wasted.

examples.zh: 你别以为帮了他就是白帮,他会记在心里的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bié yǐ wéi bāng le tā jiù shì bái bāng, tā huì jì zài xīn lǐ de。
examples.en: Don't think helping him was for nothing; he'll keep it in mind.

examples.zh: 辛苦了大半年,一场大水把庄稼全冲走了,全白干了。
examples.pinyin: Xīn kǔ le dà bàn nián, yī cháng dà shuǐ bǎ zhuāng jià quán chōng zǒu le, quán bái gàn le。
examples.en: After half a year's toil, a flood washed away the crops — all for nothing.

examples.zh: 这份恩情我不能白受,以后一定要好好报答。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn ēn qíng wǒ bù néng bái shòu, yǐ hòu yí dìng yào hǎo hǎo bào dá。
examples.en: I can't accept this kindness for free; I must repay it well.

title: "V了又V" ile tekrarlanan geçmiş eylem
titleEn: Repeated actions in the past with "you"
summary: "V了又V" bir eylemin geçmişte defalarca tekrarlandığını canlı biçimde anlatır: 他看了又看,还是没发现问题 = Baktı baktı, yine de sorunu bulamadı.
explanation: "V了又V" kalıbı, aynı fiili "了" ve "又" ile tekrarlayarak bir eylemin GEÇMİŞTE tekrar tekrar, defalarca yapıldığını canlı ve vurgulu biçimde anlatır: "...-dı ...-dı (durdu), defalarca ...-dı". 他想了又想,最后还是没拿定主意 (Düşündü düşündü, sonunda yine de karar veremedi), 我看了又看,确认没有写错 (Baka baka kontrol ettim, yanlış yazmadığımdan emin oldum), 她读了又读那封信,几乎能背下来了 (O mektubu okudu okudu, neredeyse ezberledi). İlk fiil "了" alır, ikinci fiil "又" ile eklenir (aynı fiil). Eylemin ısrarla, sabırla ya da çaresizce yinelendiğini gösterir; çoğu zaman bir emek, kararsızlık ya da çabanın büyüklüğünü vurgular. Türkçedeki "...-dı ...-dı (durdu), defalarca ...-dı, baka baka / düşüne düşüne" ikilemeli tekrar ifadelerine denk gelir.

examples.zh: 他把那封信看了又看,舍不得放下。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà fēng xìn kàn le yòu kàn, shě bù de fàng xià。
examples.en: He read that letter over and over, unwilling to put it down.

examples.zh: 我想了又想,最后还是决定听从自己的内心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le yòu xiǎng, zuì hòu hái shì jué dìng tīng cóng zì jǐ de nèi xīn。
examples.en: I thought and thought, and finally decided to follow my heart.

examples.zh: 这道题他算了又算,始终觉得哪里不对劲。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí tā suàn le yòu suàn, shǐ zhōng jué de nǎ lǐ bú duì jìn。
examples.en: He calculated this problem again and again, always sensing something off.

examples.zh: 妈妈在门口望了又望,盼着孩子早点回家。
examples.pinyin: Mā mā zài mén kǒu wàng le yòu wàng, pàn zhe hái zi zǎo diǎn huí jiā。
examples.en: Mom looked out the door again and again, longing for the child's return.

examples.zh: 他把这段话改了又改,还是不太满意。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè duàn huà gǎi le yòu gǎi, hái shì bù tài mǎn yì。
examples.en: He revised this passage over and over, still not quite satisfied.

examples.zh: 临走前,她回头看了又看那熟悉的老房子。
examples.pinyin: Lín zǒu qián, tā huí tóu kàn le yòu kàn nà shú xī de lǎo fáng zi。
examples.en: Before leaving, she looked back again and again at the familiar old house.

examples.zh: 这些照片我翻了又翻,勾起了很多回忆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiē zhào piān wǒ fān le yòu fān, gōu qǐ le hěn duō huí yì。
examples.en: I flipped through these photos again and again, stirring many memories.

examples.zh: 他把说明书读了又读,才敢动手操作那台机器。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ shuō míng shū dú le yòu dú, cái gǎn dòng shǒu cāo zuò nà tái jī qì。
examples.en: He read the manual over and over before daring to operate the machine.

examples.zh: 孩子把那个玩具玩了又玩,一点儿都不觉得腻。
examples.pinyin: Hái zi bǎ nà ge wán jù wán le yòu wán, yì diǎn ér dōu bù jué de nì。
examples.en: The child played with that toy again and again, never tiring of it.

examples.zh: 我把行李检查了又检查,生怕落下什么东西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ xíng lǐ jiǎn chá le yòu jiǎn chá, shēng pà là xià shén me dōng xī。

examples.zh: 他犹豫了又犹豫,最终还是没有说出那句话。
examples.pinyin: Tā yóu yù le yòu yóu yù, zuì zhōng hái shì méi yǒu shuō chū nà jù huà。

examples.zh: 老师把重点强调了又强调,希望学生们记牢。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo shī bǎ zhòng diǎn qiáng diào le yòu qiáng diào, xī wàng xué shēng men jì láo。
examples.en: The teacher stressed the key points repeatedly for students to remember.

examples.zh: 这条路我走了又走,闭着眼睛都不会走错。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù wǒ zǒu le yòu zǒu, bì zhuó yǎn jīng dōu bú huì zǒu cuò。

examples.zh: 她把那首歌听了又听,几乎能一字不差地唱下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà shǒu gē tīng le yòu tīng, jī hū néng yī zì bù chà de chàng xià lái。

examples.zh: 他把钱数了又数,确认一分都没有少。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ qián shù le yòu shù, què rèn yī fēn dōu méi yǒu shǎo。

examples.zh: 面对这个决定,我们商量了又商量,始终没有定论。

examples.zh: 他把讲稿练习了又练习,就怕上台的时候出错。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiǎng gǎo liàn xí le yòu liàn xí, jiù pà shàng tái de shí hòu chū cuò。
examples.en: He practiced the speech over and over, fearing mistakes on stage.

examples.zh: 奶奶把这个故事讲了又讲,我们百听不厌。
examples.pinyin: Nǎi nǎi bǎ zhè ge gù shì jiǎng le yòu jiǎng, wǒ men bǎi tīng bù yàn。
examples.en: Grandma told this story over and over, and we never tired of it.

examples.zh: 他把那张照片看了又看,眼睛渐渐湿润了。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà zhāng zhào piān kàn le yòu kàn, yǎn jīng jiàn jiàn shī rùn le。
examples.en: He looked at that photo over and over, his eyes moistening.

examples.zh: 这个方案我们讨论了又讨论,最后才终于定了下来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge fāng àn wǒ men tǎo lùn le yòu tǎo lùn, zuì hòu cái zhōng yú dìng le xià lái。
examples.en: We discussed this plan again and again before finally settling it.

examples.pinyin: Wèi le zuò hǎo zhè dào cài, tā shì le yòu shì, zhōng yú zhǎo dào le jué qiào。

examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ nà jù huà zài xīn lǐ mò niàn le yòu niàn, hái shì méi gǎn shuō chū kǒu。

examples.zh: 临别时,他们握了又握手,谁都不愿先松开。

examples.zh: 这本书我读了又读,每次都有新的收获。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ dú le yòu dú, měi cì dōu yǒu xīn de shōu huò。

examples.zh: 他把门锁检查了又检查,才放心地离开了家。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ mén suǒ jiǎn chá le yòu jiǎn chá, cái fàng xīn de lí kāi le jiā。
examples.en: He checked the door lock over and over before leaving home at ease.

title: "难道" ile retorik soru: "yoksa ...mı?"
summary: "难道...吗?" güçlü bir retorik soru kurar: 难道你忘了吗? = Yoksa unuttun mu (unutmuş olamazsın)?
explanation: "难道" güçlü bir RETORİK (mecazi) soru kurar; gerçek bir cevap beklemez, bir gerçeği vurgular ya da bir duruma inanmazlık/şaşkınlık/itiraz belirtir: "yoksa ...mı?, olur mu hiç?, sakın ...değil ya?". Genelde "难道...吗?" biçiminde gelir (sonda "吗" ya da "不成"): 难道你不知道这件事吗? (Yoksa bunu bilmiyor musun? = elbette biliyorsun), 都这么晚了,难道他还不睡? (Bu kadar geç oldu, hâlâ uyumayacak mı yani?), 难道就没有别的办法了吗? (Yani başka çare yok mu hiç?). "难道" cümleye kuvvetli bir şaşkınlık, itiraz ya da inanmazlık tonu katar; olumlu biçim aslında olumsuz, olumsuz biçim aslında olumlu bir anlam taşır (retorik). Konuşmacı bir varsayımı sorgulayarak aslında tersini vurgular. Türkçedeki "yoksa ...mı?, olur mu hiç?, sakın ... değil ya?, yani ...mı?" retorik sorularına denk gelir; güçlü bir vurgu ya da itiraz sunmanın yoludur.

examples.zh: 这么明显的道理,难道你还不明白吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me míng xiǎn de dào lǐ, nán dào nǐ hái bù míng bái ma?

examples.zh: 我为你付出了这么多,难道你都看不到吗?
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèi nǐ fù chū le zhè me duō, nán dào nǐ dōu kàn bú dào ma?

examples.zh: 都到这个时候了,难道我们还能退缩吗?

examples.pinyin: Nán dào nǐ wàng le wǒ men dāng chū de yuē dìng le ma?

examples.zh: 大家都在努力,难道你就甘心落在后面吗?

examples.zh: 这么好的机会摆在面前,难道你要白白错过吗?

examples.zh: 难道除了这个办法,就真的没有别的选择了吗?

examples.en: Is there really no other choice besides this method?

examples.zh: 他平时那么可靠,难道这次会骗我们不成?
examples.pinyin: Tā píng shí nà me kě kào, nán dào zhè cì huì piàn wǒ men bù chéng?

examples.zh: 你都答应人家了,难道现在又要反悔吗?

examples.zh: 这么冷的天,难道他还要坚持在外面跑步?

examples.zh: 为了一点小事就吵成这样,难道值得吗?

examples.zh: 难道你连自己最亲的人都不愿意相信吗?

examples.zh: 这么多人都做到了,难道你就做不到吗?
examples.pinyin: Zhè me duō rén dōu zuò dào le, nán dào nǐ jiù zuò bú dào ma?
